text: Nag-react ang pila ka Ukrainian citizens kasunod sang nangin statement sang Marcos-Sara tandem nga indi na kinahanglan nga manindugan ang Pilipinas sa Russian invasion sa Ukraine.
english: Some Ukrainian citizens reacted following the statement of the Marcos-Sara tandem that the Philippines no longer needs to stand up to the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

text: Suno kay presidential bet Bongbong Marcos, indi man involved ang Pilipinas magluwas lang sa nationals nga yara sa amo nga pungsod.
english: According to presidential bet Bongbong Marcos, the Philippines is not involved except for the nationals in the country.

text: Suno naman sa runningmate sini nga si Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio, dapat anay nga unahon ang Philippine interest kag dapat lamang lamang nga manindugan kun yara na sa risgo ang interes sang Pilipinas.
english: His runningmate, Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio, said the Philippine interest should come first and should only stand up when the Philippine interest is at risk.

text: Ang Marcos-Sara tandem amo ang nagapanguna sa presidential surveys sa 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: The Marcos-Sara tandem is leading the presidential surveys in the 2022 elections.

text: Ginakahangawa naman ini sang Ukrainian citizens kag ginpahayag nga indi ini malayo sa position sang China sa ginhimo sang Russia sa Ukraine halin sang Pebrero 24.
english: Ukrainian citizens are concerned about this and said it is not far from China's position on Russia's actions in Ukraine since February

text: Ang China ang una na nagpamalibad nga tawgon nga invasion ang ginhimo sang Russia.
english: China has previously refused to call Russia's actions an invasion.

text: Ginrespeto sang China ang sovereignty sang Russia kag complex suno diri ang isyu sa Ukraine.
english: China respects Russia's sovereignty and says the Ukraine issue is complex.

text: Suno naman kay Dmitry Popov, isa ka Ukrainian Citizen nga yara subong sa Metro Manila, kinahanglan nga binag-binagon na sang publiko kun amo sini ang panindugan sang kandidato bangud replika ini kun ano sila nga sahi sang lider kag kun ano ang ila nga mangin leadership.
english: According to Dmitry Popov, a Ukrainian citizen who is currently in Metro Manila, the public should consider whether this is the position of the candidate because it is a replica of what kind of leader they are and what their leadership will be.

text: “Those who support the territorial regimes have a certain kind of mindset — to have a very strong possibility of having this kind of leadership of this country — that is bred from tyrannical dictatorship of the past,” suno kay Popov.
english: “Those who support the territorial regimes have a certain kind of mindset — to have a very strong possibility of having this kind of leadership of this country — that is bred from tyrannical dictatorship of the past,” according to Popov.

text: Naghakot sang nagkalain-lain nga reaksyon ang pahayag sang isa ka senador sa Estados Unidos nga naga-engganyo nga patyon si Russian President Vladimir Putin agud nga matapos na ang problema sa Ukraine.
english: A US senator's statement calling for the assassination of Russian President Vladimir Putin to end the crisis in Ukraine has sparked mixed reactions.

text: Ini amo ang Republican senator sang South Carolina nga si Senator Lindsey Graham.
english: This is South Carolina’s Republican senator Senator Lindsey Graham.

text: Si Graham ang nakaserbe sa Kongreso sa Estados sa sulod sang masobra 20 na ka tuig.
english: Graham has served in Congress in the United States for more than 20 years.

text: Suod ini nga kaalyado ni former president Donald Trump.
english: He is a close ally of former president Donald Trump.

text:
Antes ang iya pahayag nga dapat nga patyon si Putin, nagduso man siya sang resolution nga nagakondenar sa Russian president kag sang iya nga military commanders bangud sa ginkomiter sini nga “war crimes” kag “crimes against humanity.”

Kasunod sini, madasig naman ang Russian officials sa pag-atake kay Graham kag gintawag nga kriminal ang iya nga komento.
english:
Before his statement that Putin should be killed, he also proposed a resolution condemning the Russian president and his military commanders for committing “war crimes” and “crimes against humanity.”

Russian officials were quick to attack Graham, calling his comments criminal.

text: Nagdemanda man ang mga opisyal sang Russia sa US Government nga maghatag sang paathag kaangot sa pahayag sang amo nga senador.
english: Russian officials also demanded that the US Government provide an explanation for the senator's statement.

text: Nangakig man ang Russian ambassador to the United States nga si Anatoly Antonov bangud indi sini mabaton ang statement sang senador.
english: Russian ambassador to the United States Anatoly Antonov was also angry because he could not accept the senator's statement.

text: Napasaka na sa Department of Justice (DOJ) ang reklamo batok kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kaangot sa pahayag sini sang nagligad nga semana nga pangpatyon ang 15 ka mga senador agud nga makapwesto ang mga kandidato nga iya nga gina-endorso.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) has filed a complaint against former President Rodrigo Duterte over his statement last week that 15 senators will be killed in order to seat candidates he endorses.

text: Suno kay Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) chief Police Brigadier General Nicolas Torre III, ang iya nga gin-file nga complaint para sa case build-up amo ang unlawful utterances kag inciting to sedition.
english: According to Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) chief Police Brigadier General Nicolas Torre III, he filed a complaint for the case build-up for unlawful utterances and inciting to sedition.

text: Bisan pa nga nagdepensa ang mga kaalyado ni Duterte nga joke lamang sang former president ang amo nga pahayag, nagsabat naman si Torre nga “Bagong Pilipinas” na subong kag indi pwede ini nga mga statement nga ipaguwa nga lahog-lahog lamang.
english: Although Duterte's allies defended the former president's statement as a joke, Torre replied that it is a “Bagong Pilipinas” now and these statements cannot be issued as jokes.

text: Indi man ini isyu sa pulitika suno kay Torre, bangud maathag nga ginlapas ni Duterte ang laye.
english: This is not a political issue, Torre said, because Duterte clearly violated the law.

text: “Alam niyo bagong Pilipinas na, eh.
english: “You know it's a new Philippines, eh.

text: Hindi na pwede ‘yung mga gano’ng statements na kinabukasan joke only na lang,” suno kay Torre.
english: It is no longer possible to make such statements that tomorrow it will be a joke only,” Torre said.

text: “Hanggang ngayon ba naman dadalhin natin ang gulo na ‘yan na puro patay-patay na lang?
english: “Are we still going to carry that mess of dead people?

text: Tapos if they will be taken on their word, bigla na lang sasabihin na joke only.
english: Then if they will be taken on their word, suddenly they will say that it is a joke only.

text: Or ang latest naman na palusot is he’s only expressing a legal opinion,” dugang sini.
english: Or the latest excuse is he’s only expressing a legal opinion,” he added.

text: Matandaan nga gin-himo ni Duterte ang statement sa proclamation rally sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino Laban (PDP-Laban) sang nagligad nga semana.
english: It can be recalled that Duterte made the statement at the proclamation rally of the Partido Demokratiko Pilipino Laban (PDP-Laban) last week.

text: “Patayin natin ‘yung mga senador ngayon para mabakante.
english: “Let's kill the senators now to make vacancies.

text: Kung makapatay tayo ng mga 15 na senador, pasok na tayong lahat… Talking of opportunities, the only way to do it is pasabugin na lang natin,” pahayag sang anay punong ehekutibo.
english: If we can kill about 15 senators, we're all in... Talking of opportunities, the only way to do it is let's just blow it up,” the former chief executive said.

text: Ini nga statement ang ginbalusan man ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: This statement was also reciprocated by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: sang nagpangampanya naman ang iya alyansa sa Davao del Norte sang Sabado sang hapon.
english: when his alliance campaigned in Davao del Norte on Saturday afternoon.

text: Antes ang lihok ni Torre, may mga mamalidha man nga nagpanawagan sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) nga imbestigaran ang joke sang former president.
english: Before Torre's move, some lawmakers also called on the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to investigate the former president's joke.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, may gin-file man ang NBI nga reklamo nga inciting to sedition kag grave threats batok sa bata ni former President Duterte nga si Vice-President Sara Duterte-Carpio.
english: Last week, the NBI also filed a complaint of inciting to sedition and grave threats against former President Duterte's daughter, Vice-President Sara Duterte-Carpio.

text: Ini kaangot naman sa iya pamahog nga patyon sanday President Ferdinand R. Marcos, Jr., iya asawa nga si Liza, kag si House Speaker Martin Romualdez pananglitan may magpatay man sa iya.
english: This is in connection with his threat to kill President Ferdinand R. Marcos, Jr., his wife Liza, and House Speaker Martin Romualdez if someone kills him.

text:
Nagpaandam si retired Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio sa publiko nga mag-andam gid sa pagboto sa mga kandidato nga makabig nga “pro-China.”

Suno kay Carpio, kun ma-eleher ini nga mga tawo sa pwesto, ang interes sang People’s Republic of China amo ang ila iduso kag itib-ong bangud nga may pondo nga ginahatag ang China sa ila.
english:
Retired Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio warned the public to be very careful about voting for candidates who are considered “pro-China.”

According to Carpio, if these people are elected to office, the interest of the People's Republic of China is what they will push and promote because China is giving them funds.

text: Wala sang ginhingadlan si Carpio kun sin-o ang iya buot-silingon nga mga kandidato.
english: Carpio did not name any candidates.

text: Apang dugang sini, mahimo nga ginagatungan pa gid sang Beijing ang mga disinformation sa social media para nga mas matunga pa gid ang publiko.
english: But in addition, Beijing may be fueling disinformation on social media to further divide the public.

text: “This election is not purely about internal politics, about internal matters, because there is a country that wants to grab our maritime zones and island territories.
english: “This election is not purely about internal politics, about internal matters, because there is a country that wants to grab our maritime zones and island territories.

text: So, we should be careful not to vote for Manchurian candidates, candidates who will do China’s bidding,” suno kay Carpio sa statement nga ginpaguwa sang Stratbase ADR Institute.
english: So, we should be careful not to vote for Manchurian candidates, candidates who will do China’s bidding,” Carpio said in a statement issued by the Stratbase ADR Institute.

text: “They can come out with their own social media campaign,” dugang sini.
english: “They can come out with their own social media campaign,” it added.

text:
“As we have seen in the past, recent past, that there have been candidates, who, when they won, were favoring China against our national interest.”

Nagpaandam man ang natungdan nga delikado ang West Philippine Sea pananglitan magdaog ang mga kandidato nga pro-China.
english:
“As we have seen in the past, recent past, that there have been candidates, who, when they won, were favoring China against our national interest.”

He also warned that the West Philippine Sea is dangerous if pro-China candidates win.

text: “Those who are pro-China, they [China] can give campaign funds to.
english: “Those who are pro-China, they [China] can give campaign funds to.

text: That’s usually what other countries do if they want to destabilize a certain state.
english: That’s usually what other countries do if they want to destabilize a certain state.

text: I expect China to do that… Once elected, they will say, the Philippines has no right to name the West Philippine Sea as West Philippine Sea,” dugang sini.
english: I expect China to do that… Once elected, they will say, the Philippines has no right to name the West Philippine Sea as West Philippine Sea,” it added.

text: Nakaalerto ang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) subong nga nagahilapit ang Dinagyang Festival 2025 agud nga indi magamit ang kahiwatan sa iligal nga druga.
english: The Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) is on alert as the Dinagyang Festival 2025 approaches to prevent the event from being used for illegal drugs.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head sang City Drug Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga padayon ang ila monitoring sa mga lugar nga mahimo gamiton agud makasulod ang iligal nga druga sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head of the City Drug Enforcement Unit, said they are continuously monitoring the areas that could be used to smuggle illegal drugs into the city.

text: Suno kay Inot, doblehon sang talatapan ang effort agud nga indi madismaya ang mga Ilonggo sa pagselebrar sang Dinagyang Festival.
english: According to Inot, the office will redouble its efforts so that Ilonggos will not be disappointed in the celebration of the Dinagyang Festival.

text: Wala naman ginadula sang natungdan ang posibilidad nga gamiton sang mga durugista ang kahiwatan agud mangin oportunidad sa pagbaligya sang illegal drugs.
english: He did not rule out the possibility that drug pushers will use the event as an opportunity to sell illegal drugs.

text: Lakip naman ang Bakhaw, Mandurriao kag mga balay-ilimnan sa mga ginabantayan sang otoridad nga mahimo pahamtangan sang mga durugista sa pag-execute sang iligal nga mga aktibidad.
english: Bakhaw, Mandurriao and bars are among the areas monitored by the authorities that could be used by drug pushers to execute illegal activities.

text: Ginpa-guwa ni US President Joe Biden ang bag-o kag dalagku nga mga sanctions batok sa Russia nga nagatuyo nga ipiton si Russian President Vladimir Putin bangud sa pagpang-atake sini sa Ukraine.
english: US President Joe Biden has issued new and major sanctions against Russia aimed at pressuring Russian President Vladimir Putin over its invasion of Ukraine.

text: Ang bag-o nga target sang sanctions ang nagalakip sa pinakamanggaranon nga mga bilyonaryo sa Russia.
english: The new target of sanctions includes the richest billionaires in Russia.

text: Dala diri ang walo ka myembro sang Russian elite nga ginapahayag cronies ni Putin.
english: It includes eight members of the Russian elite who are allegedly Putin's cronies.

text: Suno kay Biden, utdon ang ila nga koneksyon sa bilog nga financial system sang Estados Unidos, iga-freeze ang ila nga assets sa US kag indi naman magamit ang ila nga mga propiedad.
english: According to Biden, their connection to the entire US financial system will be cut off, their assets in the US will be frozen and their properties will not be used.

text: Dala man sa gin-sanction amo ang mga pamilya sang sini nga mga bilyonaryo.
english: Also among those sanctioned were the families of these billionaires.

text: Samtang, sa ika-walo nga adlaw sang pagpang-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine, ginpahayag naman ni Russian President Vladimir Putin nga nagasunod ang tanan sandig sa kun ano ang ginplano.
english: Meanwhile, on the eighth day of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, Russian President Vladimir Putin said everything is going according to plan.

text: Gindayaw man ni Putin ang mga Russian soldiers kag madinalag-on suno sa iya ang military operation apisar pa may mga report nga nahalitan man ang ila nga defense system.
english: Putin also praised the Russian soldiers and said the military operation was successful despite reports that their defense system was also damaged.

text: Indi gid ma-negar nga may mga tawo nga nahadlok magpa-paltak bisan may edad na.
english: There is no denying that there are people who are afraid to have sex even when they are old.

text: Amo man ini ang problema nga nakit-an sa probinsya sang Cebu sa Central Visayas rason nga naglunsar ang city government sang Lapu-Lapu sang “Operasyon Libreng Tuli” (Operation Free Circumcision).
english: This is also the problem seen in the province of Cebu in Central Visayas, which is why the city government of Lapu-Lapu launched “Operation Libreng Tuli” (Operation Free Circumcision).

text: Magluwas diri, may yara man sang gintanyag ang local government nga cash nga P10,000 sa pinaka-tigulang nga indibidwal nga magpapaltak sang Hunyo 21.
english: In addition, the local government also offered a cash prize of P10,000 to the oldest individual who will vote on June 21.

text: Diri kag wala na nagduha-duha si certain Alfredo, Jr., residente sang Barangay Basak.
english: Certain Alfredo, Jr., resident of Barangay Basak, did not hesitate.

text: Nagpalapit ini sa staff kag nag-intra sa operasyon nga ginsaksihan mismo ni Lapu-Lapu Mayor Junard “Ahong” Chan.
english: He approached the staff and participated in the operation which was witnessed by Lapu-Lapu Mayor Junard “Ahong” Chan.

text: Gintuman man sang alkalde ang promisa sini nga ihatag kay Alfredo ang cash.
english: The mayor also kept his promise to give Alfredo the cash.

text: Nagdangat naman sa 1,350 individuals ang nag-avail sang free circumcision nga ginpangunahan sang volunteer schools kag sang Department of Health-Central Visayas.
english: A total of 1,350 individuals availed of free circumcision led by volunteer schools and the Department of Health-Central Visayas.

text: Madamo naman ang nagdayaw kag nagtawag kay Alfredo nga swerte bangud magluwas sa cash, ang nurse nga nag-assist sa operasyon amo si Binibining Lapu-Lapu 2023 Cheron Kisses Co.
english: Many praised and called Alfredo lucky because besides the cash, the nurse who assisted in the operation was Binibining Lapu-Lapu 2023 Cheron Kisses Co.

text: May libre naman nga ice cream kag burgers nga ginhatag sa iban pa nga nagpapaltak kadungan sang amo nga programa sa Hoops Dome sa Barangay Gun-ob, Lapu-Lapu.
english: Free ice cream and burgers were also given to other participants during the program at the Hoops Dome in Barangay Gun-ob, Lapu-Lapu.

text: Ini ang may tema nga “Transforming lives, one cut at a time” nga gin-umpisahan sang city governmentsang Hunyo 14 kag may natalana nga isa pa ka Operation Tuli sa Hunyo 28 sa siyam ka areas sa amo nga syudad.
english: The theme is “Transforming lives, one cut at a time” which was launched by the city government on June 14 and another Operation Tuli is scheduled for June 28 in nine areas in the city.

text: Nagsaka na sa 3-0 ang record sang Gilas Pilipinas Boys Under-16 squad sa 2025 FIBA U16 Asia Cup SEABA Qualifiers.
english: The record of the Gilas Pilipinas Boys Under-16 squad in the 2025 FIBA ​​U16 Asia Cup SEABA Qualifiers has risen to 3-0.

text: Ini matapos gintambakan sini ang Singapore sang 64-puntos nga abanse sa pagtakop sang hampang sa Pampanga, 101-37.
english: This after it piled up Singapore with a 64-point lead to close the game in Pampanga, 101-37.

text: Anum sa players nga ginapangunahan ni Coach LA Tenorio ang naka-skor sang double digits para sa national team.
english: Six of the players led by Coach LA Tenorio scored double digits for the national team.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Gilas sa Myerkules ang Indonesia nga may pareho nga undefeated record sa qualifiers.
english: The Gilas next face Indonesia on Wednesday with the same undefeated record in the qualifiers.

text: Ang mga nalutos sang Indonesia amo ang Singapore, Malaysia, kag Thailand.
english: Indonesia’s losers were Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.

text: TARSO ining abyan naton.
english: This friend of ours is TARSO.

text: Indi siya luyag madayon ang masunod nga boksing ni Manny Pacquiao.
english: He doesn't want Manny Pacquiao's next boxing fight to happen.

text: Labi na gid kay malapit na ang 2022 election.
english: Especially since the 2022 election is just around the corner.

text: “Man, gamiton lang sina ang iya kitaon sa boksing sa iya  kampanya sa palaabuton nga 2022 election,” siling niya.
english: “Man, he will just use his boxing earnings for his campaign in the upcoming 2022 election,” he said.

text:
“Siling ko anay ga-enjoy ka gid sang boksing ni Pacquiao?”

“Indi na subong!
english:
"I said you really enjoy Pacquiao's boxing?"

“Not now!

text: Gamiton lang sina ang iya minilyon nga kitaon sa iya pagdalagan kontra sa akon kandidato,” dugang niya.
english: He will just use his millions of dollars to run against my candidate,” he added.

text:
“Ngaa, sin-o ang kandidato mo para presidente?”

“Natural, indi si Pacquiao.
english:
“Why, who is your presidential candidate?”

“Naturally, not Pacquiao.

text: Okey lang siya sa boksing.
english: He's okay with boxing.

text: Pero, indi boksing ang pagka-presidente.
english: However, the presidency is not boxing.

text:
Kinahanglan niya ang bastante nga alam kag guts.”

“Well, kulang gid man sing alam si Pacquiao, pero basi bastante man siya sa pinaniiran agud magpalakat sing panghimanwa.
english:
He needs enough knowledge and guts.”

“Well, Pacquiao is really stupid, but maybe he has enough knowledge to run a citizenship.

text:
Sa guts, sobra-sobra man siya a. Daw toro kon magsoroso sa kontra sa ring!”

“Ano nga pinaniiran man?
english:
In guts, he's too much. He's like a bull when he kicks his opponent in the ring!”

“What's the matter?

text: Basi magsugo lang nga magsugo kag isalig lang niya ang tanan sa mga tinawo kay sa boksing man lang sia sagad.
english: Maybe he'll just order and leave everything to the staff because he's used to boxing.

text: Aba, delikado ina, nga daan damo corrupt sa gobyerno.
english: Oh, that's dangerous, that there are already many corrupt people in the government.

text: Kon sa guts, wala man.
english: As for the guts, nothing.

text: Wala gani niya ginpangapinan ang pagpamuyayaw ni Presidente sa Diyos, nga gintawag niya nga ‘stupid’.
english: He did not even defend the President's insult to God, which he called 'stupid'

text: Wala siya kuno kabati sinang ginsiling ni Presidente.
english: He said he did not hear what the President said.

text: Wala man siya naghatag opinyon sa pag-apin sa Diyos kon diin daw pastor siya sa iya relihiyon  (Tuod?).
english: He did not give an opinion in defense of God where he seems to be a pastor of his religion (Really?).

text: Maayo pa si Brother Eddie, ginsaway gid niya si Presidente kag ginlaygayan nga sala yadtong ginhimo ni Presidente,” paathag pa sang aton abyan.
english: Brother Eddie was better, he reprimanded the President and advised him that what the President did was wrong,” our friend explained.

text: Well, opinyon ina ya sang aton abyan.
english: Well, that's our friend's opinion.

text: Kon luyag ninyo husayon ini sa boksing, siling lang kamo kay sugiran ko ining akon abyan.
english: If you want to settle this in boxing, just tell me and I'll tell my friend.

text: He-he-he!
english: He-he-he!

text:
***

Good news!
english:
***

Good news!

text: Sunu sa report sang World Health Organization, nga gindala sang Washington Post sadtong Peb.
english: According to a report by the World Health Organization, carried by the Washington Post on Feb.

text: 17, 2021, daku na ang pagnubo sang mga kaso sang COVID-19 sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: 17, 2021, there has been a significant decline in COVID-19 cases worldwide.

text: Mga 16 ka porsyento na, bisan sa pag-outbreak pa sang pila ka lugar.
english: It's about 16 percent, even with the outbreak still in some places.

text: Sa Filipinas gani daku man ang pagnubo sang COVID-19 cases halin sadtong pag-peak sini sadtong Agosto 2020.
english: In the Philippines, the number of COVID-19 cases has decreased significantly since its peak in August 2020.

text: Sunu sa Dept.
english: According to the Dept.

text: of Health (DOH), may 4,358 ka new cases sadtong Agosto 15, 2020, samtang ang 7-day average naglab-ut sa 4,333.
english: of Health (DOH), there were 4,358 new cases on August 15, 2020, while the 7-day average reached 4,333.

text: Amat-amat ini nagnubo on the 7-day average sa 4,330 sadtong Agosto 10, 2020, although ang bag-o nga kaso sa ina nga adlaw naglab-ut sa 6,725.
english: It gradually decreased on the 7-day average to 4,330 on August 10, 2020, although the new cases on that day reached 6,725.

text: Halin sadto (Agosto 15, 2020) madasig na nagnubo ang 7-day average sini, kag nag-plateau (nagnubo nga wala na gawa nagsaka) na tubtub Pebrero 18, 2021, kon san-o nag-average na lang ang mga kaso sa pitu ka adlaw sa 1,697, samtang may bag-o nga mga kaso sa sina nga adlaw sing 1,739.
english: Since then (August 15, 2020) its 7-day average has declined rapidly, and plateaued until February 18, 2021, when the seven-day average of 1,697 cases, while there were 1,739 new cases on that day.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Ina seguro sa sige-sige nga pagtuman sang health protocols sang kadam-an kontra sa pagpanglaton ukon transmission sang virus.
english: This is probably due to the constant observance of health protocols by the public against the spread or transmission of the virus.

text: Aang mga scientist nagapati ugaling nga indi na ini maglab-ut pa sa zero transmission.
english: Scientists believe, however, that it will not reach zero transmission.

text: Una, tungod sa karon indi pa mapatuman sing lubos ang vaccination tungod madamo ang wala luyag magpa-bakuna.
english: First, because vaccination is not yet fully implemented because many do not want to be vaccinated.

text: Tungod ini sa pagkahangawa sa pila ka kaso sang pagkamatay sa vaccination.
english: This is due to concerns over some cases of vaccination deaths.

text: Ang Bloomberg Media nag-report nga 50% ang indi luyag magpabakuna sa United States kag mga 40% naman sa Uropa.
english: Bloomberg Media reported that 50% are unwilling to get vaccinated in the United States and about 40% in Europe.

text: Amo-amo man ang indi luyag magpabakuna sa Filipinas.
english: The same is true of those who do not want to be vaccinated in the Philippines.

text: Nagdugang pa gid ang problema sang pagtuhaw sang mga variant nga nagtuhaw sa UK, South Africa kag Brazil nga sobra kadasig sang pagpanglaton nga indi malab-ut sang vaccination para sa herd immunity.
english: The problem has been compounded by the emergence of variants that have emerged in the UK, South Africa and Brazil that are too fast to spread beyond the reach of vaccination for herd immunity.

text: So, ang daku gid lang nga mahimo naton amo ang proteksyon sa kada isa nga mabakunahan, nga indi man gani lubos kay ang immunity nga mahatag sini wala gapareho sa kada tawo.
english: So, the biggest thing we can do is protect everyone who gets vaccinated, which is not even complete because the immunity it gives is not the same for each person.

text: Naga-range lang ini halin sa tatlo tubtub  6 ka bulan.
english: It only ranges from three to 6 months.

text: Although indi na mag-severe ang igu sang COVID-19 sa ila.
english: Although the impact of COVID-19 will not be severe on them.

text: Ang indi malab-ut sang bakuna masalig na gid lang seguro sa pagpabakud sang ila immune system paagi sa bagay nga pagkaon, ehersiyo, kag sang hygienic practice.
english: Those who cannot reach the vaccine will probably rely on strengthening their immune system through proper diet, exercise, and hygienic practices.

text: Makabulig man sa “peace of mind” sang iban nga “mild” lang ang igu sang COVID-19 sa kadam-an (80%) nga madali man paayuhon.
english: It will also help the “peace of mind” of others that the majority (80%) of the COVID-19 cases are “mild” and easy to recover.

text: Posible man gani, sunu sa experyensya sa coronavirus epidemic sang 1889, nga magtahaw na ang epekto sini kag mahulog na lang sa “common cold” nga ma-tolerar na sang katauhan, nga pwede naton ma-expect sa padayon nga pagnubo sang mga kaso sang COVID-19./PN
english: It is even possible, according to the experience of the coronavirus epidemic in 1889, that its effects will moderate and fall into a “common cold” that can be tolerated by humanity, which we can expect from the continuous decline in cases of COVID-19./PN

text: Ginkakas sa puwesto ang hepe sang Philippine National Police – Highway Patrol Group (PNP-HPG) Investigation Management Division bangud sa pagkastigo sa isa ka patrolman sa sulod sang Camp Crame.
english: The chief of the Philippine National Police – Highway Patrol Group (PNP-HPG) Investigation Management Division has been removed from his post for beating a patrolman inside Camp Crame.

text: Suno kay HPG Director PBrig.
english: According to HPG Director PBrig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Hansel Marantan, ginahanda naman ang kaso nga administratibo kag criminal batok sa nasambit nga hepe nga may ranggo nga colonel.
english: Hansel Marantan, meanwhile, administrative and criminal cases are being prepared against the said chief with the rank of colonel.

text: Nakuhaan sang video ang pagkastigo, pagtaya sang pusil kag pagpahog niya sa biktima.
english: The video captured the beating, pointing of the gun and threatening the victim.

text: Ginpahayag nga natabo ang insidente sang Disyembre 16 sang gab-i pagkatapos sang ila nga Christmas Party.
english: The incident reportedly happened on December 16 night after their Christmas Party.

text: Suno sa biktima, halos 30 minutos siya nga ginkastigo sang hepe.
english: According to the victim, the chief beat him for almost 30 minutes.

text: Gin-alegar naman sang suspek nga masami siya ginabastos sang biktima.
english: The suspect alleged that the victim often abused him.

text: Ginpanginwala naman sang biktima ang alegasyon sang suspek.
english: The victim denied the suspect's allegation.

text: Matabo subong nga adlaw ang ikaduha nga hearing sang tripartite committee sa Kamara para maistoryahan ang paglapta sang fake news kag disinformation.
english: The second hearing of the tripartite committee in the House of Representatives to discuss the spread of fake news and disinformation will take place today.

text: 28 ka social media influencers kag vloggers ang gindagdagan sang show cause orders para sa sini nga hearing matapos wala nagtambong sa nauna nga inquiry sadtong Pebrero 4.
english: 28 social media influencers and vloggers were added show cause orders for this hearing after not attending the previous inquiry on February 4.

text: Lakip sa dalagku nga pangalan nga ginpatawag amo sanday anay press secretary Trixie Cruz-Angeles; former government anti-insurgency task force spokesperson Lorraine Marie Badoy-Partosa; kag ang broadcaster nga si Jeffrey Celiz.
english: Among the big names summoned were former press secretary Trixie Cruz-Angeles; former government anti-insurgency task force spokesperson Lorraine Marie Badoy-Partosa; and broadcaster Jeffrey Celiz.

text: Suno kay Sta.
english: According to Sta.

text: Rosa City Rep.
english: Rosa City Rep.

text: Dan Fernandez nga amo ang overall chairperson sang tripartite committee, importante nga mapasabat ang digital influencers sa ila papel sa pagpalapta sang misleading content.
english: Dan Fernandez, who is the overall chairperson of the tripartite committee, said it is important to hold digital influencers accountable for their role in spreading misleading content.

text: Gina-insister ni Fernandez nga wala sila sang tuyo nga balabagan ang free speech.
english: Fernandez insists that they have no intention of obstructing free speech.

text: Ang tuyo diri suno sa iya amo nga maimbestigaran kun bala ginagamit ang social media agud nga patalangon ang publiko, pakanubuon ang mga institusyon, kag i-facilitate ang pagsulod sang foreign disinformation.
english: The purpose, he said, is to investigate whether social media is being used to mislead the public, undermine institutions, and facilitate the entry of foreign disinformation.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang committee nga ang sin-o man sa vloggers kag content creators nga indi magsunod sa show cause orders ang mahimo magresulta sa dugang nga legal action lakip na ang pag-isyu sang subpoena kag pag-cite in contempt.
english: The committee earlier warned that any of the vloggers and content creators who fail to comply with the show cause orders could result in further legal action including the issuance of a subpoena and citation in contempt.

text: Ang nagabug-os sini nga superpanel amo ang committees on public order and safety, information and communications technology, and public information.
english: This superpanel is composed of the committees on public order and safety, information and communications technology, and public information.

text: Gintukod ini agud nga ma-usisa ang nagadamo pa nga mga online disinformation kag fake news.
english: It was established to check the ever-growing online disinformation and fake news.

text: Lakip sa resource persons subong nga adlaw amo sanday Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor and Anti-Money Laundering Council Chairman Eli Remolona Jr., Internal Revenue Commissioner Romeo Lumagui Jr., Information and Communications Technology Secretary Ivan Uy kag Philippine National Police chief Gen.
english: Among the resource persons today were Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor and Anti-Money Laundering Council Chairman Eli Remolona Jr., Internal Revenue Commissioner Romeo Lumagui Jr., Information and Communications Technology Secretary Ivan Uy and Philippine National Police chief Gen.

text: Rommel Francisco Marbil.
english: Rommel Francisco Marbil.

text: Ginalauman man ang presensya sang mga representative halin sa ByteDance (TikTok), Google Philippines kag Meta (Facebook/Instagram).
english: Representatives from ByteDance (TikTok), Google Philippines and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) are also expected to be present.

text: Ginpaboran sang United Nations General Assembly ang resolusyon nga nagakondenar sa pagsalakay sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: The United Nations General Assembly approved a resolution condemning Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

text: Ginmaduan man sang UN ang Russia nga gilayon bawi-on ang ila military forces sa nagkalain-lain nga syudad sa Ukraine.
english: The UN also ordered Russia to immediately withdraw its military forces from various cities in Ukraine.

text: Ang resolusyon ang ginsuportahan sang 141 sa 193 ka mga myembro sa tumalagsahon nga emergency General Assembly session nga ginpatawag sang UN Security Council.
english: The resolution was supported by 141 of the 193 members in an extraordinary emergency General Assembly session convened by the UN Security Council.

text: Ini ang pinakauna nga ginpatigayon nga emergency meeting sang assembly humalin sang 1982, base sa U.N website.
english: This is the first emergency meeting of the assembly since 1982, according to the U.N. website.

text: Samtang, sa apisar sini, mas ginpabaskog pa sang Russia sa ila ikapito nga adlaw nga pagpang-salakay sa Ukraine pinaagi sa pag-atake sa iban pa nga mayor nga syudad sang amu nga pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, despite this, Russia has intensified its seventh-day attack on Ukraine by attacking other major cities of the country.

text: Ginkumpirma naman sang Russia nga kontrolado na nila ang syudad sang Kherson, ang syudad sa north sang Crimean peninsula.
english: Russia has confirmed that it has taken control of the city of Kherson, the city in the north of the Crimean peninsula.

text: Ginakahangaw-an naman ang posible mataas nga numero sang mga nagkalamatay sa syudad sang Mariupol, isa sa malapit ng lugar sa border sang Russia.
english: There are concerns about the possible high number of deaths in the city of Mariupol, one of the areas near the Russian border.

text: Gin-igu man sang rocket attack ang police department kag parte sang isa ka unibersidad sa Kharkiv, ikaduha sa pinakdako nga syudad sa Ukraine.
english: The rocket attack also hit a police department and part of a university in Kharkiv, Ukraine's second-largest city.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag naman nga masobra na sa 2,000 ang mga napatay nga civilian humalin sang Pebrero 24, ang pagsugod sang Russian invasion.
english: Meanwhile, more than 2,000 civilians have been killed since February 24, the beginning of the Russian invasion.

text: Suno naman kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, kapin 6,000 na ka mga soldado sang Russia ang ila nga napatay.
english: According to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, more than 6,000 Russian soldiers have been killed.

text: Ini ang baliskad sa pahayag ni Russian Ministry of Defense spokesperson Maj.
english: This is contrary to the statement of Russian Ministry of Defense spokesperson Maj.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text:
Igor Konashenkov, sa diin suno sa iya, narekord lang sang Russia ang 498 nga mga napatay nga Russian soldiers kag 1,597 ang mga napilasan

Dugang pa niya, 2,870 ka mga Ukrainian service members ang ila napatay kag 3,700 ang nagkalapilasan umpisa sang nagsugud ang invasion.
english:
Igor Konashenkov, where he said Russia had only recorded 498 dead Russian soldiers and 1,597 wounded

He added that 2,870 Ukrainian service members have been killed and 3,700 wounded since the invasion began.

text: Suno naman sa isa ka senior US defense officer, masobra na sa 450 ang ginlunsyar nga missile strike sang Russia.
english: According to a senior US defense officer, Russia has launched more than 450 missile strikes.

text: Balik trabaho na ang mga personnel sang Bansoy Construction sa ginakaayo nga dalan sa Barangay Sinamay, Alimodian, Iloilo matapos ang malapit isa ka bulan man nga ginbayaan kag gin-untatan ang proyekto.
english: Bansoy Construction personnel are back to work on the road being repaired in Barangay Sinamay, Alimodian, Iloilo after nearly a month of abandonment and suspension of the project.

text: Sang damlag lang, wala ginhuna-huna ni Engr.
english: Recently, Engr.

text: Romeo Andig, Head sang Iloilo Provincial Engineer’s Office, nga pabay-an sang contractor ang isa ka porsyon sang dalan nga inug-semento kag bangud sa kaugot man sang pumuluyo, nagtanom ang mga ini sang saging kag niyog sa duta.
english: Romeo Andig, Head of the Iloilo Provincial Engineer's Office, said the contractor neglected a portion of the road to be paved and due to the anger of the residents, they planted bananas and coconuts on the ground.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Andig, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa kapabayaan sang contractor, ginpatawag sila sang Iloilo Provincial Government agud mahibaluan kun ano ang natabo sa isa sa sulod sang malapit isa ka bulan nga wala sila makapakita sa area.
english: Andig, he said that due to the negligence of the contractor, they were summoned by the Iloilo Provincial Government to find out what happened to one of them for nearly a month that they did not show up in the area.

text: Gintu-ad sang Bansoy Construction suno sa iya nga may internal problem sila nga wala na nila gindetalye pa kun ano apang posible nga ginkulang sa working capital ang contractor.
english: Bansoy Construction admitted that they have an internal problem that they did not elaborate on but it is possible that the contractor lacked working capital.

text: Apang pahayag ni Engr.
english: However, Engr.

text: Andig, may mga proyekto naman sadto anay nga ginakaptan ang Bansoy Construction nga wala man gani nagakapalpak.
english: Andig, there were projects in the past that Bansoy Construction was handling that did not even fail.

text: Ginpasikto sang Iloilo Provincial Government sa contractor kun masarangan pa bala sini nga tapuson ang proyekto kag nagpromisa man sila nga trabahuon nila ang nabilin nga kalay-uhon.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government asked the contractor if he can still complete the project and they also promised to do the remaining work.

text: Ang completion date sang reblocking, repair kag widening sang P18.7 million nga Alimodian-Poblacion-Sulong-Sinamay-San Miguel road ang natalana kuntani sang Disyembre 18, 2024 sa diin sang amo nga petsa, yara sa 62.7 percent na ang accomplishment.
english: The completion date of the reblocking, repair and widening of the P18.7 million Alimodian-Poblacion-Sulong-Sinamay-San Miguel road was scheduled for December 18, 2024 where as of that date, the accomplishment is 62.7 percent.

text: Bangud delayed na dugang sang natungdan, may yara na sang liquidated damages nga malapit P7,000 nga penalidad ang contractor humalin sang Disyembre 18, 2024 tubtob nga indi matapos ang dalan.
english: Because of the delay, he added, the contractor will have liquidated damages of nearly P7,000 from December 18, 2024 until the road is completed.

text: Sang Lunes pa sang nasiplatan sa satellite ang 64-kilometros nga kalabaon sang convoy sang mga tangke kag armado nga mga salakyan sang Russia nga padulong sa Kyiv, ang kapital sang Ukraine.
english: It wasn't until Monday that a satellite spotted a 64-kilometer-long convoy of Russian tanks and armored vehicles heading towards Kyiv, the Ukrainian capital.

text: Ginapahayag 25 ka kilometros na lang ang nabilin kag malab-ot na sang una nga bahin sang convoy ang Kyiv.
english: It is reported that only 25 kilometers remain and the first part of the convoy will reach Kyiv.

text: Apang nanotisyaran man nga wala ini nagahulag kag ginapahayag nag-untat sa dalan.
english: However, it was also noticed that it was not moving and allegedly stopped on the road.

text: Gintumod ang pila ka logistics problems nga amo ang na-encounter sang tropa.
english: Some of the logistics problems encountered by the troops were identified.

text: Lakip diri ang kagutom kag ang kakulang sa gatong.
english: These include hunger and fuel shortages.

text:
Suno sa wala ginpangalanan nga senior US defence official, may Russian military columns nga nag-“literally run out of fuel and, in some places, they were running out of food.”

Apang ginpahayag man nga may madamo pa nga combat power ang Russia nga wala pa nagamit.
english:
According to an unnamed senior US defense official, there were Russian military columns that “literally ran out of fuel and, in some places, they were running out of food.”

But it was also said that Russia still has a lot of combat power that has not been used.

text: Nagpasalig si Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-jam” Baronda nga pangitaan sang pondo ang Mandurriao Public Market kon may kakulangan sa budget sini.
english: Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-jam” Baronda assured that the Mandurriao Public Market will find funds if there is a shortfall in its budget.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Representative “Jam-jam” Baronda, iya ginpahayag nga indi gid malikawan nga ma-delay ang proyekto ilabi na kon may mga problema nga ginapangatubang ang kontraktor lakip na ang budget.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Representative “Jam-jam” Baronda said it is inevitable that the project will be delayed especially if there are problems facing the contractor including the budget.

text: Suno kay Baronda, P100 million ang pondo nga ginpain sa amo nga proyekto apang P90 million lamang ang na-implementar.
english: According to Baronda, P100 million was allocated for the project but only P90 million was implemented.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga ginatinghuwaan sang City Engineers Office nga makapan-kapan ang delay sang proyekto agud liwat mabuksan kag magamit sang mga pumuluyo.
english: He also believes that the City Engineers Office is trying to cover the delay of the project so that it can be reopened and used by the residents.

text: Ginalantaw man ni Baronda nga hatagan sang ayuda ang mga vendors sa Mandurriao Market nga apektado sang huol nga natuga sang delay nga pagpatukod.
english: Baronda also looks forward to providing assistance to vendors in Mandurriao Market who are affected by the inconvenience caused by the delay in construction.

text: Nakit-an ang tatlo ka mga barko sang China Coast Guard (CCG) sa distansya nga 35 nautical miles ukon 65 kilometros halin sa El Nido, Palawan.
english: Three China Coast Guard (CCG) ships were spotted at a distance of 35 nautical miles or 65 kilometers from El Nido, Palawan.

text: Base ini sa gin-report ni former US defense attaché kag maritime security expert Raymond Powell.
english: This is based on the report of former US defense attaché and maritime security expert Raymond Powell.

text: Ginpahayag nga halin ang mga barko sa Scarborough Shoal kag nagkadto sa El Nido kahapon sang aga.
english: The ships reportedly left Scarborough Shoal for El Nido yesterday morning.

text: Sa punta ini sang ila ginatawag nga nine-dash line nga wala man ginakilala sang Permanent Court of Arbitration.
english: It is at the end of what they call the nine-dash line which is also not recognized by the Permanent Court of Arbitration.

text: Pahayag sini, makatulublag ang panibag-o nga pagpakita-pwersa sang China nga kabahin sang ila tuyo nga panindugan ang pag-claim sa teritoryo sang Pilipinas.
english: He said China's new show of force is disturbing as part of its intention to claim Philippine territory.

text: Indi ini kinaandan suno sa iya bangud masami nga tag-isa ukon duha lang ka barko ang ginapadala sang China gani nagapati ini nga may particular nga mensahe nga dala ang amo nga Chinese ships.
english: He said this is unusual because China usually sends only one or two ships each so he believes that the Chinese ships have a particular message.

text: “Usually, they go sort of one or maybe two at a time, so taking three ships is sending a particular message of strength,” suno kay Powell.
english: “Usually, they go sort of one or maybe two at a time, so taking three ships is sending a particular message of strength,” according to Powell.

text: Natabo ini isa ka semana matapos nakit-an man ang isa sa pinakadaku nga Chinese research vessel nga malapit man sa Palawan.
english: This comes a week after one of the largest Chinese research vessels was also found near Palawan.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nagrason ini nga naglain ini sang ruta bangud sa malain nga panahon.
english: At the time, he argued that he took a different route due to bad weather.

text: May mga naga-guluwa subong nga video nga nagapakita kun paano ginabatuan sang Ukraine ang pwersa sang Russia nga amo ang nagsulod sa ila nga pungsod sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Videos are now emerging showing how Ukraine is fighting the Russian forces that invaded their country last week.

text: Isa sa nag-viral gid nga video amo ang black-and-white footage nga gin-post sa account sang Ukrainian armed forces nga may caption: “Have fear, enemies!
english: One of the videos that went viral was black-and-white footage posted on the account of the Ukrainian armed forces with the caption: “Have fear, enemies!

text:
There will be no peace for you on our earth!”

Nagapakita ini kun ano ang epekto sang Ukrainian drone strikes sa Russian hardware.
english:
There will be no peace for you on our earth!”

This shows the impact of Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian hardware.

text: Sandig sa statement si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, kapin 6,000 na ka mga soldado sang Russia ang ila nga napatay halin sang ginpatigayon sang Moscow ang invasion sang Pebrero 24.
english: According to a statement by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, more than 6,000 Russian soldiers have been killed since Moscow launched the invasion on February 24.

text: Ang bida sa sini nga video amo ang Bayraktar TB2 – isa ka sahi sang Turkish drone nga amo ang gingamit sang Ukrainian military batok sa Russian forces halin sang nagligad nga semana.
english: The protagonist of this video is the Bayraktar TB2 – a type of Turkish drone which is what the Ukrainian military has used against Russian forces since last week.

text: Kahapon, ginpahayag sang Ukrainian military nga ginguba sang Bayraktar drones ang isa ka tangke kag surface-to-air missile systems sang Russia sa sulod lang sang isa ka gabi.
english: Yesterday, the Ukrainian military said Bayraktar drones destroyed a Russian tank and surface-to-air missile systems in just one night.

text: Sa iban pa nga videos, ginpakita man kun paano ginpanas sang Bayraktar drones ang Russian fuel convoy kag grupo sang supply trucks.
english: Other videos also showed how Bayraktar drones wiped out a Russian fuel convoy and a group of supply trucks.

text: Ang amo nga drone ang may yara sang 12-meter nga wingspan kag makapabilin sa kahawaan sa sulod sang 30 ka oras.
english: The drone has a 12-meter wingspan and can stay in the air for 30 hours.

text: Ang kada drone ang maka-karga sang apat ka laser-guided missiles.
english: Each drone can carry four laser-guided missiles.

text: Makalupad ini sa 138 miles kada oras, makasarang nga nga makadala sang apat ka smart munitions ukon military weapons nga tubtub sa 330 pounds.
english: It can fly at 138 miles per hour, capable of carrying four smart munitions or military weapons of up to 330 pounds.

text: Antes ang bulig sini sa Ukraine, ang Turkish Bayraktar drones ang nakapasundayag naman sa Ethiopia, Azerbaijan, Libya kag Syria.
english: Before its assistance to Ukraine, Turkish Bayraktar drones have demonstrated in Ethiopia, Azerbaijan, Libya and Syria.

text: Sa away sang Azerbaijan kag Armenia sang 2020, ang Turkish drones ang nagpadaog sang Azeri batok sa Armenia – pungsod nga kaalyado man sang Russia.
english: In the fight between Azerbaijan and Armenia in 2020, Turkish drones gave Azeri a victory against Armenia – country that is also an ally of Russia.

text: Ginpahayag sang U.S. and European military analysts nga amo ini ang “unexpected weaknesses” sa bahin sang Russian army.
english: U.S. and European military analysts said these were “unexpected weaknesses” on the part of the Russian army.

text: Ginaduso sang Committee on Engineering, Construction and Public Works sang Iloilo City Council nga imbestigaran ang Mandurriao Public Market bangud sa kakulangan sang City Engineers Office.
english: The Committee on Engineering, Construction and Public Works of the Iloilo City Council is proposing to investigate the Mandurriao Public Market due to the lack of City Engineers Office.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo City Councilor Johnny Young, chairman sang Committee on Engineering, Construction and Public Works, iya ginpahayag nga ginpatawag na ang nasambit nga opisina bangud sa tuman ka delay na gid ang proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo City Councilor Johnny Young, chairman of the Committee on Engineering, Construction and Public Works, he said the office has been summoned because of the delay in the project.

text: Nagsugod ang pagtukod sang merkado sang Nobyembre 2021 kag nag-resume sang Agosto 2022 kag nagpasalig nga matapos Nobyembre 2023 apang wala natigayon matapos.
english: Construction of the market began in November 2021 and resumed in August 2022 and promised to be completed by November 2023 but failed to complete.

text: Suno kay Young, suno sa City Engineers Office, na-delay bangud sa pag-untat trabaho sang 2021.
english: According to Young, according to the City Engineers Office, it was delayed due to the 2021 work stoppage.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sa subong natapos na ang kabilogan sang merkado.
english: He also said that the entire market is now completed.

text: Magapatuman naman sang ocular inspection ang talatapan kaupod ang Office of the Building Official (OBO) agud ma-check ang Mandurriao Public Market.
english: The office will conduct an ocular inspection with the Office of the Building Official (OBO) to check the Mandurriao Public Market.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang City Engineers Office nga nakulangan sang budget ang proyekto rason nga na-delay kag wala gilayon napadayon.
english: Earlier, the City Engineers Office said the project was delayed due to lack of budget.

text: Naka-schedule sa Miyerkules, Pebrero 19, ang hearing sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) sa pending petition nga ipasaka sa P15 ang minimum fare sa jeep.
english: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) is scheduled to hear the pending petition to raise the minimum fare to P15 on Wednesday, February 19.

text: Suno kay LTFRB technical division head Joel Bolano, amo ini ang request sang nagkalain-lain nga transport groups nga ginpasa sang nagligad pa nga 2023.
english: According to LTFRB technical division head Joel Bolano, this is the request of various transport groups that was submitted last 2023.

text: Sang amo nga tion, wala ini ginpasugtan.
english: At the time, it was not allowed.

text: Sa baylo, gin-grant sang LTFRB ang piso nga provisional increase kun sa diin, halin sa P12, ginpasaka sa P13 ang plete sa traditional jeepneys samtang halin sa P14, nahimo naman nga P15 ang para sa modern jeepneys.
english: Instead, the LTFRB granted a one-peso provisional increase where, from P12, the fare for traditional jeepneys was increased to P13 while from P14, it was increased to P15 for modern jeepneys.

text: “The petition was to increase the minimum fare to P15 from the current P13,” suno kay Bolano kaangot sa pending request.
english: “The petition was to increase the minimum fare to P15 from the current P13,” Bolano said regarding the pending request.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, matandaan nga nagsiling ang regulatory board nga ginarepaso pa nila ang petisyon nga pasakaan ang minimum fare bangud madamo nga transport groups ang nag-petisyon para sa pagpataas sa plete.
english: Last month, the regulatory board said it was still reviewing the petition to raise the minimum fare as many transport groups had petitioned for a fare increase.

text: Nagsabat ang ahensya nga lakip sa ila nga ikonsiderar amo ang trend sa pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong, ang inflation rate, kag ang kabug-usan nga economic impact sa mga commuter.
english: The agency responded that among the factors they will consider are the trend in fuel prices, the inflation rate, and the overall economic impact on commuters.

text: Nagsiling man ang public land transport regulator nga igakonsiderar man sini ang posible nga epekto sang requested minimum fare hike sa riding public.
english: The public land transport regulator also said it will also consider the possible impact of the requested minimum fare hike on the riding public.

text: Nadugangan nanaman ang mga napatay nga civilian kasunod sang liwat nga pagpalupad sang missile strikes sa isa ka TV tower sa Kyiv, ang capital city sang Ukraine.
english: The civilian death toll has risen following renewed missile strikes on a TV tower in Kyiv, Ukraine's capital city.

text: Naigu man sang pinakaulihi nga airstrike sa Kyiv ang Babyn Yar Holocaust memorial.
english: The latest airstrike in Kyiv also hit the Babyn Yar Holocaust memorial.

text: Padayon naman ang amat-amat nga pagpadulong sang military convoy sang Russia sa Kyiv.
english: The Russian military convoy continues to slowly move towards Kyiv.

text: Napalibutan naman subong sang Russian troops ang ikaduha sa pinakadako nga lugar sa Ukraine, ang Kharkiv.
english: Russian troops have now surrounded Ukraine's second largest city, Kharkiv.

text: Ginpahayag nga mas nagadamo ang air kag artillery strikes sang Russia sa sulod lang sang 48 ka oras.
english: Russia's air and artillery strikes have reportedly increased in just 48 hours.

text: Nangin emosyonal naman ang mga eksena sa special session sang European Parliament kun sa diin gin-debatehan ang nagakatabo nga kinagamo sa Ukraine.
english: The scenes became emotional during the special session of the European Parliament where the ongoing conflict in Ukraine was debated.

text: Ini matapos nag-standing ovation para kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky ang Members sang European Parliaments samtang suksok kag bitbit ang t-shirts nga may Ukrainian flag.
english: This was after Members of the European Parliaments gave a standing ovation for Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky while wearing and carrying t-shirts with the Ukrainian flag.

text: Ginpasalamatan sang Presidente sang European parliament, nga si Roberta Mesola si President Zelensky.
english: The President of the European parliament, Roberta Mesola thanked President Zelensky.

text: Nagpanawagan naman si Zelensky sa European Union nga ila ipakita nga kaupod sila sang Ukraine nga nagapakigbato sa gyera batok sa Russia.
english: Zelensky called on the European Union to show solidarity with Ukraine in its fight against Russia.

text: Suno kay Zelensky, sa tunga sang trahedya nga nagakatabo sa ila pungsod, padayon sila nga makig-away para sa ila kinamatarong kag kahilwayan.
english: According to Zelensky, amidst the tragedy unfolding in their country, they will continue to fight for their rights and freedom.

text: Tuman man ang kaakig sini sang napatay ang 16 ka mga bata bangud sa pag-atake sang Russia.
english: It was also very angry when 16 children were killed in a Russian attack.

text: Samtang, humalin sang Pebrero 24, narekord sang United Nations Human Rights ang kabug-usan nga 536 ka mga napatay nga civilian lakip na ang 13 ka mga kabataan.
english: Meanwhile, since February 24, the United Nations Human Rights has recorded a total of 536 civilian deaths including 13 children.

text: Ginabanta 400 ka indibidwal naman ang pilason lakip na ang 26 ka mga kabataan.Suno naman sa Russian media, may yara sang patigayunon nga second round sang peace talk subong nga adlaw sa Belarus, malapit sa Belarus-Poland border.
english: An estimated 400 individuals were injured, including 26 children. According to Russian media, a second round of peace talks will be held today in Belarus, near the Belarus-Poland border.

text: Ini matapos nga wala sang maayo nga resulta ang una nga peacetalk bangud nagpakatig-a si Russian President Vladymir Putin.
english: This comes after the first peace talks failed because Russian President Vladymir Putin became stubborn.

text: Ginhingyo ni Lanao del Sur Rep.
english: Lanao del Sur Rep.

text: Zia Alonto Adiong sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) nga imbestigaran ang damlag lang nga pahayag ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Roa Duterte angot sa pagpatay sa 15 ka mga senador agud makapungko ang ila mga kandidato.
english: Zia Alonto Adiong to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to investigate the recent statement of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte regarding the killing of 15 senators to seat their candidates.

text: Suno kay Adiong, kun ginlunsar sang NBI ang imbestigasyon sa ginaalegar pamahog ni Vice President Sara Duterte batok kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, kag Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez, nagakabagay lamang nga usisaon man ang mga pahayag sang anay presidente.
english: Adiong said if the NBI launched an investigation into Vice President Sara Duterte's alleged threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, and Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez, it would be appropriate to investigate the former president's statements.

text: Sa isa ka pagtililipon sa syudad sang San Juan, ginhambal ni Duterte angot sa palaabuton nga eleksyon kag sa karon nga komposisyon sang Senado.
english: At a rally in San Juan City, Duterte spoke about the upcoming elections and the current composition of the Senate.

text: Sa iya pamulong-pulong, ginduso niya ang isa ka radikal nga paagi agud masiguro nga ang iya mga kaalyado nga mga kandidato magadaug.
english: In his speech, he proposed a radical way to ensure that his allied candidates would win.

text: Ang iya pahayag ginsugata sang mabaskog nga pagdayaw gikan sa iya mga sumalakdag, nga dungan nga nagsinggit, “Kill!
english: His statement was met with loud cheers from his supporters, who chanted in unison, “Kill!

text: Kill!
english: Kill!

text:
Kill!”

Ginhatagan pagtamod ni Adiong nga indi dapat pagbalewalaon ang kaangay nga mga pahayag, ilabi na nga may mga instances nga nag-akto ang mga supporters ni Duterte sa iya mga tinaga.
english:
Kill!”

Adiong stressed that such statements should not be ignored, especially since there have been instances when Duterte's supporters have acted on his words.

text:
Ginhatagan niya pagtamod nga bisan pa nga mahimo mag-insister si Duterte nga ang iya mga tinaga isa lamang ka joke, “indi niya matago ang pamahog sa mga senador sa likod sang joke.”

Bangud sini, gin-engganyo sini ang NBI nga usisaon kon ang amo nga mga pahayag, ilabi na ang nagapatuhoy sa violence, ang sakop sang nagakaigo nga mga kasuguan.
english:
He noted that while Duterte may insist that his words were just a joke, “he cannot hide the threat to the senators behind the joke.”

He urged the NBI to investigate whether such statements, especially those referring to violence, are covered by relevant laws.

text: Nagboto ang Pilipinas sang pabor sa resolusyon agud i-kondena ang pagsalakay sang Russia sa Ukraine sa emergency special session sang United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).
english: The Philippines voted in favor of a resolution to condemn Russia's invasion of Ukraine in an emergency special session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).

text: Sa nasambit nga session, nag-apelar ang Philippine delegation nga proteheran ang mga sibilyan kag tapuson na ang kinagamo sa Ukraine.
english: During the session, the Philippine delegation appealed for the protection of civilians and an end to the conflict in Ukraine.

text: Ginpatigayon ang United Nations General Assembly emergency session matapos gingamit sang Russia ang ila veto power agud punggan ang Security Council resolution nga nagakondena sa ginahimo nga pagsalakay sang ila militar sa Ukraine.
english: The United Nations General Assembly held an emergency session after Russia used its veto power to block a Security Council resolution condemning its ongoing military invasion of Ukraine.

text: Una diri, ginpahayag ni Defense Secretary Delfin Lorenzana nga mangin “neutral” ukon wala sang dampigan ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sa nagakatabo nga kinagamo sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: Earlier, Defense Secretary Delfin Lorenzana said the Philippine government will remain “neutral” in the ongoing conflict between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Sa isa ka presidential debate sang nagligad nga Miyerkules, ginpahayag ni presidential candidate kag senador nga si Panfilo Lacson, nga dapat mag-upod ang Pilipinas sa “peace-loving” countries nga nagapamatok sa ginahimo sang Russia.
english: In a presidential debate last Wednesday, presidential candidate and senator Panfilo Lacson said the Philippines should join the “peace-loving” countries that oppose Russia's actions.

text: Bisan malayo ang Pilipinas, ginpahayag sang senador nga madalahig ang pungsod sa istorya sa ekonomiya sa tion nga maglala pa gid ang sitwasyon sa Ukraine.
english: Although the Philippines is far away, the senator said the country will be involved in economic talks in case the situation in Ukraine worsens.

text: Suno sa UN, ini ang pinaka-una nga United Nations General Assembly emergency special session humalin sang 1982.
english: According to the UN, this is the first United Nations General Assembly emergency special session since 1982.

text: Huwebes, Pebrero 24 sang nagligad nga semana sang nag-umpisa ang Russian invasion.
english: The Russian invasion began on Thursday, February 24 last week.

text: Ginrason ni Russian President Vladimir Putin, nga nagpangayo sang bulig ang separatist leaders sang Donetsk kag Lugansk regions sa Ukraine, agud punggan ang ginapahayag pag-atake sa ila sang pwersa sang Ukraine.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin argued that the separatist leaders of the Donetsk and Lugansk regions in Ukraine had asked for help, to prevent an alleged attack on them by Ukrainian forces.

text: Wala naman nagapati ang Western countries kag United Nations sa mga rason ni Putin.
english: Western countries and the United Nations do not believe Putin's reasons.

text: Ini bangud ginapahayag nga ginlapas sang Russia ang Article 2 sang UN Charter, nga nagamando sa mga miyembro nga indi maggamit sang kalakasan kag pagpamahog sa pagresolba sa mga isyu.
english: This is because Russia allegedly violated Article 2 of the UN Charter, which mandates members not to use violence and intimidation to resolve issues.

text: Nadugangan pa gid ang mga nagkalamatay nga inosente nga mga sibilyan kag dugang nga ginatos ang nagkalapilasan kasunod sang missile strikes sa eastern city sang Kharkiv nga puluy-an sang 1.4 million ka mga tawo.
english: More innocent civilians have been killed and hundreds more injured following missile strikes in the eastern city of Kharkiv, home to 1.4 million people.

text: Ini nga pagpang-atake ang nagdungan sa ginpatigayon nga peace talks sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine sa Belarusian border.
english: The attack coincided with peace talks between Russia and Ukraine on the Belarusian border.

text: Suno kay Ukrainian Interior Ministry adviser Anton Herashchenko, ginabanta 11 mga tawo ang dugang nga napatay.
english: According to Ukrainian Interior Ministry adviser Anton Herashchenko, an estimated 11 more people were killed.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagmando si Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelensky sang ”immediate ceasefire” kag ginhingyo ang tanan nga Russian troops nga maglayas na sa Ukraine.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky immediately ordered an "immediate ceasefire" and asked all Russian troops to leave Ukraine.

text: Gin-akusahan naman sang State Department ang Russia sa ila ginhimo nga human rights abuses matapos ginwasak sang Russian troops ang pila ka mga buluthuan, ospital, radio stations, kag puluy-an, kag linibo na ang nagkalamatay nga sibiliyan nga ginalakipan sang mga kabataan.
english: The State Department has accused Russia of human rights abuses after Russian troops destroyed several schools, hospitals, radio stations, and homes, killing thousands of civilians, including children.

text: Nahibaluan nga naghuyhuy lang ang abaga sang mga opisyal sang Ukraine matapos ang peace talks nila sang Russia sa Ukraine-Belarus border.
english: Ukrainian officials shrugged their shoulders after the peace talks with Russia on the Ukraine-Belarus border.

text: Ini matapos nagpakatig-a sa gihapon si Russian President Vladimir Putin nga makig-areglo sa Ukraine.
english: This comes after Russian President Vladimir Putin remained adamant about negotiating with Ukraine.

text: Samtang nag-anunsiyo naman ang European Union members sang bag-o nga mga sanctions batok sa Russia kag ginpasiguro sa Ukraine ang dugang nga military support sa masunod nga mga inadlaw.
english: Meanwhile, European Union members announced new sanctions against Russia and assured Ukraine of additional military support in the coming days.

text: Ginaplano sang Committee on Public Order and Security sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Iloilo nga magpaguwa sang mga resolusyon nga nagaduso sa Department of Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 nga i-review kag pasiguraduhon nga wala na sang may matabo nga ‘fallen debris’ sa Ungka Flyover.
english: The Committee on Public Order and Security of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Iloilo plans to issue resolutions urging the Department of Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 to review and ensure that there will be no fallen debris on the Ungka Flyover.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar,chairman sang Public Order and Security, iya ginpahayag nga ang tikang ang magatulod man sa kontaktor sang flyover nga magbutang sang safety personnel.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar, chairman of the Public Order and Security, said the move will also prompt the flyover contactor to deploy safety personnel.

text: Nagapati naman ang natungdan nga kon may safety officers sa lugar, matalupangdan sang mga motorista ano man nga hazard nga posible matuga sang proyekto.
english: He believes that if there are safety officers in the area, motorists will notice any hazard that may be caused by the project.

text: Suno kay Mondejar, tutokan man sang komitiba ang masami nga reklamo nga madanlog ang flyover ilabi na kon bag-o lang ini tapos paidalom sa jet grouting.
english: Mondejar said the committee will also focus on the frequent complaints that the flyover is slippery especially if it is newly completed under jet grouting.

text: Kon balikan, isa ka pulis ang anay nagreklamo kasunod sang pagkahulog sang debris halin sa flyover nga nag-igo sa helmet sini samtang nagamaneho sang motorsiklo.
english: Looking back, a police officer once filed a complaint following falling debris from a flyover hitting his helmet while riding a motorcycle.

text: Kaangot diri, sang damlag lang, nataktakan sang semento halin sa Flyover ang driver man sang motorsiklo nga papauli kuntani sa Cabatuan, Iloilo halin sa trabaho.
english: In this regard, recently, the driver of a motorcycle who was returning home from work in Cabatuan, Iloilo was hit by cement from the flyover.

text: Wala na sang Low Pressure Area (LPA) nga na-monitor sa gwa sang Pilipinas.
english: No Low Pressure Area (LPA) has been monitored outside the Philippines.

text: Ang Shear Line ang nagaapekto naman sa Extreme Northern Luzon.
english: The Shear Line is affecting Extreme Northern Luzon.

text: Ang Shear Line ang isa ka linya ukon makitid nga lugar sa diin may gulpi nga pagbag-o sa direksyon sang hangin.
english: A Shear Line is a line or narrow area where there is a sudden change in the direction of the wind.

text: Bangud sa pagbunggu-anay ukon convergence sang hangin, nagaluntad ang masami nga pagpangilat ukon mga pag-ulan sa shear line.
english: Due to wind collision or convergence, frequent lightning or showers occur along the shear line.

text: Ang Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) ang nagaapekto sa Southern Mindanao.
english: The Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) affects Southern Mindanao.

text: Ang ITCZ amo ang ang lugar sa diin ang hangin sang Northern Hemisphere kag Southern Hemisphere ay nagakit-anay kag nagaresulta sang malain nga panahon kaangay sang Low Pressure Area kag Bagyo.
english: The ITCZ ​​is the area where the Northern Hemisphere and Southern Hemisphere winds meet and result in bad weather such as Low Pressure Areas and Typhoons.

text: Samtang ang Easterlies ukon ang mainit nga hangin halin sa Dagat Pasipiko ang nagaapekto sa nabilin nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, the Easterlies or the warm winds from the Pacific Ocean affect the rest of the country.

text: Wala sang preferred ukon specific nga brand sang COVID-19 vaccines para sa mga cancer patients ukon may history sang nasambit nga balatian.
english: There is no preferred or specific brand of COVID-19 vaccines for cancer patients or those with a history of the disease.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Anita Jesena, Oncologist, iya ginpahayag nga ang mga tawo nga may cancer ukon may history sang sini nga balatian, ang mahimo makapabakuna sa bisan ano nga brand sang COVID-19 vaccine nga aprubado sang Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Anita Jesena, Oncologist, said that people with cancer or a history of the disease can be vaccinated with any brand of COVID-19 vaccine approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

text: Suno kay Jesena, importante man nga antes magpabakuna ang isa ka pasyente nga may cancer, nakapakig-angot kag may abiso ini nga nabaton sa iya personal nga medical specialist ukon medical oncologist.
english: According to Jesena, it is also important that before a cancer patient gets vaccinated, he has contacted and received notification from his personal medical specialist or medical oncologist.

text: Pahayag sang doktor, ang tanan man nga COVID-19 vaccine nga may yara sang emergency use authorization (EUA) ang epektibo kag safe nga gamiton.
english: The doctor said that all COVID-19 vaccines that have emergency use authorization (EUA) are effective and safe to use.

text: Nakadepende man suno kay Jesena sa rekomendasyon sang medical doctor sang isa ka cancer patient kun san-o ini nagakadapat nga magbaton sang COVID-19 vaccination.
english: Jesena said it also depends on the recommendation of the medical doctor of a cancer patient when he should receive the COVID-19 vaccination.

text: Napili nga “Women of the Year” sang Billboard Philippines ang P-pop powerhouse nga BINI nga ginabug-usan nanday Jhoanna, Aiah, Colet, Maloi, Gwen, Stacey, Mikha.
english: P-pop powerhouse BINI consisting of Jhoanna, Aiah, Colet, Maloi, Gwen, Stacey, Mikha was named “Women of the Year” by Billboard Philippines.

text: Ginpasidunggan sila sa “Women in Music: The Executive Edition” ceremony kaupod sa iban nga dalagku nga female industry leaders.
english: They were honored at the “Women in Music: The Executive Edition” ceremony alongside other great female industry leaders.

text: Kaupod sang girl group sa seremonya amo sanday Rhiza Pascua (Management, Concerts, and Live Entertainment), Kathleen Dy-Go (OPM Vanguard), Marivic Benedicto (Music Rights), Georgette Tengco (Music Distribution), Audry Dionisio (Independent Record Labels) kag Roslyn Pineda (Industry and Record Label).
english: Joining the girl group at the ceremony were Rhiza Pascua (Management, Concerts, and Live Entertainment), Kathleen Dy-Go (OPM Vanguard), Marivic Benedicto (Music Rights), Georgette Tengco (Music Distribution), Audry Dionisio (Independent Record Labels) and Ros Pineda (Record and Industry).

text: Ikaduha na ini nga tion nga ginkilala sang Billboard Philippines ang BINI matapos nakuha man anay ang Rising Star award sang March 2024.
english: This is the second time that Billboard Philippines has recognized BINI after it also won the Rising Star award in March 2024.

text: Sang nagligad nga edisyon, lakip sa awardees amo sanday Sarah Geronimo, Regine Velasquez, Pilita Corrales, Ena Mori, Morissette Amon kag Belle Mariano.
english: In the last edition, among the awardees were Sarah Geronimo, Regine Velasquez, Pilita Corrales, Ena Mori, Morissette Amon and Belle Mariano.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip sa ginahandaan subong sang girl group amo ang upcoming world tour nga may shows sa Dubai, London, Canada kag sa US matapos ang first leg sa Philippine Arena sa temprano nga bahin subong nga tuig.#
english: The girl group is preparing for an upcoming world tour with shows in Dubai, London, Canada and the US after the first leg at the Philippine Arena early this year.

text: Gin-athag ni Atty. Jobert Pahilga nga isa ka Human Rights Lawyer ang rason sang appeals chamber sa indi paghatag sang interim release kay Former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Atty. explained. Jobert Pahilga, a Human Rights Lawyer, cited the appeals chamber's refusal to grant interim release to Former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Pahilga, ginklaro sini nga may tatlo ka rason kun nga-a wala ginhatagan sang temporaryo nga kahilwayan si Duterte.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Pahilga, he clarified that there are three reasons why Duterte was not granted temporary release.

text:
Ini amo ang:

Base sa ginhiwat nga hearing, isa man sa rason amo ang posibilidad nga pagpangindulaan ni Duterte kag indi na pagtambong sa mga masunod nga hearing.
english:
These are:

Based on the hearing, one of the reasons is the possibility that Duterte will refuse to attend the next hearings.

text: Si Duterte isa man sa gihapon sa may mataas nga posisyon kag ginatangla sang kadam-an bangud nagdaug ini nga alkade sang Davao, ara sa posisyon ang iya mga kabataan kag madamo pa sa subong ang nagasuporta sa iya.
english: Duterte is still one of the high-ranking officials and is looked up to by the public because he won the mayoralty of Davao, his children are in office and many more are now supporting him.

text: Mataas man ang risgo nga maghatag ini sang intimidation sa mga witness kontra sa iya bangud sa history sini nga ginawaragwag ang iya gin-obrasang mga nagligad kaangay sang Extra Judicial Killings.
english: He is also at high risk of intimidating witnesses against him because of his history of publicizing his past activities such as Extra Judicial Killings.

text: Isa man sa rason nga gahingyo ang kampo ni Duterte sang interim release, amo ang supposed third state nga handa mag-amuma kay anay Presidente Duterte.
english: One of the reasons why Duterte's camp is asking for an interim release is the supposed third state that is ready to take care of former President Duterte.

text: Suno kay Atty. Pahilga, posible man sa gihapon nga mahatagan sang interim release ang anay presidente kun maguwa na ang resulta sang psychological or health related test kag kun nagakinahanglan ini sang dugang nga atensyon.
english: According to Atty. Pahilga said it is still possible that the former president will be granted interim release once the results of the psychological or health related test are released and if he needs further attention.

text: MALAPIT na lang ang May 2022 presidential election.
english: THE May 2022 presidential election is just around the corner.

text: Sa padayon nga popularity ni President Duterte tubtub sa sining ulihi, ang kalidad nga ini ni Duterte bala ang luyag botohon gihapon sang mga pumuluyo?
english: With President Duterte's continued popularity until recently, is this quality of Duterte what the people still want to vote for?

text: Kon amo sina, sin-o sa inyo pensar ang posible nga kahintulad ni Duterte sa iya political group ang dapat nga kandidato nila sa pagka-presidente?
english: If so, who do you think is likely to be like Duterte in his political group should be their presidential candidate?

text: Ugaling kon ang luyag sang pumuluyo lain naman nga personalidad, nga posible halin sa oposisyon, sin-o naman ayhan ini sila?
english: But if the people want another personality, possibly from the opposition, who are they?

text:
***

Ano gid bala ang naluyagan sang mga pumuluyo nga  padayon ang pagsuporta sa kay Duterte despite sang mabug-at man niya nga mga kasaypanan sa moral kag legal sense sang iban?
english:
***

What do the people really want that continue to support Duterte despite his serious mistakes in the moral and legal sense of others?

text: Sa mga napasalamatan na sang iban sa kay Duterte, yara ang pag-doble sa sweldo sang mga soldado kag mga pulis.
english: Among the things that some have already thanked Duterte for is the doubling of the salaries of soldiers and policemen.

text: Ginpataasan man ang sweldo kag dugang nga benepisyo sang iban nga mga empleyado sa gobyerno.
english: Other government employees have also received increased salaries and additional benefits.

text: Pati na ang mga pensionado.
english: Even the pensioners.

text: Napahagan-hagan man ang problema sa drug menace kag mga dalagku nga mga krimen, ugaling lang kay daw mas natutok ini sa mga imol samtang mahapos gihapon makalusot ang mga may sarang kag poderoso.
english: The problem of drug menace and major crimes has also been alleviated, but it seems to be more focused on the poor while the rich and powerful are still easy to get away with.

text: Napamag-an man, ukon libre na gani, ang pagtuon sa pang-publiko nga kolehiyo kag unibersidad.
