english: Tuition at public colleges and universities has also become easier, or even free.

text: Ginapasige man ang programa para sa mga 4Ps.
english: The program for 4Ps is also being intensified.

text: Napalawak man ang health care program.
english: The health care program has also been expanded.

text: Sa sining panahon sang pandemic, may padayon man nga bulig sa mga nawad-an ubra kag agud mapadayon ang negosyo sang iban.
english: In this time of pandemic, there is also continuous assistance to those who lost their jobs and to continue the business of others.

text: May nagakaigu man nga pagtatap sa mga na-quarantine, na-isolate kag natepok sa pandemic.
english: There is also proper care for those who are quarantined, isolated and exposed to the pandemic.

text: Napauswag man ang mga dalanon kag mga taytay.
english: Roads and bridges have also been improved.

text: Nabuligan man ang mga mangunguma kag iban pa nga sektor sa ila pangabuhian sa masarangan sang gobyerno.
english: The government has also helped farmers and other sectors in their livelihood.

text: Of course indi mo man ma-please ang tanan.
english: Of course you can’t please everyone.

text: In fact, madamo man ang may reklamo.
english: In fact, many people have complaints.

text: Diri na masulod ang panindugan sang political opposition labi na gid sa nagahilapit nga May 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: This is where the position of the political opposition comes in especially in the upcoming May 2022 elections.

text: Isa na seguro ang mga akusasyon batok sa extrajudicial killing nga ginapabangod sa mga soldado kag kapulisan direkta sa command responsibility sang Presidente nga nakalab-ut na gani sa United Nations.
english: One of the accusations against extrajudicial killings attributed to soldiers and police directly to the command responsibility of the President that has even reached the United Nations.

text: Ang gina-alegar nga pang-harass sa mga kritiko labi na gid sa pila ka independent media.
english: The alleged harassment of critics is especially pronounced in some independent media.

text: Ang padayon nga pagpakig-away sang armado nga komunista nga grupo tungod sa wala gihapon kahusayan nga problema sa agraryo kag kaimolon sa kaumhan.
english: The continued struggle of the armed communist group is due to the still unsettled agrarian problem and rural poverty.

text: Kag yara man ang pagpakamalaut ni Presidente sa kay Pope Francis sang pag-abot sini diri sa Filipinas.
english: And there is also the President's condemnation of Pope Francis upon his arrival here in the Philippines.

text: At worst, sang gintawag niya nga “stupid” ang Diyos nga ginasimba ni Pope Francis kag sang 80 porsyento sang aton populasyon, nga ginatoohan man sang mga Muslim kag Jewish Faith – ang Diyos Amay, ang tagtuga sang una mga tawo nga sanday Adan kag Eba.
english: At worst, when he called “stupid” the God worshiped by Pope Francis and 80 percent of our population, who is also believed by Muslims and Jewish Faith – God the Father, the creator of the first humans Adam and Eve.

text: Idugang ta pa ang indi ma-intiendihan nga panindugan ni Presidente Duterte sa aton relasyon sa China angot sa aton kinamatarong sa 200-nautical mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone sa West Philippine Sea kag sa Scarborough Shoal, nga gindaug na naton sa Permanent Court of Arbitration sa Hague, Netherlands.
english: Add to that President Duterte's incomprehensible stance on our relationship with China regarding our rights to the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone in the West Philippine Sea and the Scarborough Shoal, which we have already won in the Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Ining reklamo gin-file sang administrsyon ni former President Noynoy Aquino batok sa China angot sa pag-agaw sangChina sang Scarborugh Shoal sadtong Hunyo 2013.
english: The complaint was filed by the administration of former President Noynoy Aquino against China over China's seizure of the Scarborough Shoal in June 2013.

text: Gindaug naton ining kaso sang Hulyo 2016, nga nag-legitimize na sang aton claim sa West Philippine Sea kag Scarborough Shoal.
english: We won this case in July 2016, which has already legitimized our claim to the West Philippine Sea and Scarborough Shoal.

text: Ugaling lang kay wala ini ginakilala sang China kag padayon nga daw gina-bebe pa gihapon naton ini sa idalom sang administrasyon ni Duterte.
english: However, China does not recognize it and we continue to seem to be babying it under the Duterte administration.

text: Samtang may sovereign right kita diri, nagagwa gani nga daw luyag ta pa i-surrender ini sa Komunistang China, samtang huyog ta pa nga pakalainon ang United States nga dapat kadampig naton sa demokrasyahon nga Free World.
english: While we have a sovereign right here, it seems that we want to surrender it to Communist China, while we still tend to criticize the United States that should be our side in the democratic Free World.

text: Well, sa nasiling na naton malapit na ang May 2021 nga eleksyon.
english: Well, as we have said, the May 2021 election is near.

text: Kamo, nga mga pinalangga naton nga mga kasimanwa, na lang seguro ang mag-binagbinag kon sin-o gid tagaan ninyo sing pagsakdag.
english: You, our dear fellow citizens, should probably consider whom you will support.

text: Of course, pagkatapos sang inyo nagakaigu nga pagbinag-binag sa pagsugod na sang pag-file sang kandidatura sa palaabuton nga Oktubre.
english: Of course, after your due consideration, the filing of candidacies will begin in October.

text: Ang may panimuot bala katulad ni Duterte, ukon bala ang lain nga personalidad nga makapaseguro sang mas maayo nga pangabuhi kag panindugan sa Demokrasya upod ang aton mga ally sa Free World?/PN
english: Is it the one with the attitude of Duterte, or is it the different personality that can ensure a better life and stand for Democracy with our allies in the Free World?/PN

text: Nagabubo ang pagdayaw sa isa ka manugpaninlo sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3 (NAIA-3) matapos wala ini nagduha-duha nga magpanugid sa otoridad sang nakit-an sini ang medyas nga may unod nga $18,800 ukon P1.1-million.
english: A cleaner at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3 (NAIA-3) is being praised after he did not hesitate to tell the authorities when he found a sock containing $18,800 or P1.1-million.

text: Ang honest cleaner ang ginkilala nga si Rosalinda Celero, 41.
english: The honest cleaner was identified as Rosalinda Celero, 41.

text: Nakit-an sini ang medyas sa idalom sang gang chair sa south wing sang departure area sang NAIA-3 kasunod sang final security checkpoint.
english: He found the socks under the gang chair in the south wing of the departure area of ​​NAIA-3 following the final security checkpoint.

text: Gilayon sini nga gindala ang iya nakit-an sa lost and found section sang terminal.
english: He immediately took what he found to the lost and found section of the terminal.

text: Gina-check na subong sang security personnel sang Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) ang closed-circuit television footage agud matumod kun sin-o ang tag-iya sang kuwarta kag kun paano natigayon nga mapalusot ini nga cash sa security checks.
english: Security personnel of the Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) are now checking the closed-circuit television footage to identify the owner of the money and how the cash managed to slip through the security checks.

text: Ginalantaw sang MIAA nga gin-smuggle sang tag-iya ang cash bangud sandig sa pagsulundan, tubtub lamang sa $10,000 ang ginatugutan sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas nga dal-on sang pasahero.
english: MIAA believes that the owner smuggled the cash because according to the rules, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas only allows up to $10,000 to be carried by passengers.

text: Ginpanginbulahan naman ni MIAA general manager Eric Ines si Celero bangud nangin honest ini apisar daku nga kantidad ang iya nakit-an.
english: MIAA general manager Eric Ines congratulated Celero for being honest despite the large amount of money he found.

text: “We are delighted to have individuals like Rosalinda who exemplify strength of character and righteousness in the face of tempting situations,” kabahin sang statement ni Ines.
english: “We are delighted to have individuals like Rosalinda who exemplify strength of character and righteousness in the face of tempting situations,” Ines’ statement said.

text: “Her action is a testament to the values we uphold in NAIA.
english: “Her action is a testament to the values ​​we uphold in NAIA.

text:
Truly, there are angels in our midst.”

Kilalahon si Celero kadungan sang July flag-raising ceremony sang MIAA kun sa diin natalana ini nga hatagan sang certificate of commendation.#
english:
Truly, there are angels in our midst.”

Celero will be recognized during the July flag-raising ceremony of the MIAA where he is scheduled to be awarded a certificate of commendation.

text: Nag-file sang petisyon ang isa ka abogado agud nga mahingyo sa Korte Suprema nga suguon ang Senado nga mag-convene na bilang impeachment court kag umpisahan ang trial batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: A lawyer has filed a petition to ask the Supreme Court to order the Senate to convene as an impeachment court and begin the trial against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ang nagpasaka ang 22-page petition for mandamus amo si Atty. Catalino Generillo Jr.
english: The 22-page petition for mandamus was filed by Atty. Catalino Generillo Jr.

text: nga nakapungko anay bilang Presidential Commission on Good Government special government counsel.
english: who previously served as Presidential Commission on Good Government special government counsel.

text: Sa iya petisyon, ginsiling sini nga ang Konstitusyon wala nagatugot sa Senado nga mag-atrasar sang ila ulubrahon kun recess ukon session break.
english: In his petition, he said the Constitution does not allow the Senate to delay its work during recess or session break.

text: Pahayag sini, may constitutional duty ang Senado nga indi sini mapalagyuhan kag ini amo ang pag-tingob na sa labing-madali nga tion bilang isa ka impeachment court kun mabaton na ang Articles of Impeachment halin sa Kamara.
english: He said the Senate has a constitutional duty that it cannot escape and that is to unite as soon as possible as an impeachment court once the Articles of Impeachment are received from the House.

text: May ginpadala man nga kopya kay Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero kag sa Office of the Solicitor General.
english: A copy was also sent to Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero and the Office of the Solicitor General.

text: Pebrero 5 sang gin-impeach sang Kamara si Sara matapos nagpabor ang 215 ka mga mamalidha.
english: The House of Representatives impeached Sara on February 5 after 215 lawmakers voted in favor.

text: Pagkasunod nga inadlaw, ginkumpirma nga may 25 ka dugang nga mga kongresista nga nagpirma man sa complaint, buot silingon, 240 na ang pabor sa impeachment.
english: The next day, it was confirmed that 25 additional congressmen had also signed the complaint, bringing the total to 240 in favor of impeachment.

text: Sang Pebrero 5 man sang nag-adjourn ang session sa Kongreso bangud sa eleksyon, kag natalana nga mag-resume sa Hunyo 2.
english: Also on February 5, the session in Congress adjourned due to the election, and is scheduled to resume on June 2.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Escudero nga wala ini sang plano nga magpatawag sang special session agud nga mapatigayon ang trial kay Sara bisan naka-election break ang Kamara kag Senado.
english: Escudero earlier said he has no plans to call a special session to conduct the trial of Sara despite the election break in the House and Senate.

text: Nagbalos si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. retaliated.

text: sa pahayag ni former President Rodrigo Duterte nga pangpatyon ang 15 ka mga senador para nga may bakante nga mga posisyon para sa mga kandidato sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino (PDP)-Laban.
english: in the statement of former President Rodrigo Duterte that 15 senators will be killed so that there will be vacant positions for candidates of the Democratic Party of the Philippines (PDP)-Laban.

text: Ang sabat ni Marcos ang natabo kadungan sang rally sang Alyansa Para sa Bagong Pilipinas senatorial slate sa Davao Del Norte nga baluwarte mismo sang mga Duterte.
english: Marcos' response came during the rally of the Alliance for a New Philippines senatorial slate in Davao Del Norte, the Duterte's own stronghold.

text: Suno kay Marcos, daw kaangay nga nahadlok ang iban nga partido kun makit-an ang Alyansa sang administrasyon bangud lain-lain na ang ila ginapanghambal.
english: According to Marcos, it seems that other parties are afraid to see the Alliance of the administration because they are talking differently.

text: Mabudlay suno sa chief executive bangud may iban nga mga tawo nga ang isahanon nga solusyon nga nakita sa mga problema amo nga magpatay sang tawo.
english: The chief executive said it is difficult because there are some people whose only solution to problems is to kill people.

text: “Nakikita natin ang ibang partido… nagugulat sila, natatakot yata sila sa inyo dahil pag nakita ang line-up ng Alyansa ay kung anu-ano na ang sinasabi,” suno sa presidente.
english: “We see the other parties... they are surprised, they are probably afraid of you because when they see the line-up of the Alliance, they are saying something,” the president said.

text: “Narinig lang natin nung isang araw, wala daw pag-asa siguro… wala silang pag-asa kaya papatay na lang sila ng 15 senador.
english: “We just heard the other day, they said there was no hope... they had no hope so they would just kill 15 senators.

text: Sabagay, mahirap naman ang ibang tao, ang iniisip lang nila ang kaisa-isang solusyon sa lahat ng problema ay pumatay pa ng Pilipino.
english: After all, some people are poor, they only think of the only solution to all the problems is to kill Filipinos.

text:
Nakakapagtaka kung bakit ganoon.”

Wala direkta nga ginhambal ni Marcos ang pangalan ni former President Duterte, apang kun balikan, ang anay punong ehekutibo amo ang nag-lahog sa rally sang senatorial slate sang PDP sang nagligad nga Huwebes nga kun makapatay sila sang 15 ka mga senador, sulod na ang tanan nga kandidato nga iya gina-endorso.
english:
I wonder why that is.”

Marcos did not directly mention former President Duterte's name, but it was the former chief executive who threatened at the rally of the PDP's senatorial slate last Thursday that if they kill 15 senators, all the candidates he endorses will be included.

text: Bisan nga ginsiling nga “joke” lamang ini sang former president, may iban nga nagbwelta kag nagsabat nga pwede ini makasuhan bangud sa pagpamahog.
english: Although the former president said it was a joke, others replied that he could be sued for intimidation.

text: Sa iya speech sa Davao, liwat nga ginsulit ni Marcos ang kaundan man sang iya speech sa Laoag, Ilocos Norte kag sa Iloilo City kun sa diin nagpabati-bati ini nga ang iya mga senatorial candidates ang wala sang involvement sa extrajudicial killings kag kurapsyon sang tion sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: In his speech in Davao, Marcos reiterated the contents of his speech in Laoag, Ilocos Norte and Iloilo City where he insisted that his senatorial candidates were not involved in extrajudicial killings and corruption during the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ginsulit man sini nga indi sila pro-China kag wala man sila nagapabor sa Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators ukon POGO.
english: He also reiterated that they are not pro-China and do not favor the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators or POGO.

text: “Ngunit maiintindihan mo rin dahil kung ako nga ay nasa kabilang partido at itong mga ito ang kaharap natin, sasabihin ko, mahirap na kampanya ito dahil mabigat ang kalaban.
english: “But you can also understand because if I am in the other party and these people are facing us, I will say, it is a difficult campaign because the opponent is heavy.

text: Dahil kung kikilatisin natin sila isa-isa, napakatingkad po ng mga record nila, napakaganda ng kanilang mga naging performance sa kanilang iba’t-ibang inupuang mga posisyon sa pamahalaan,” dayaw ni Marcos sa iya nga mga kaalyado.#
english: Because if we look at them one by one, their records are very good, their performances in their various positions in the government are very good,” Marcos praised his allies.

text: Nagpataw sang bag-o nga sanctions ang nagkalain-lain nga pungsod batok sa Russia kasunod sang invasion sini sa Ukraine.
english: Various countries have imposed new sanctions against Russia following its invasion of Ukraine.

text: Ang European Union, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, kag Taiwan ang parehos nga nagpataw sang bag-o nga injunction sa Moscow, Russia agud nga i-kondena ang pagsugud sang gyera sa tunga nila sang Ukraine.
english: The European Union, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, and Taiwan have all issued new injunctions to Moscow, Russia to condemn the start of the war between them and Ukraine.

text: Ginpahayag man nga duha ka missiles ang nag-igu sa Kyiv.
english: Two missiles also reportedly hit Kyiv.

text: Apang, wala pa nahibalu-an ang nangin target sang amu nga atake.
english: However, the target of the attack is still unknown.

text: Suno sa Kyiv’s city government, isa sa mga missile ang nag-igu sa isa ka residential building kag ang isa ang nag-igu sa lugar nga malapit sa paluparan sang Zhuliany.
english: According to Kyiv’s city government, one of the missiles hit a residential building and the other hit the area near Zhuliany airport.

text: Nagdangat naman sang 100,000 ka mga tawo ang naka-cross na sang border padulong sa Poland isa ka semana ang nagligad humalin sang naglala nga tensyon sa tunga sang Ukraine kag Russia.
english: More than 100,000 people have crossed the border into Poland a week ago since tensions between Ukraine and Russia escalated.

text: Suno kay Polish Deputy Interior Minister Pawel Szefernaker 90 percent sa mga refugees ang may yara na sang lugar nga tiniran sa Poland.
english: According to Polish Deputy Interior Minister Pawel Szefernaker 90 percent of the refugees already have a place to live in Poland.

text: Suno naman kay Bombo International Correspondent Rhea Rose Ramos Taiboya, –direkta sa Ukraine, tuman ang ila kakulba kag kakibot na nagakatabo nga pagpang-atake sang Russia.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Rhea Rose Ramos Taiboya, –directly in Ukraine, they are very worried and shocked that Russia is attacking.

text: Suno sa iya, nakahanda na ang underground storage sang iya pamilya agud nga ila panaguans a tion nga malab-ot na sa ila lugar ang pangpangbomba sang Russia.
english: He said his family's underground storage is ready to hide in case the Russian bombing reaches their area.

text: Dugang pa niya, wala pa man nagakulang sang suplay sang pagkaon sa ila lugar kag wala man ini sang na-obserbahan nga panic buying.
english: He added that there is no shortage of food supply in their area and he has not observed any panic buying.

text: May yara naman suno sa natungdan sang pila ka Pinoy ang nag-cross sang border padulong sa Poland nga naghalin sa Kyiv.
english: He said some Filipinos crossed the border to Poland from Kyiv.

text: Wala naman ginpahanugutan ang mga kalalakinhan nga nag-edad snag 18-60 nga mag-cross sang border amu nga apektado ang mga pinoy nga nakapangasawa sang Ukrainians.
english: Men aged 18-60 are not allowed to cross the border, affecting Filipinos married to Ukrainians.

text: Ginapabugal sang Department of Agrarian Reform ang masobra 60,000 ka mga agrarian reform cases nga madinalag-on nga naresolbar sa idalum sang administrasyon ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Department of Agrarian Reform is proud of the more than 60,000 agrarian reform cases that were successfully resolved under the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Suno kay Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III, padayon ang pagsolbar sang mga gobyerno sa mga kaso sang agrarian reform sang mga lokal nga mangunguma sa pungsod.
english: Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III said governments continue to resolve agrarian reform cases of local farmers in the country.

text: Ang ini nga tikang nagatuyo nga mabuhinan ang kabalaka sang mga mangunguma sa ila talamnan.
english: This measure aims to reduce farmers' concerns about their fields.

text: Ginpahayag ni Estrella nga sa subong madamo pa sang pending nga kaso, lakip na ang 30-anyos nga mga kaso nga padayon nila nga gina-re-review.
english: Estrella said there are still many pending cases, including 30-year-old cases that they are still re-reviewing.

text: Base sa datos sang ahensya sang 2024, ang narekord nga case load naglab-ot sa kabug-usan nga 65,822 ka mga agrarian reform cases.
english: Based on the agency’s 2024 data, the recorded case load reached a total of 65,822 agrarian reform cases.

text: Gikan sa nasambit nga numero, tubtob sa 62,754 ka mga kaso ang naresolbar, katumbas sa 95.34% nga resolution rate sang gobyerno.
english: From the said figure, as many as 62,754 cases were resolved, corresponding to the government’s 95.34% resolution rate.

text: Naka-alerto ang mga kapulisan kag katapo sang militar sa Espanya kasunod sang pagdagsa sang protesters sa Russian Embassy sa Madrid matapos ginsalakay sang Russia ang Ukraine.
english: Police and military personnel in Spain are on alert following the flood of protesters at the Russian Embassy in Madrid following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Jean Bornales, hugot na nga ginabantayan sang mga otoridad ang palibot sang Russian Embassy sa Madrid kasunod sang ‘anti-war actions’ nga ginpatigayon sang Ukrainian supporters.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Jean Bornales, authorities are already tightly monitoring the area around the Russian Embassy in Madrid following the anti-war actions conducted by Ukrainian supporters.

text: Sang amo nga tion, may pila man ka Ukrainian residents nga naga-istar sa Madrid nga nag-protesta sa atubang sang Russian Embassy, kag nag-sininggitan pa sang pagpamatok kay Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: At the same time, some Ukrainian residents living in Madrid also protested in front of the Russian Embassy, ​​and even shouted opposition to Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Nahibaluan nga hugot nga ginkondena sang gobyerno sang Espanya ang Russian military invasion sa Ukraine.
english: The Spanish government has strongly condemned the Russian military invasion of Ukraine.

text: Ginpamakaayo na lang sang pila ka mga Filipino nga magpabilin sa Kyiv, Ukraine sa tunga sang nagalala nga Russian invasion.
english: Some Filipinos have been blessed to stay in Kyiv, Ukraine amid the escalating Russian invasion.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent April Atoc Voytenko, direkta sa Kyiv, Ukraine, kasubong nga na-stranded na sila sa ila mga balay bangud tuman ang pagpugok sang trapiko padulong sa exit sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent April Atoc Voytenko, directly in Kyiv, Ukraine, they are stranded in their homes because of the heavy traffic congestion leading to the exit of the said area.

text: Gin-abisuhan naman ang tanan nga indi maggwa sa mga balay bangud tuman ka delikado ang nagalinupad nga debris kag bala sang armas-luthang.
english: Everyone was advised not to leave their homes because of the danger of flying debris and firearm bullets.

text: May mga Russian man nga yara sa Ukraine kag na-ipit sa kinagamo.
english: There are also Russians who are in Ukraine and caught up in the conflict.

text: Nahibaluan nga bisan ang alkalde sang Kyiv, nag-upod naman sa pagpakig-away batok sa Russian troops.
english: Even the mayor of Kyiv joined the fight against the Russian troops.

text: Pila na ka mga Ukrainian residents ang nagpangisog sa pagkapyot sang armas-luthang bisan wala sang training sa militar, agud sundon ang panawagan sang gobyerno nga magbulig sa pagpakigbato para sa Ukraine.
english: Several Ukrainian residents have dared to take up arms without military training, to follow the government's call to help fight for Ukraine.

text: Ginaduso sang Australia, United Kingdom, France kag iban pa nga pungsod nga pahalinon ang Russia sa SWIFT bank-messaging system bilang penalidad sa pagsulod sini sa Ukraine.
english: Australia, the United Kingdom, France and other countries are pushing for Russia to be removed from the SWIFT bank-messaging system as penalty for its intrusion into Ukraine.

text: Ang SWIFT ukon Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication amo ang kooperatiba sang financial institutions nga natukod sang 1973 kag may headquarters sa Belgium.
english: SWIFT or Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication is the cooperative of financial institutions founded in 1973 and headquartered in Belgium.

text: Ginauyatan sini ang minilyon ka impormasyon sa hulag sang kuwarta agud nga mabuligan ang mga bangko sa ila nga transaksyon kada adlaw.
english: It holds millions of pieces of information on the movement of money to help banks with their daily transactions.

text: Lakip sa SWIFT amo ang 11,000 ka financial institutions sa masobra 200 ka mga pungsod kag teritoryo.
english: SWIFT includes 11,000 financial institutions in more than 200 countries and territories.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede direkta sa Australia, kun mapalayas ang Russia sa SWFIFT, mabudlayan ang negosyo sang pungsod kag ang pagpakig-angot sini sa iban nga mga lugar.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede directly in Australia, if Russia is expelled from SWFIFT, the country's business and relations with other areas will be difficult.

text: Kun mautod ang kaangtanan sang Russia sa iban nga international financial transactions, maapektuhan sini ang ginansya sang pungsod pati sa oil kag gas production nga naga-account sang 40 percent sang revenue sang pungsod.
english: If Russia cuts ties with other international financial transactions, it will affect the country's profits including oil and gas production, which accounts for 40 percent of the country's revenue.

text: Indi naman ini makabayad kag makapatigayon sang bayad sa financial institutions sang iban nga pungsod nga ginagamit sini sa trade transactions.
english: It cannot pay and make payments to financial institutions of other countries that it uses for trade transactions.

text: Magalunsar ang Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) sang bag-o nga mga benefit packages nga magapasanyog pa sang delivery sang healthcare services sa mga pasyente sa mga ospital.
english: The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) will launch new benefit packages that will further enhance the delivery of healthcare services to patients in hospitals.

text: Ini ang kabahin sang priority programs sang state health insurer sa 2025.
english: This is part of the state health insurer's priority programs for 2025.

text: Ang bag-o nga benefit packages ang maga- cater sa Diagnosis-Related Groups (DRGs) paagi sa Comprehensive Outpatient Benefit Package (COBP).
english: The new benefit packages will cater to Diagnosis-Related Groups (DRGs) through the Comprehensive Outpatient Benefit Package (COBP).

text: Samtang ang Z Benefit Packages naman ang maga- expand sang coverage para sa Heart Valve Surgery, Assistive Devices of Children with Disabilities, Kidney Transplantation, Prostate cancer, Cervical Cancer, kag Open Heart Surgeries, kag iban pa.
english: Meanwhile, Z Benefit Packages will expand coverage for Heart Valve Surgery, Assistive Devices of Children with Disabilities, Kidney Transplantation, Prostate cancer, Cervical Cancer, and Open Heart Surgeries, among others.

text: Suno kay (PhilHealth) Region VI Acting Regional Vice President Lazaro T. Tabsing, kabahin ini sang padayon nga pagtinguha sang state health insurer nga mag-deliver sang commitment agud paayuhon pa ang National Health Insurance Program (NHIP.
english: According to (PhilHealth) Region VI Acting Regional Vice President Lazaro T. Tabsing, this is part of the state health insurer's ongoing efforts to deliver a commitment to improve the National Health Insurance Program (NHIP).

text: Matandaan nga sang 2024, naglunsar ang PhilHealth sang 13 ka bag-o kag enhanced benefit packages nga nagalakip sang para sa hemodialysis nga nagtaas sa P6,350 para sa 156 sessions kada tuig halin sa P2,600 sang 2023.
english: It can be recalled that in 2024, PhilHealth launched 13 new and enhanced benefit packages including for hemodialysis which increased to P6,350 for 156 sessions per year from P2,600 in 2023.

text: Ang iban nga mas ginpaayo nga benefit packages ang ginpatuman man nga nagalakip sang severe dengue hemorrhagic fever, COVID-19 inpatient benefits, peritoneal dialysis, kidney transplantation, ischemic heart disease, kag cataract extraction.
english: Other more improved benefit packages have also been implemented which include severe dengue hemorrhagic fever, COVID-19 inpatient benefits, peritoneal dialysis, kidney transplantation, ischemic heart disease, and cataract extraction.

text: Ang pinakabag-o nga benefit packages sang PhilHealth ang nagalakip sang preventive tubtob curative kag rehabilitative care para sa outpatient emergency care, preventive oral health services sa primary care, amo man sa physical medicine, rehabilitation, kag assistive devices.
english: PhilHealth's latest benefit packages include preventive to curative and rehabilitative care for outpatient emergency care, preventive oral health services in primary care, as well as physical medicine, rehabilitation, and assistive devices.

text: Kaso nga murder ang pagatubangon sang retired coast guard nga nagtiro-patay sa isa ka barbero sa Zone 6, Barangay Calumpang, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: A retired coast guard who shot dead a barber in Zone 6, Barangay Calumpang, Molo, Iloilo City will face murder charges.

text: Ang biktima amo si Bryan Gabuelo, 41-anyos; ang suspek naman amo si Noel Amboy, 66-anyos, lunsay residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victims were identified as Bryan Gabuelo, 41; The suspect was identified as Noel Amboy, 66, both residents of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 4, iya ginpahayag nga nahulog sa murder ang kaso sang suspek bangud lakip sa ila ginalantaw amo ang resulta sang medication sang biktima.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 4, said the suspect's case fell into murder because among the factors they are looking at is the result of the victim's medication.

text: Suno kay Inot, may ground sila nga ginakaptan bangud may ‘intent to kill’ ang suspek batok sa biktima paagi man sa agresibo nga pagsulod sini sa balay sang biktima.
english: According to Inot, they have ground because the suspect had an intent to kill against the victim by aggressively entering the victim's house.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga ginatun-an sang ila talatapan kon nalapas sang suspek ang election gun ban sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) bangud natabo ang insidente sa sulod sang balay.
english: He also explained that his office is studying whether the suspect violated the election gun ban of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) because the incident occurred inside the house.

text: Nahibaluan nga gindekalarar sang attending physician nga patay ang biktima kahapon nga adlaw apisar nga ginlapatan ini sang pagbulong.
english: The attending physician declared the victim dead yesterday despite being treated.

text: Kon balikan, ginluthang sang suspek sa ulo kag sa lawas gamit ang .45 caliber nga armas nga amo ang gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: The suspect shot her in the head and body with a .45 caliber pistol, which led to her death.

text: Boluntaryo naman nga nagsungka ang suspek sa mga pulis kag gin-surrender sini ang iya armas kag isa ka empty shell sang .45 caliber.
english: The suspect voluntarily surrendered to the police and surrendered his firearm and an empty shell of .45 caliber.

text: Ginklaro sang Pilipinas nga wala ini nagpromisa sa China nga i-withdraw sini ang Typhon missile system sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The Philippines clarified that it did not promise China that it would withdraw the Typhon missile system of the United States of America.

text: Sabat ini ni National Security Council (NSC) spokesperson Jonathan Malaya matapos nagpahayag si Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun nga wala nagtuman ang Pilipinas sa commitment sini nga temporaryo lamang ang pag-estasyon sang Typhon missile sa pungsod.
english: National Security Council (NSC) spokesperson Jonathan Malaya said this after Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said the Philippines has not kept its commitment to temporarily station the Typhon missile in the country.

text: Suno kay Malaya, para lamang sa depensa ang Typhon missile.
english: According to Malaya, the Typhon missile is only for defense.

text: Ginsulit man ni Malaya ang kondisyon nga ginbuy-an ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr..
english: Malaya also reiterated the condition that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. released.

text: Ginsiling anay sang presidente nga tumanon sini ang Beijing nga ibalik sa US ang Typhon missiles kun mag-untat man ang China sa iligal nga pagpatrolya, pagpang-harass kag pagtinir sang mga barko sini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The president earlier said he would comply with Beijing's request to return the Typhon missiles to the US if China stopped illegally patrolling, harassing and staying its ships in the West Philippine Sea.

text: “The Philippines never promised the People’s Republic of China that we would withdraw the Typhon missile system,” suno kay Malaya sa news briefing sang National Task Force for the West Philippine Sea.
english: “The Philippines never promised the People’s Republic of China that we would withdraw the Typhon missile system,” Malaya said in a news briefing of the National Task Force for the West Philippine Sea.

text:
“We never made any commitment to PRC with this regard.”

Sa regular briefing sang Myerkules, nagsiling naman si Guo nga: “The Philippines has explained itself multiple times regarding the introduction of the Typhon system, pledging that the deployment was ‘temporary’ and that the system will be shipped out of the country after relevant military exercises… However, it has breached such commitments, claiming [it] would acquire its own midrange system and field these deterrent capabilities, and linking the South China Sea issue with the Typhon system.”

Ang Typhon ukon MRC Launcher ang una nga gindala sa Pilipinas sang April 2024.
english:
“We never made any commitment to PRC with this regard.”

In a regular briefing on Wednesday, Guo said: “The Philippines has explained itself multiple times regarding the introduction of the Typhon system, pledging that the deployment was ‘temporary’ and that the system will be shipped out of the country after relevant military exercises, it has breached such commitments, claiming these systems own and would acquire its own field… deterrent capabilities, and linking the South China Sea issue with the Typhon system.”

The Typhon or MRC Launcher will be first brought to the Philippines in April 2024.

text: Gin-deploy ini sa Ilocos Norte kadungan sang bilateral army-to-army Salaknib exercises, apang ginsaylo sang ulihi sa wala ginsapubliko nga lokasyon.
english: It was deployed in Ilocos Norte during the bilateral army-to-army Salaknib exercises, but was later moved to an undisclosed location.

text: Ang Tomahawk cruise missiles sa launchers ang sarang makaigu sa target sini sa China kag Russia kun ipalupad halin sa Pilipinas.
english: The Tomahawk cruise missiles on the launchers can hit their targets in China and Russia if launched from the Philippines.

text: Ang SM-6 missiles nga yara man sa Typhon ang sarang makaigu sa air kag sea targets sa distansya nga 200 km (165 miles).
english: The SM-6 missiles, also on the Typhon, can hit air and sea targets at a distance of 200 km (165 miles).

text: Wala sang autonomous sanctions law sa New Zealand apang wala ini nakapugong sa ila prime minister nga magpahilabot man kag magpataw sang sanctions sa Russia bangud sa pag-atake sa Ukraine.
english: New Zealand does not have an autonomous sanctions law but this did not prevent its prime minister from intervening and imposing sanctions on Russia for its attack on Ukraine.

text:
Yari ang lakip sa sanctions suno kay New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern:

Una, pagdumili sang byahe sang Russian government officials sa New Zealand kag amo man sa iban nga mga indibidwal nga may labot sa pag-sulod sa Ukraine; buot silingon, indi sila makakuha sang visa nga makasulod sa New Zealand.
english:
Here is what the sanctions include, according to New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern:

First, banning flights of Russian government officials to New Zealand as well as other individuals involved in the invasion of Ukraine; that is, they cannot obtain a visa to enter New Zealand.

text: Ikaduha, pagdumili sa export sang mga produkto sa Russian military kag security forces.
english: Second, a ban on the export of products to the Russian military and security forces.

text: Ikatatlo, pagsuspinder sa bilateral Foreign Ministry consultations tubtub nga may bag-o nga abiso nga ipa-guwa ang gobyerno.
english: Third, suspension of bilateral Foreign Ministry consultations until further notice is issued by the government.

text: Sa subong suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Tess Peeters, magatanyag man ang New Zealand government sang bulig sa Ukraine.
english: Meanwhile, according to Bombo International Correspondent Tess Peeters, the New Zealand government will also offer aid to Ukraine.

text: May nagahulat man nga mga staff sa eastern Poland agud makabulig sa mga New Zealand citizens nga luyag magbaya sa Ukraine.
english: Staff are also on standby in eastern Poland to assist New Zealand citizens who wish to leave Ukraine.

text: Pangaluyagan ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: kag Alyansa para sa Bagong Pilipinas ang Mindanao subong nga adlaw, Pebrero 15.
english: and Alliance for a New Philippines Mindanao today, February 15.

text: Baluwarte ini sang mga Duterte apang suno sa campaign manager sang Alyansa nga si Navotas City Rep.
english: It is a stronghold of the Dutertes but according to the campaign manager of the Alliance, Navotas City Rep.

text: Toby Tiangco, nagasalig sila sa resulta sang 2022 elections kun sa diin nakuha ni Marcos ang landslide victory sa Davao del Norte nga may 470,000 ka mga boto sa 577,781 registered voters.
english: Toby Tiangco, they are confident in the results of the 2022 elections where Marcos won a landslide victory in Davao del Norte with 470,000 votes out of 577,781 registered voters.

text: “Just as they stood behind PBBM, we believe our Mindanaoan brothers and sisters will back our Senate slate, which shares his vision for progress,” suno kay Tiangco.
english: “Just as they stood behind PBBM, we believe our Mindanaoan brothers and sisters will back our Senate slate, which shares his vision for progress,” Tiangco said.

text: Sang amo nga tion, maayo pa ang relasyon sang Uniteam kun sa diin kaupod ni Marcos si Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: At that time, Uniteam had a good relationship with Marcos and Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Antes sini nga Mindanao leg, natabo ang kick-off sang kampanya sang senatoriables sang administrasyon sa Laoag City, Ilocos Norte nga balwarte sang mga Marcos.
english: Before this Mindanao leg, the kick-off of the administration's senatoriables campaign took place in Laoag City, Ilocos Norte, the Marcos stronghold.

text: Sang Huwebes, gindala ang kampanya sa Iloilo City.
english: On Thursday, the campaign was brought to Iloilo City.

text: Sa pareho nga kampanya, pareho nga nagpalagtik si Marcos sa mga kandidato nga gina-endorso ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: In the same campaign, Marcos both attacked candidates endorsed by former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text:
Yari ang kabahin sang speech sang chief executive:

“Tingnan niyo po ang record ng ating mga kandidato.
english:
Here is part of the chief executive’s speech:

“Look at the record of our candidates.

text: Wala sa kanila ang may bahid ng dugo dahil sa tokhang.
english: None of them had a blood stain from the tokhang.

text: Wala sa kanila ang kasabwat sa pagbulsa ng sako-sakong pera, pinagsamantalahan ang krisis ng pandemya, pinabayaan ang ating mga kababayan na magkasakit at mamatay.
english: None of them are complicit in pocketing sacks of money, taking advantage of the pandemic crisis, letting our fellow citizens get sick and die.

text: Wala sa kanila ang mga pumapalakpak sa Tsina at natutuwa pa kapag tayo ay binobomba ng tubig, tinatamaan ang ating mga Coast Guard, hinaharang ang ating mga mangingisda, ninanakaw ang kanilang huli, at bukod pa roon ay inaagaw pa ang mga isla natin para maging bahagi ng kanilang bansa.
english: None of them applaud China and rejoice when we are bombed with water, our Coast Guard is hit, our fishermen are blocked, their catch is stolen, and our islands are being taken away to be part of their country.

text: Wala po sa kanila ang tilang sakristan ng isang bulaang propeta na nasasakdal dahil sa pagyurak sa ating kabataan at sa ating kababaihan.
english: None of them are the priests of a foolish prophet who is being persecuted for destroying our youth and our women.

text:
Wala sa kanila ang tagataguyod ng pugad ng krimen, ng sentro nang paglalapastangan ng mga kababaihan na mga POGO.”

Kun matapos ang Mindanao leg, magakadto ang coalition sa Pasay City para sa pag-umpisa sang kampanya para sa National Capital Region.
english:
None of them are the supporters of the nest of crime, the center of the humiliation of women who are POGOs.”

After the Mindanao leg, the coalition will go to Pasay City to launch the campaign for the National Capital Region.

text: Makaluluoy ang sitwasyon sang mga kabataan sa pila ka bahin sang Ukraine kasunod sang asud-asud nga pagsinigabong sa nagapadayon nga Russian invasion.
english: The situation of children in some parts of Ukraine is dire following the violent outbreak of the ongoing Russian invasion.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino, direkta sa Kyiv, Ukraine, nagahinibi nalang ang mga kabataan nga nagatinir sa basements kag sa bomb shelters matapos namurag-mugaran sa wala untat kag makakululbaan nga rocket strikes.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino, directly in Kyiv, Ukraine, children living in basements and bomb shelters are crying after being exposed to the continuous and frightening rocket strikes.

text: Yara na subong sa tunga-tunga sang Kyiv ang nagakatabo nga kinagamo.
english: The unrest is now in the heart of Kyiv.

text: Nagadinaguso man ang tanke de giyera sang Russian troops sa capital sang Ukraine kun sa diin mabatian sa bilog nga syudad ang maggahod nga sirena kag paglinupok sang mga armas-luthang.
english: Russian troops' tanks are also rushing to the Ukrainian capital, where sirens and gunfire can be heard throughout the city.

text:
Una na nagpaandam si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky nga gub-on gid sang Russia ang bilog nga syudad sang Kyiv ‘overnight.’

Gin-abisuhan man ang mga pumuluyo nga magpabilin sa sulod sang balay ukon shelters kag likawan ang pagtinir malapit sa bintana agud malikawan nga ma-igo sang debris kag mga bala.
english:
Earlier, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia would destroy the entire city of Kyiv 'overnight.'

Residents were also advised to stay indoors or shelters and avoid staying near windows to avoid being hit by debris and bullets.

text: Pahayag ni Tolentino, sa nagakahilanabo subong, ang mga bata gid ang pinaka-apektado nga kasubong nga ginapabay-an na lang bangud sa nagalala nga sitwasyon.
english: Tolentino said that in the current situation, children are the most affected as they are being neglected due to the worsening situation.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala ginapalampuwas sang Russia pati ang mga kindergarten kag orphanage sa Ukraine.
english: It is known that Russia does not spare even kindergartens and orphanages in Ukraine.

text: Ginkumpirma mismo sang Ukraine’s foreign minister nga ginsulod sang Russia ang kindergarten kag orphanage sa Okhtyrka, isa ka gamay nga syudad sa probinsya sang Sumy.
english: Ukraine’s foreign minister himself confirmed that Russia broke into the kindergarten and orphanage in Okhtyrka, a small city in Sumy province.

text: Ginapahayag nga may mga napatay, kag may mga nakaagom sang malala nga mga injuries.
english: Some people were reportedly killed, and some suffered serious injuries.

text: Lakip diri ang mga kabataan.
english: This includes children.

text: Ginkakas na sa puwesto ang 16 ka mga pulis kalakip na ang ila nga hepe matapos nga ma-involve sa ‘drinking session’ sa ila ‘Christmas party’ sa sulod sang police station sa Dolores, Eastern Samar.
english: Sixteen policemen including their chief have been removed from their posts after being involved in a drinking session at their Christmas party inside the police station in Dolores, Eastern Samar.

text: Suno kay P/Lt.Col.Analiza Armeza, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office (PRO) 8, may ranggo nga Police Captain ang hepe sang Dolores Municipal Police Station.
english: According to P/Lt.Col.Analiza Armeza, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office (PRO) 8, the chief of the Dolores Municipal Police Station has the rank of Police Captain.

text: Ginkakas ang hepe bangud sa prinsipyo sang ‘command responsibility’ nga ginapatuman sang organisasyon.
english: The chief was removed because of the principle of 'command responsibility' implemented by the organization.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, natabo ang insidente samtang naka-duty ang mga pulis sang Disyembre 15.
english: According to the investigation, the incident occurred while the police were on duty on December 15.

text: Ang pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon samtang yara sa duty ang hugot nga ginadumilian sa mga police premises sa idalom sang regulasyon kag protocols sang PNP.
english: Drinking alcoholic beverages while on duty is strictly prohibited in police premises under PNP regulations and protocols.

text: INDI mabasol si former President Noynoy Aquino kag ang United States kon ngaa wala naton mabawi sa China ang aton kinamatarong sa Scarborough Shoal, sunu sa duha ka abyan nga nasugilanon naton sang nagligad nga semana.
english: FORMER President Noynoy Aquino and the United States cannot be blamed for not regaining our rights to the Scarborough Shoal from China, according to two friends we spoke to last week.

text: In fact, gaugyon kita sa sining panghuna-huna nga wala kita sing dapat basulon kay Aquino kag sa US sa ila kapaltahan sa pagbawi sa Scarborough Shoal sang pwersahan nga gin-agaw ini sang China sadtong 2012.
english: In fact, we agree with this view that we have nothing to blame Aquino and the US for their failure to recover the Scarborough Shoal when it was forcibly seized by China in 2012.

text: Dapat magpasalamat pa gani kita kay sa pagdala ni Aquino sang aton reklamo sa Hague Permanent Court of Abitration batok sa China na-legitimize ining aton mga claim sa Scarborough Shoal kag sa West Philippine Sea nga nasulod sa South China Sea (SCS).
english: We should even be grateful that Aquino's bringing our complaint to the Hague Permanent Court of Arbitration against China legitimized our claims to the Scarborough Shoal and the West Philippine Sea within the South China Sea (SCS).

text: Nag-legitimize man ini sang kinamatarong sang iban pa nga pungsod agud makaagi sa SCS “on free navigation on sea and air”.
english: It also legitimized the right of other countries to pass through the SCS “on free navigation on sea and air”.

text:
***

Wala gid kuno nagpakita ang gobyerno ni Aquino bisan diutay nga kaisug ukon pangunahan man lang ang isa ka mabaskug nga public condemnation sa ginhimo sang China.
english:
***

The Aquino government has never shown the slightest courage or led a strong public condemnation of China's actions.

text: Daw idu ini kuno nga bahag ang ikog kag mag-ingos-ingos lang sa kahadlok sa singkit nga amo.
english: It looks like a bear with a long tail and just groans in fear of the narrow boss.

text: Maayo pa kuno ang mga estudyante nga bisan paano ginbatuta nila sing pagmakamalaut ang China sa ila mga rally.
english: The students are supposed to be better off somehow denouncing China at their rallies.

text: Ginpakamalaut man sining mga kritiko ang US kay wala kuno nagbulig ini samtang may nahimo tani ini sa idalom sang aton Mutual Defense Treaty.
english: These critics also criticized the US for not helping when it should have done something under our Mutual Defense Treaty.

text: Ina nga mga akusasyon malisyoso kag pamulitika lang, siling ugaling sining duha ta ka abyan.
english: Those accusations are malicious and political, however, say these two friends.

text:
***

Ang aton Constitution naga-renounce war, sa Article II, Section 2, “as an instrument of public policy”.
english:
***

Our Constitution renounce war, in Article II, Section 2, “as an instrument of public policy”.

text: So, ngaa gid makig-gyera kita sa China.
english: So, why would we go to war with China.

text: Kon makig-away gid man kita, ina lang sa isa ka defensive war.
english: If we do fight, it will only be in a defensive war.

text: Tungod indi luyag makig-gyera ang aton sadto Presidente Aquino, alang-alang man nga magmato-mato ang US mag-declare war sa iya lang luyag.
english: Because our former President Aquino did not want to go to war, the US should declare war on its own.

text: Luyag lang ni Aquino nga husayon ang ila gumontang sa malinong nga paagi.
english: Aquino just wants to resolve their dispute peacefully.

text: Gin-ugyunan man ining tindug ni Aquino sang US samtang nagapasalig nga indi ini pabay-an ang Filipinas kon atakehon gid man sang China sa diin man nga bahin sang iya teritoryo.
english: Aquino's position was also supported by the US while assuring that it would not abandon the Philippines if China attacked any part of its territory.

text: Ugaling lang kay indi gid luyag magpahusay ang China kag sige gihapon ang iya pamahog, gani nag-file na si Aquino sang kaso sa Hague Tribunal sadtong Hunyo 2013 agud i-declare nga “invalid” ang claim sang China.
english: However, because China did not want to settle and continued to threaten, Aquino filed a case with the Hague Tribunal in June 2013 to declare China's claim "invalid".

text: Tinindugan man sini ang aton kinamatarong sa West Philippine Sea, sa Scarborough kag iban pa nga lugar sa South China Sea nga may claim kita.
english: It also upholds our rights in the West Philippine Sea, in Scarborough and other areas in the South China Sea where we have a claim.

text: Salamat kay nagdaug ang aton kaso sa Hague Tribunal sa “ruling” sini sadtong Hulyo 2016.
english: Thankfully, our case was won by the Hague Tribunal in its ruling in July 2016.

text:
***

Gin-declare sang Hague Tribunal nga “invalid” kag “illegal” ang claim sang China sa idalom sang iya kuno “historic rights” sa South China Sea.
english:
***

The Hague Tribunal declared China’s claim under its supposed “historic rights” in the South China Sea “invalid” and “illegal”.

text: Sakop kuno ini sang ila territorial sea sa sulod sang nine-dash-line nga ila ginhimo sa mapa, nga daw sa submarino pa nila gin-drowing sa galumpat-lumpat nga terrain sa idalom tubig.
english: It is supposed to be part of their territorial sea within the nine-dash-line they made on the map, as if they had drawn it in a submarine in the rugged underwater terrain.

text: Gin-legitimize man sang Hague Tribunal ang 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) sang Filipinas nga gin-prescibe sang UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) sa sobra 160 ka myembro sini.
english: The Hague Tribunal also legitimized the Philippines' 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) prescribed by the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to its more than 160 members.

text: Sakop sining EEZ naton, sunu sa Hague Tribunal, ang mga uru-isla sa Spratly nga nagalakip sang Pag-asa Island, ang Scarborough Shoal, kag iban pa sa West Philippine Sea nga nahamtang sa SCS.
english: This EEZ includes, according to the Hague Tribunal, the Spratly islands that include Pag-asa Island, the Scarborough Shoal, and others in the West Philippine Sea located in the SCS.

text: Ginsiling sini nga ining mga uru-isla sa West Philippine Sea kag ang Scarborough Shoal indi matuod-tuod nga mga isla, gani wala ini sila sang territorial sea nga pwede masakop sa sulod sang aton EEZ sa SCS.
english: He said that these islands in the West Philippine Sea and the Scarborough Shoal are not true islands, so they do not have a territorial sea that can be covered within our EEZ in the SCS.

text: Dapat tani ma-recognize ini sang China bilang signatory man sang UNCLOS kaupod ang Filipinas.
english: China should recognize this as a signatory of UNCLOS along with the Philippines.

text: Ugaling lang kay nagapatig-a gid ang China kag wala nagakilala sining “ruling” sang Hague Tribunal.
english: However, China is very stubborn and does not recognize this “ruling” of the Hague Tribunal.

text: Tungod sini nagapabilin nga problema naton ini kon paano ma-implementar ang aton sovereign rights sa Scarborough kag sa mga uru-isla sa Spratly kag iban pa nga mga “rocks, kag low-tide elevations” sa sulod sang aton EEZ.
english: Therefore, it remains our problem how to implement our sovereign rights in Scarborough and the Spratly islands and other “rocks, and low-tide elevations” within our EEZ.

text: Man, wala sing organo ang United Nations nga makapatuman sining “ruling” sang Hague Tribunal.
english: Also, the United Nations has no organ that can enforce this “ruling” of the Hague Tribunal.

text: Dapat gid lang anay seguro nga mangin vigilant gid kita batok sa posible nga pag-atake sang China ukon sin-o man nga nagapangontra sa aton lehitimo nga interes diri./PN
english: We should be vigilant against possible attacks by China or anyone who opposes our legitimate interests here./PN

text: Atensyon sa tanan nga mahilig magluto!
english: Attention all cooks!

text: Sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga pandemya, ang iban nag-ala ‘professional chef’ na sa ila tagsa ka mga balay bangud sa pagtuon sang nagkalain-lain nga mga recipe halin sa internet.
english: In the midst of the ongoing pandemic, some have become professional chefs in their own homes by learning various recipes from the internet.

text: Apang ang imo pagluto kag pagpreparar sang pagkaon sa aga, udto kag hapon ang indi lamang makabulong sa imo kagutom.
english: But your cooking and meal prep in the morning, lunch and dinner alone will not cure your hunger.

text: Suno kay Dr. John Moore, senior health specialist sa Pennsylvania sa Estados Unidos, ang pagluto kag pagtuon sang mga recipe ang makapaboost sang mental kag physical health.
english: According to Dr. John Moore, senior health specialist in Pennsylvania in the United States, cooking and learning recipes can boost mental and physical health.

text: Pahayag ni Moore, ang pagluto kag pagtuon sang bag-o nga recipe ang isa ka stimulating activity nga makahatag sang powerful cognitive benefits sa utok.
english: Moore said cooking and learning new recipes is a stimulating activity that can provide powerful cognitive benefits to the brain.

text: Ang pagluto suno kay Moore ang makapasangkad man sang self-confidence bangud nagahatag ini sang sense of independence sa isa ka tawo nga magpili sang ingredients nga kihadon kag panakot nga ilakot sa linuto.
english: Cooking, Moore said, can also boost self-confidence because it gives a person a sense of independence to choose the ingredients to choose and spices to add to the dish.

text: Pabor man ang pagluto suno sa doktor sa mga tigulang bangud isa ini sa pamaagi nga mangin busy, focused kag alerto sa gihapon ang ila paminsaron samtang naga-enjoy sa pagluto sang paborito nga sud-an ukon recipe.
english: The doctor said cooking is also favored by the elderly because it is one of the ways to keep their minds busy, focused and alert while enjoying cooking their favorite dishes or recipes.

text: Ginpasalig ni Finance Secretary Ralph Recto nga madamo na sila sang ginatun-an nga mas istrikto nga mga pagsulundan agud nga mas ma-regulate pa gid sang gobyerno ang online gambling.
english: Finance Secretary Ralph Recto assured that they are already studying stricter rules so that the government can further regulate online gambling.

text: Isa sa ginalantaw suno sa tiglikom amo ang pagpasaka sang buwis.
english: One of the issues, according to the secretary, is the increase in taxes.

text: Ginakonsiderar man ang pagtugyan sini sa Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) nga amo ang makapasaka sang fees and charges nga ginakolekta sini sa online games.
english: It is also considering handing it over to the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) which will increase the fees and charges it collects on online games.

text: Kun pasakaan ang buwis sang 10% suno sa opisyal base sa gross gaming revenue, makakolekta ang gobyerno sang dugang nga P20 billion kada tuig.
english: If the tax is increased by 10% based on gross gaming revenue, the government will collect an additional P20 billion annually.

text: Lakip sa iban nga ginaproponer amo ang pagdumili sa mga opisyal sang gobyerno sa pagpasakop sa online gambling, pag-display sang mga paandam sa risgo sang gambling, kag paggamit sang national ID agud masiguro nga ang 21-anyos panubo nga mga indibidwal ang indi maka-access sa online gaming sites.
english: Among others proposed are banning government officials from engaging in online gambling, displaying warnings on the risks of gambling, and using national ID to ensure that individuals under 21 years of age cannot access online gaming sites.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagakolekta ang PAGCOR sang 30% rate sa e-gaming platforms, samtang nagasukot naman ang Bureau of Internal Revenue sang dugang nga 5% franchise tax kag 3% auditing fee rason nga nagalab-ot ang total effective rate sa 38%.
english: PAGCOR collects a 30% rate from e-gaming platforms, while the Bureau of Internal Revenue charges an additional 5% franchise tax and 3% auditing fee, bringing the total effective rate to 38%.

text: Lauman nga makay-o na buwas nga adlaw, Nobyembre 30 ang technical issues sa pila ka models sang Airbus aircraft nga nagresulta sa kanselasyon kag pagka-delay sang pila ka mga domestic flight sa Pilipinas, suno sa Air Carriers Association of the Philippines (ACAP) subong nga Sabado.
english: Technical issues in some models of Airbus aircraft that resulted in the cancellation and delay of some domestic flights in the Philippines are expected to be repaired tomorrow, November 30, according to the Air Carriers Association of the Philippines (ACAP) this Saturday.

text: Ini matapos mag-isyu ang Airbus sang technical advisory para sa pila ka Airbus models sini nga A320/A31 para magpaidalom sa software update.
english: This comes after Airbus issued a technical advisory for some Airbus models of its A320/A31 to undergo a software update.

text: Gin-report ni ACAP executive director Jose Enriquez Perez de Tagle, 50% halin sa mga apektado nga aircraft ang natapos na nga mag-update sang ila software.
english: ACAP executive director Jose Enriquez Perez de Tagle reported that 50% of the affected aircraft have already completed updating their software.

text: Isa ka aircraft naman suno sa iya ang kinahanglan sang duha ka oras para matapos ang pag-upgrade ukon pag-update sang software sini.
english: Another aircraft, he said, needs two hours to complete the upgrade or update of its software.

text: Una na nga ginsiling ni Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez, yara sa 75 aircraft ang naapektuhan sa software update, nga nagresulta sa pagkanselar sang 78 domestic flights kag pagka-delay sang iban pa nga flights.
english: Earlier, Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez said 75 aircraft were affected by the software update, which resulted in the cancellation of 78 domestic flights and delays in other flights.

text: Suno naman sa ACAP executive director, 24 hours halin subong, amat-amat na nga mabalik ang nakanselr nga operasyon sang airlines.
english: According to the ACAP executive director, 24 hours from now, the canceled operations of the airlines will gradually resume.

text: Samtang, sa oras naman nga makumpleto na ang software update, kinahanglan sang mga airline nga magsumiter sang compliance report angot sa airworthiness sang eroplano para mahatagan sang clearance nga liwat makalupad.
english: Meanwhile, once the software update is complete, airlines will need to submit a compliance report on the airworthiness of the aircraft to be given clearance to fly again.

text:
Siling nila, “the more, the merrier.”

Amo gid ini ang sitwasyon sa isa ka balay kun sa diin naga-istar ang identical twin sisters nga nakapamana man sang identical twin brothers.
english:
They say, “the more, the merrier.”

This is exactly the situation in a house where identical twin sisters who are also married to identical twin brothers live.

text: Ang kapid nga babaye amo sanday Brittany kag Briana Deane.
english: The twin sister is Brittany and Briana Deane.

text: Humalin sang bata pa, nakaandan na nila nga pareho sila sa tanan nga bagay amo man sa ila hilig.
english: From an early age, they were used to being the same in everything and in their hobbies.

text: 2017 sang nagkadto sila sa Twins Day Festival sa Twinsburg, Ohio kun sa diin may biological twins, triples, quads, kag madamo pa.
english: 2017 when they went to the Twins Day Festival in Twinsburg, Ohio where there were biological twins, triples, quads, and more.

text: Didto nila nakilala ang ila makabig soulmates nga sanday Josh kag Jeremy Salyers nga pareho sa ila, kapid man.
english: There they met their soulmates Josh and Jeremy Salyers who, like them, were also twins.

text: Wala na ginpadugay bangud makaligad ang isa ka tuig, ginkasal si Briana kay Jeremy kag si Brittany kay Josh.
english: It wasn't delayed because a year later, Briana was married to Jeremy and Brittany to Josh.

text: Ang amazing pa gid amo nga gindungan ang seremonya sa ila nga kasal.
english: What's even more amazing is that the ceremony coincided with their wedding.

text: Kag ang mas amazing amo nga nag-istar sila sa isa lang ka balay sa Bedford County, Virginia!
english: And what’s even more amazing is that they lived in the same house in Bedford County, Virginia!

text: Sa subong, palareho na sila nga parents.
english: Now, they are both parents.

text: Sanday Brittany kag Josh ang may anak nga si Jett, samtang may Jax naman subong sanday Jeremy kag Briana.
english: Brittany and Josh have a son named Jett, while Jeremy and Briana now have Jax.

text: Pareho nga tatlo ka tuig na subong ang edad sang mga bata.
english: Both kids are now three years old.

text: Technically, magpakaisa sanday Jett kag Jax, apang bangud sa ila nga unique situation nga pareho nga identical twins ang ila nga mga ginikanan, ang duha ka bata ang makabig nga genetic brothers.
english: Technically, Jett and Jax are cousins, but due to their unique situation of being identical twins, the two children are considered genetic brothers.

text: Ang tawag diri amo ang quaternary twins bangud ang duha ka sets sang parents ang may pareho lang nga DNA.
english: They are called quaternary twins because both sets of parents share the same DNA.

text: Samtang nagadaku ang mga bata, mas labi man sila nga naga-close kag daw kaangay nga kapid man kaangay sa ila nga parents!
english: As children grow older, they become closer and more like their parents!

text: (Photo: salyerstwins via New York Post)
english: (Photo: salyerstwins via New York Post)

text: Gin-insister sang isa ka House leader nga indi dapat pagbalewalaon ang pahayag ni former President Rodrigo Duterte kaangot sa pagpatay sa mga senador.
english: Gin-insister sang isa ka House leader nga indi dapat pagbalewalaon ang pahayag ni former President Rodrigo Duterte kaangot sa pagpatay sa mga senador.

text: Suno kay House of Representatives Assistant Majority Leader kag Tingong Party-list Representative Jude Acidre, ang pagpahog sa public officials — bisan lahog man ukon indi — ang mahimo makabig nga krimen sa idalom sang laye sang Pilipinas.
english: According to House of Representatives Assistant Majority Leader and Tingong Party-list Representative Jude Acidre, intimidation of public officials — whether joking or not — can be considered a crime under Philippine law.

text: Mahimo ini maangot sa inciting to sedition ukon grave threats kag may mga penalidad suno pa sa mamalidha.
english: This can be linked to inciting to sedition or grave threats and there are penalties, the lawmaker said.

text: Kun balikan, sa proclamation rally sang senatorial slate sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino – Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban), nag-joke si Duterte nga pangpatyon ang 15 ka mga senador para nga may bakante nga mga pwesto nga mahimo buslan sang iya mga kandidato.
english: In the proclamation rally of the senatorial slate of the Philippine Democratic Party – Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban), Duterte joked that he would kill 15 senators so that there would be vacancies that could be filled by his candidates.

text: Ang reelectionists nga sanday Christopher “Bong” Go kag Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa nga long-time allies sang mga Duterte ang nalakip sa lista sang senador nga gina-endorso sang anay punong ehekutibo para sa eleksyon.
english: Reelectionists Christopher “Bong” Go and Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, long-time allies of the Dutertes, are included in the list of senators endorsed by the former chief executive for the election.

text: Para naman kay Acidre, ang pamahog sang violence ang katumbas sa pamahog sa seguridad kag naga-promote pa sang culture of violence.
english: For Acidre, the threat of violence is equivalent to a threat to security and promotes a culture of violence.

text: “Hindi lang ito basta padalos-dalos na salita—krimen ito sa ilalim ng batas.
english: “It's not just a word—it's a crime under the law.

text: Ang pagbabanta sa mga opisyal ng gobyerno ay maituturing na inciting to sedition o grave threats, at may kaakibat na parusa,” kabahin sang statement sang mamalidha.
english: Threats against government officials can be considered inciting to sedition or grave threats, and carry associated penalties,” the lawmaker said in a statement.

text:
“Hindi puwedeng balewalain ito kasi nagdadala ito ng tunay na banta sa seguridad, at napipilitan ang gobyerno na gumastos ng pondo at magpakilos ng pulis at militar para tugunan ang banta, kahit pa sinasabi nilang biro lang ito.”

Ginpahayag man sini nga ang statement ni Duterte ang salamin gid sa ginhimo sang iya anak nga si Vice President Sara Duterte nga nagpahog man nga patyon sanday President Ferdinand “Bongbong” R. Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta – Marcos, kag House Speaker Martin Romualdez pananglitan may magpatay sa iya.
english:
“It cannot be ignored because it poses a real threat to security, and the government is forced to spend funds and mobilize the police and military to address the threat, even if they say it is a joke.”

He also said that Duterte's statement is a mirror of the actions of his daughter, Vice President Sara Duterte, who also threatened to kill President Ferdinand “Bongbong” R. Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, and House Speaker Martin Romualdez if someone kills him.

text: Matandaan nga gin-impeach na sang Kamara ang bise-presidente kag ginahulat naman ang mangin trial sa senado.
english: The House of Representatives has already impeached the vice-president and is awaiting trial in the Senate.

text: 240 ka mga mamalidha ang nagpabor sa impeachment complaint nga nagpasaka sini sa upper chamber.#
english: 240 lawmakers voted in favor of the impeachment complaint that was filed in the upper chamber.

text: Nagapati si US President Joe Biden nga indi lang Ukraine ang tuyo sang Russia sang ginpatigayon sini ang full-scale invasion.
english: US President Joe Biden believes that Russia's full-scale invasion was not just aimed at Ukraine.

text: Ginpasibangdan ni Biden si Russian President Vladimir Putin nga may daku nga ambisyon nga amo ang pag-establisyar liwat sang former Soviet Union.
english: Biden blamed Russian President Vladimir Putin who has the grand ambition of re-establishing the former Soviet Union.

text: Sa iya speech sa White House, ginpahayag man ni Biden nga ang bag-o nga sanction nga iya gin-impose sa Russia.
english: In his speech at the White House, Biden also said that the new sanctions he imposed on Russia.

text: Target sang sanctions ang apat ka bangko sang Russia nga may kabug-usan nga $1 trillion nga assets lakip na ang pinakadaku nga bangko sang Russia; buot silingon sini, ma-freeze ang ila assets sa Amerika.
english: The sanctions target four Russian banks with a total of $1 trillion in assets including Russia’s largest bank; this means that their assets in America will be frozen.

text: Target man sang sanctions ang manggaranon nga mga Russians nga malapit gid mismo kay Putin.
english: The sanctions also target wealthy Russians who are close to Putin himself.

text: Gin-anunsyo man sini nga may bag-o nga deployment sang pwersa kag air forces sa eastern flank sang NATO.
english: He also announced a new deployment of forces and air forces on NATO's eastern flank.

text: Gin-athag ni Biden nga ang ila deployment ang indi para sa away sa Ukraine kundi para pangapinan ang ila kaalyado sa NATO.
english: Biden made it clear that their deployment was not for the fight in Ukraine but to defend their NATO ally.

text: Nagpamalibad ang Malacañang nga maghatag sang komento sa pinakaulihi nga mga tirade ukon palabtik nga ginhimo ni anay President Rodrigo Duterte batok sa administrasyon ni President Ferdinand “Bong-bong” Marcos, Jr.
english: Malacañang declined to comment on the latest tirades or jokes made by former President Rodrigo Duterte against the administration of President Ferdinand “Bong-bong” Marcos, Jr.

text: Ini kasunod man sa pagpangayo sang katapo sang media sa palasyo sang komento halin Presidential Communications Office (PCO) sa pinakaulihi nga pahayag ni Duterte, partikular ang iya sentimyento sa mataas nga presyo sang bugas.
english: This follows a member of the media at the palace asking for comment from the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) on Duterte's latest statement, particularly his sentiments on the high price of rice.

text: Liwat man nga gin-swipe ni Duterte si Presidente Marcos Jr., liwat nga gin-akusahan ang chief executive nga nagagamit sang iligal nga droga.
english: Duterte also took a swipe at President Marcos Jr., again accusing the chief executive of using illegal drugs.

text: Ginhimo ni Duterte ang mga tirades sa iya pagtambong sa proclamation rally sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino (PDP) Laban sa Club Filipino, sa diin ginbayaw niya ang mga kamot sang iya mga gina-endorso sa opening salvo sang ila kampanya.
english: Duterte made the tirades when he attended the proclamation rally of the Democratic Party of the Philippines (PDP) against the Filipino Club, where he raised the hands of his endorsees in the opening salvo of their campaign.

text: Suno kay Duterte, si Marcos isa ka Presidente nga high sa droga kag indi siya buang pero long-term ang epekto sa droga.
english: According to Duterte, Marcos is a President who is high on drugs and he is not crazy but the effects of drugs are long-term.

text: Gintumod man sini nga mabuang si Marcos sa dalayon nga paggamit sang heroin kag alab-ot niya ang 80 pero pag-abot sina nga tion, indi na siya makahulag.
english: He also pointed out that Marcos will go crazy with the constant use of heroin and he will reach 80 but when that time comes, he will not be able to move.

text: Sang Enero 2024, gintawag man ni Duterte si Marcos nga “bangag,” kag ginbawi ini sang masunod nga bulan, nga nagasiling nga wala gid niya gin-akusahan si Marcos nga naga-intra sa ilegal nga droga.
english: In January 2024, Duterte also called Marcos a “hole,” and retracted it the following month, saying he never accused Marcos of being involved in illegal drugs.

text: Sang ginpamangkot kon ano ang reaksyon ni Marcos, siya nagsiling, nga anay presidente ang nagagamit sang fentanyl.
english: When asked what Marcos' reaction was, he said, that the former president uses fentanyl.

text: Suno kay Marcos, ang mga manugbulong ukon physicians ang dapat mag-atipan sa kay Duterte.
english: According to Marcos, doctors or physicians should take care of Duterte.

text: Desidido ang Iloilo City Government nga tapuson na lang ang pag-rehabilitate sang Mandurriao Public Market.
english: The Iloilo City Government is determined to complete the rehabilitation of the Mandurriao Public Market.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Jerry Treñas nga nakalab-ot sa iya igtalupangod nga posible nga wala na sang budget ang Iloilo City District Engineering Office para sa proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Jerry Treñas said it has come to his attention that the Iloilo City District Engineering Office may no longer have a budget for the project.

text: Suno sa alkalde, istoryahon niya ang Department of Public Works and Highways tuhoy diri.
english: The mayor said he will talk to the Department of Public Works and Highways about it.

text: Pahayag niya, kun makumpirma nga wala na gid man sang budget, hingyuon nalang niya sa ahensya nga i-turn-over ang proyekto sa syudad agud mapangitaan sang pondo kag makompleto na ang pagpakay-o sang amo nga merkado.
english: He said that if it is confirmed that there is no budget, he will ask the agency to turn over the project to the city so that funds can be found and the renovation of the market can be completed.

text: Pasidunggan sang Ukraine ang mga border guards sa Snake Island nga ginpatay matapos nagpamalibad nga mag-surrender sa Russian war ship sa Black Sea.
english: Ukraine will honor border guards on Snake Island who were killed after refusing to surrender to a Russian war ship in the Black Sea.

text: Suno kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, iga-isyu niya ang posthumous honors sa security forces bangud makabig sila nga baganihan.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he would issue posthumous honors to the security forces because they would be considered heroes.

text: Nag-guwa naman subong ang isa ka audio clip nga amo ang ginapahayag nagaunod sang paandam sang Russian warship sa Ukrainian soldiers nga amo ang nagabantay sa Snake Island sa Black Sea.
english: An audio clip has now emerged that allegedly contains a warning from a Russian warship to Ukrainian soldiers guarding Snake Island in the Black Sea.

text: Matapos ang ila pagpakatig-a nga magsurrender, nagpalupok ang Russians.
english: After their stubbornness to surrender, the Russians opened fire.

text: 13 ka mga guards ang napatay.
english: 13 guards were killed.

text: Ang Snake Island ang yara nahamtang sa southeast border sang Ukraine.
english: Snake Island is located on the southeast border of Ukraine.

text: Gin-atake ini sang Hwebes nga adlaw.
english: It was attacked on Thursday.

text: Sandig sa report sang Ukrainian media, duha ka naval vessels ang nagpalapit sa mga guards.
english: According to Ukrainian media reports, two naval vessels approached the guards.

text: Sa transcript sang audio exchange, nabatian ang isa sa Russian ships nga nag-radyo sa outpost sang mga guard.
english: In the transcript of the audio exchange, one of the Russian ships could be heard radioing the guards’ outpost.

text: “This is a Russian warship, I repeat.
english: “This is a Russian warship, I repeat.

text: I suggest you surrender your weapons and capitulate otherwise I will open fire.
english: I suggest you surrender your weapons and capitulate otherwise I will open fire.

text: Do you copy?” suno sa Russian ship.
english: Do you copy?” according to the Russian ship.

text: Sunod nga nabatian ang isa ka Ukrainian guard.
english: A Ukrainian guard was heard next.

text:
Ang siling, “This is it.” Pagkatapos, ginpamangkot sini ang isa man ka guard: “Should I tell him to go f*ck himself?”

May isa man ka guard nga nagsabat, “Just in case.” Sunod nga nag-radyo ang una nga guard: “Russian warship, go f*ck yourself.”

May yara man sang isa ka short video sa amo nga insidente nga nagguwa man subong sa social media.
english:
The saying, “This is it.” Afterwards, he asked another guard: “Should I tell him to go f*ck himself?”

Another guard replied, “Just in case.” The first guard radioed next: “Russian warship, go f*ck yourself.”

There is also a short video on the incident which has also now surfaced on social media.

text: Makit-an diri ang duha ka soldado nga yara man sa Snake Island kag naga-livestream sang natabo.
english: It shows two soldiers who were also on Snake Island livestreaming the incident.

text: Nagasuksok ang mga soldado sang military helmets.
english: The soldiers were wearing military helmets.

text: Sunod nga nabatian ang paglupok, nagsinggit ang isa, kag napatay ang video.
english: An explosion is heard next, someone screams, and the video turns off.

text: Sang ulihi, ginkumpirma sang otoridad nga patay gid ang tanan nga guards sa Snake Island.
english: Authorities later confirmed that all the guards on Snake Island were dead.

text: Sa Ukraine, ginatawag ang amo nga isla nga Zmiinyi Island.
english: In Ukraine, the island is called Zmiinyi Island.

text: Ginahulat pa sang Iloilo City Council ang iga-isyu nga rekomendasyon sang City Legal Office (CLO) may kaangtanan sa halos duha ka tuig na nga ginsuguran nga inisyatibo agud i- review ang Joint Venture Agreement (JVA) para sa Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal Services (GIFTS) sa Parola Wharf.
english: The Iloilo City Council is still waiting for the recommendation of the City Legal Office (CLO) regarding the almost two-year-old initiative to review the Joint Venture Agreement (JVA) for the Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal Services (GIFTS) at Parola Wharf.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, chairman sang Committee on Transportation, iya ginpahayag nga wala pa nakagwa ang legal office sang rekomendasyon sa nagakaigo nga legal nga tikang angot sa ginaalegar kapaslawan sang Double Dragon Properties Corporation nga magtuman sa mga probisyon sang agreement.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, chairman of the Committee on Transportation, said the legal office has not yet issued a recommendation on appropriate legal action regarding the alleged failure of Double Dragon Properties Corporation to comply with the provisions of the agreement.
