text: Suno kay Cabaluna, base sa mga dokumento nga ila ginauyatan, kinahanglan gid ang mas maid-id nga review bangud nagagwa nga madamo sang disbentaha mga madul-ong sa syudad ang kasugtanan.
english: According to Cabaluna, based on the documents they are holding, a more thorough review is needed because it turns out that there are many disadvantages when the agreement is brought to the city.

text: Matandaan nga sang Marso 2023, nag-request ang City Council sang Legal Office nga i- review ang probisyon kag i-assess ang pagtuman sang magtimbang nga bahin agud mahibaluan kun kinahanglan ang liwat nga negosasyon ukon ang pag-revoke sang kontrata.
english: It can be recalled that in March 2023, the City Council requested the Legal Office to review the provision and assess the compliance of both parties to determine whether renegotiation or revocation of the contract is necessary.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa committee report, pila sa mga nakit-an nga concerns amo ang masunod: ang gina-remit sang Double Dragon ang tuman ka nubo kun ipaanggid sa volume sang pasahero; napaslawan ang Double Dragon nga mag-account sang insakto sang share sang syudad sa ginakita sang terminal; kag ang kapaslawan sang tiglawas sang Double Dragon nga magtambong sa committee hearings nga ginpatawag sang City Council sa pila ka mga kahigayunan.
english: It is known that in the committee report, some of the concerns identified are as follows: the remittance of Double Dragon is very low compared to the volume of passengers; Double Dragon failed to properly account for the city's share of terminal revenue; and the failure of the Double Dragon representative to attend committee hearings convened by the City Council on several occasions.

text: Pahayag sang konsehal, indi makapadayon sa imbestigasyon kun wala sang legal nga bulig halin sa Legal Office.
english: The councilor said the investigation cannot continue without legal assistance from the Legal Office.

text: Tuig 2012 sang ginpirmahan ang Joint Venture Agreement kun sa diin nasaad ang paghatag sang syudad sang exclusive 25-year rights sa Double Dragon nga i- develop kag i- operate ang 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.
english: In 2012, a Joint Venture Agreement was signed in which the city promised to grant Double Dragon exclusive 25-year rights to develop and operate the 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.

text: Sa kasugtanan, nasaad ang share sang syudad nga 1-5% sang gross terminal fee revenues, 1% sang gross berthing fee revenues, 1% sang gross cargo fee revenues, kag 1% sang gross rental revenue.
english: The agreement stipulates the city's share of 1-5% of gross terminal fee revenues, 1% of gross berthing fee revenues, 1% of gross cargo fee revenues, and 1% of gross rental revenues.

text: May urgent call man si Cabaluna kay Mayor Jerry Treñas nga bisitahon ang mga probisyon sang amo nga agreement.
english: Cabaluna also urgently called on Mayor Jerry Treñas to visit the provisions of the agreement.

text: Nahuman ang agreement sang tion sang administrasyon ni former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.
english: The agreement was completed during the administration of former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.

text: ILOILO CITY- Asud-asod na nga pagsigabong ang nabatian sang mga tawo sa pila ka syudad sa Ukraine.
english: ILOILO CITY – People in several cities in Ukraine have heard loud explosions.

text: Ini kasunod sang pag-anunsyo ni Russian President Vladimir Putin sang military operation sa Ukraine agud depensahan ang mga separatists sa nasidlangan nga bahin sang pungsod nga ginatawag nga Donbas region.
english: This follows Russian President Vladimir Putin announcing a military operation in Ukraine to defend separatists in the eastern part of the country known as the Donbas region.

text: Sa statement sang Ukrainian interior ministry, gina-target sang rocket attacks sang Russia ang Ukrainian fighter jets sa airport sa gwa sang Kyiv, ang kapital sang Ukraine.
english: In a statement, the Ukrainian interior ministry said Russian rocket attacks were targeting Ukrainian fighter jets at the airport outside Kyiv, the Ukrainian capital.

text: Pahayag naman sang state emergency service, ginlunsar ang mga atake batok sa 10 ka Ukrainian regions, ilabi na sa east kag south sang pungsod.
english: The state emergency service said the attacks were launched against 10 Ukrainian regions, mainly in the east and south of the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino direkta sa Ukraine, iya ginpahayag nga isa siya sa madamo nga mga tawo sa Kyiv,ang capital city sang Ukraine, nga nagbiya na sa syudad agud magpadulong sa mga lugar nga malayo sa mga area nga mahimo malab-ot sang Russian invasion.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino said she is one of many people in Kyiv, Ukraine's capital city, who have left the city to go to areas far from the areas that could be reached by the Russian invasion.

text: Suno kay Tolentino, kada 20 tubtob 30 minutos, mabatian ang matunog nga paglinupok sang missile.
english: According to Tolentino, every 20 to 30 minutes, a loud missile explosion can be heard.

text: Kasunod sang pagsalakay sang Russia, gilayon naman nga nagpaandam si US President Joe Biden sang konsekwensiya para sa Russia kag ginsiling nga dako ang salabton sang Russia bangud sa nangin tikang sini nga pat-ud nga magaresulta sa kamatayon sang madamo nga tawo kag pag-antos sang katawhan.
english: Following the Russian invasion, US President Joe Biden immediately warned of consequences for Russia and said that Russia is responsible for its actions that will surely result in the deaths of many people and human suffering.

text: Suno naman sa secretary general sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization nga si Jens Stoltenberg, magatingob ang mga magkaalyado nga pungsod agud nga atubangon ang posible resulta sang agresibo nga tikang sang Russia.
english: North Atlantic Treaty Organization secretary general Jens Stoltenberg said the allies will work together to deal with the possible consequences of Russia's aggressive move.

text: May gindihon nga proposal ang Committee on Transportation sang City Council kaupod ang mga stakeholders para solusyunan ang magutok nga sitwasyon sang trapiko sa syudad.
english: The Committee on Transportation of the City Council together with stakeholders has developed a proposal to solve the traffic situation in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, iya ginpahayag nga sa 22 ka mga ginakabig nga choke areas sa syudad, tatlo ka chokepoints ang ila tutukan sa amo nga proposal.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Councilor Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, he said that out of the 22 choke areas in the city, three chokepoints will be focused on in the proposal.

text: Ini ginalakipan sang Tagbak, Jaro malapit sa terminal; Atrium/Capitol Area/Arroyo Fountain; kag Molo Plaza.
english: These include Tagbak, Jaro near the terminal; Atrium/Capitol Area/Arroyo Fountain; and Molo Plaza.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna, kabahin sang mga proposals ang pag-convert sang pila ka one- way streets agud mangin two-way.
english: According to Cabaluna, part of the proposals is the conversion of some one-way streets to two-way.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ka public hearing kag consultation ang ginpatigayon para sa traffic management plan kun sa diin kaupod diri ang City Planning and Development Office, Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) kag iban pa.
english: A public hearing and consultation was held for the traffic management plan involving the City Planning and Development Office, Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) and others.

text: Natapos na ang public hearing para sa proposed scheme sa Tagbak, Jaro malapit sa terminal kag Atrium/Capitol Area/Arroyo Fountain.
english: The public hearing for the proposed scheme in Tagbak, Jaro near the terminal and Atrium/Capitol Area/Arroyo Fountain has been completed.

text: Igasunod naman ang Molo Plaza sa masunod nga mga inadlaw para sa consultation sa mga apektado nga mga sektor ilabi na ang riding public.
english: Molo Plaza will be followed in the coming days for consultation with the affected sectors especially the riding public.

text: Ginalauman ng ibaligya sang India sa Pilipinas ang mga short-range missiles sini subong nga tuig paagi sa isa ka kasugtanan nga nagabalor sang masobra $200 million.
english: India is expected to sell its short-range missiles to the Philippines this year through a deal worth more than $200 million.

text: Ini ang ikaduha nga major defense export contract sang India kaupod ang Pilipinas sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga tension batok sa China.
english: This is India's second major defense export contract with the Philippines amid ongoing tensions against China.

text: Ginatawag ini nga Akash missile system nga gin-develop sang defense research body sang India kun sa diin gilayon nga nagpabutyag sang interes diri ang Pilipinas.
english: It is called the Akash missile system developed by India's defense research body where the Philippines immediately expressed interest in it.

text: Ini nga surface-to-air missile system nga may range sang tubtob sa 25 km (16 miles) ang na-export sa Armenia sang 2024 paagi sa $230-million deal apang mas mangin mahal naman ang presyo nga ibaligya sa Pilipinas.
english: This surface-to-air missile system with a range of up to 25 km (16 miles) was exported to Armenia in 2024 through a $230-million deal but will be more expensive to sell in the Philippines.

text:
Wala naman gindetalye ang numero sang missiles kalakip na ang accompanying systems kaangay sang radars

Ini nga deal amo ang kasunod man sang $375-million sale sang India sang mid-range BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles sa Pilipinas sang 2022.
english:
The number of missiles including accompanying systems such as radars was not detailed

This deal also follows India’s $375-million sale of mid-range BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles to the Philippines in 2022.

text: Gindeklarar na ang state of emergency sa Ukraine kadungan sang abiso sa mga pumuluyo sini nga yara pa subong sa Russia nga magbiya na sa amo nga pungsod.
english: A state of emergency has been declared in Ukraine along with a warning to its citizens still in Russia to leave the country.

text: Ang 30 ka adlaw nga state of emergency amo ang makadumili sa hulag sang conscripted reservists kag magapahanugot man sang personal document checks.
english: The 30-day state of emergency will restrict the movement of conscripted reservists and will also allow personal document checks.

text: Sandig ini sa draft text nga aprubahan pa sang parliament.
english: This is based on the draft text that will be approved by parliament.

text: Ang restrictions naman ang ginalauman nga maga-take effect subong nga Huwebes.
english: The restrictions are expected to take effect this Thursday.

text: Gin-anunsyo man sang Ukrainian Government ang compulsory military service para sa mga lalaki para sa ila nga ginahandaan nga away batok sa Russia.
english: The Ukrainian Government has also announced compulsory military service for men for their upcoming fight against Russia.

text: Ini nga desisyon ang kasunod sang pagkilala ni Russian President Vladimir Putin sa independence sang duha ka rebel regions subong nga semana.
english: The decision follows Russian President Vladimir Putin's recognition of the independence of the two rebel regions this week.

text: Nagmandu man si Putin sang pag-deploy sang tropa sang Russia sa amo nga mga rehiyon sa Ukraine agud nga mag-akto bilang mga peacekeepers.
english: Putin also ordered the deployment of Russian troops to such regions in Ukraine to act as peacekeepers.

text: Wala pa subong sang maathag nga indikasyon kun may idugang pa gid nga pwersa militar sa Ukraine.
english: There is currently no clear indication of whether more military forces will be added to Ukraine.

text:
‘MAGBIYA NA’

Ginabanta 3 million sang mga citizens sang Ukraine ang yara sa Russia kag amo subong ang ginaabisuhan nga magpauli.
english:
‘LEAVE NOW’

An estimated 3 million Ukrainian citizens are in Russia and are now being advised to return home.

text: Sa statement nga gin-release sang Ukrainian foreign ministry, ginpanawagan man sini ang ila nga citizens nga indi na magbyahe padulong sa Russia.
english: In a statement released by the Ukrainian foreign ministry, it also called on its citizens not to travel to Russia.

text: Nagpaandam man ang Ukraine sa nagapakatig-a magbiya sa Russia nga limitado lang ang ila nga resources agud nga mabuligan ang mga Ukrainians kun halimbawa may matabo nga major diplomatic rupture.
english: Ukraine also warned those who dare to leave Russia that they have limited resources to help Ukrainians in the event of a major diplomatic rupture.

text: Liwat nga gintawag nga ‘bangag’ ni former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte once again called President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. a 'bangag'

text: Ini kadungan sabf ginhiwat naman nga proclamation rally sang Partido ng Demokratiko Pilipino (PDP) sa San Juan City.
english: This coincides with the proclamation rally of the Democratic Party of the Philippines (PDP) in San Juan City.

text: Suno sa chairman sang Partido, adik sa illegal drugs si Marcos kag mag-abot ini sa edad nga 80, pat-ud nga wala na nagahulag ang presidente.
english: According to the party chairman, Marcos is addicted to illegal drugs and when he reaches the age of 80, the president will certainly not move.

text: Sang 2024, gin-akusahan man ni Duterte si Marcos nga nagagamit sang illegal drugs.
english: In 2024, Duterte also accused Marcos of using illegal drugs.

text: Ang alegasyon nagtulod naman kay Marcos nga magbalos kag gin-akusahan ang former president nga nagagamit sang fentanyl.
english: Ang alegasyon nagtulod naman kay Marcos nga magbalos kag gin-akusahan ang former president nga nagagamit sang fentanyl.

text: Samtang, sa amo man nga rally, ginmuno man ni Duterte ang mataas nga presyo sang bugas nga, suno sa iya, nagagwa nga wala sang ikasarang si Marcos nga panubuon ini.
english: Meanwhile, at the same rally, Duterte also criticized the high price of rice which, he said, shows that Marcos does not have the ability to lower it.

text: Madumduman nga sang nagpadalagan si Marcos para sa pagka- presidente sang 2022, ginpromisa sini nga panubuon ang presyo sang bugas.
english: It can be recalled that when Marcos ran for president in 2022, he promised to reduce the price of rice.

text: ILOILO CITY- Dagdagan sang Britanya sang mabug-at nga economic sanctionsang Russia matapos ginmando na ni President Vladimir Putin ang deployment sang tropa sini sa duha ka breakaway regions sa eastern Ukraine.
english: ILOILO CITY – Britain will increase heavy economic sanctions against Russia after President Vladimir Putin ordered the deployment of its troops in two breakaway regions in eastern Ukraine.

text: Ini ang ginbuy-an nga pahayag ni British Prime Minister Boris Johnson.
english: This was released in a statement by British Prime Minister Boris Johnson.

text: Suno sa mg testigo, nakit-an ang tangke de giyera kag iban nga military hardware nga nagahulag padulong sa separatist-controlled city sang Donetsk sa eastern Ukraine.
english: According to witnesses, the tank and other military hardware were seen moving towards the separatist-controlled city of Donetsk in eastern Ukraine.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang masobra 150,000 Russian troops ang nagapalibot sa border sang Ukraine.
english: It is known that there are more than 150,000 Russian troops surrounding the Ukrainian border.

text: Nagpatawag sang emergeny Security Council meeting ang United Nations matapos nga nagmandu si Russian President Vladimir Putin sang deployment sang Russian military troops sa duha ka ginakabig breakaway regions sang Ukraine.
english: The United Nations called an emergency Security Council meeting after Russian President Vladimir Putin ordered the deployment of Russian military troops in two considered breakaway regions of Ukraine.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Putin nga ang deployment sang Russia ang para sa peacekeeping sa rebel-held Donetsk kag Luhansk regions sang Ukraine.
english: Putin had previously said the Russian deployment was for peacekeeping in the rebel-held Donetsk and Luhansk regions of Ukraine.

text: Nagapati naman si US Ambassador Linda Thomas-Greenfield, ang amu nga lihok ni Putin ang paagi agud nga makadeploy ini sang dugang nga invasion force sa border sang Ukraine.
english: US Ambassador Linda Thomas-Greenfield believes that Putin's move is a way for him to deploy more invasion forces on the Ukrainian border.

text: Pinaagi naman sa televised speech, gintawag ni Putin ang Ukraine nga “failed state” kag “puppet” sang Western countries.
english: In a televised speech, Putin called Ukraine a “failed state” and a “puppet” of Western countries.

text: Makapila ka beses naman nga gindumili-an ni Putin ang anu man nga Security Council session bilang amu ang naga-hold sang rotating presidency sang konseho apang sa gihapon ginpatigayon sang United States.
english: Putin has repeatedly banned any Security Council session as he holds the rotating presidency of the council but the United States still held it.

text: Wala naman nagpagwa sang dugang pa nga detalye ang Moscow, Russia angut sa deployment sang “peacekeeping” forces.
english: Moscow, Russia did not release further details on the deployment of peacekeeping forces.

text: Nagnubo ang numero sang mga Pinoy nga malipayon pa sa ila nga love life sandig sa resulta sang Fourth Quarter 2024 Social Weather Survey sang Social Weather Stations (SWS).
english: The number of Filipinos who are still happy with their love life has decreased according to the results of the Fourth Quarter 2024 Social Weather Survey of the Social Weather Stations (SWS).

text: Suno sa survey, 46% na lang sang mga Pilipino ang “very happy” sa love life nga amo ang pinakamanubo sa sulod sang duha ka dekada.
english: According to the survey, only 46% of Filipinos are “very happy” with their love lives, the lowest in two decades.

text: Pahayag pa sang report, 12 points ini nga mas manubo sa 58% nga na-rekord sang Disyembre 2023.
english: This is 12 points lower than the 58% recorded in December 2023, the report said.

text: Patas naman ini sa 46 percent nga na-rekord sa amo man nga survey sang 2004.
english: This is equal to 46 percent recorded in the same survey in 2004.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, 36 percent sang respondents ang nagsiling nga “could be happier” pa ang ila love life, mas mataas sa 23 percent sang December 2023.
english: On the other hand, 36 percent of respondents said their love life “could be happier”, up from 23 percent in December 2023.

text: Ang mga wala naman sang love life ang nagnubo man sa 18% halin sa 19% sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Those without a love life also dropped to 18% from 19% last year.

text: Base pa sa sini nga survey, ang pinaka-common nga love language sa mga Pinoy amo ang Acts of Service nga may 67%.
english: Based on this survey, the most common love language among Filipinos is Acts of Service with 67%.

text: Lakip diri ang pagluto sa pagkaon para sa pinalangga, paghimo sang trabaho para sa ila, pagbulig sa iban pa nga mga ulubrahon, kag kaangay man sa pagpanghimos kag pagmato-mato sa sulod sang balay.
english: This includes cooking meals for loved ones, doing chores for them, helping with other chores, and cleaning and cleaning the house.

text: Ang iban pa nga nga nagapanguna nga love language amo ang Words of affirmation (51%), Quality time (51%), Giving gifts (33%), kag Physical touch (29%).#
english: Other top love languages ​​are Words of affirmation (51%), Quality time (51%), Giving gifts (33%), and Physical touch (29%).#

text: Nagpatawag si Ukraine president Volodymyr Zelenskiy sang pagsinapol sang national security kag defense council kasunod sang pagpaggwa sang mga pahayag sang security council sang Russia.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has called a meeting of the national security and defense council following the release of statements by Russia's security council.

text:
Suno sa security council sang Russia nga ginapamunuan ni Russian President Vladimir Putin, suportado nila ang pagkilala sa duha ka rehiyon sang sa nasidlangan nga bahin sang Ukraine bilang ‘independent.’

Nahibaluan nga kontrolado sang pro-Russian separatists ang duha ka ‘breakaway regions’ sa Ukraine.
english:
According to Russia's security council headed by Russian President Vladimir Putin, they support the recognition of both regions of the eastern part of Ukraine as 'independent.'

It is known that pro-Russian separatists control two ‘breakaway regions’ in Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Putin, magapaggwa siya sang pinal nga desisyon sini nga mga inadlaw.
english: Putin said he would issue a final decision in the coming days.

text: Pahayag naman ni Zelenskiy, nagpatawag naman siya sang ‘urgent talks’ kaupod si French President Emmanuel Macron kag German Chancellor Olaf Scholz.
english: Zelenskiy said he had called urgent talks with French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Olaf Scholz.

text: Ginhingyo sang Australia ang China nga imbestigahan ang ginapahayag paggamit nila sang laser agud nga masilawan ang piloto sang Australian jets.
english: Australia has asked China to investigate its alleged use of lasers to illuminate the pilot of Australian jets.

text: Suno kay Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison, delikado kag makakululbaan ang ini nga warship sang People’s Liberation Army Navy.
english: According to Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison, this warship of the People's Liberation Army Navy is dangerous and threatening.

text: Natabo ang insidente samtang nagapatigayon sang normal surveillance ang Australian fighter jet sa Exclusive Economic Zone.
english: The incident occurred while the Australian fighter jet was conducting normal surveillance in the Exclusive Economic Zone.

text: Ginpanginwala naman ni Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Wang Wenbin ang alegasyon sang Australia.
english: Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Wang Wenbin denied Australia's allegation.

text: Suno kau Wenbin, nagakadapat nga respetuhon sang Australia ang kinamatarong sang Chinese vessels nga nasaad sa international laws.
english: Wenbin said Australia should respect the rights of Chinese vessels under international law.

text: Nasuya si former Presidential Chief Legal Counsel Salvador Panelo sa ginhimo sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) nga pagpasaka sang kaso batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Former Presidential Chief Legal Counsel Salvador Panelo is disgusted with the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI)'s filing of a case against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Gin-file sa Department of Justice (DOJ) ang reklamo nga inciting to sedition and grave threat batok sa bise presidente kahapon, Pebrero 12.
english: A complaint of inciting to sedition and grave threat against the vice president was filed with the Department of Justice (DOJ) yesterday, February 12.

text: Suno kay Panelo, dapat magbalik sa law school si NBI Director Jaime Santiago bangud wala man sang basehan sa kamatuoran kag sa layi ang ila complaint batok kay Sara.
english: Panelo said NBI Director Jaime Santiago should return to law school because their complaint against Sara is not based on fact and law.

text: May lamod-pamulitika ang tikang sang NBI suno kay Panelo, kag isa man ka demolition job para nga indi makadayon si Sara sa presidential race sa 2028.
english: Panelo said the NBI's move is politically motivated, and also a demolition job to prevent Sara from running in the 2028 presidential race.

text: Dugang sini, uyang lang sa kuwarta sang taxpayers ang criminal complaints batok kay Sara.
english: He added that the criminal complaints against Sara are a waste of taxpayers' money.

text: Dapat suno sa iya nga magtutok na lang ang NBI sa pagpauntat sa mga criminal sa paghimo sang dugang nga krimen.
english: He said the NBI should focus on stopping criminals from committing more crimes.

text: “The Director of the NBI should go back to law school… There can be no crime of a ‘threat’ from the grave,” suno sa long-time Duterte defender.
english: “The Director of the NBI should go back to law school… There can be no crime of a ‘threat’ from the grave,” according to the long-time Duterte defender.

text:
“Neither has VP Sara publicly and tumultuously incited the people to perform acts of sedition as defined by law or to go against the constituted authorities or to stop the enforcement of laws.”

“It obviously is tainted with politics, and still part of the demolition job on her by her political enemies to put her out of contention in the presidential race of 2028,” dugang sini.
english:
“Neither has VP Sara publicly and tumultuously incited the people to perform acts of sedition as defined by law or to go against the constituted authorities or to stop the enforcement of laws.”

“It obviously is tainted with politics, and still part of the demolition job on her by her political enemies to put her out of contention in the presidential race of 2028,” it added.

text: “The NBI should instead focus on stopping criminals from committing crimes or filing charges against them instead of harassing VP Sara with ludicrous and baseless criminal complaints.
english: “The NBI should instead focus on stopping criminals from committing crimes or filing charges against them instead of harassing VP Sara with ludicrous and baseless criminal complaints.

text:
It’s a waste of taxpayers money.”

Nag-ugat ang reklamo sa online press conference ni Sara sang kaagahon sang nagligad nga tuig.
english:
It’s a waste of taxpayers money.”

The complaint stemmed from Sara’s online press conference early last year.

text: Tuman ang kaakig sini kag may statement nga nagsiling nga naka-kontak na siya sang tawo nga magpatay kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Lisa Araneta-Marcos kag House Speaker Martin Romualdez pananglitan may yara man sang magpatay sa iya.
english: He was very angry and said in a statement that he had already contacted someone to kill President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Lisa Araneta-Marcos and House Speaker Martin Romualdez if someone killed him.

text: Pila ka beses nga ginpatawag si Sara agud magpaathag apang wala ini nagsipot matapos ginpahibalo sang iya abogado nga pwede man siya makapadala lang sang counter affidavit.
english: Sara was summoned several times to explain but she did not hesitate after her lawyer informed her that she could also send a counter affidavit.

text: Kasunod sang pag-file sang complaint, ipaidalom na ini sa evaluation kag preliminary investigation sa National Prosecution Service kag kun makitaan sang probable cause, ipasaka ini sa korte para sa trial.
english: Following the filing of the complaint, it will be subjected to evaluation and preliminary investigation by the National Prosecution Service and if probable cause is found, it will be submitted to court for trial.

text: Nakuhaan sang ginabanta 300 grams nga iligal nga druga nga may standard drug price nga P204,000 ang isa ka tricycle driver sa Purok 5, Barangay San Vicente, Leganes, Iloilo.
english: A tricycle driver in Purok 5, Barangay San Vicente, Leganes, Iloilo was recovered with 300 grams of illegal drugs with a standard drug price of P204,000.

text: Ang nadakpan amo si Lester Daza, 31-anyos, kasado kag residente sang Barangay Cari Mayor, Leganes, Iloilo.
english: The suspect was identified as Lester Daza, 31, married, resident of Barangay Cari Mayor, Leganes, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain General Enrique Robles, Leganes Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ang subject ang Newly Identified Drug Personality kag ginakabig nga Street Level Individual.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain General Enrique Robles, Leganes Municipal Police Station, said the suspect is a Newly Identified Drug Personality and is considered a Street Level Individual.

text: Suno kay Robles, nakuha man sa subject ang walo ka sachets sang ginapatihan nga shabu lakip na ang buy-bust item.
english: According to Robles, eight sachets of suspected shabu and a buy-bust item were also recovered from the suspect.

text: Naglawig naman sang duha tubtob tatlo ka semana ang ginpatigayon nga monitoring sang otoridad antes natigayon nga madakpan ang subject.
english: It took two to three weeks of monitoring before the suspect was arrested.

text: Nakahunong na sa Leganes Municipal Police Station si Daza kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: Daza is currently detained at the Leganes Municipal Police Station and is facing charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Si Matthew — nga nagatiglawas sang CALABARZON kag hinablos sang una nga Filipino Olympic champion nga si Hidilyn Diaz — amo ang nagpangibabaw sa 48kg division sang Secondary Boys matapos nahakwat ang 73kg sa snatch kag 93kg sa clean and jerk.
english: Matthew — who represents CALABARZON and is the nephew of former Filipino Olympic champion Hidilyn Diaz — dominated the 48kg division of the Secondary Boys after lifting 73kg in the snatch and 93kg in the clean and jerk.

text: Kaangay sa iya tiya, luyag man ni Matthew nga maka-representar sang Pilipinas sa Olympic stage.
english: Like his aunt, Matthew wants to represent the Philippines on the Olympic stage.

text: “Halos po lahat ng ka-pamilya ko nasa weightlifting kaya sinunod ko po ‘yung hilig nila at gusto ko rin po maglaro sa Olympics parang siya (Hidilyn Diaz).
english: “Almost all of my family members are in weightlifting so I followed their passion and I want to play in the Olympics like her (Hidilyn Diaz).

text: Na-inspire niya po ako, gusto ko na rin po na maging Olympian po,” pahayag sini matapos ang kadalag-an sa Palaro.
english: He inspired me, I want to be an Olympian too,” he said after winning the Palaro.

text: “Gusto ko rin po ma-achieve.
english: “I want to achieve it too.

text:
Pinu-push ko po ‘yug sarili ko para makarating po ako sa rank na ‘yun sa Olympics.”

Gin-reintroduce ang weightlifting bilang demonstration sport subong nga tuig, gani ang medals nga nadag-an sini nga kategorya ang indi pa mahimo malakip sa overall medal tally.
english:
I'm pushing myself to get to that rank in the Olympics.”

Weightlifting was reintroduced as a demonstration sport this year, so medals won in this category cannot be included in the overall medal tally.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Hidilyn nga kampyon sa weightlifting sa Olympiada sadtong 2021 sa Japan amo man ang nagaserbe nga tournament director sa weightlifting sa sini nga 2025 sa Laoag, Ilocos Norte.
english: Hidilyn, who was the weightlifting champion at the 2021 Olympiad in Japan, is also serving as the tournament director in weightlifting in 2025 in Laoag, Ilocos Norte.

text: Sa opening ceremony, siya man ang nagpanguna sa oathtaking sang technical officials kag coaches.#
english: At the opening ceremony, he also led the oathtaking of technical officials and coaches.

text: MAKATULUBLAG na sa aton mga pumuluyo ang padayon nga pagpamatay sang riding-in-tandem, ukon ining naga-angkasanay sa motorcycle nga mga kriminal.
english: OUR residents are disturbed by the continuous killings of riding-in-tandem, or these motorcycle-riding criminals.

text: Naglala pa gani ini sa pagsugod sang Gyera Kontra Droga ni Presidente Duterte sa iya pagpamahog nga “I will kill you!” Tumod sini ang mga drug personalities.
english: It even worsened with the beginning of President Duterte's War on Drugs with his threat of “I will kill you!” It refers to drug personalities.

text: Tungod sini, ang suspetso sang madamo nga kahimuan ini sang pila ka pulis sa pagsunod sa sining sugo ni Presidente Duterte sunu sa ila paghangop.
english: Because of this, the suspicion of many is that some policemen are doing this to follow this order of President Duterte according to their understanding.

text: Ngaa man?
english: Why else?

text: Man, ang nabiktima nila mga suspetsado sa ilegal nga droga.
english: Man, their victims are illegal drug suspects.

text: Pila sining pagpatay kwestyonable gani nga wala naman sing may napasakaan kaso.
english: Some of these killings are questionable and no one has been charged.

text: Dugang pa kay gin-justify ini sang mga vigilante.
english: Moreover, the vigilantes justified it.

text: Pribado ini nga mga tawo nga may daku nga kaakig kag luyag gid magpatay sa mga durugista.
english: These are private people who have a lot of anger and really want to kill drug dealers.

text: Either tungod nangin biktima ang pila ka myembro sang ila pamilya sang salot nga droga.
english: Either because some of their family members have become victims of the drug epidemic.

text:
Ukon tungod mismo sa kahinay sang hustisya sa pungsod nga luyag na

gid lang nila ibutang ang kasuguan sa ila mga kamot.
english:
Or because of the very slowness of justice in a country that wants to

they just want to take the law into their own hands.

text: Ang siste pa kay naghatag pa ini seguro sing justification sa iban agud tumbahon ang ila ginakaugtan, labi na gid kay wala man sing pakialam ukon nahadlok man makialam ang publiko.
english: The joke is that it probably gave justification to others to knock down what they hate, especially since the public doesn't care or is afraid to care.

text: In fact, sunu sa Panay News, sa Pebrero 9, 2021 sini nga isyu, mga 1,828 na ang napatay sang mga motorcycle-riding nga mga kriminal sugod sadtong Agoto 1, 2019 tubtub Marso 1, 2020.
english: In fact, according to Panay News, as of February 9, 2021 of this issue, about 1,828 people have been killed by motorcycle-riding criminals from August 1, 2019 to March 1, 2020.

text: Ugaling lang kay indi gid ma-justify sang aton Kristohanon nga sosyedad ang pagpatay sang pila sini nga daw ilihaon lang nga manok.
english: However, our Christian society cannot justify the killing of some of these chickens.

text: Sa pagtudlo ni Kristo, dapat pangitaon kag ibalik gid ining mga “lost sheep” sa matarong nga katilingban.
english: In Christ's teaching, these “lost sheep” must be found and brought back to righteous society.

text: Ang tawag gani sa aton mga prisuhan amo ang rehabilitation center, kon diin ginatagaan ang nagkasala sing tsansa sa pagbalik-loob kag magtadlong sang ila pangabuhi kon pwede pa lang.
english: Our prisons are called rehabilitation centers, where offenders are given a chance to repent and correct their lives if possible.

text:
***

Tungod sining indi mapauntat nga pinatyanay sang riding-in-tandem, nangin daku ini matuod nga palaligban.
english:
***

Because of this unstoppable killing of riding-in-tandems, it has become a real problem.

text: In fact, daw indi masarangan resolbaron ini sang aton mga otoridad (nga indi kahimbon sang riding-in-tandem).
english: In fact, it seems that our authorities (who are not involved in riding-in-tandem) cannot resolve this.

text: Wala naman sing mahimo ang aton mga pumuluyo nga wala ikasarang magdampig sang ila kaugalingon.
english: Our people who are not able to defend themselves can do nothing.

text:
Ang pamangkot: “Paano bala mapauntat ining pinatyanay sang riding-in-tandem sa ngalan sang aton Kristohanon nga sosyedad?”

Kon may mga lihok gid man sa karon, daw wala gid gani sang matudlo nga maayo nga solusyon luas sa solusyon sang mga wala sing Diyos nga mga otoridad (fuera los Buenos) nga wala nagapati sa rule of law.
english:
The question: “How can this riding-in-tandem killing in the name of our Christian society be stopped?”

If there are any movements now, it seems that there is no good solution except the solution of the godless authorities (fuera los Buenos) who do not believe in the rule of law.

text: Natural lang nga may mahatag man sila nga rason sa ila kapaltahan.
english: Naturally, they will also have an excuse for their shortcomings.

text: Ang malapit nga rason nila, nga luyag lang magpahapos, amo nga kulang sing tinawo ang kapulisan sa pagbantay kag pagkilala sa mga suspek.
english: The proximate reason they, who just want to make things easier, is that the police lack the manpower to monitor and identify suspects.

text: Mga tanod sa barangay wala man sing ikasarang makigbato sa sining armado nga mga kriminal.
english: Barangay tanods are also incapable of fighting these armed criminals.

text: Ang mga pumuluyo nahadlok man makialam kag magtudlo sa mga suspek.
english: Residents are also afraid to intervene and point out the suspects.

text:
***

Sang sining ulihi lang, nadumduman naman sang mga otoridad ang pagtukod sang mga “secret marshals”.
english:
***

Recently, the authorities recalled the establishment of secret marshals.

text: Pero ano gid bala sila kadamo agud mabantayan ang ining mga riding-in-tandem sa kalapad sang aton palibut?
english: But are there really enough of them to keep track of these riding-in-tandems in the vastness of our environment?

text: Ang lain pa, sunu sa PN Lapsus, kay basi ining “secret marshals” amo man mismo ang mga pulis nga nagahampang vigilante.
english: Another, according to PN Lapsus, is that these “secret marshals” may be the police themselves who play vigilante.

text: Ti sin-o abe ang magdakop kag maglagas sa ila?
english: Who will catch them and chase them?

text: Maayo na gid lang ang neutral nga kasuguan nga mapatuman sing husto.
english: Fortunately, neutral law is properly enforced.

text: Katulad sang isa ka opisyal nga luyag iduso ang isa kasuguan nga nagadula sang angkasanay sa motorcycle.
english: Like an official who wants to push a law that eliminates motorcycle riding.

text: Ugaling kay indi ini pwede!
english: But this is not possible!

text: Undemocratic kag discriminatory ini.
english: It is undemocratic and discriminatory.

text: Dispabor ini sa aton mga kubos nga mga pumuluyo.
english: This is unfavorable to our poor citizens.

text: Pabor lang ini sa mga manggaran nga makasarang magbakal sang awto, mga van, kag iban pa nga kasubong nga mga salakyan.
english: It only favors the wealthy who can afford cars, vans, and other similar vehicles.

text: Paano abe matuod ang mga kubos nga makasarang lang sang motorsiko nga installment pa ang pagbayad agud makaangkon sini?
english: What about the poor who can only afford a motorcycle without paying in installments to get it?

text: Naka-istorya kita sa pila ka abyan kag ang ila suhestyon amo ang “No All-Male Tandem”, ukon wala sing puro lalake nga nagaangkas, kay sa masami ang mga puro lalake man lang ang mga kriminal sa riding-in-tandem.
english: We have talked to some friends and their suggestion is “No All-Male Tandem”, or no all-male riders, because often all-male riders are the criminals in riding-in-tandem.

text: Daw maayo ina nga suhetyon a, kay pwede makaaangkas ang asawa ukon bana ukon kahagugma, nga malayo masuspetsuhan nga mga kriminal.
english: That seems like a good suggestion, because the wife or husband or lover, who are far from suspected criminals, can ride.

text:
Preventive measure ini, kag indi bala “Prevention is better than cure?”

Pwede man tugtan nga ma-convertible ining motorcycle para matakdan sing sidecar nga magamit sang pamilya sa ila paglagaw-lagaw.
english:
It’s a preventive measure, and isn’t “Prevention is better than cure?”

This motorcycle can also be convertible to be attached to a sidecar that can be used by the family for their outings.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Ano abe sa inyo?/PN
english: What do you think?/PN

text: Padayon ang vaccination program sa Indonesia sa pihak sang pagpositibo sa COVID-19 sang 350 ka mga doctor kag medical workers apisar nabakunahan na gamit ang China made Sinovac vaccines.
english: Indonesia's vaccination program continues despite the confirmation of 350 doctors and medical workers who tested positive for COVID-19 despite being vaccinated with China made Sinovac vaccines.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Stella Marie Arungayan direkta sa Indonesia, kadam-an sa mga medical workers ang asymptomatic kag naka-home quarantine naman.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Stella Marie Arungayan directly in Indonesia, most of the medical workers are asymptomatic and are under home quarantine.

text: Apang madamo subong ang na admit sa mga ospital bangud sa pagbatyag sang mataas nga hilanat.
english: But many are now admitted to hospitals due to high fevers.

text: Pahayag ni Arungayan, posible nga Delta variant ang nagtapik nga virus sa mga healthcare workers sa diin ini ang ginapatihan nga mas makalalaton.
english: Arungayan said it is possible that the Delta variant infected healthcare workers which is believed to be more contagious.

text: Ang mga medical personnel amo ang una nga ginbakunahan sa Indonesia sang nag-umpisa ang ila inoculations sang Enero.
english: Medical personnel were the first to be vaccinated in Indonesia when their inoculations began in January.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Indonesian Medical Association nga kadam-an sa mga nagpositibo sa COVID-19 amo ang mga nakabaton sang vaccine nga gindevelop sang Chinese biopharmaceutical company Sinovac.
english: Earlier, the Indonesian Medical Association said most of those who tested positive for COVID-19 were those who received the vaccine developed by Chinese biopharmaceutical company Sinovac.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong nga bulan lang sang Hunyo gin-aprubahan sang World Health Organization (WHO) ang emergency use sang Sinovac vaccine.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) approved the emergency use of the Sinovac vaccine in June.

text: Duguon nga gindala sa ospital ang isa ka pasahero sang jeep matapos maigo sang nagtalang nga bala sang airsoft gun sa Binangonan, Rizal.
english: A jeep passenger was taken to the hospital bleeding after being hit by a stray bullet from an airsoft gun in Binangonan, Rizal.

text: Ang biktima amo si Claudette Jacobo.
english: The victim was identified as Claudette Jacobo.

text: Suno kay Jacobo, gindumdom niya nga may naghaboy lang sa iya likod apang sang iya ini ginhikap, nakibot ini nga may dugo na ang iya kamot.
english: According to Jacobo, he thought someone threw something on his back but when he touched it, he was surprised to find blood on his hand.

text: Gindala ini sang driver sang jeep sa police outpost kag gindiretso sa ospital.
english: The driver of the jeep took him to the police outpost and directed him to the hospital.

text: Sa X-ray nakumpirmar nga airsoft gun pellet ang nag-igo sa iya.
english: X-rays confirmed that an airsoft gun pellet hit him.

text: Nagapasalamat man ini nga indi siya sa ulo naigo.
english: He is also grateful that he was not hit in the head.

text: Natalana naman ini nga ipaidalom sa operasyon para makuha ang bala.
english: He is scheduled to undergo surgery to remove the bullet.

text: Excited na ang South Korean actor nga si Song Joong-ki nga maka-upod ang iya Filipino fans sa pagbisita sini sa Manila.
english: South Korean actor Song Joong-ki is excited to be with his Filipino fans during his visit to Manila.

text: Ang actor nga kilala sa hit romance drama nga “Descendants of the Sun” ang naka-schedule nga magpatigayon sang “IAM Song Joong-ki: Live in Manila” fan meet sa Mall of Asia Arena sa May 24.
english: The actor known for the hit romance drama “Descendants of the Sun” is scheduled to hold an “IAM Song Joong-ki: Live in Manila” fan meet at the Mall of Asia Arena on May 24.

text: Ini nga one-night event dala sang IAM Worldwide amo ang una nga live appearance ni Joong-ki sa Manila.
english: This one-night event brought by IAM Worldwide is Joong-ki’s first live appearance in Manila.

text: “I am very excited at the thought of spending a wonderful time together with all of you who have always supported me,” pahayag sini sa isa ka promotional video, kun sa diin gin-engganyo man sini ang fans sa event.
english: “I am very excited at the thought of spending a wonderful time together with all of you who have always supported me,” he said in a promotional video, where he also encouraged fans to the event.

text: Ginplastar naman ang seat map kag ang ticket prices nga naga-umpisa sa P2,500 pasaka sa P12,500.
english: The seat map and ticket prices starting from P2,500 to P12,500 were also laid out.

text: Popular man si Joong Ki sa dramas nga “Sungkyunkwan Scandal,” “Arthdal Chronicles,” “Vincenzo” kag “Reborn Rich.”
english: Joong Ki is also popular in the dramas “Sungkyunkwan Scandal,” “Arthdal ​​Chronicles,” “Vincenzo” and “Reborn Rich.”

text: Nagbubo ang mensahe sang simpatiya kag pagpakig-unong para sa pamilya kasunod sang hinali nga kamatayon sang 65-anyos nga internationally renowned Filipino chef kag restaurateur nga si Margarita Fores.
english: Messages of sympathy and condolences poured in for the family following the sudden death of 65-year-old internationally renowned Filipino chef and restaurateur Margarita Fores.

text: Nasapwan ang chef nga wala na sang kabuhi sa sulod sang iya hulot sa hotel sa Hong Kong matapos nga wala ini nakatambong sa isa ka scheduled meeting.
english: The chef was found dead inside his hotel room in Hong Kong after he missed a scheduled meeting.

text: Wala sang ginhatag ang pamilya kag pulis nga detalye kaangot sa rason sang iya kamatayon.
english: The family and police did not provide details regarding the cause of his death.

text: “Our family is mourning this unexpected loss, and we kindly ask for your prayers during this time,” pahayag sang iya bata nga si Amando Fores.
english: “Our family is mourning this unexpected loss, and we kindly ask for your prayers during this time,” said his son, Amando Fores.

text:
“We will be able to share more in due time.”

Ginakabig si Fores nga pioneer sa culinary industry kag nagpabantog man sang Filipino cuisine sa iban nga mga iban nga mga pungsod.
english:
“We will be able to share more in due time.”

Fores is considered a pioneer in the culinary industry and also popularized Filipino cuisine in other countries.

text: Nabun-ag siya sang 1959 sa prominente nga Araneta Family kag nagtubo ang iya passion sa Italian food samtang nagapuyo sa New York.
english: He was born in 1959 to the prominent Araneta Family and developed a passion for Italian food while living in New York.

text: Sang 1986, naghanas siya sa idalom sang tatlo ka chefs agud nga matun-an ang traditional Italian cooking.
english: In 1986, he trained under three chefs to learn traditional Italian cooking.

text: Ginapanag-iyahan sini ang madamo nga restaurants lakip na ang Cibo chain, Lusso, Grace Park, kag Alta.
english: It owns many restaurants including the Cibo chain, Lusso, Grace Park, and Alta.

text: Sang 2016, ginhingadlan siya nga Best Female Chef.
english: In 2016, she was named Best Female Chef.

text: Nagapabilin ang iya adbokasiya sa organic ingredients kag commitment sa dekalidad nga Italian kag Filipino cuisine nga amo ang naghatag sa iya sang pagkilala halin man sa international circles.
english: His advocacy for organic ingredients and commitment to quality Italian and Filipino cuisine remains, which has earned him recognition from international circles.

text: Nakilala man siya sa international television shows lakip na sa Inspired with Anna Olson kag Culinary Journeys nga iya sang CNN.
english: She has also appeared on international television shows including Inspired with Anna Olson and CNN's Culinary Journeys.

text: Nangin two-time cancer survivor man si Fores, lakip na ang thyroid cancer nga nalampuwasan sini sang 2006.
english: Fores has also been a two-time cancer survivor, including thyroid cancer which she overcame in 2006.

text: Ginpahanumdom ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. reminded

text: sa mga municipal mayors nga himuon gid nga prayoridad ang serbisyo-publiko bisan pa sa tunga sang away sa pulitika samtang nagahilapit ang 2025 midterm elections.
english: to municipal mayors to make public service a priority even in the midst of political infighting as the 2025 midterm elections approach.

text: Sang Pebrero 11 nag-umpisa ang campaign period para sa mga senador kag sa party-lists, apang sa Marso 28 pa magasugod ang kampanya para sa magapadalagan sa local positions lakip na ang sa pagka-gobernador kag sa pagka-alkalde.
english: The campaign period for senators and party-lists began on February 11, but the campaign for local positions including governor and mayor will begin on March

text: Sa general assembly sang League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP), ginpahayag ni Marcos nga ang rason kun ngaa nagapungko sa pwesto amo nga buligan ang mga tawo.
english: At the general assembly of the League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP), Marcos said the reason why he is in office is to help the people.

text: Bisan mainit ang away kag makahang ang mga tinaga nga nagakawas sa bibig, dapat dumdumon sang pulitiko suno kay Marcos nga ang puno kag punta sini tanan amo nga mabuligan ang mga Pilipino.
english: Even if the fight is hot and the words that come out of the mouth are bitter, Marcos said politicians should remember that the bottom line is to help the Filipinos.

text: “Sa init ng kampanya, sa init ng halalan, huwag natin kakalimutan na tayo ay nandito, tayo ay pumasok sa serbisyo na publiko upang tulungan ang taumbayan,” pahayag sini.
english: “In the heat of the campaign, in the heat of the election, let us not forget that we are here, we are in the public service to help the people,” he said.

text:
“Kahit na mainit na nga ang laban, maanghang na ang mga binibitawan na salita, sa puno’t dulo nito ginagawa natin lahat ito para makatulong sa ating minamahal na kapwa Pilipino.”

Naghaylo man ini sa local chief executives nga tapuson na ang garot kag tugutan ang kada partido nga magbulig sa nasyon kun matapos na ang eleksyon.
english:
“Even if the fight is hot, the words are spicy, in the end we do it all to help our beloved fellow Filipinos.”

He also urged local chief executives to end the garo and allow each party to help the country after the election.

text: “Pagkatapos ng halalan, alam ko kung minsan napakahirap na magpalamig ng ulo ulit,” suno pa sa presidente.
english: “After the election, I know sometimes it is very difficult to cool down again,” the president said.

text:
“Ngunit kailangan nating gawin yun dahil kailangan natin ang lahat na mga gustong tumulong na magkapit bisig upang magtulungan.”

Sang Martes, ginsuguran ang kampanya sang Alyansa Para sa Bagong Pilipinas senatorial slate sa Ilocos Norte kun sa diin ang chief executive mismo ang nagpanguna.
english:
“But we need to do that because we need all those who want to help to join hands to help each other.”

On Tuesday, the campaign of the Alliance for the New Philippines senatorial slate was launched in Ilocos Norte where the chief executive himself took the lead.

text: Nagpalagtik pa ini sang istorya nga wala sang mga kandidato ang administrasyon nga naakusahan sang human rights violations sa idalom sang drug war kag wala man sang naakusahan sang corruption and negligence sang tion nga may pandemic.
english: He also fueled the story that the administration has no candidates who have been accused of human rights violations under the drug war and none of them have been accused of corruption and negligence during the pandemic.

text: Si former President Rodrigo Duterte ang nagapungko sang tion nga may pandemya.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte was in office during the pandemic.

text: Magapadulong sa Iloilo City ang pila ka mga matag-as nga opisyal sang gobyerno sa national kag local agud nga magtambong sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: Several senior national and local government officials will travel to Iloilo City to attend the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga magapadulong sa syudad amo sanday Makati City Mayor Abby Binay, Former Senator Franklin Drilon, Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives Camille Villar, Former Senator Bam Aquino, kag iban pa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, he said that among those who will visit the city are Makati City Mayor Abby Binay, Former Senator Franklin Drilon, Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives Camille Villar, Former Senator Bam Aquino, and others.

text: Suno kay Treñas, madamo pa sang mga Local Government Units ang nagahayo sa iya nga magapadulong sa syudad agud nga maglantaw sang pinasahi nga Dinagyang Festival.
english: According to Treñas, many Local Government Units are still asking him to come to the city to watch the special Dinagyang Festival.

text: Gin-thag man sini nga indi sini masigurado kon magatambong si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: He also said he is not sure if President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will attend.

text: kag First Lady Liza Marcos.
english: and First Lady Liza Marcos.

text: Handa naman ang alcalde nga maghatag sang mikropono sa matag-as nga opisyal agud nga makahambal sa publiko apang siguraduhon man sini nga malip-ot lang.
english: The mayor is ready to give a microphone to the high-ranking official so that he can speak to the public but he will also make sure that it is brief.

text: Ginpasigurado man sang natungdan nga imbitado si Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julinne “Jamjam” Baronda sa kahiwatan.
english: He also assured that Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julinne “Jamjam” Baronda was invited to the event.

text: May Low Pressure Area (LPA) nga na-monitor sa gwa sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: A Low Pressure Area (LPA) was monitored outside the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Apang manubo naman ang tyansa sini nga mangin Tropical Depression sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: However, it has a low chance of becoming a Tropical Depression in the next 24 hours.

text: Ini ang nasiplatan sa kalayuon nga 260 kms West Northwest sang Pag-asa Island, Kalayaan, Palawan.
english: It was spotted 260 kms West Northwest of Pag-asa Island, Kalayaan, Palawan.

text: Samtang, ang Shear Line ang nagaapekto naman sa Central kag Southern Luzon.
english: Meanwhile, the Shear Line is affecting Central and Southern Luzon.

text: Ang Shear Line ang isa ka linya ukon makitid nga lugar sa diin may gulpi nga pagbag-o sa direksyon sang hangin.
english: A Shear Line is a line or narrow area where there is a sudden change in the direction of the wind.

text: Bangud sa pagbunggu-anay ukon convergence sang hangin, nagaluntad ang masami nga pagpangilat ukon mga pag-ulan sa shear line.
english: Due to wind collision or convergence, frequent lightning or showers occur along the shear line.

text: Samtang ang Northeast Monsoon ukon hangin Amihan ang nagaapekto sa Northern Luzon.
english: Meanwhile, the Northeast Monsoon is affecting Northern Luzon.

text: Nagdangat sa 150 ka mga Pinoy ang apektado sang wildfires sa Los Angeles, California sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Up to 150 Filipinos were affected by wildfires in Los Angeles, California in the United States of America.

text: Suno kay Consul General Adelio Angelito Cruz sang Philippine consulate general sa Los Angeles, ini nga mga Pinoy nga na-displace ang nagatinir subong sa nagkalain-lain nga evacuation centers.
english: According to Consul General Adelio Angelito Cruz of the Philippine consulate general in Los Angeles, these displaced Filipinos are currently staying in various evacuation centers.

text: Nagatrabaho man ang gobyerno suno sa consul agud nga mabuligan sila nga makapangita sang long-term housing kasunod sang mandatory evacuation nga ginmandu sang mga opisyal sa California bangud wala pa gihapon napalong ang kalayo.
english: The consul said the government is also working to help them find long-term housing following the mandatory evacuation ordered by officials in California because the fire has not yet been extinguished.

text: Magluwas diri, natukiban man nga ang iban nga mga Pinoy nga nasunugan ang undocumented kag ang pila ang may yara lang sang minimal insurance.
english: In addition, it was also discovered that some Filipinos who were affected by the fire are undocumented and some have minimal insurance.

text: Una na nga naghatag sang otorisasyon ang Department of Foreign Affairs sa consulate nga maghatag sang emergency assistance nga tubtub sa $200 ukon masobra P11,700 sa Filipinos nga naapektuhan sang wildfires.
english: Earlier, the Department of Foreign Affairs authorized the consulate to provide emergency assistance of up to $200 or more than P11,700 to Filipinos affected by the wildfires.

text: Nahibaluan nga 24 na subong ang kumpirmado nga patay bangud sa amo nga hitabo sa Los Angeles kag madamo pa ang nadeklarar nga missing samtang labi pa nga nagalapta ang kalayo.
english: At least 24 people have been confirmed dead in Los Angeles and many more have been declared missing as the fire spreads.

text: (Photo: NBC News)
english: (Photo: NBC News)

text: Ginakabig na nga ‘endangered species’ ukon dali na lang maubos ang mga sapat nga Koala sa duha ka estado sa pungsod Australia.
english: Koalas are considered an endangered species in two states in Australia.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede, direkta sa Australia, endangered na ang nasambit nga native marsupial habitats bangud sa tuman ka init nga temperatura kag nagakatabo nga bushfire ukon nagluntad nga mga sunog sa kagulangan.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede, directly in Australia, the native marsupial habitats are already endangered due to extremely hot temperatures and bushfires.

text: Nagpaandam naman ang scientists sa gobyerno nga kun indi ma-aktuhan ang pagguba sang developers sa ilistiran sang mga Koala sa eucalypt forests, pat-od nga mangin extinct na ang mga ini ukon maubos na sa kalibutan.
english: Scientists have warned the government that if developers do not stop the destruction of Koala habitat in eucalypt forests, they will surely become extinct or disappear from the world.

text: Nahibaluan nga sandig sa World Wide Fund for Nature study, masobra 60,000 ka koala ang nagkalamatay sa bushfires nga nagluntad sang 2019 kag sang 2020.
english: According to a World Wide Fund for Nature study, more than 60,000 koalas died in bushfires in 2019 and 2020.

text: Nagkalamatay man ang koala habitats bangud sa asud-asud nga land clearing para sa , urban development, mining kag forestry.
english: Koala habitats have also been destroyed due to rampant land clearing for urban development, mining and forestry.

text: Gintamnan sang saging, palawan, kag niyog sang mga residente ang half lane sang dalan sa Barangay Sinamay, Alimodian, Iloilo matapos nga ginkalkal kag ginpabay-an sang kontraktor sini.
english: Residents planted bananas, palawan, and coconuts in the half lane of the road in Barangay Sinamay, Alimodian, Iloilo after it was dug up and abandoned by its contractor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Romeo Andig, Head sang Iloilo Provincial Engineer’s Office, iya ginpahayag nga kontani gin-ideyahan sang kontraktor nga Bansoy Construction and Supply ang proyekto agud nga matapos ini gilayon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Romeo Andig, Head of the Iloilo Provincial Engineer's Office, said the contractor, Bansoy Construction and Supply, should have ideated the project so that it could be completed immediately.

text: Ginpatawag man sang natungdan ang Bansoy Construction and Supply agud nga sapolan ang pagpadayon sang proyekto.
english: He also summoned Bansoy Construction and Supply to facilitate the continuation of the project.

text: Suno kay Andig, ang P18.2 million nga proyekto ang yara na sa 62% nga kompleto kon sa diin, Hunyo 2024 sang gin-umpisahan ini patukod.
english: According to Andig, the P18.2 million project is already 62% complete with June 2024 when construction began.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sini nga matapos kontani ang dalan sa Disyembre 18, 2024 apang wala ini nahingaw rason nga dapat magbayad ang kontraktor sang liquidated damages nga P6,987 per day sa mga adlaw nga nagaligad samtang wala pa ini matapos.
english: He also revealed that the road was supposed to be completed on December 18, 2024 but it was not completed so the contractor must pay liquidated damages of P6,987 per day for the days that pass while it is not completed.

text: Naghatag naman sang huol sa economic activities sang barangay ang wala matapos-tapos nga proyekto.
english: The unfinished project has also affected the economic activities of the barangay.

text: Wala paman sang tul-id nga sabat ang kontraktor kon magatambong ini sa pagsinapol nga patigayunon buwas nga adlaw.
english: The contractor has not yet given a definite answer on whether he will attend the meeting tomorrow.

text: Ginpalagtikan ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: si former President Rodrigo Duterte kadungan sang campaign rally sang mga senatorial bets sang administrasyon sa una nga adlaw sang campaign period para sa May 2025 midterm elections.
english: former President Rodrigo Duterte during the campaign rally of the administration's senatorial bets on the first day of the campaign period for the May 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa iya speech sa Ilocos Norte Centennial Arena, ginpahayag sang Presidente nga wala sang bisan isa sa mga kandidato sang administrasyon nga may mantsa sang dugo bangud sa tokhang, wala sang kaangtanan sa pagbulsa sang sako-sako nga kwarta, ginhingalitan ang krisis sang pandemya, kag ginpabay-an ang mga pumuluyo na magmasakit kag mapatay.
english: In his speech at the Ilocos Norte Centennial Arena, the President said none of the administration's candidates are stained with blood because of tokhang, have nothing to do with pocketing sacks of money, exploiting the pandemic crisis, and letting the people get sick and die.

text: Dugang pa niya, wala man sa iya mga kandidato ang nagapalakpak sa China kag nasadyahan kun ginabombahan sang tubig kag ginasakit ang mga katapo sang Coast Guard.
english: He added that none of his candidates applaud China and enjoy being bombed with water and tortured by Coast Guard members.

text: Apisar wala ini sang ginmitlang nga pangalan, maathag nga ginaatake sini si Duterte nga nagapangatubang subong sang alegasyon kaangay sang crimes against humanity kag iban pa.
english: Although he did not mention his name, he clearly attacked Duterte who is currently facing allegations such as crimes against humanity and others.

text:
Timprano nga i-shutdown ukon siraduhon ang pinakadako nga coal-fired power station sa Australia bangud indi na maka-compete sa “influx of renewables.”

Nahamtang ang 2.88 gigawatt nga planta sa Hunter region sa naaminhan sang Sydney, Australia.
english:
Australia’s largest coal-fired power station will be shut down early because it can no longer compete with the “influx of renewables.”

The 2.88 gigawatt plant is located in the Hunter region north of Sydney, Australia.

text: Ini nga planta ang gina-operate sang Origin Energy.
english: This plant is operated by Origin Energy.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede, direkta sa Australia, tuig 2025 na siraduhon ang pinakadako nga planta — pito ka-tuig nga mas timprano sa orihinal nga plano sang shutdown.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede, directly from Australia, the largest plant will be closed by 2025 — seven years earlier than the original shutdown plan.

text: Ini ang pagabayluhan sang large-scale battery.
english: It will be replaced by a large-scale battery.

text: Isa lang ini sa coal plants sa nasambit nga pungsod nga pwersa nga siraduhon bangud sa growth sang mas barato nga renewable energy nga naglab-ot sa masobra 30 percent sang grid generation sang nagligad nga tuig kag base sa forecast, magasaka pa sa 69% sa 2030.
english: It is just one of the coal plants in the country that will be forced to close due to the growth of cheaper renewable energy that reached more than 30 percent of grid generation last year and based on forecasts, will rise to 69% by 2030.

text:
Ginpagwa sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) ang alternatibo nga Filipino translation sang pangamuyo nga “Hail Mary.”

Sa baylo nga ang Tagalog-based nga “Aba Ginoong Maria,” ang bag-o gin-aprubahan amo ang “Ave Maria,” kaangay sa Latin nga bersiyon.
english:
The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) has released an alternative Filipino translation of the prayer “Hail Mary.”

Instead of the Tagalog-based “Aba Lord Maria,” the newly approved one is “Ave Maria,” similar to the Latin version.

text: Ini nga bag-o nga bersiyon ang aprubado sa pinakaulihi nga plenary session sang CBCP kadungan sang pagsulod sang Catholic Church sa Jubilee Year sang 2025.
english: This new version was approved at the latest plenary session of the CBCP in conjunction with the Catholic Church's entry into the Jubilee Year of 2025.

text: Suno kay Msgr.
english: According to Msgr.

text: Bernardo Pantin, CBCP Secretary General, ang bag-o nga text wala nagailis sa daan nga bersiyon apang nagatuyo nga mag- provide sang mas accurate nga translation sang orihinal nga text.
english: Bernardo Pantin, CBCP Secretary General, said the new text does not replace the old version but aims to provide a more accurate translation of the original text.

text: Ginpaathag man sang CBCP nga ang revision ang nasentro sa principles sang biblical accuracy kag prayerfulness.
english: The CBCP also explained that the revision is centered on the principles of biblical accuracy and prayerfulness.

text:
Yari ang Tagalog version:

ABA GINOONG MARIA (Tagalog version)

Aba Ginoong Marianapupuno ka ng grasya,ang Panginoong Diyosay sumasaiyo.Bukod kang pinagpalasa babaeng lahat atpinagpala namanang iyong Anakna si Hesus.
english:
Here is the Tagalog version:

ABA GINOONG MARIA (Tagalog version)

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Besides, you have blessed all women and blessed your Son Jesus.

text: Santa Maria,Ina ng Diyos,ipanalangin mo kamingmakasalanan ngayonat kung kami’y mamamatay.Amen.
english: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners now that we are dying. Amen.

text:
Yari naman ang bag-o gin-release nga version sang pangamuyo:

AVE MARIA (Alternative Filipino version)

Ave Maria,puno ka ng grasya,ang Panginoonay sumasaiyo.Pinagpala ka sa kababaihanat pinagpala ang bungang iyong sinapupunanna si Jesus.
english:
Here is the newly released version of the prayer:

AVE MARIA (Alternative Filipino version)

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

text: Santa Maria,Ina ng Diyos,ipanalangin mo kamingmakasalanan ngayonat sa oras ng aming kamatayan.Amen.
english: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

text: Ini nga tikang nagamarka sang ika-50 nga anibersaryo sang CBCP pastoral letter sa Blessed Virgin Mary, Ang Mahal nga Birhen Maria nga gin-isyu sang Pebrero 2, 1975.
english: This measure marks the 50th anniversary of the CBCP pastoral letter on the Blessed Virgin Mary, The Blessed Virgin Mary issued on February 2, 1975.

text: Ang pastoral letter naga- highlight sa madalom nga debosyon sang mga Filipino kay Birhen Maria.
english: The pastoral letter highlights the deep devotion of Filipinos to the Virgin Mary.

text: Suno kay Interior Minister Denys Monastyrskiy, ginabanta nga denosena ka mortar rounds ang nag-land ‘100 meters’ ang kalayuon sa posisyon sang Ukranian military troops.
english: According to Interior Minister Denys Monastyrskiy, it is estimated that dozens of mortar rounds landed ‘100 meters’ away from the position of Ukrainian military troops.

text: Dugang pa pa sang ministry, duha ka Ukrainian serviceman ang napatay kag apat ang pilason sa pila na kasunod sunod nga explosions.
english: The ministry said two Ukrainian servicemen were killed and four wounded in several consecutive explosions.

text:
Ginapatihan nga nakasulod naman sa teritoryo sang Ukraine ang private Russian paramilitary nga ‘Wagner’— (Russian army nga associated sa separatists nga una na gin-deploy sa Libya, Syria, Central African Republic kag iban pa nga punsgod)

Suno naman kay British Foreign Secretary Liz Truss, posible nga matabo ang “worst-case scenanrio” sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine sa masunod nga semana.
english:
The private Russian paramilitary 'Wagner' is believed to have entered Ukrainian territory.

British Foreign Secretary Liz Truss said a "worst-case scenario" between Russia and Ukraine is likely next week.

text: Samtang, suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino, — direkta sa Ukraine, nagapabilin sa gihapon sa border sang Ukraine ang Russian military troops taliwas sa ginpahayag nga withrawal sang Russian government.
english: Meanwhile, according to Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino, — directly in Ukraine, Russian military troops remain on the Ukrainian border despite the announced withdrawal of the Russian government.

text: Suno kay Tolentino, wala naman sang nagsiput nga Russian delegation sa kuntani pagsinapul sa tunga sang Ukraine kag Russia angut sa nagapadayon nga tensyon.
english: According to Tolentino, no Russian delegation attended the meeting between Ukraine and Russia due to the ongoing tensions.

text: Naka-alerto ang Ukrainian military troops sa posibilidad sang gyera sa tunga sang Russia matapos sang mortar shell explosion sa eastern Ukraine.
english: Ukrainian military troops are alert to the possibility of war between Russia after a mortar shell explosion in eastern Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Interior Minister Denys Monastyrskiy, ginabanta nga denosena ka mortar rounds ang nag-land ‘100 meters’ ang kalayuon sa posisyon sang Ukranian military troops.
english: According to Interior Minister Denys Monastyrskiy, it is estimated that dozens of mortar rounds landed ‘100 meters’ away from the position of Ukrainian military troops.

text: Dugang pa pa sang ministry, duha ka Ukrainian serviceman ang napatay kag apat ang pilason sa pila na kasunod sunod nga explosions.
english: The ministry said two Ukrainian servicemen were killed and four wounded in several consecutive explosions.

text:
Ginapatihan nga nakasulod naman sa teritoryo sang Ukraine ang private Russian paramilitary nga ‘Wagner’— (Russian army nga associated sa separatists nga una na gin-deploy sa Libya, Syria, Central African Republic kag iban pa nga punsgod)

Suno naman kay British Foreign Secretary Liz Truss, posible nga matabo ang “worst-case scenanrio” sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine sa masunod nga semana.
english:
The private Russian paramilitary 'Wagner' is believed to have entered Ukrainian territory.

British Foreign Secretary Liz Truss said a "worst-case scenario" between Russia and Ukraine is likely next week.

text: Samtang, suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino, — direkta sa Ukraine, nagapabilin sa gihapon sa border sang Ukraine ang Russian military troops taliwas sa ginpahayag nga withrawal sang Russian government.
english: Meanwhile, according to Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino, — directly in Ukraine, Russian military troops remain on the Ukrainian border despite the announced withdrawal of the Russian government.

text: Suno kay Tolentino, wala naman sang nagsiput nga Russian delegation sa kuntani pagsinapul sa tunga sang Ukraine kag Russia angut sa nagapadayon nga tensyon.
english: According to Tolentino, no Russian delegation attended the meeting between Ukraine and Russia due to the ongoing tensions.

text: Nagaalalawas na ang mga pasyente sa ospital sa HongKong bangud sa pagsaka sang kaso sang COVID-19.
english: Hospital patients in Hong Kong are overflowing due to the rise in COVID-19 cases.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Joy Alcubilla,– direkta sa Hongkong, madamo na sa mga pasyente ilabi na ang mga tigulang naga nagahulat sa malaba nga pila sa gwa sang ospital.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Joy Alcubilla, – directly in Hong Kong, many patients especially the elderly are waiting in long queues outside the hospital.

text: Suno kay Alcubilla, nagsugud ang pagsaka sang kaso sang COVID-19 matapos ang holiday season.
english: According to Alcubilla, the increase in COVID-19 cases began after the holiday season.

text: Isa ka COVID positive ang nagpadulong sa restaurant kag dito na nagsugud ang madasig nga paglapta sang virus.
english: A COVID positive went to the restaurant and that's where the virus started spreading rapidly.

text: Nagpasalig naman ang HongKong government nga makontrol na ang sitwasyon kag pagtaas sa kaso sang COVID-19 sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw.
english: The Hong Kong government has assured that the situation and the increase in COVID-19 cases will be brought under control within a few days.

text: Ginalimitahan man ang paggwa sang mga tawo agud nga malikawan ang paglatnanay sang virus.
english: People's outings are also limited to prevent the spread of the virus.

text: Madamo naman sa mga Pinoy sa amu nga pungsod ang nagpositibo sa COVID-19.
english: Many Filipinos in the country have tested positive for COVID-19.

text: Nangin matalunsay ang paghiwat sang National Rally for Peace sang Iglesia Ni Cristo (INC) sa Iloilo City.
english: The National Rally for Peace of the Iglesia Ni Cristo (INC) was held in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, tigpamaba sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), iya ginpahayag nga wala sang mga insidente ang na-record sang ila talatapan sa bahin sang peace and order.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), said no incidents were recorded by their office in terms of peace and order.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, naglab-ot sa estimated 18,000 ka mga myembro sang Iglesia Ni Cristo nga naghalin sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang Western Visayas ang nagpadulong sa syudad.
english: According to Sangrines, an estimated 18,000 members of Iglesia Ni Cristo from various parts of Western Visayas came to the city.

text: Ginpabugal man sini nga naplantsa sang maayo ang preparasyon sa aktibidad lakip na ang dalagan sang trapiko.
english: He also boasted that the preparations for the activity including the flow of traffic were well ironed out.

text: Ini bangud man suno sa natungdan sa pagkoordinar sang talatapan sa Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO).
english: This is also due to the coordination of the office with the Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO).

text: Nahibaluan nga as of 3AM kahapon nga adlaw, nagpatuman na ang ICPO sang paneling agud nga masekyar ang venue kag malikawan ang ano man nga sahi sang pagpamahog sa seguridad.
english: As of 3AM yesterday, the ICPO has already implemented paneling to check the venue and avoid any kind of security threat.

text: Nakuha ni Chrisia Mae Tajarros gikan sa Rehiyon 8 ukon Eastern Visayas ang labing-una nga bulawan nga medalya sa Palarong Pambansa 2025 sa secondary girls’ 3,000m run.
english: Chrisia Mae Tajarros from Region 8 or Eastern Visayas won the first gold medal in the Palarong Pambansa 2025 in the secondary girls’ 3,000m run.

text: Suno kay Chrisia Mae, sa pihak sang kabudlay kag kakapoy nga iya naeksperyensyahan sa tion sang iya paghanas, ini ang ginbuslan sang kadalag-an.
english: According to Chrisia Mae, despite the hardship and exhaustion she experienced during her training, it was replaced with success.

text: Suno sa iya, nag-umpisa siya sa paghanas sa athletics sang Grade 1 pa lang siya.
english: He said he started training athletics when he was in Grade 1.

text: Ginpaathag niya nga ang iya orihinal nga i-sport amo ang paglangoy ukon swimming apang siya ang nagsaylo sa athletics.
english: He explained that his original sport was swimming but he switched to athletics.

text: Ginpasalamatan naman ni Chrisia ang Dios sa iya panibag-o nga kadalag-an kag gin-ako nga mabudlay sa training apang ginhimo niya ang masarangan agud malab-ot ang iya ginahandum nga medalya.
english: Chrisia thanked God for her new victory and admitted that it was difficult in training but she did her best to achieve her dream medal.

text: Si Tajarros isa ka Grade 9 Student sa Tanauan National High School sa Leyte sa diin nakakuha ini sang silver medal sa Cebu City sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Tajarros is a Grade 9 student at Tanauan National High School in Leyte where he won a silver medal in Cebu City last year.

text: Nahibaluan nga suno sa Coach ni Chrisia nga si Mr. Damaso Olidan Jr., nagasugod ang ila training alas 7:00 sang aga tubtub alas 12:00 sang udto.
english: Chrisia's coach, Mr. Damaso Olidan Jr., their training starts at 7:00 am until 12:00 noon.

text: Padayon ang ginapasangkad nga preparasyon sang Iloilo City para sa patigayunon nga 49th High-Level Task Force in ASEAN Economic Integration sa Pebrero 25-27, 2026.
english: Iloilo City continues to expand its preparations for the 49th High-Level Task Force in ASEAN Economic Integration on February 25-27, 2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nag-deploy na sang dugang nga augmentation ang kapulisan agud masiguro ang seguridad sang mga delegado kag maga-bisita sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Raisa Treñas said the police have already deployed additional augmentation to ensure the security of the delegates and visitors to the city.

text: Nagpatigayon naman sang ocular visit sa mga venue sang patigayunan sang aktibidad kaupod ang regional agency kahapon nga adlaw.
english: The regional agency conducted an ocular visit to the venues of the activity yesterday.

text: Suno pa sa alkalde, dako nga bugal ini para sa syudad bangud ginapakita sini nga handa na ang Iloilo City sa pag-host sang mga kaangay sini nga international events.
english: The mayor said this is a great pride for the city because it shows that Iloilo City is ready to host such international events.

text: Bilang chairman sang Economic Development Committee sang Regional Development Council-6, ginpahayag ni Treñas nga dako ini nga oportunidad para sa Western Visayas agud ma-highlight ang mga nagkalain-lain nga industriya sa rehiyon.
english: As chairman of the Economic Development Committee of the Regional Development Council-6, Treñas said this is a great opportunity for Western Visayas to highlight the various industries in the region.

text: Paagi sa ASEAN meeting, mahimo ma-promote ang local products pareho sang handicrafts sa mga pungsod nga kabahin sang Association of Southeast Asian Nations ukon ASEAN.
english: Through the ASEAN meeting, local products such as handicrafts can be promoted in countries that are part of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations or ASEAN.

text: Dugang pa niya, ang pagkabaton sang Iloilo City sang ASEAN Clean Tourist City Award nagahatag sang dako nga impact sa imahe sang syudad bilang isa ka high-urbanized city nga ginakilala sa katinlo sini kag maayo nga pagdumala sa syudad.
