english: He added that Iloilo City's receipt of the ASEAN Clean Tourist City Award has a major impact on the city's image as a high-urbanized city recognized for its cleanliness and good city management.

text: Nahibaluan man nga ang Iloilo City ginpasidunggan bilang UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, nga amo ang labing una kag isahanon nga syudad sa bug-os nga Pilipinas nga nakabaton sang kaangay nga pasidungog.
english: Iloilo City was also honored as a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, the first and only city in the Philippines to receive such an honor.

text: Nagapakita man ini sang mabakod nga reputasyon sang syudad kun pagahambalan ang culinary excellence sa pungsod.
english: It also shows the city's strong reputation when it comes to culinary excellence in the country.

text: Indi na maka-compete sa 2025 Universal Woman pageant ang reigning Universal Woman Philippines 2025 nga si Sophia Bianca Santos.
english: Reigning Universal Woman Philippines 2025 Sophia Bianca Santos will not be able to compete in the 2025 Universal Woman pageant.

text:
Ini matapos nga wala siya nag-qualify sa age requirement sang amo nga international pageant

Ang Universal Woman competition nagabaton sang participants nga nagaedad 25 tubtob 45 apang 21-anyos pa lang si Santos.
english:
This is after she did not qualify for the age requirement of the international pageant

The Universal Woman competition accepts participants aged 25 to 45 but Santos is only 21 years old.

text: Matandaan nga ginkoronahan ang 21-anyos nga Kapampangan bilang Universal Woman Philippines sang nag-compete ini sa 2024 Miss Grand Philippines pageant.
english: The 21-year-old Kapampangan was crowned Universal Woman Philippines when she competed in the 2024 Miss Grand Philippines pageant.

text: Bangud sa sini nga development, gin-appoint naman bilang official representative sa 2025 Universal Woman pageant si Jasmine Omay.
english: Due to this development, Jasmine Omay was appointed as the official representative of the 2025 Universal Woman pageant.

text: Si Omay ang batchmate man ni Santos sa Miss World Philippines 2024 kun sa diin si Omay ang ginkoronahan bilang First Princess, samtang si Santos naman ang Second Princess.
english: Omay is also Santos' batchmate in Miss World Philippines 2024 where Omay was crowned First Princess, while Santos was Second Princess.

text: Sa amo nga pageant, si Krishnah Gravidez ang nagdaug sang Miss World Philippines title.
english: In that pageant, Krishnah Gravidez won the Miss World Philippines title.

text: Natalana nga magpadulong si Omay sa India sa ulihi nga semana sang Mayo agud tinguhaan nga makuha ang back to back title matapos nga ginkoronahan man sang nagligad nga tuig ang Pinay nga si Maria Gigante nga amo ang pinakauna nga nangin tiglawas sang Pilipinas sa Universal Woman contest kag nadala gilayon pauli ang korona.
english: Omay is scheduled to travel to India in the last week of May to try to win the back to back title after being crowned last year by Filipina Maria Gigante, who was the first Philippine representative in the Universal Woman contest and immediately brought home the crown.

text: Bantog na sa mga Filipino ang pamahaw nga uga nga may pares nga mainit nga kan-on.
english: Dry breakfast paired with hot food is already popular among Filipinos.

text: May yara sang wala nagakaon sang uga bangud sa baho sini apang paborito naman ini sang iban.
english: Some people don't eat dried fruit because of its smell, but others prefer it.

text: Magluwas nga makagalana ini bilang kalakip sang pamahaw kun aga, nakahibalo ka bala nga manggaranon ang uga sa nutristansya nga makabulig sa pagpasangkad sang imo ikaayong lawas?
english: Besides being delicious as part of breakfast in the morning, did you know that dried fruit is rich in nutrients that can help improve your health?

text: Suno kay Dr. Brahmanand Nayak, author, healthcare strategist kag visionary sa Bangalore, India, ang proteins, vitamins kag minerals nga yara sa uga ang epektibo nga pambato sa high blood pressure.
english: According to Dr. Brahmanand Nayak, author, healthcare strategist and visionary in Bangalore, India, the proteins, vitamins and minerals present in the dry are effective against high blood pressure.

text: Ang omega-3 fatty acids kag vitamin D nga yara sa uga ang makatapna naman sang pila ka mental health issues.
english: The omega-3 fatty acids and vitamin D in the dried fruit can also prevent some mental health issues.

text: Pahayag ni Nayak, ang uga ang may yara sang natural anti-depressant nutrients nga makapakalma sang mood swings sang tawo kag nagapalikaw sa depression.
english: Nayak said dry fruit contains natural anti-depressant nutrients that can calm mood swings and prevent depression.

text: Ang omega-3 acids ukon healthy fat nga yara sa uga, ang ginakabig nga ‘essential’ para sa ikaayong lawas, kag nagabulig man sa proper functioning sang utok kag mga mata sang tawo.
english: Omega-3 acids, or healthy fats, are considered essential for health, and also help in the proper functioning of the human brain and eyes.

text: DAKU naton nga problema ang wala pagsalig sang mga pumuluyo sa COVID-19 vaccine.
english: OUR BIG problem is the lack of confidence of the people in the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Sunu sa isa ka pungsodnon nga survey, kag bisan sa mga survey sa lokal nga mga radyo, wala katunga sang aton pumuluyo sa subong ang wala gid luyag magpabakuna anay sa COVID-19 vaccine.
english: According to a national survey, and even surveys on local radio stations, less than half of our people today do not want to be vaccinated against the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Initially, tungod ang ining mga vaccine pang-emergency lang kag manubo ang “efficacy and safety” sini.
english: Initially, because these vaccines are only for emergencies and have low efficacy and safety.

text: In fact, kay pang-emergency lang ini tungod sa pandemic, ginapahanugutan ini sang World Health Organization (WHO) bisan 50 ka porsyento lang ang “efficacy and safety”.
english: In fact, since it is only an emergency due to the pandemic, the World Health Organization (WHO) allows it even if it is only 50 percent “efficacy and safety”.

text: Ano naman ang paathag sang mga health experts parti sini?
english: Ano naman ang paathag sang mga health experts parti sini?

text: Indi seguro tanto sa kaso sang “efficacy” sa laboratory-controlled environment, nga sa aktwal nga “effectiveness” mas manubo pa dira ini tungod sa mga intervening factors sa natural environment.
english: Probably not so much in the case of efficacy in the laboratory-controlled environment, which in actual effectiveness is even lower due to intervening factors in the natural environment.

text: Sunu kay L.J. Tan, chief strategist sang non-profit nga Immunization Action Coalition, ang “effectiveness” nagatumod sa ikasarang sang vaccine agud mapunggan (prevent) ang pagluntad sang aktwal nga balatian.
english: According to L.J. Tan, chief strategist of the non-profit Immunization Action Coalition, said “effectiveness” refers to the ability of a vaccine to prevent the occurrence of the actual disease.

text:
In other words, por ejemplo lang, siling niya,“If you vaccinate 100 people, 50 people will not get the disease.”

Ano naman ang matabo sa nabilin nga 50?
english:
In other words, for example, he said, “If you vaccinate 100 people, 50 people will not get the disease.”

What about the remaining 50?

text: “It may mean that people are less likely to be hospitalized, require ICU care or die,” siling naman ni Dr. Bill Miller sang Ohio State University College of Public Health.
english: “It may mean that people are less likely to be hospitalized, require ICU care or die,” said Dr. Bill Miller of Ohio State University College of Public Health.

text: Sa aton pa, may benepisyo gihapon ang mabakunahan sang vaccine nga manubo ang “efficacy”, that is, kon indi ka man lubos ma-protektahan sang vaccine, ang “weak” nga immunity response mo sa vaccine pwede makapahagan-hagan sang igu sang COVID-19.
english: In other words, there is still a benefit to being vaccinated with a low-efficacy vaccine, that is, even if the vaccine does not fully protect you, your weak immune response to the vaccine can mitigate the impact of COVID-19.

text:
***

Ang daku gid naton nga problema angot sa “safety” sang pagpabakuna.
english:
***

Our biggest problem is the safety of vaccination.

text: Ina tungod ang wala nakit-an nga adverse effects sa clinical trials pwede magtuhaw sa aktwal na nga kaso, gani kinahanglan i-monitor gid pirme.
english: That's because undetected adverse effects in clinical trials can appear in actual cases, so they need to be monitored regularly.

text: Ang ining adverse effects ginapanan-aw sing mga health experts sa kaso sang mga tigulang kag ang may mga pondo nga balatian katulad sang hypertension, diabetes, congested heart, may immunity problem, kag iban pa nga ma-determine sang health specialist.
english: These adverse effects are observed by health experts in the case of the elderly and those with underlying diseases such as hypertension, diabetes, congested heart, immunity problems, and others that can be determined by a health specialist.

text: Ang ining mga vaccine wala man gani ginapagamit pa sang pila ka manufacturer sa mga kabataan kag sa mga sobra katigulang.
english: These vaccines are not even used by some manufacturers in children and the elderly.

text: Ang Sinovac sang China nga may 50 percent lang sing “efficacy and safety”, por ejemplo, pwede lang sa mga may edad 18 tubtub 59.
english: China's Sinovac, which has only 50 percent efficacy and safety, for example, is only available to those aged 18 to 59.

text: Ang Pfizer/biotech, nga ang “efficacy and safety” sobra sa 90%, wala man nag-experimento sa mga may edad kubos sa 18 anyos.
english: Pfizer/biotech, whose “efficacy and safety” is over 90%, also did not test on those under 18 years of age.

text: Naglakip ugaling ini sang mga senior citizen (60 anyos pataas).
english: However, it includes senior citizens (60 years and above).

text: Kon may problema man sa pagpabakuna sa Sinovac sang China, wala kita kahibalo ugaling tungod mahuyog mag-cover-up ini sang mga importante nga kamatuoran.
english: If there is a problem with China's Sinovac vaccination, we don't know because it tends to cover-up important facts.

text: Samtang, ang balita sa Pfizer nagasiling nga may mga napatay na sa mga nabakunahan sini.
english: Meanwhile, the news on Pfizer says there have been deaths among those vaccinated with it.

text: Napulo kuno sa Germany kag kasubong man kadamo sa Norway nga halos tanan sini mga senior citizen.
english: Ten in Germany and as many in Norway, almost all of whom are senior citizens.

text: Although may mga senior citizen man nga wala man mag-sufrir sang peligroso nga adverse effects, katulad sa kaso ni Pope Franics kag ni retired Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI.
english: Although there are also senior citizens who have not suffered dangerous adverse effects, such as the case of Pope Franics and retired Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI.

text: Tungod sini, ginapa-imbestigar pa karon kon ano gid ang kabangdanan sang ila kamatayon.
english: The cause of their death is still being investigated.

text: Meantime, ang Australia nagpauntat anay sang pangbakuna sang Pfizer sa ila pungsod tungod sini.
english: Meantime, Australia has suspended the Pfizer vaccine in its country because of this.

text: Tungod man sini, ang nasulod sa ulo sang mga tawo amo ang mga kaso sang mga napatay, nga nagdugang pa gid sa kulba sang aton mga pumuluyo.
english: Because of this, what came into people's minds were the cases of the dead, which added to the anxiety of our people.

text: Tungod sini, diri sa pungsod, ang wala sadto anay luyag magpabakuna kag ang mga may pangduha-duha,luyag anay mahibal-an kon sin-o ang una magpabakuna sa ila mga opisyales sang banwa.
english: Therefore, here in the country, those who did not want to be vaccinated and those who have doubts, want to know who will be the first to vaccinate their town officials.

text: Lakip na dira si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kag pila pa ka meyor.
english: This includes Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas and several other mayors.

text: Si Presidente Duterte sugot mauna, ugaling indi siya luyag ipa-publiko kay kalaw-ay kuno kay sa buli siya mapa-injection.
english: President Duterte agreed to go first, but he did not want to be made public because he said it was obscene because he would be injected in the buttocks.

text: Ayhan ukon nakapabakuna na upod sa iya mga special bodyguards?
english: Maybe or already vaccinated with his special bodyguards?

text: Ambot lang.
english: I don't know.

text: Pero, kon nakapabakuna na si Presidente, indi seguro sa Sinovac kay tubtub lang 59 ang pwede sini pabakunahan kag si Presidente over 70 years old na.
english: However, if the President has already been vaccinated, it is not safe for Sinovac because it can only vaccinate up to 59 people and the President is over 70 years old.

text: Kon ako ang pamangkuton, tungod sa pangduha-duha sang madamo sa vaccine, ang dapat mauna amo ang mga soldado.
english: If you ask me, because of the hesitancy of many about the vaccine, the first should be the soldiers.

text: Obligasyon nila nga i-risgo ang ila kabuhi sa pagdampig sang aton sovereign people nga ila amo.
english: It is their obligation to risk their lives on the side of our sovereign people who are their masters.

text: Pwede na seguro ang 1,000 ka soldado nga paunahon agud maseguro kon ano gid ang mangin epekto sang bakuna sa ila.
english: Perhaps 1,000 soldiers could be deployed to ensure the effect of the vaccine on them.

text: Ano abe sa inyo?/PN
english: What do you think?/PN

text: Ginpasugurado sang Task Force Anti-squatting and Illegal Structure Unit nga naubos na pangkakas ang mga tarpaulins ukon visual materials sang mga kandidato nga yara sa judging area sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The Task Force Anti-squatting and Illegal Structure Unit ensured that the tarpaulins or visual materials of the candidates in the judging area of ​​the Dinagyang Festival 2025 have been removed.

text: Ini kasunod man sang ginpaguwa nga Executive Order 167 ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.
english: This is also in line with the issue of Executive Order 167 by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Love Joy Hosenilla,head sang Anti-squatting and Illegal Structure Unit, iya ginpahayag nga pribado man ukon pampubliko nga tarpaulins, indi ini makaluwas sa pagpangbaklas sang talatapan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Love Joy Hosenilla, head of the Anti-squatting and Illegal Structure Unit, said that whether private or public tarpaulins, they will not save the office from being demolished.

text: Suno kay Hosenilla, natigayon naman nga mahimos ang mga nakuha nila nga tarpaulins.
english: According to Hosenilla, they were able to repair the tarpaulins.

text: Gin-ako man sang natungdan nga dako nga pagpanghangkat sa ila nga bahin ang pagkakas sang mga visual materials sang national candidates.
english: He also acknowledged that the removal of visual materials of national candidates is a big challenge for them.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang alkalde nga ang tikang ang isa ka paagi agud nga malikawan ang political colors sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: Earlier, the mayor said the move is a way to avoid political colors in the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Santo naman sa paragraph A, B, C, and D section 1 sang EO, ginabawal ang mga election materials kaangay sang printed kag visual materials nga may itsura kag pangalan sang mga kandidato.
english: According to paragraphs A, B, C, and D section 1 of the EO, election materials such as printed and visual materials with the images and names of candidates are prohibited.

text: Naakig ang China sa joint statement sang Estados Unidos kag Japan nga nagamuno sang ila nga pagpang-garit-garit sa West Philippine Sea.
english: China is angered by the joint statement by the United States and Japan condemning their claims in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Suno kay Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun, ang amo nga pahayag ang maathag nga naga-hilabot sa internal affairs sang China.
english: According to Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun, the statement clearly interferes in China's internal affairs.

text: Ginpahayag man nga naga-atake ini sa ila ngalan kag naga-exaggerate sa tension sa Indo-Pacific region.
english: It has also been said to be launching attacks on their behalf and exaggerating tensions in the Indo-Pacific region.

text: “The China-related content of the US-Japan joint statement blatantly interferes in China’s internal affairs, attacks and smears China and exaggerates regional tensions,” suno kay Guo.
english: “The China-related content of the US-Japan joint statement blatantly interferes in China’s internal affairs, attacks and smears China and exaggerates regional tensions,” according to Guo.

text: Ang ginatumod nga statement ang ginpaguwa kadungan sang bilateral meeting nanday US President Donald Trump kag Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba sang Biyernes.
english: The statement was issued during a bilateral meeting between US President Donald Trump and Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba on Friday.

text: Gin-athag sang duha ka mga lider nga ginapamatukan nila ang iligal nga maritime claims sang China, militarisasyon sang reclaimed features, kag pagpamahog nga ginahimo sini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The two leaders made it clear that they oppose China's illegal maritime claims, militarization of reclaimed features, and threats it is making in the West Philippine Sea.

text: “The two leaders reaffirmed their strong opposition to the PRC’s unlawful maritime claims, militarization of reclaimed features, and threatening and provocative activities in the South China Sea,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “The two leaders reaffirmed their strong opposition to the PRC’s unlawful maritime claims, militarization of reclaimed features, and threatening and provocative activities in the South China Sea,” the statement read.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Japan amo ang isa sa pinakasuod nga kaalyado sang US sa Asya.
english: It is known that Japan is one of the closest allies of the US in Asia.

text: May yara sang 54,000 US military personnel nga naka-estasyon sa amo nga pungsod.
english: There are 54,000 US military personnel stationed in the country.

text: Wala nagaisol ang Russia kundi labi pa gid gani nga nagaabante!
english: Russia is not retreating but is advancing even more!

text: Ini ang bag-o nga alegasyon sang Estados Unidos kag sang NATO ukon North Atlantic Treaty Organization apisar una na nga nagpahayag ang Russia nga gina-bawi na sini ang ila tropa nga ginpangbutang malapit sa border sang Ukraine.
english: This is the latest allegation by the United States and NATO or the North Atlantic Treaty Organization despite Russia's earlier statement that it is withdrawing its troops deployed near the Ukrainian border.

text: Sa Ukraine, ginpasaka sang mga tawo ang ila nga hayahay kag ginpatunog ang national anthem agud nga mapakita ang pag-isa sa tunga sang ginakahangaw-an nga Russian invasion.
english: In Ukraine, people raised their flags and played the national anthem to show solidarity amid the feared Russian invasion.

text: Ginhimo ini sang Ukraine apisar ginbiktima sang lapnagon nga cyberattack ang websites sang ila nga state banks, defense ministry, kag armed forces — atake nga gintudlo sa Russia, kag atake nga ginpanginwala man sang Russia.
english: Ukraine did this despite widespread cyberattacks on the websites of its state banks, defense ministry, and armed forces — attacks blamed on Russia, and attacks Russia has denied.

text: Kun Russian defense ministry naman ang pahambalon, ginpahalin na ang ila nga pwersa sa Ukraine bangud natapos na ang exercises sa southern kag western military districts sa Ukraine.
english: As for the Russian defense ministry, it has already withdrawn its forces from Ukraine because the exercises in the southern and western military districts of Ukraine have ended.

text: Sa isa ka ginbalhag nga video, ginpakita ang mga tangke, infantry fighting vehicles, kag self-propelled artillery units nga nagbiya sa Crimean peninsula.
english: In a published video, tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, and self-propelled artillery units were shown leaving the Crimean peninsula.

text: Apang wala diri nagapati ang Estados Unidos.
english: But the United States does not believe this.

text: Suno kay US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, nagapalapit pa gid gani ang Russian units sa border, baliskad sa ila pahayag nga nagapalayo na sila.
english: According to US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Russian units are even getting closer to the border, contrary to their claims that they are moving away.

text: Suno sa senior Western intelligence official, nagapabilin nga mataas ang risgo sang Russian aggression batok sa Ukraine sa bilog nga bulan sang Pebrero.
english: According to the senior Western intelligence official, the risk of Russian aggression against Ukraine remains high throughout the month of February.

text: Mahimo suno sa opisyal nga mag-atake ang Russia nga wala na sang warning nga himuon.
english: The official said Russia could launch an attack without warning to do so.

text: Suno naman kay NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg, wala naga-withdraw ang tropa sang Russia gani nga ginakontra lang sang Moscow ang mensahe sang diplomasiya.
english: NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg said Russia's troops are not withdrawing and Moscow is only countering the message of diplomacy.

text: Gin-athag sang Regional Joint Security Control Center (RJSCC) sa Western Visayas nga wala pa ma- finalize ang listahan sang election areas of concern may kaangtanan sa May 12, 2025 elections.
english: The Regional Joint Security Control Center (RJSCC) in Western Visayas clarified that the list of election areas of concern in connection with the May 12, 2025 elections has not yet been finalized.

text: Ang amo nga control center ang ginapamunuan sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) kaupod ang Philippine National Police (PNP), Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), kag Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) bilang myembro.
english: The control center is headed by the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) with the Philippine National Police (PNP), Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), and Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) as members.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dennis Ausan, regional director sang Commission on Elections Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga padayon pa nga gina-evaluate ang security risks sa rehiyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dennis Ausan, regional director of the Commission on Elections Region 6, said the security risks in the region are still being evaluated.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa amo nga listahan, ang Calinog gid lamang ang napaidalom sa “Red” category nga amo ang highest level sang election-related security concerns.
english: It is known that in the list, only Calinog is under the “Red” category which is the highest level of election-related security concerns.

text: Suno kay Ausan, nagapatigayon pa ang control center sang workshops, evaluations, kag data sharing sa mga ahensya nga myembro agud nga mas maplantsa ang listahan.
english: Ausan said the control center is still conducting workshops, evaluations, and data sharing with member agencies to further iron out the list.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Brigadier General Michael Samson, commander sang 301st Infantry Brigade sang Philippine Army, iya ginpahayag nga ginpaidalom ang Calinog sa “Red” category bangud sa mga encounters sa tunga-tunga sang 2024.
english: Brigadier General Michael Samson, commander of the 301st Infantry Brigade of the Philippine Army, said Calinog was placed under the “Red” category due to the encounters in mid-2024.

text: Suno kay Samson, ini nga mga encounters ang nagresulta sa pag-neutralize sa pila ka matag-as nga opisyal sang New People’s Army (NPA) kag ang pagkabungkag sang Central Front sang Komiteng Rehiyon.
english: According to Samson, these encounters resulted in the neutralization of some senior officials of the New People's Army (NPA) and the dissolution of the Central Front of the Regional Committee.

text: Pahayag ni Samson, kun basehan ang sitwasyon subong, ginsuhestiyon sini nga dapat panubuan sa “Yellow” category ang Calinog.
english: Samson said that based on the current situation, he suggested that Calinog should be lowered to the “Yellow” category.

text: Sa idalom sang “Yellow” category, nga nagakahulugan nga may history sang election-related incidents ang area, nalakip diri ang Tobias Fornier sa Antique; President Roxas sa Capiz; Ajuy, Lemery, kag San Dionisio sa Iloilo; kag Isabela kag San Enrique sa Negros Occidental.
english: Under the “Yellow” category, which means the area has a history of election-related incidents, it includes Tobias Fornier in Antique; President Roxas in Capiz; Ajuy, Lemery, and San Dionisio in Iloilo; and Isabela and San Enrique in Negros Occidental.

text: Ang “Orange” category,ukon areas of immediate concern, ang nagalakip sang Tapaz sa Capiz; Janiuay, Leon, Maasin, San Joaquin, kag Badiangan sa Iloilo; kag Calatrava, Cauayan, kag Sipalay City sa Negros Occidental.
english: The “Orange” category, or areas of immediate concern, includes Tapaz in Capiz; Janiuay, Leon, Maasin, San Joaquin, and Badiangan in Iloilo; and Calatrava, Cauayan, and Sipalay City in Negros Occidental.

text: Ginakumpirma sang Philippine Navy nga nakalayag sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Palawan ang isa sa pinakadaku sa research vessels sang China.
english: The Philippine Navy confirms that one of China's largest research vessels has sailed in the waters of Palawan.

text: Suno kay Navy spokesman for the West Philippine Sea Rear Adm.
english: According to Navy spokesman for the West Philippine Sea Rear Adm.

text: Roy Vincent Trinidad, ini nga Chinese research vessel Lan Hai 101 ang natumod sang Littoral Monitoring Station (LMS) Melville nga amo ang nag-isyu sang challenge.
english: Roy Vincent Trinidad, this Chinese research vessel Lan Hai 101 was identified by the Littoral Monitoring Station (LMS) Melville which issued the challenge.

text: Nagsabat man ang vessel nga nagsaylo sila sang ruta sa eastern waters sang Palawan bangud malain ang kondisyon sang dagat sa western side.
english: The vessel also replied that they changed the route to the eastern waters of Palawan because of the bad sea conditions on the western side.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga magpadayon sa paglayag samtang nagasunod sa rights of innocent passage sa Philippine archipelagic sea lanes.
english: It also pledged to continue sailing while observing the rights of innocent passage in the Philippine archipelagic sea lanes.

text: “They assured that the vessel would continue its transit while adhering to the rights of innocent passage through the Philippine archipelagic sea lanes, opting to exit near Coron, Palawan,” suno kay Trinidad.
english: “They assured that the vessel would continue its transit while adhering to the rights of innocent passage through the Philippine archipelagic sea lanes, opting to exit near Coron, Palawan,” Trinidad said.

text: Nag-deploy naman ang Western Command sang Philippine Navy vessel BRP Andres Bonifacio kaupod sa Philippine Coast Guard vessel BRP Melchora Aquino para mabantayan ang Lan Hai 101.
english: The Western Command of the Philippine Navy vessel BRP Andres Bonifacio along with the Philippine Coast Guard vessel BRP Melchora Aquino deployed to monitor Lan Hai 101.

text: “The deployment of naval and coast guard assets serves as a testament to the collaborative approach in addressing maritime challenges,” dugang ni Trinidad.
english: “The deployment of naval and coast guard assets serves as a testament to the collaborative approach in addressing maritime challenges,” Trinidad added.

text: Antes ang kumpirmasyon sang Navy, si former US Air Force official kag former defense attaché Ray Powell ang nag-post sa X kaangot sa presensya sang barko.
english: Before the Navy's confirmation, former US Air Force official and former defense attaché Ray Powell posted on X regarding the ship's presence.

text: “The Lan Hai 101, one of China’s two largest fisheries research ships, is now transiting the Philippines’ archipelagic waters.
english: “The Lan Hai 101, one of China’s two largest fisheries research ships, is now transiting the Philippines’ archipelagic waters.

text: It appears to be en route to the Philippine Sea,” kabahin sang post sini.#
english: It appears to be en route to the Philippine Sea,” part of his post.

text: Nagsaka na sa 58 ang numero sang patay bangud sang tatlo ka oras nga mamunog nga ulan nga nagresulta sa landslides kag lapnagon nga pagbaha sa Rio de Janeiro sa Brazil.
english: The death toll from three hours of heavy rains that resulted in landslides and widespread flooding in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, has risen to 58.

text: Indi pa maathag subong kun pila ka tawo ang missing sandig sa latest report sang Rio de Janeiro Fire and Civil Defense Department.
english: It is not clear how many people are missing based on the latest report of the Rio de Janeiro Fire and Civil Defense Department.

text: Tuman ka baskog ang baha rason nga masobra 200 ka mga tawag ang nabaton sang fire department nga nagapangayo sang tabang.
english: The flood was so severe that the fire department received more than 200 calls for help.

text: Makit-an man sa footage nga ginpost sa social media nga nagakalaanod pati ang mga salakyan kag balay.
english: Footage posted on social media also showed vehicles and houses being washed away.

text: Sa subong ginapatigayon pa ang rescue mission nga ginapangunahan sang 180 ka mga myembro sang militar.
english: The rescue mission led by 180 military personnel is still ongoing.

text: Ginakahangaw-an nga magasaka pa ang numero sang mga patay.
english: The death toll is feared to rise.

text: Nagtipon sa Iloilo City ang kapin ginabanta 30,000 nga mga myembro sang Iglesia ni Cristo para sa National Rally for Peace.
english: More than 30,000 members of the Church of Christ gathered in Iloilo City for the National Rally for Peace.

text: Ginpatigayon ang aktibidad sa Iloilo Freedom Grandstand.
english: The activity was held at the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand.

text: Nagtambong sa kahiwatan ang mga myembro sang religious group gikan sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang Panay.
english: The event was attended by members of religious groups from different parts of Panay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay John Mark Zarandin, member sang Iglesia ni Cristo, iya ginpahayag nga sa Aklan pa sila naghalin para sa kahiwatan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, John Mark Zarandin, a member of the Iglesia ni Cristo, said they came from Aklan for the event.

text: Suno sa iya, ang pagtambong niya sa “National Rally for Peace” sang Iglesia ni Cristo amo nga suportahan ang pahayag ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: He said his attendance at the National Rally for Peace of the Church of Christ was to support the statement of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga indi na lang mag-file sang impeachment complaints batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: not to file impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Matandaan nga ginsuportahan sang INC ang UNITEAM ukon tandem nanday Marcos kag Duterte sang 2022 elections.
english: It can be recalled that the INC supported the UNITEAM or tandem of Marcos and Duterte in the 2022 elections.

text: Sa subong, tatlo ka impeachment complaints ang ginapangatubang ni Sara nga lunsay nag-ugat sa kontrobersyal nga confidential funds sang Office of the Vice President kag Department of Education nga iya man anay ginpamunuan antes siya nagbiya sa Gabinete ni Marcos.
english: Sara is currently facing three impeachment complaints, all stemming from the controversial confidential funds of the Office of the Vice President and the Department of Education, which she also headed before leaving the Marcos Cabinet.

text: Ginahingyo sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) Region 6 indi lamang ang mga kandidato kundi pati ang mga campaign leader kag mga supporter nga magsunod gid sang istrikto sa mga regulasyon sang poll body kaangot sa pagpangampanya.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) Region 6 urged not only candidates but also campaign leaders and supporters to strictly follow the poll body's regulations regarding campaigning.

text: Subong nga Martes, Pebrero 11, opisyal nga nagsugod ang 90 ka adlaw nga campaign period para sa national elective positions ukon para sa magapadalagan sa pagka-senador amo man ang party-list groups.
english: This Tuesday, February 11, officially began the 90-day campaign period for national elective positions or for senatorial candidates as well as party-list groups.

text: Suno kay Atty. Dennis Ausan, director sang Comelec 6, dapat nga ibutang lamang ang posters sa designated common poster areas.
english: According to Atty. Dennis Ausan, director of Comelec 6, said the posters should only be placed in designated common poster areas.

text: Pwede man ini sa private properties apang dapat nga may yara sang pahanugot halin sa tag-iya.
english: This is also allowed on private properties but must be obtained with the permission of the owner.

text: Dugang sa pagsulundan, indi dapat maglapaw sa two feet by three feet ang size sang poster ukon campaign material.
english: In addition to the rules, the size of the poster or campaign material should not exceed two feet by three feet.

text: Kun may makit-an nga mas daku nga poster ipaanggid sa limit, i-kumpiskar ini sang Comelec kag i-report sa Law Department para sa nagakaigu nga disposisyon.
english: If any poster is found that is larger than the limit, the Comelec will confiscate it and report it to the Law Department for proper disposition.

text: 72 oras antes ang official nga pagsugod sang kampanya, dapat nga nakakas naman ang campaign posters nga wala sa designated areas kaangay sang ginpangbutang sa mga poste, kahoy, waiting sheds, kag iban pa nga public structures.
english: 72 hours before the official start of the campaign, campaign posters that are not in designated areas such as those placed on poles, trees, waiting sheds, and other public structures must be removed.

text: Magluwas diri, ang tanan nga campaign posters ang dapat nga nagalakip man sang phrase nga “Paid by” ukon “Donated by” para mabutang kun sin-o ang naghatag sang finance para sa material.
english: In addition, all campaign posters must also include the phrase “Paid by” or “Donated by” to indicate who provided the finance for the material.

text: Ginplastar man ni Ausan ang ruling sang Korte Suprema nga indi ma-regulate sang Comelec ang posters sa pribado nga propiedad basta may yara sang pahanugot halin sa tag-iya.
english: Ausan also cited the Supreme Court's ruling that the Comelec cannot regulate posters on private property as long as there is permission from the owner.

text: Bangud subject na ang mga kandidato sa national elections sa Comelec rules and regulations, ang anuman nga paglapas sa Fair Election Act ang mahimo mag-resulta sa election offenses nga mahimo masilutan sa idalom sang Section 264 sang Omnibus Election Code (OEC).
english: Since candidates in national elections are subject to Comelec rules and regulations, any violation of the Fair Election Act can result in election offenses punishable under Section 264 of the Omnibus Election Code (OEC).

text: Mahimo mapreso ang may sala sang isa-anum ka tuig, ma-disqualify sa pagpungko sa gobyerno, kag mahimo makakasan sang kinamatarong sa pagboto.
english: The guilty could be imprisoned for one to six years, disqualified from holding government positions, and could lose the right to vote.

text:
Ginalauman nga 30,000 ka mga miyembro ni Iglesia ni Cristo halin sa Panay ang magatipon sa Iloilo Freedom Grandstand sa City Proper umpisa 6:00 subong nga aga tubtub alas sais karon sa gab-i para sa “National Rally for Peace.”

Lakip sa magatambong amo ang 4,000 halin sa Antique kag northern Iloilo, tag-5,000 halin sa Aklan kag Capiz kag 12,000 halin sa southern Iloilo.
english:
It is expected that 30,000 members of Iglesia ni Cristo from Panay will gather at the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand in City Proper from 6:00 this morning until 6 pm tonight for the “National Rally for Peace.”

Among those who will attend are 4,000 from Antique and northern Iloilo, 5,000 each from Aklan and Capiz and 12,000 from southern Iloilo.

text: Kahapon kag kagab-i, madamo na ang nag-abot sa syudad agud mag-set up sang venue para sa bilog nga adlaw nga mga aktibidad subong nga Lunes, Enero 13.
english: Yesterday and last night, many have arrived in the city to set up the venue for the whole day of activities this Monday, January 13th.

text: Ang iban naman ang nagpaligad na sang gab-i sa hotels para mas temprano sila nga makaabot sa venue subong nga aga.
english: Others have spent the night in hotels so they can get to the venue earlier this morning.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Minister Troy Calimpong sang Christian Family Organization sang INC Iloilo District, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang entertainment kaangay sang pagkanta kag lantawon man nila ang peace rally sang iban nila nga kaupdanan sa iban nga sites sa Pilipinas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Minister Troy Calimpong of the Christian Family Organization of INC Iloilo District said there will be entertainment such as singing and they will also watch the peace rally of their colleagues in other sites in the Philippines.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga nagsunod sila sa tanan nga proseso kaangay sang pag-secure sang permit.
english: He said they followed all the processes such as securing the permit.

text: Ginpaathag man sini nga ang tuyo sang “National Rally for Peace” amo nga suportahan ang pahayag ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: He also explained that the purpose of the “National Rally for Peace” is to support the statement of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: Suspendido ang face-to-face classes sa tanan nga lebel sa Iloilo City subong nga adlaw, Enero 13, kadungan sang pagpatigayon sang Iglesia Ni Cristo sang National Rally for Peace.
english: Face-to-face classes at all levels in Iloilo City are suspended today, January 13, in conjunction with the Iglesia Ni Cristo's National Rally for Peace.

text: Suno kay Mayor Jerry Treñas, ini nga desisyon ang kasunod sang coordination meeting sang concerned offices sa mga organizers sang peace rally.
english: According to Mayor Jerry Treñas, this decision follows the coordination meeting of the concerned offices with the organizers of the peace rally.

text: Bangud sa kadamuon sang attendees kag agud mangin matalunsay ang operasyon, ginpakamaayo suno kay Treñas nga ipa-iway anay ang face to face nga klase apang ginapanugyanan ang mga eskwelahan kag unibersidad nga magsaylo sa modular learning.
english: Due to the number of attendees and to ensure a smooth operation, Treñas said it was decided to suspend face-to-face classes but schools and universities are advised to switch to modular learning.

text: Sa bahin sang mga operasyon sang mga opisina sang Iloilo City Government, gin-athag nga magapadayon sila subong nga adlaw.
english: Regarding the operations of the offices of the Iloilo City Government, it was clarified that they will continue today.

english: 005-A, the mayor also encourages the heads of offices and operations of national government agencies and offices and private companies and offices to operate in skeletal force.

text: Aktibo nga nagpatuman sang check point sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang Iloilo ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) sa pagsugod sang election gun ban para sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) actively implemented check points in various parts of Iloilo to start the election gun ban for the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang tanan nga police stations ang naglibot agud mag-conduct sang check points kaupod election officers.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said all police stations went around to conduct check points with election officers.

text: Suno kay Araño, nangin smooth sailing ang labing-una nga check point nga nagsugod alas-8 sang aga.
english: According to Araño, the first check point, which started at 8 am, was smooth sailing.

text: Nagpasalig man ang natungdan nga sige-sige na nga ipatuman ang tikang tubtob nga magtakop ang election period.
english: He also assured that the measure will be implemented until the end of the election period.

text: Sa mga checkpoint, ang visual inspections lang ang ginatugotan.
english: At checkpoints, only visual inspections are allowed.

text: Ginadumilian ang mga pulis sa pagbukas sang vehicle’s trunk ukon glove compartment sang salakyan, subong man ang pag-require sa mga drayber kag pasahero nga magpanaug kag usisaon.
english: Police are prohibited from opening a vehicle’s trunk or glove compartment of a vehicle, as well as requiring drivers and passengers to dismount and be searched.

text: Indi halos mabatyagan sang mga Pilipino sa Moscow, Russia ang Russia-Ukraine tensions apisar nga bilog nga kalibutan na ang nagaistorya sini nga ginamo kag gin-intrahan na sang iban nga dalagku nga mga pungsod.
english: Filipinos in Moscow, Russia can hardly feel the Russia-Ukraine tensions even though the whole world is talking about this conflict and other major countries have joined.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Ejay Merced direkta sa Moscow, wala pa man sang abiso ang embahada sang Pilipinas sa Russia sa mga Pilipino nga nagatinir sa amo nga pungsod.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Ejay Merced directly in Moscow, the Philippine embassy in Russia has not yet issued a notice to Filipinos staying in the country.

text: Wala man sang naobserbaran nga daw lain nga lebel sang deployment sang mga personnel sang pulis kag militar.
english: There were no observed differences in the level of deployment of police and military personnel.

text: Mabatyagan lang ang gamo “economically” bangud suno sa natungdan, wala na sila ginapasugtan nga mag-transact nga mga remittance centers nga ginapanag-iyahan sang West.
english: The chaos will only be felt “economically” because according to him, they are no longer allowed to transact as remittance centers owned by the West.

text: Partikular sini nga gintumod ang Western Union, isa ka American multinational financial services company, nga naka-base sa Russia.
english: It specifically targeted Western Union, an American multinational financial services company, based in Russia.

text: Posible suno kay Merced nga amo sini ang epekto sang gamo kag nagaumpisa na sila subong sa pagpangita sang mga kumpaniya nga sarang maagyan sang ila nga kuwarta bangud ginakahangaw-an nga indi na maka-operate ang American companies sa Moscow.
english: Merced said it is possible that this is the effect of the unrest and they are now starting to look for companies that can pass their money because they are concerned that American companies will no longer be able to operate in Moscow.

text: 30 ka tuig na nga naga-operate ang Western Union sa Russia apang sandig sa ginpaguwa nga advisory, untatan sini ang internal money transfers halin sa Abril 1.
english: Western Union has been operating in Russia for 30 years but according to an advisory issued, it will stop internal money transfers from April 1.

text: Magatutok ini sa cross-border business sa tion sang increased competition sa Russian market.
english: It will focus on cross-border business at a time of increased competition in the Russian market.

text: Wala gintumod sang amo nga world’s largest money transfer firm kun may kaangtanan ini sa Russia-Ukraine tensions apang ginpahayag nga ang desisyon ang kasunod sang nagasikat pa gid nga inter-bank transfers nga nagagamit lang sang mobile phone number sa Russia.##
english: The world's largest money transfer firm did not specify whether it was related to Russia-Ukraine tensions but said the decision followed the increasingly popular inter-bank transfers using only mobile phone numbers in Russia.##

text: Pagasiraduhon ang porsyon sang Mulley Loney St., Iloilo City Proper buwas nga adlaw, Enero 13, 2025 kaangot hiwaton nga National Rally for Peace sang Iglesia ni Cristio-Christian Family Organization.
english: The portion of Mulley Loney St., Iloilo City Proper will be closed tomorrow, January 13, 2025 in connection with the National Rally for Peace of the Church of Cristio-Christian Family Organization.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCOL.
english: PCOL.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga dalan ang siraduhon bangud nga malapit ini sa freedom grandstand nga hiwatan sang aktibidad.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, said the road will be closed because it is close to the freedom grandstand where the activity will be held.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, mahimo nga mapuno sang 30,000 ka nga indibidwal ang Iloilo Freedom Grandstand para sa nasambit nga kahiwatan nga naghalin man sa nagkalain-lain nga perte sang Rehiyon 6.
english: According to Garbanzos, the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand can be filled with 30,000 individuals for the event who also came from different parts of Region 6.

text: Gina-ekspektar man sang natungdan nga ginabanta 1,000 ka mga salakyan ang magasulod sa syudad dala ang tagsa nila ka mga representatives para sa aktibidad.
english: He also expects that about 1,000 vehicles will enter the city with their representatives for the activity.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa ginpirmahan ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga Executive Order 005-A series of 2025, nagrekomendar ini sa mga national government agencies kag mga pribado nga kompaniya sa pag-suspend sang ila operasyon kaangot sa kahiwatan.
english: It is known that in the Executive Order 005-A series of 2025 signed by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, he recommended to national government agencies and private companies to suspend their operations in connection with the event.

text: Bangud sa paglaum nga makaangkon sang anak nga lalaki, nagpasugot ang isa ka nagabusong nga babayi sa Pakistan nga magpalansang sa iya nga ulo.
english: In the hope of having a son, a pregnant woman in Pakistan agreed to have her head nailed.

text: Natabo ini sa Peshawar, ang capital kag pinakadaku nga syudad sa probinsya sang Khyber Pakhtunkhwa sa Pakistan.
english: It happened in Peshawar, the capital and largest city in Pakistan’s Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.

text: Sandig sa report, nagdali-dali ang babayi nga magpangayo sang bulig sa ospital matapos sini gintilawan nga gabuton ang 5 sentimetros ukon duha ka inches nga kalabaaon sang lansang.
english: According to the report, the woman rushed to the hospital after she tried to pull out the 5 centimeters or two inches long nail.

text: Gingamit sini ang pliers.
english: It used the pliers.

text: Una nga gin-alegar sang babayi nga siya ang naglansang sa iya nga ulo, apang sang ulihi, gin-ako sini nga ang naglansang sa iya ulo amo mismo ang faith healer nga nagpangako sa iya nga makabun-ag siya sa isa ka lapsag nga lalaki kun magpasugot sa amo nga akto.
english: The woman initially alleged that he nailed her in the head, but later, she admitted that the one who nailed her in the head was the faith healer who promised her that she would give birth to a baby boy if she agreed to the act.

text: Suno kay Dr. Haider Khan, staff member sa Lady Reading Hospital, “fully conscious” ang babayi apang tuman ang kasakit nga iya nabatyagan.
english: According to Dr. Haider Khan, staff member at Lady Reading Hospital, said the woman was “fully conscious” but she was in a lot of pain.

text: Suno pa sa impormasyon halin sa ospital, may tatlo na ka anak ang amo nga babayi.
english: According to information from the hospital, the woman has three children.

text: Ginapahayag ginpahog siya sang iya bana nga bayaan kun babayi gihapon ang iya igabun-ag nga lapsag.
english: Her husband allegedly threatened to leave her if she gave birth to a girl.

text: Sa kahadlok sang babayi, nagpalapit ini sa faith healer.
english: Terrified, the woman approached the faith healer.

text: Sa subong gin-imbestigaran na sang mga pulis ang x-ray images sang injury nga nag-appear man online.
english: Police are now investigating x-ray images of the injury that also appeared online.

text: Sandig sa tweet ni Peshawar police chief Abbas Ahsan, may special investigative team na nga gintukod agud pasabton ang ginatudlo nga faith healer kag agud mahatagan hustisya ang natabo sa babayi.
english: According to a tweet by Peshawar police chief Abbas Ahsan, a special investigative team has been formed to hold the alleged faith healer accountable and to bring justice to the woman.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa pigado nga mga nasyon sa South Asia, ang anak nga lalaki ang ginapatihan makadala sang swerte para sa financial security sang mga ginikanan.
english: It is known that in poor South Asian countries, the son is believed to bring good luck for the financial security of the parents.

text: Common naman ang faith healers sa pila ka bahin sang Pakistan, ilabi na sa north-western tribal areas.
english: Faith healers are common in some parts of Pakistan, especially in the north-western tribal areas.

text:
Ang ila practice ang nakasandig sa Sufi lore nga ginalaragway man nga “form of Islamic mysticism.”

Ini nga mga aktibidad ang banned man sa madamo nga mga eskwelahan sang Islam.
english:
Their practice is rooted in Sufi lore which is also described as a “form of Islamic mysticism.”

These activities are also banned in many Islamic schools.

text: Indi mag-kumpirmar ang senior US officials sa report nga ginalantaw na sang US intelligence nga sudlon ukon i-invade sang Russia ang pungsod Ukraine sa Myerkules nga adlaw subong nga semana.
english: Senior US officials would not confirm reports that US intelligence is expecting Russia to invade Ukraine on Wednesday.

text: Apisar wala sang kumpirmasyon, ginpahayag naman sang Estados Unidos nga tinguhaan nila nga malikawan ang anuman nga “surprise attack” paagi sa pag-share kun ano ang ila nga mahibaluan sa mga plano sang Russia.
english: Although there was no confirmation, the United States said it would try to avoid any "surprise attack" by sharing what it knows about Russia's plans.

text: Mangin si Pentagon spokesperson John Kirby ang nagpahayag nga posible matabo ang Russian military action sa anuman nga adlaw bangud base sa sources kag base sa mismo literal nga makit-an sang mata, masobra na sa 100,000 troops sang Russia ang ginraya sa border sang Ukraine.
english: Even Pentagon spokesperson John Kirby said Russian military action could happen any day because based on sources and based on what the eye can see, more than 100,000 Russian troops have been deployed to the Ukrainian border.

text: Ginsulit man ni White House National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan nga posible matabo ang Russian invasion anuman nga adlaw.
english: White House National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan also reiterated that a Russian invasion could happen any day.

text: Ginpasalig man sini liwat nga suportahan ni US President Joe Biden ang Ukraine kun may Russian invasion nga matabo kag depensahan man sang Estados Unidos ang teritoryo sang NATO ukon sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization.
english: He also reassured that US President Joe Biden will support Ukraine in the event of a Russian invasion and that the United States will defend the territory of NATO or the North Atlantic Treaty Organization.

text: Sa pamangkot kun san-o ang posible atake nga himuon sang Russia, ginpahayag ni Sullivan nga posible ini matabo antes matapos ang Winter Olympics sa Beijing, China nga naka-schedule nga magtakop sa Pebrero 20.
english: Asked when Russia might launch an attack, Sullivan said it could happen before the end of the Winter Olympics in Beijing, China, scheduled to end on February 20.

text: Suno kay Sullivan, protektahan sang Estados Unidos ang “every inch” sang Article Five territory sang NATO kag nagalaum sila nga mahangpan man sang Russia ini nga mensahe.
english: Sullivan said the United States will protect “every inch” of NATO’s Article Five territory and they hope Russia gets that message as well.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi kabahin sang alyansa sang NATO ang Ukraine.
english: It is known that Ukraine is not part of the NATO alliance.

text: Sanday Sullivan kag Kirby ang naglunsay man nagsulit sang paandam sa mga Amerikado nga magbiya na subong sa ila nahamtangan sa Ukraine.
english: Sullivan and Kirby also reiterated the warning to Americans to leave Ukraine now.

text: Mas nagdamo pa ang mga pungsod nga asud-asud nga nagkondenar sa padayon nga pagpalupad sang North Korea sang ballistic missiles.
english: More and more countries have condemned North Korea's continued launch of ballistic missiles.

text: Lakip sa nagkondenar amo ang matag-as nga opisyal sang Japan, South Korea kag Estados Unidos.
english: Among those who condemned were senior officials from Japan, South Korea and the United States.

text: Ginpangunahan ni US Secretary of State Antony Blinken ang meeting sa Honolulu, Hawaii nga gintambungan naman nanday South Korean Foreign Minister Chung Eui-yong kag Japanese Foreign Minister Hayashi Yoshimasa.
english: US Secretary of State Antony Blinken chaired the meeting in Honolulu, Hawaii, which was attended by South Korean Foreign Minister Chung Eui-yong and Japanese Foreign Minister Hayashi Yoshimasa.

text: Gintawag sang mga top diplomats nga “destabilising” ang pito na ka mga indidente sang ballistic missile nga ginhimo sang North Korea.
english: Top diplomats called North Korea's seven ballistic missile launches “destabilizing.”

text: Suno sa sini nga mga pungsod, dapat na nga untatan sang North Korea ang amo nga aktibidad kag sa baylo, mag-istoryanay na lang sila.
english: According to these countries, North Korea should stop such activity and instead engage in dialogue.

text: Padayon man ang mga lihok agud nga ma-denuclearize ang bilog nga Korean Peninsula, kag agud nga maka-dialogue na ang North Korea kag ang nasambit nga mga pungsod.
english: Efforts are also underway to denuclearize the entire Korean Peninsula, and to enable dialogue between North Korea and these countries.

text: Halin sang administrasyon ni US President Joe Biden, wala naman sang nabatian nga sabat halin sa North Korea kun mapasugot sila sa istoryahanay.
english: Since the administration of US President Joe Biden, no response has been heard from North Korea if they agree to talks.

text: Ang North Korea ang may yara sang malawig nga maragtas sang pag-garit garit sa iban nga mga pungsod paagi sa missile ukon nuclear tests agud nga makaganar sang international concessions.
english: North Korea has a long history of provoking other countries with missile or nuclear tests in order to gain international concessions.

text: Malapit na mahitso ang kasugtanan sang Canada kag Pilipinas agud matugutan ang isa kag isa sa pagpadala sang tropa-militar sa pungsod sang kada isa.
english: Canada and the Philippines are about to sign an agreement to allow each other to send military troops to each other's countries.

text: Suno kay Canadian ambassador to Manila David Hartman, ini ang magapadalom pa sang kooperasyon sa tunga sang duha ka nasyon kag maga-establisar man sang mas substantive participation sa pag-ensayo para nga mapaayo pa gid ang kapasida.
english: According to Canadian ambassador to Manila David Hartman, this will deepen cooperation between the two countries and also establish more substantive participation in the exercise to further improve capacity.

text: Nagalaum ang envoy nga matabo ang pirmahanay kag ang ratipikasyon sang kasugtanan sang duha ka gobyerno antes magtakop ang 2025.
english: The envoy hopes that the signing and ratification of the agreement between the two governments will take place before the end of 2025.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, may diskusyon ang Canadian kag Filipino officials halin sa Department of National Defense (DND) kag Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).
english: Last month, Canadian and Filipino officials from the Department of National Defense (DND) and Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) had a discussion.

text: Kun may yara na sang agreement, mahimo na makaupod ang Canadian troops sa dalagku nga joint military exercises nga tuigan nga ginahimo sang Pilipinas kag US.
english: Once an agreement is reached, Canadian troops can join the major joint military exercises that the Philippines and the US conduct annually.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara na sang visiting forces agreement ang Pilipinas kaupod sa US kag Japan, kag subong gina-istorya man ang France kag ang New Zealand samtang padayon naman ang China sa mga pagpang-garit-garit sini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The Philippines already has a visiting forces agreement with the US and Japan, and is now in talks with France and New Zealand while China continues its claims in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Patay ang nasa 56 katao dahil sa malawakang pagbaha sa Sri Lanka at landslides.
english: At least 56 people have been killed in Sri Lanka due to widespread flooding and landslides.

text: Ayon sa Disaster Management Centre (DMC) na mayroong 21 ang nasawi sa Badulla district ng maganap ang landslide na tumama sa mga kabahayan.
english: According to the Disaster Management Center (DMC), 21 people were killed in Badulla district when a landslide hit houses.

text: Nagbunsod ang malakas na pag-ulan dahil sa bagyong Ditwah na tumama sa eastern coast ng bansa.
english: Heavy rains were caused by Typhoon Ditwah which hit the eastern coast of the country.

text: Pinalikas naman ang maraming residente na malapit sa mga kailugan dahil sa pag-apaw bunsod ng malakas na pag-ulan.
english: Many residents near rivers were evacuated due to flooding caused by heavy rains.

text: Nagapabilin sa Pilipinas ang International Boxing Federation (IBF) minimumweight title matapos liwat nga ginlutos ni Pedro Taduran ang Japanese boxer nga si Ginjiro Shigeoka.
english: The Philippines retains the International Boxing Federation (IBF) minimumweight title after Pedro Taduran again defeated Japanese boxer Ginjiro Shigeoka.

text: Nagdaog ang Pinoy boxer paagi sa split decision subong nga Sabado sa sambuwa nga ginpatigayon sa Osaka, Japan.
english: The Filipino boxer won by split decision this Saturday in the fight held in Osaka, Japan.

text: Duha ka judges ang nagpabor sa defending Filipino world champion, 118-110, 115-113; kag isa naman ang nagpabor sa Japanese, 113-115, matapos ang 36 minutos nga hampang.
english: Two judges favored the defending Filipino world champion, 118-110, 115-113; and another favored the Japanese, 113-115, after 36 minutes of play.

text: Samtang nagaselebrar si Taduran, nakit-an naman sa live feed nga nalipong si Shigeoka, apang sang ulihi na-umpawan man, nagpamahid sang iya nawong, kag ginsakay ini sa stretcher pagguwa sa ring.
english: While Taduran was celebrating, Shigeoka was seen on the live feed fainting, but later regained consciousness, wiped his face, and was put on a stretcher out of the ring.

text: Ginpatigayon ini nga rematch 10 ka bulan matapos ang kadalag-an sang Pinoy paagi sa ninth-round stoppage sang una sila nga nagkitaay sa Otsu sa Hulyo 2024.
english: The rematch was held 10 months after the Filipino's ninth-round stoppage victory when they first met in Otsu in July 2024.

text: Nagsaka na sa 18-4-1 ang record ni Taduran nga may 13 knockouts.
english: Taduran's record has risen to 18-4-1 with 13 knockouts.

text: Posible nga ang masunod para sa Pinoy fighter amo ang unification fight batok sa Puerto Rican nga si Oscar Collazo nga amo ang naga-uyat sang paha sa WBA kag WBO.
english: It is likely that next for the Pinoy fighter is a unification fight against Puerto Rican Oscar Collazo who holds the belts in the WBA and WBO.

text: Indi na bag-uhan si Collazo sa pag-atubang sa Pinoy sa world title clash.
english: Collazo is no stranger to facing the Filipino in the world title clash.

text: Undefeated siya sa 12 fights nga may siyam ka knockouts, kag lakip sa iya nalutos amo si Melvin Jerusalem sang Mayo 2023 para sa WBO strap.
english: He is undefeated in 12 fights with nine knockouts, and among those he defeated was Melvin Jerusalem in May 2023 for the WBO strap.

text: HALOS tanan na nga “Power” ang nadumduman sang mga tawo nga may hilway nga panghuna-huna agud i-away ang ila mga kawsa.
english: ALMOST all “Power” has been remembered by free-thinking people to fight for their causes.

text: People Power!
english: People Power!

text: Women Power!
english: Women Power!

text: Youth Power!
english: Youth Power!

text: Student Power!
english: Student Power!

text: Kag ano pa nga Power agud tumbahon lang ang Dictatorial Power!
english: And what Power to overthrow Dictatorial Power!

text: Indi man kita gali malipat sa Media Power, nga nagapadumdum sa aton sang away sang Duterte Administrasyon kag sang ABS-CBN Media Network.
english: Let's not forget about Media Power, which reminds us of the fight between the Duterte Administration and the ABS-CBN Media Network.

text: Daku nga tunok sa Duterte administrasyon ang ABS-CBN, ang pinakadaku nga media network sa pungsod, sa ginadala sini sing wala kahadlok nga mga balita, opinyon kag bisan pa sa ginapagwa sini nga pangkalingawan nga mga programa.
english: ABS-CBN, the country's largest media network, is a major thorn in the side of the Duterte administration in its fearless delivery of news, opinion and even entertainment programs.

text: Tungod sini gin-medyosan gid nila nga mapunggan ang renewal sang franchise sini sa sulod sang dugang pa nga 25 anyos bisan pa wala man sing kaso nga napamatud-an batok sini.
english: Because of this, they tried to prevent the renewal of its franchise for another 25 years even though no case was proven against it.

text: Sa matuod, tunok gid man sa mga balat-sibuyas nga mga pulitiko ang hilway (independent) nga media sa Demokrasya, labi na gid kon ang luyag lang nila mabatian ang pagdayaw sa ila kag indi ang pagsaway sa ila kakulangan.
english: In fact, the independent media in Democracy is a thorn in the side of onion-skinned politicians, especially when they only want to hear praise for them and not criticism of their shortcomings.

text: Nalipat ugaling sila nga indi ini (ABS-CBN) lubos-lubos nga mapatay tungod sa convenient access sa free TV nga bukas sa international media – katulad sang YouTube kag Facebook – kag bisan paano masunod gihapon sang mga supporters ang pila ka programa sini.
english: However, they forget that it (ABS-CBN) will not die completely because of the convenient access to free TV that is open to international media – such as YouTube and Facebook – and anyway supporters can still follow some of its programs.

text: Yara man ang Social Media sa internet nga bisan sin-o lang pwede makapamati kag makatugda sing libre.
english: There is also Social Media on the internet where anyone can listen and suggest for free.

text: Of course, and traditional media, nga kinahanglan may pahanugot (franchise) sa pagpalayag sang gobyerno, importante gihapon tungod makalab-ut ini sa labing madamo nga mga pumuluyo tubtub sa mga pinakalayo gid, nga importante sa aton “right to information” sa Demokrasya.
english: Of course, the traditional media, which must have a franchise to broadcast the government, is still important because it can reach as many people as possible to the most remote, which is important to our “right to information” in democracy.

text: Kutlon mo ang isa lang ka daku nga media network – radyo man ukon TV katuld sang ABS-CBN – daku na nga “krimen” ini sa aton Demokrasya, labi na gid sa mga kubos naton nga mga utod nga indi makasarang magpanag-iya sang smartphone.
english: If you quote just one big media network – whether radio or TV like ABS-CBN – it is a big “crime” against our democracy, especially for our poor brothers and sisters who cannot afford to own a smartphone.

text:
***

Sa Kamara (House) nag-file na gani liwat sadtong Enero 18 si Representative Vilma Santos (Batangas 6th District) sang House Bill No.
english:
***

In the House of Representatives, Representative Vilma Santos (Batangas 6th District) filed House Bill No.

text: 8298 agud iduso ang franchise renewal sang ABS-CBN sa sulod pa sang 25 anyos sa bahin sang mga myembro sang Kamara nga halso tanan sini madalagan man for reelection.
english: 8298 to push for the franchise renewal of ABS-CBN for another 25 years on the part of the members of the House of Representatives, almost all of whom will also run for reelection.

text: Sa Senado naman, 16 sa 24 ka senador ang nagpahayag na nga pabor sini sa pagpanguna ni Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto sa iya Senate Bill No.
english: In the Senate, 16 of the 24 senators have already expressed their support for Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto's Senate Bill No.

text:
Lakip diri si Senador Grace Poe, upod ang 15 nga nakapirm na sa bill ni Sotto nga sanday Senate President Pro Tempore Ralph Recto, Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri, Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon;

Mga senador nga sanday Panfilo Lacson, Sonny Angara, Nancy Binay, Sherwin Gatchalian, Richard Gordon, Lito Lapid, Manny Pacquiao, Joel Villanueva, Risa Hontiveros, Francis Pangilinan, Aqulino “Koko” Pimentel III, kag  Leila de Lima.
english:
They include Senator Grace Poe, along with 15 who have already signed Sotto's bill, Senate President Pro Tempore Ralph Recto, Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri, Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon;

Senators Panfilo Lacson, Sonny Angara, Nancy Binay, Sherwin Gatchalian, Richard Gordon, Lito Lapid, Manny Pacquiao, Joel Villanueva, Risa Hontiveros, Francis Pangilinan, Aqulino “Koko” Pimentel III, and  Leila de Lima.

text: Nahibal-an naman ninyo seguro kon sin-o ang wala nag-co-author sang Sotto bill.
english: You probably know who did not co-author the Sotto bill.

text:
***

Ngaa ayhan ginadalian gid ining pagduso sang renewal sang franchise sang ABS-CBN?
english:
***

Why is this push for the renewal of ABS-CBN's franchise so urgent?

text: Kag sin-o ang sa ila pwede mag-interest sa suporta sang ABS-CBN kag sang fans sini sa 2022 presidential election tungod sa Media Power sini?
english: And who among them can be interested in the support of ABS-CBN and its fans in the 2022 presidential election because of its Media Power?

text: Ang 10 sang 16 nga mga senador nga nagpahayag sa pagsuporta sa renewal sang ABS-CBN franchise mga reelectionist sa 2022, nga pila sini basi maghandom man sa mas mataas nga pwesto sang Bise Presidente kag Presidente.
english: Ten of the 16 senators who expressed support for the renewal of the ABS-CBN franchise are reelectionists in 2022, some of whom may also aspire to the higher posts of Vice President and President.

text: Ini sanday Leila de Lima (Liberal Party), Win Gatchalian (NPC), Richard Gordon (Independent), Risa Hontiveros (Akbayan), Panfilo Lacson (ndependent), Manny Pacquiao (PDP-Laban), Francis Pangilinan (Liberal), Joel Villanueva CIBAC) kag Juan Miguel Zubiri (Independent).
english: They are Leila de Lima (Liberal Party), Win Gatchalian (NPC), Richard Gordon (Independent), Risa Hontiveros (Akbayan), Panfilo Lacson (independent), Manny Pacquiao (PDP-Laban), Francis Pangilinan (Liberal), Joel Villanueva CIBAC) and Juan Miguel (Independent Zubiri).

text: Sa mapadaug nila ukon indi ang renewal sang ABS-CBN franchise, daku na nga abanse ini nila sa mga bumoloto nga naglain ang buot sa pagpasara sang Duterte administrasyon sa ABS-CBN.
english: Whether or not they win the renewal of the ABS-CBN franchise, they have a big lead over the voters who were upset by the Duterte administration's closure of ABS-CBN.

text: Kon pensar sang anti-ABS-CBN ma-kontrol sini ang media tungod yara sila sa poder, I don’t think nga mahimo nila ini tungod sa Social Media Power nga magamit libre sang oposisyon kag sang coalition sini sa mga independent.
english: If the anti-ABS-CBN thinks it can control the media because they are in power, I don’t think they can do it because of the Social Media Power that can be used free of charge by the opposition and its coalition with the independents.

text:
***

Meantime, sin-o ang inyo botohon para Presidente kag Vice Presidente sang opposition/Independent nga grupo?
english:
***

Meantime, who will you vote for President and Vice President of the opposition/Independent group?

text: Pwede ang Leni Robredo for President kag Joel Villanueva for Vice President, ukon ang Robredo-Lacson tandem.
english: It could be Leni Robredo for President and Joel Villanueva for Vice President, or the Robredo-Lacson tandem.

text: Ang maki-Duterte nga grupo syempre may ara man sila nga mga kandidato nga wala pa kita ugaling ideya bisan katiting./PN
english: The pro-Duterte group of course has candidates that we have no idea yet./PN

text: Literal nga sabaw ang gindangatan sang isa ka buwaya matapos ini nga nagpangaon sang mga hinuptanan nga ido sa isa ka komunidad.
english: A crocodile was literally soup after it ate pet dogs in a community.

text: Natabo ini sa Australia kun sa diin naga-ugtas na ang mga residente bangud magluwas nga nagapanglamon sang ido, ini nga buwaya ang nagapamahog pa sang mga kabataan kag nagatuga sang tuman nga kahadlok.
english: This happened in Australia where residents are already worried because besides eating dogs, this crocodile also threatens children and causes great fear.

text: Nagalaba ini nga sapat sang 3.6 metros.
english: This animal is 3.6 meters long.

text: Ginapahayag nga sang nagbinaha sa temprano nga bahin subong nga tuig, nagtakas ini nga buwaya kag nagsaylo sang ilistaran sa Baines River ukon ang suba nga malapit kaayo sa mga balay sang mga tawo sa Bulla community.
english: It is reported that during the floods earlier this year, the crocodile escaped and moved to the Baines River, which is very close to the houses of the people in the Bulla community.

text: Bangud sa reklamo sang mga pumuluyo nga nagakadula ang ila mga hinuptanan, nagpatunga na ang pulis kag nagpatigayon sang konsultasyon sa mga tigulang kag traditional landowners sa Bulla.
english: Due to complaints from residents that their pets are disappearing, the police have intervened and conducted consultations with the elderly and traditional landowners in Bulla.

text: Ini ginplanuhan nga tiruhon ini kag wala gid sang nagpamalabag bangud sang oras nga patay na ang sapat, nag-preparar pa gani sang fiesta ang mga tawo.
english: It was planned to shoot it and no one objected because when the animal was dead, people even prepared a fiesta.

text: Ang ending?
english: The ending?

text: Gintunga-tunga ang lawas sini suno sa Northern Territory Police kag ginluto sa nagkalain-lain nga putahe.
english: The body was cut in half, according to the Northern Territory Police, and cooked in various dishes.

text: Lakip diri amo ang crocodile tail soup, barbecue, may ara man nga ginputos sa dahon sang saging kag ginsugba.
english: These include crocodile tail soup, barbecue, some wrapped in banana leaves and grilled.

text: Isa ka traditional feast ang natabo nga gin-enjoy naman sang mga tawo.
english: A traditional feast took place which was enjoyed by the people.

text: Pagkatapos sini, nag-conduct man ang Parks and Wildlife team sang “crocodile safety session” agud nga mapahibalo sa mga kabataan kun ano ang risgo kun magtinir sa mga suba ukon sa mga lugar nga posible ginatiniran man sang sini nga sapat.
english: After that, the Parks and Wildlife team also conducted a “crocodile safety session” to inform the children about the risks of staying in rivers or in areas where this animal may also live.

text: Sa mga mahilig magkaon sang prutas nga jackfruit ukon langka, masami mo bala nga ginahaboy gilayon ang liso sini?
english: For those who like to eat jackfruit or langka, do you usually throw away the seeds immediately?

text: Nahibal-an mo bala nga ang jackfruit seeds ukon ang liso sang langka ang napamatud-an nga epektibo sa pagbuild sang muscles, nagapalikaw sa balatian nga anemia kag makabulig pasangkad sang imo sexual pleasure?
english: Did you know that jackfruit seeds or langka seeds have been shown to be effective in building muscles, prevent anemia and help increase your sexual pleasure?

text: Suno kay Ariana Fiorita, Registered and Licensed Dietitian kag Functional Nutritionist sa Cleveland, Florida, USA, ang jackfruit seeds ukon ang liso sang langka ang manggaranon sa iron nga amo ang importante nga component sang hemoglobin.
english: According to Ariana Fiorita, Registered and Licensed Dietitian and Functional Nutritionist in Cleveland, Florida, USA, jackfruit seeds or langka seeds are rich in iron which is the essential component of hemoglobin.

text: Ang iron nga yara sa liso sang langka ang nagapadugang sa produksyon sang red blood cells nga nagapaboost sang immunity sang tawo kag nagapalikaw sa balatian nga anemia.
english: The iron in langka seeds increases the production of red blood cells which boosts human immunity and prevents anemia.

text: Ginpahayag ni Fiorita nga ang liso sang langka ang ginagamit man bilang traditional Asian medicine agud bunglon ang sexual disorders.
english: Fiorita said langka seeds are also used as traditional Asian medicine to treat sexual disorders.

text: Ini bangud ang iron nga yara sa liso sang langka ang nagapukaw sang sexual pleasure sang tawo.
english: This is because the iron present in langka seeds stimulates sexual pleasure in humans.

text: Magluwas diri, manggaranon man sa protein ang liso sang langka nga nagabulig sa pagbuild sang muscles sa diin pwede mo gid ini madugang sa imo nga diet food.
english: In addition, langka seeds are also rich in protein that helps build muscles and you can add them to your diet.

text: Nagpamatok ang mga pasahero sa ginaduso nga pagpasaka sang plete sa fiberboat nga may byahe nga Iloilo pa-Guimaras.
english: Passengers have protested against the proposed fare hike on the fiberboat flight from Iloilo to Guimaras.

text: Ini matapos ang plano sang Guimaras Island Transport Multi-Purpose Cooperative nga ang anay regular fare nga P30, madugang ini sang P10 ukon magalab-ot na sa P40.
english: This follows the plan of the Guimaras Island Transport Multi-Purpose Cooperative to increase the regular fare of P30 by P10 or reach P40.

text: Sa discounted fare para sa mga studyante, senior citizens kag PWD, halin sa P24, magasaka ini sa P32; kag para sa nighttime rate naman, halin sa P30, mangin P45 na.
english: The discounted fare for students, senior citizens and PWDs, from P24, will increase to P32; and for the nighttime rate, from P30, it will be P45.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vancyrel Malcon, isa ka residente sang Guimaras nga naga-eskwela sa siudad sang Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga dako nga huol para sa ila pananglitan nga madayun ang pagpatuman sang pagsaka sang plete.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vancyrel Malcon, a resident of Guimaras who is studying in Iloilo City, said it will be a big problem for them if the fare increase continues.

text: Suno pa kay Malcon, dugang gid nga allowance halin sa iya ginikanan ang iya nga kinahanglanon pananglitan nga magsaka ang pamasahe.
english: According to Malcon, he will need an additional allowance from his parents in case the fare goes up.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Janrex Casabuena, isa ka regular nga pasahero, iya man ginpahayag nga mabug-at gid ini para sa iya nga makapila gid magbalik-balik sa isla ang Guimaras.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Janrex Casabuena, a regular passenger, said it is very difficult for him to go back and forth to the island of Guimaras so many times.

text: Nagpahayag man si Casabuena nga kun presyo sang gatong ang basehan sa pagsaka sang plete, dapat nga wala gid sang tuman nga pagsaka bangud nga nagalain-lain man ang presyo sini kada semana.
english: Casabuena also said that if the price of fuel is the basis for the fare increase, there should be no excessive increase because the price varies every week.

text: Nanindugan si former House Speaker Pantaleon Alvarez nga indi politika ang yara sa likod sang ila natalana nga pag-file sang kaso batok kay House Speaker Martin Romualdez kag iban pa nga mga mamalidha.
english: Former House Speaker Pantaleon Alvarez insisted that politics is not behind their planned filing of cases against House Speaker Martin Romualdez and other lawmakers.

text: Pahayag sini, maathag nga nakahimo sang krimen si Romualdez kag iban pa nga kaalyado sini nga mga kongresista bangud sa mga blangko nga items nga ginbutang sa bicameral report kaangot sa 2025 national budget.
english: He said Romualdez and other allied congressmen clearly committed a crime because of the blank items included in the bicameral report regarding the 2025 national budget.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga nahibaluan nila ini sang gin-email sa ila ang report, kag natukiban man nila nga sang ginpirmahan sang president, kumpleto na ang yara sa report sa national budget.
english: He said they learned of this when the report was emailed to them, and they also discovered that when the president signed it, the national budget report was complete.

text: Duda man ini kun matawag ini nga typographical error ukon grammatical error bangud nagalab-ot suno sa iya saP241 billion ang kantidad nga yara sa ginapahayag nga blank items.
english: He also doubted whether it was a typographical error or grammatical error because he said the amount in the alleged blank items amounted to P241 billion.

text: “Nagulat na lang kaming lahat noong makita namin kung bakit iyon in-e-mail sa amin na bicam report.
english: “We were all surprised when we saw why that was e-mailed to our bicam report.

text: May mga blangko po rito.
english: There are blanks here.

text: Ngunit noong pinirmahan ng presidente, kumpleto na,” pahayag sini sa press conference.
english: As soon as the president signs it, it is complete,” he said in a press conference.

text: “Ewan ko kung matatawag na typographical error ‘yan o grammatical error.
english: “I don’t know if that’s a typographical error or a grammatical error.

text:
Napakalaki po ng halaga, P241 billion.”

“Itong pag-file namin ng criminal cases, hindi po kasama sa politika ito.
english:
It's a huge amount, P241 billion.”

“Our filing of criminal cases is not political.

text: Malinaw na mayroong krimen na nangyari,” dugang pa sang anay house speaker.
english: It is clear that there was a crime,” the former house speaker added.

text: Gindugang man sini nga wala siya sang upod nga congressman sa pag-file sang kaso bangud nahadlok ang iban nga mawad-an sila sang budget sa AKAP kag TUPAD.
english: He added that he did not have a congressman with him to file the case because others were afraid that they would lose their budget to AKAP and TUPAD.
