text: Pareho sanday Alvarez kag PDP Laban member Atty. Jimmy Bondoc nga kaalyado sang mga Duterte apang pareho man sila nga nanginwala nga ini nga tikang ang kabahin sang away-pulitika batok sa mga Marcos.
english: Both Alvarez and PDP Laban member Atty. Jimmy Bondoc, an ally of the Dutertes, but they both denied that the move was part of a political fight against the Marcoses.

text: Suno kay Bondoc, ang pag-file sang kaso-kriminal ang separado sa iya pagpadalagan bilang senador.
english: Bondoc said the filing of the criminal case is separate from his run for senator.

text: Suno sa iya, naga-akto siya sa kapasidad bilang parte sang legal team sang PDP Laban.
english: He said he was acting in the capacity as part of PDP Laban’s legal team.

text: “We are really fighting against the corruption that is nasa institusyon.
english: “We are really fighting against the corruption that is in the institution.

text: Wala po itong kinalaman sa politika.
english: It has nothing to do with politics.

text: Very little to do with politics,” suno sa singer-songwriter kag abogado nga senatorial aspirant sa 2025 elections.
english: Very little to do with politics,” said the singer-songwriter and lawyer who is a senatorial aspirant in the 2025 elections.

text: Disyembre 30 sang ginpirmahan ni President Marcos ang P6.326-trillion national budget para sa 2025.
english: On December 30, President Marcos signed the P6.326-trillion national budget for 2025.

text: Gin-veto sini ang masobra P194 billion nga balor sang line items nga indi consistent sa prayoridad sang iya administrasyon.
english: He vetoed more than P194 billion worth of line items that were not consistent with his administration's priorities.

text: Ang una nga nagpalupok sang balita kaangot sa blank items sa budget amo sanday former President Rodrigo Duterte kag Davao City 3rd District Representative Isidro Ungab.
english: The first to blast the news regarding the blank items in the budget were former President Rodrigo Duterte and Davao City 3rd District Representative Isidro Ungab.

text: Gin-alegar nga may missing budget amounts sa items sa idalom sang Department of Agriculture kag unprogrammed appropriations.
english: It was alleged that there are missing budget amounts in items under the Department of Agriculture and unprogrammed appropriations.

text: Kasunod sadto, sanday fomer executive secretary kag senatorial aspirant Vic Rodriguez, Ungab, kag iban pa ang naghingyo sa Supreme Court (SC) nga ideklarar ang 2025 national budget bilang unconstitutional.
english: Subsequently, fomer executive secretary and senatorial aspirant Vic Rodriguez, Ungab, and others urged the Supreme Court (SC) to declare the 2025 national budget as unconstitutional.

text: Sang amo nga tion, una na nga nagpahayag si Marcos nga nagabinutig si Duterte.
english: At that time, Marcos had already said that Duterte was lying.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – 70% na nga handa ang walo ka mga tribu sa Ati Tribes competition sa Iloilo Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – The eight tribes in the Ati Tribes competition at the Iloilo Dinagyang Festival 2025 are 70% ready.

text:
Ang 2025 edition sang Dinagyang Festival ang may tema nga “Buhi nga Pagtuo sa Kinabuhi sang mga Ilonggo.”

Ang mga tribu nga nagapasakop sa Dinagyang Ati Tribes competition amo ang:

Tribu Paghidaet sang La Paz National High School,
Tribu Salognon sang Jaro National High School,
Tribu Parianon sang District of Molo,
Tribu Ilonganon sang Jalandoni Memorial National High School,
Tribu Pag-Asa Kang Manduryaw sang District of Mandurriao,
Tribu Hangaway sang Graciano Lopez Jaena Elementary School,
Tribu Molave sang Barangay San Rafael, Mandurriao, kag
Tribu Pan-Ay sang Fort San Pedro National High School.
english:
The 2025 edition of the Dinagyang Festival will have the theme “Living Faith in the Lives of Ilonggos.”

The tribes participating in the Dinagyang Ati Tribes competition are:

Tribu Paghidaet of La Paz National High School,
Tribu Salognon of Jaro National High School,
Tribe Parianon of District of Molo,
Tribu Ilonganon of Jalandoni Memorial National High School,
Tribu Pag-Asa Kang Manduryaw of District of Mandurriao,
Tribu Hangaway of Graciano Lopez Jaena Elementary School,
Tribu Molave of Barangay San Rafael, Mandurriao, and
Tribu Pan-Ay of Fort San Pedro National High School.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Eric Divinagracia, artistic director sang Iloilo Dinagyang Festival, iya ginpahayag nga ginpatemprano nila ang Opening Salvo agud nga may yara sang malawig nga tyempo ang mga tribu para sa big day.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Eric Divinagracia, artistic director of the Iloilo Dinagyang Festival, said they postponed the Opening Salvo so that the tribes would have more time for the big day.

text: Suno kay Divinagracia, magapatigayon na sang blocking sa masunod nga semana ang mga tribu antes ang hightlight sa Enero 26.
english: According to Divinagracia, the tribes will conduct blocking next week before the highlight on January 26.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang natungdan sa mga tribu nga magsunod sa mga regulasyon.
english: He also reminded the tribes to follow the regulations.

text: Magluwas sa Dinagyang Ati Tribes competition, balantayan man ang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan, Dinagyang ILOmination Streetdance Competition kag Sadsad sa Calle Real.
english: Besides the Dinagyang Ati Tribes competition, there will also be Kasadyahan sa Babanwahan, Dinagyang ILOmination Streetdance Competition and Sadsad on Calle Real.

text: Nagsugod na subong nga adlaw, Enero 12, ang election period kag amo man ang implementasyon sang gun ban sa bilog nga Pilipinas.
english: The election period began today, January 12, and so did the implementation of the gun ban throughout the Philippines.

text: Nakabase ini sa Omnibus Election Code kun sa diin nakasaad nga maga-umpisa ang election period 90 days antes ang adlaw sang election kag magatakop naman 30 ka adlaw pagkatapos sang piniliay ukon magatupa sa Hunyo 11.
english: This is based on the Omnibus Election Code which states that the election period will begin 90 days before election day and end 30 days after the election or fall on June 11.

text: Suno kay Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairman George Garcia, sulit-sulit gid nga ginapahanumdom sa tanan nga indi gid pwede ang pagdala ukon pagbyahe sang mga armas ukon anuman nga makamamatay nga mga hinganiban magluwas lamang kun may nakasulat nga otorisasyon halin sa Comelec.
english: According to Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairman George Garcia, everyone is repeatedly reminded that it is strictly prohibited to carry or transport firearms or any deadly weapons unless there is written authorization from the Comelec.

text: Indi man pwede makagamit ang mga kandidato sang security personnel ukon bodyguards magluwas lamang kun otorisado man sang komisyon.
english: Candidates are also not allowed to use security personnel or bodyguards unless authorized by the commission.

text: Ginadumilian man ang pag-organisa kag paghupot sang reaction forces, strike forces, ukon kaangay sini nga mga grupo.
english: The organization and maintenance of reaction forces, strike forces, or similar groups is also prohibited.

text: Indi man pwede ang pagsaylo ukon pag-reassign sang mga opisyal kag mga empleyado sa civil service magluwas lamang kun may nauna na nga approval halin sa poll body.
english: The transfer or reassignment of officers and employees in the civil service is also prohibited unless there is prior approval from the poll body.

text: Indi man pwede ang suspension sang elective provincial, city, municipal ukon barangay officer nga wala sang prior approval sang Comelec.
english: The suspension of an elective provincial, city, municipal or barangay officer without prior approval of the Comelec is also not allowed.

text: Ang anuman nga paglapas sa namensyonar nga mga pagsulundan ang makonsiderar na nga election offense.
english: Any violation of the said rules will be considered an election offense.

text: Mabug-at ang penalidad kaangay sang pagkapreso sang 1-6 ka tuig, disqualification sa pag-uyat sang public office, kag mahimo man nga makakasan sang kinamatarong nga makaboto.
english: The penalties are severe such as imprisonment of 1-6 years, disqualification from holding public office, and can also be deprived of the right to vote.

text: Bangud hugot man ang mga security measures sa bilog nga pungsod, ginpahayag ni Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen.
english: Due to tight security measures nationwide, Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen.

text: Rommel Francisco Marbil nga ang mga pulis sa checkpoints ang dapat man nga magsuksok sang body-worn cameras kag iban pa nga alternatibo nga recording devices.
english: Rommel Francisco Marbil said police officers at checkpoints should also wear body-worn cameras and other alternative recording devices.

text: Kinahanglanon ini suno sa iya agud masiguro nga protektado ang mga sibilyan kag malikawan nga may mga pagpang-abuso nga himuon ang PNP ukon paghimo sang anuman nga iligal nga akto.
english: He said this is necessary to ensure that civilians are protected and to avoid abuses by the PNP or any illegal act.

text: Paagi sa body cameras suno kay Marbil, matuman sang pulis ang plain view doctrine kun sa diin nakasaad nga mahimo makuha sang law enforcement authorities ang ebidensya sa krimen ukon kontrabando nga makit-an sa plain sight ukon paagi lamang sa visual inspection.
english: Through body cameras, Marbil said, the police can comply with the plain view doctrine which states that law enforcement authorities can obtain evidence of crime or contraband that can be seen in plain sight or only through visual inspection.

text: Buot silingon sini, indi pwede nga buksan sang pulis ang trunk ukon glove compartment sang salakyan kag indi man pwede nga papanaugon kag maghimo sang body-search sa mga pasahero.
english: This means that the police cannot open the trunk or glove compartment of the vehicle and cannot dismount and conduct a body-search on the passengers.

text: Iposisyon man ang security checkpoints sa masanag nga mga lugar kag mga areas nga may CCTV cameras kag dapat man nga naka-proper uniform ang mga police personnel kag dapat nga kit-anon ang name tags.
english: Security checkpoints will also be positioned in bright places and areas with CCTV cameras and police personnel should be wearing proper uniforms and name tags should be visible.

text: Nag-abiso naman ang Foreign Office sang United Kingdom sa tanan nga British citizens nga yara pa sa Ukraine nga magbiya na sa amo nga pungsod samtang may salakyan pa nga available.
english: The United Kingdom's Foreign Office has advised all British citizens still in Ukraine to leave the country while vehicles are available.

text: Ang advisory ang gin-isyu bangud sang padayon nga pagtaas sang kahangawa nga malapit na lang sakupon sang Russia ang Ukraine.
english: The advisory was issued amid ever-increasing concerns that Russia is about to invade Ukraine.

text: Antes ang advisory halin sa UK, nauna na si US President Joe Biden sa pagpanawagan sa US citizens sa Ukraine nga maghimos na kag magbiya sa amo nga lugar.
english: Antes ang advisory halin sa UK, nauna na si US President Joe Biden sa pagpanawagan sa US citizens sa Ukraine nga maghimos na kag magbiya sa amo nga lugar.

text: Gin-anunsyo man sang US President nga may yara sang emergency military plans nga pasakyon sa eroplano ang Americans nga nagpalagyo halin sa Ukraine padulong sa Poland.
english: The US President also announced that there are emergency military plans to fly Americans fleeing Ukraine to Poland.

text: Ini agud nga malikawan ang kapalpakan sa evacuation kaangay sang natabo sa Kabul sa Afghanistan sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is to avoid a failure in the evacuation like what happened in Kabul in Afghanistan last year.

text: Sa bahin sang UK, ginpahayag sang foreign office nga wala sang may gina-plano nga emergency airlift bangud madamo pa sang commercial flights nga naga-operate sa land border sa Poland.
english: On the UK side, the foreign office said no emergency airlift is planned as there are still many commercial flights operating at the land border with Poland.

text: Ginmuno kag ginsaway sang health and medical advocates ang pag-insulto ni Sen.
english: Health and medical advocates condemned Sen.

text: Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa sa nawong ni Akbayan Rep.
english: Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa in the face of Akbayan Rep.

text: Percival Cendaña nga isa gali ka stroke survivor.
english: Percival Cendaña who is actually a stroke survivor.

text: Nag-ugat ini sang nagkomento si Cendaña kaangot sa impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: This stemmed from Cendaña's comments on the impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sang nagsiling si Sara nga mas masakit pa nga mabayaan sang nobya ukon nobyo ipaanggid sa pag-impeach sang Kamara sa iya, nagkomento man si Cendaña nga indi ini nahanungod sa lover kundi istorya sa “public accountability and liability.
english: When Sara said that it is more painful to be abandoned by a girlfriend or boyfriend than to be impeached by the House of Representatives, Cendaña also commented that this is not about the lover but a story of “public accountability and liability.

text: Diri na kag nag-eksena si Bato kag nagsabat sa comment section nga daw nasumbagan ang nawong sang kongresista rason nga nagkiwi.
english: Bato then made a scene and replied in the comment section that the congressman's face seemed to be hit causing him to wince.

text: Ginhangkat pa niya ini nga magpalapit para nga masumbagan sa pihak nga parte sang nawong agud nga magbalanse.
english: He even challenged her to come closer so that he could hit her on the other side of the face to balance her.

text: Nagsabat naman ang Akbyan representative nga kiwi ang iya itsura bangud isa siya ka stroke survivor.
english: The Akbyan representative replied that he looks kiwi because he is a stroke survivor.

text: Nagpalabtik man ini nga maisog ang senador, pero kuntani suno sa iya, amo man ini kaisog pag-abot sa isyu sa China sa West Philippine Sea kag pag-atubang sa International Criminal Court kaangot sa isyu sa war on drugs.
english: He also praised the senator as brave, but he said he should have been as brave when it came to the China issue in the West Philippine Sea and facing the International Criminal Court on the issue of the war on drugs.

text: Si Bato amo anay ang chief sang Philippine National Police (PNP) sa idalom sang Duterte administration, samtang si Cendaña naman ang una nga nagpirma sa una sa apat ka impeachment complaints batok kay Sara Duterte.
english: Bato was the former chief of the Philippine National Police (PNP) under the Duterte administration, while Cendaña was the first to sign the first of four impeachment complaints against Sara Duterte.

text: Base naman sa joint statement sang 31 ka mga doctor kag advocates nga kadam-an parte sang umbrella group nga Epilepsy Awareness Philippines, ang komento ni Bato ang insulto sa dignidad sang mga tawo nga may health conditions.
english: Based on a joint statement by 31 doctors and advocates, most of whom are part of the umbrella group Epilepsy Awareness Philippines, Bato's comment is an insult to the dignity of people with health conditions.

text: “Senator Bato Dela Rosa’s attack on Akbayan Rep.
english: “Senator Bato Dela Rosa’s attack on Akbayan Rep.

text: Perci Cendaña is not just cruel—it is an insult to the dignity of persons with health conditions,” kabahin sang statement.
english: Perci Cendaña is not just cruel—it is an insult to the dignity of persons with health conditions,” the statement said.

text: Pahayag pa sang grupo, kun nag-research kuntani si Bato, nahibaluan kuntani sini nga na-stroke anay ang kongresista.
english: The group said that if Bato had done research, he would have known that the congressman had a stroke.

text: Ang kaangay sini nga komento suno sa grupo ang nagapadalom pa sang diskriminasyon sa mga tawo nga may problema sa ikaayong lawas.
english: Such comments, the group said, deepen discrimination against people with health problems.

text: “Instead, his appalling remarks reinforce harmful stereotypes and deepen the discrimination that people with various health concerns endure every day.
english: “Instead, his appalling remarks reinforce harmful stereotypes and deepen the discrimination that people with various health concerns endure every day.

text: Advocates have long fought for a society built on inclusivity, respect, and equal rights, yet Dela Rosa s actions undermine this progress by reducing a hlth condition to a mere punchline,” kabahin sang statement.
english: Advocates have long fought for a society built on inclusivity, respect, and equal rights, yet Dela Rosa s actions undermine this progress by reducing a hlth condition to a mere punchline,” part of the statement.

text: Mangin si former Senator Leila de Lima ang nagpahayag man nga bastos ang pahayag sang senador.
english: Even former Senator Leila de Lima said the senator's statement was rude.

text: “Hindi ito biro tahasang pambabastos ito, lalo na sa isang taong buong tapang na humarap at nalampasan ang matinding hamon sa kanyang kalusugan,” pahayag ni De Lima.
english: “This is not a joke, it is an insult, especially to a person who has bravely faced and overcome severe health challenges,” De Lima said.

text: “Ipinapakita ng ganitong asal kung bakit kailangang piliing mabuti ang mga namumuno sa ating bayan.”
english: “This behavior shows why we need to choose our leaders carefully.”

text: Hatagan sang special attention sang Commission on Elections Region 6 ang banwa sang Calinog, Iloilo kasunod sang nalakip ini sa red category list para sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Commission on Elections Region 6 will give special attention to the town of Calinog, Iloilo following its inclusion in the red category list for the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Wil Arceño, Asst.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Wil Arceño, Asst.

text: Regional Director sang Commission on Elections Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga may mga factors nga ginkosiderar rason nga ginpaidalom sa red category ang nasambit nga banwa.
english: Regional Director of the Commission on Elections Region 6, he said that there are factors that were considered reason why the said town was placed under the red category.

text: Suno kay Arceño, indi buot silingon nga kon yara sa red category ang isa ka banwa mapabilin lang ini sa amo nga posisyon bangud posible pa ini magbag-o samtang nagahilapit ang eleksyon.
english: According to Arceño, it does not mean that if a town is in the red category, it will remain in that position because it may change as the election approaches.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga magapabilin nga yara sa evaluation ang banwa kag mahimo pa nga maglain ang status sini.
english: He also explained that the town will remain under evaluation and its status may deteriorate.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa bilog nga Western Visayas, ang Calinog ang nagaisahanon nga banwa sa idalom sang “red category” nga amo ang highest level sang election-related security concerns.
english: It is known that in the entire Western Visayas, Calinog is the only town under the “red category” which is the highest level of election-related security concerns.

text: Ginkondena nanday US President Donald Trump kag Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba ang China sa mga aktibidad sini sa West Philippine Sea nga nagapang-garit-garit kag nagapasaka pa sang tensyon sa teritoryo.
english: US President Donald Trump and Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba have condemned China for its activities in the West Philippine Sea that are provocative and heighten tensions in the territory.

text: Base ini sa joint statement nga ginpaguwa matapos nga nagkit-anay ang duha ka nasambit nga lider sa bilateral summit sa Washington D.C. sang Pebrero 7.
english: This is based on a joint statement issued after the two leaders met at a bilateral summit in Washington D.C. on February 7.

text: Suno pa sa amo nga statement, ginpabakod nanday Trump kag Ishiba ang ila nga seryoso nga pagpamatok sa iligal nga martime claims sang People’s Republic of China, ang ila nga militarisasyon sa gin-reclaim nga features, kag ang mga pagpamahog sa amo nga kadagatan.
english: According to the statement, Trump and Ishiba reinforced their serious opposition to the illegal maritime claims of the People's Republic of China, their militarization of the reclaimed features, and the threats in those waters.

text: Ginpasalig man sang duha nga pareho sila nga determinado nga mag-kooperar para sa hilway kag malinong nga Indo-Pacific region.
english: The two also reassured that they are both determined to cooperate for a free and peaceful Indo-Pacific region.

text: Paagi man sa ila nga kooperasyon, ginalauman ang dekalidad nga infrastructure investments sa rehiyon kaangay sang deployment sang Open Radio Access Networks sa third countries.
english: Through their cooperation, quality infrastructure investments in the region such as the deployment of Open Radio Access Networks in third countries are expected.

text: Una na nga nagpromisa ang US kag Japan sang USD8 million para sa Open Radio Access Network (RAN) field trials nga amo ang makapasigurado sang masaligan nga impormasyon kag communications technology ecosystem sa Pilipinas.
english: The US and Japan have already pledged USD8 million for the Open Radio Access Network (RAN) field trials that will ensure a reliable information and communications technology ecosystem in the Philippines.

text: Subong nga bulan, natalana nga pormal nga magpirma ang Japan sang diplomatic notes para sa ila nga non-project grant aid para sa Open RAN System sa University of the Philippines.
english: This month, Japan is scheduled to formally sign diplomatic notes for its non-project grant aid for the Open RAN System at the University of the Philippines.

text: Ang latest nga ginahimo sang China sa West Philippine Sea amo ang pag-deploy sang ila nga coast guard vessels lakip na ang monster ship 100 nautical miles halin sa coastline sang probinsya sang Zambales.
english: China's latest move in the West Philippine Sea is the deployment of its coast guard vessels including the monster ship 100 nautical miles from the coastline of Zambales province.

text: Ordinaryo lang ang valentine’s day sa Congo, Africa.
english: Valentine’s day is ordinary in Congo, Africa.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Fr.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Fr.

text: Dave Tacay, wala ginaselebrar ang valentine’s day sang mga congolese bangud indi sila showy sang ila “love” kag wala sang public display of affection (PDA).
english: Dave Tacay, Congolese do not celebrate Valentine's Day because they are not showy of their love and do not have public display of affection (PDA).

text: Suno kay Fr.
english: According to Fr.

text: Tacay, ini masami nga makit-an ang mga congolese nga naga-date sa parks ukon restaurants.
english: Tacay, it is often seen Congolese dating in parks or restaurants.

text: Apang, bangud sa madamo nga foreigners sa amu nga pungsod, nagapreparar sa gihapon sang pila ka aktibidad kag decorations ang mga lokal sang Congo.
english: However, due to the large number of foreigners in the country, the locals of Congo are still preparing some activities and decorations.

text: Tradition naman sang Congolese nga magpatahi sang traditional dress para sa couple.
english: It is a Congolese tradition to sew a traditional dress for the couple.

text: Ini amu ang terno nga tela nga kaangay sang “malong” sa Pilipinas.
english: This is the suit of fabric similar to the “malong” in the Philippines.

text: Ginapatahi ini nga terno nga blouse kag palda para sa babayi kag polo kag pantalon naman para sa mga lalaki.
english: This suit is made into a blouse and skirt for women and a polo and pants for men.

text: Mixed ukon combination sang nagkalain-lain nga kultura sang tagsa ka foreigners ang selebrasyon sang Valentine’s day sa Congo.
english: The celebration of Valentine's Day in Congo is a mixture of different cultures of each foreigner.

text: Simple man nga nagapadulong sa restaurants kag parks ang mga couple para sa ila nga date.
english: Couples also simply go to restaurants and parks for their dates.

text: Magasugod na buwas nga adlaw, Enero 12, 2025 ang election period para sa May 2025 midterm elections.
english: The election period for the May 2025 midterm elections will begin tomorrow, January 12, 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Wil Arceño, Asst.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Wil Arceño, Asst.

text: Regional Director sang Commission on Elections Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga sa pagsugod sang election period magasugod man ang intensified nga check points sa pila ka mga dalan, pantalan, paluparan, kag mga terminal.
english: Regional Director of the Commission on Elections Region 6, he said that with the beginning of the election period, intensified check points will also begin on some roads, ports, airports, and terminals.

text: Suno kay Arceño, opisyal man nga magasugod ang estrikto nga pagpatuman sang gun ban sa Western Visayas.
english: According to Arceño, the strict implementation of the gun ban in Western Visayas will also officially begin.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sa idalom sang gun ban, istrikto nga ginadumilian ang pagdala ukon pagbyahe sang armas kag iban pa nga makamamatay nga bagay kaangay sang patalom magluwas lang kun otorisado ini.
english: He also said that under the gun ban, it is strictly prohibited to carry or travel with weapons and other deadly objects such as knives unless authorized.

text: Gintumod man ni Arceño nga makabig nga election offense ang paglapas sa gun ban kag may daku nga penalidad kaangay sang pagka-preso, permanent disqualification sa pagpungko sa public office, kag pagkadula sang kinamatarong sa pagboto.
english: Arceño also pointed out that violating the gun ban is an election offense and carries heavy penalties such as imprisonment, permanent disqualification from holding public office, and loss of the right to vote.

text: Nahibaluan nga bilang general rule, ang bona fide police, military, kag myembro sang government law enforcement agencies nga may complete uniform kag yara sa official duty ang indi sakop sang election gun ban sa bug-os nga election period.
english: As a general rule, bona fide police, military, and members of government law enforcement agencies in full uniform and on official duty are not covered by the election gun ban for the entire election period.

text: Indi maapektuhan ang preparasyon sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) apisar pa sang impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The preparations of the Commission on Elections (Comelec) will not be affected despite the impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Suno kay Comelec chairman George Garcia, isa ini ka political decision kag wala sang labot sa pagpatigayon sang piniliay.
english: According to Comelec chairman George Garcia, this is a political decision and has nothing to do with the conduct of the election.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga indi sila madisturbo sang bisan ano nga development sa pulitika bangud wala man ini sang implikasyon sang pag-print sang balota, paghanas sa mga manunudlo, kag sa pangkabug-usan nga mga preparasyon.
english: He also assured that they will not be disturbed by any political development as it has no implications on the printing of ballots, training of teachers, and general preparations.

text: “Tuloy-tuloy ang paghahanda natin at hindi kami maiistorbo dito sa kaso o sa kahit anong klaseng development sa politika dahil wala itong implication sa pagp-imprenta ng balota, sa pagt-train ng mga guro at sa paghahanda overall sa ating halalan,” pahayag sang nagapamuno sa poll body.
english: “We are continuously preparing and we will not be disturbed by the case or any kind of political development because it has no implication in the printing of ballots, the training of teachers and the overall preparation for our election,” said the head of the poll body.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Sara nga wala siya sang plano nga mag-resign sa iya posisyon bisan gin-impeach siya sang Kamara.
english: Earlier, Sara said she had no plans to resign from her position even if the House impeached her.

text: Wala man ini sang plano sa 2025 elections apang nagsiling nga handa siya nga magbulig sa Comelec para sa ila nga voter education program.
english: He also has no plans for the 2025 elections but said he is ready to help the Comelec for their voter education program.

text: Gin-abi-abi man ni Garcia ang bulig nga gintanyag sang bise presidente.
english: Garcia also welcomed the assistance offered by the vice president.

text: “Napakalaking tulong ng lahat ng ahensya ng pamahalaan hindi lang ng Office of the Vice President…sa ating pagsisimula mismo ang pananalita na tayo ay hindi mamimili ng boto, hindi tayo gagamit ng state resources at tatalima sa patakaran ng Comelec.
english: “The help of all government agencies, not just the Office of the Vice President...in our very beginning, we said that we will not vote, we will not use state resources and we will follow the policies of the Comelec.

text: Malaking tulong po yan sa Commission,” dugang ni Garcia.
english: That's a big help to the Commission,” Garcia added.

text: Sa subong, naka-imprinta na ang Comelec sang 14,747,766 official ballots kasunod sang ila pag-resume sang pag-print sang January 27.
english: So far, the Comelec has printed 14,747,766 official ballots following the resumption of printing on January 27.

text:
ILOmination Philippine Light Festival sang Iloilo Dinagyang Festival 2025, pasakopan sang 5 ka mga national festivals

Nakatalana nga maghatag sang kasanag sa mga tumalan-aw paagi sa pinakaulihi nga innovation sang ILOmination Philippine Light Festival sang Iloilo Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english:
ILOmination Philippine Light Festival of Iloilo Dinagyang Festival 2025, will be attended by 5 national festivals

The Iloilo Dinagyang Festival 2025 is set to provide light to the audience through the latest innovation of the ILOmination Philippine Light Festival.

text: Ini ang magapakita sang pagtililipon sang mga nagapanguna nga light festivals sang pungsod bilang kabahin sang tuigan nga selebrasyon sini.
english: It will feature a gathering of the country’s top light festivals as part of its annual celebration.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elvert Bañares, Director for arts and culture initiatives sang Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Elvert Bañares, Director for arts and culture initiatives of the Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Inc.

text: (IFFI), iya ginpahayag nga nagpadala sang imbitasyon si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kag positibo ang sabat sang lima ka mga festivals.
english: (IFFI), he said Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sent an invitation and the five festivals responded positively.

text: Magabuylog sa paindis-indis ang mga grupo sang Pandang Gitab, ang opisyal nga kapiestahan sang Oriental Mindoro; Pavvurulun Afi Festival sang Tuguegarao City, Cagayan; Tanglawan Festival sang San Jose del Monte, Bulacan; Hermosa Festival sang Zamboanga City; kag Bailes de Luces Festival sang La Castellana, Negros Occidental.
english: Joining the competition will be groups from Pandang Gitab, the official festival of Oriental Mindoro; Pavvurulun Afi Festival of Tuguegarao City, Cagayan; Tanglawan Festival of San Jose del Monte, Bulacan; Hermosa Festival of Zamboanga City; and Bailes de Luces Festival of La Castellana, Negros Occidental.

text: Suno kay Bañares, ang ILOmination champion sang nagligad nga tuig nga Tribu Sidlangan ang magapasundayag bilang bisita, kaupod ang Iloilo’s Banaag Festival gikan sa Anilao, ang nagaisahanon nga light festival sang probinsya.
english: According to Bañares, last year's ILOmination champion Tribu Sidlangan will perform as a guest, along with Iloilo's Banaag Festival from Anilao, the province's only light festival.

text: Ang ILOmination nagsugod sang 2023, pagkatapos sang pandemya, nga nagasimbulo sang kasanag pagkatapos sang kadulom.
english: ILOmination started in 2023, after the pandemic, symbolizing light after darkness.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang ILOmination Philippine Light Festival, nga nagakompleto sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan ang may grand prize nga P500,000.
english: The ILOmination Philippine Light Festival, which complements the Kasadyahan sa Babanwahan, has a grand prize of P500,000.

text: Gina-antisipar na sang West nga posible may atubangon nga katalagman sa masunod nga mga inadlaw kasunod sang pag-umpisa sang Russia sang military exercises sa pungsod Belarus kag sa Black Sea nga kasunod pa gid sang ila nga military build-up sa border sang Ukraine.
english: The West is already anticipating a potential threat in the coming days following Russia's launch of military exercises in Belarus and the Black Sea following its military build-up on the Ukrainian border.

text: 10 ka adlaw ang military exercises nga ipatigayon sang Russia, kag ginapatihan 3,000 ka mga tropa ang ila nga ginpadala — ang biggest Russian deployment halin sang natabo ang Cold War.
english: Russia will conduct 10 days of military exercises, and is believed to have sent 3,000 troops — the biggest Russian deployment since the Cold War.

text: Magluwas pa ini sa 100,000 ka Russian troops nga nagapabilin sa border sang Ukraine.
english: This is in addition to the 100,000 Russian troops who remain on the Ukrainian border.

text: Suno kay British Prime Minister Boris Johnson, ini na ang posible pinakadaku nga security crisis sa Europa sa sulod sang pila ka dekada.
english: According to British Prime Minister Boris Johnson, this is possibly the biggest security crisis in Europe in decades.

text: Nagapati si Johnson nga wala pa sang desisyon ang Russia sa pagpang-atake, apang wala man ini nagakahulugan suno sa iya nga wala sang may matabo nga katalagman sa labing-madali nga tion.
english: Johnson believes that Russia has not yet decided to launch an attack, but that does not mean that there will be no danger as soon as possible.

text: Ginakabalak-an man bangud nagasaka pa ang numero sang tropa nga ginapadala sang Russia, kag nagakahulugan ini nga naganubo naman ang warning time para sa posible nga pagpang-atake.
english: It is also worrying that the number of troops Russia is sending is still increasing, and this means that the warning time for a possible attack is decreasing.

text: Una na nga ginpanindugan sang Russia wala sang kamatuoran ang akusasyon sang West nga may plano ini nga sakupon ang former Soviet neighbour nga amo ang pungsod Ukraine, apang posible suno sa Moscow nga magpatigayon ini sang ‘military-technical’ action kun indi pagtumanon ang ila nga demand.
english: Russia has previously insisted that there is no truth in the West's accusation that it has plans to invade former Soviet neighbor Ukraine, but Moscow says it may conduct military-technical action if its demands are not met.

text: Nagsabat ang bata ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s son responded.

text: nga si Ilocos Norte Representative Sandro Marcos nga wala sang dapat nga ika-tingala kun ngaa siya ang una nga nagpirma agud nga ma-impeach sa Kamara si Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Ilocos Norte Representative Sandro Marcos said there is nothing surprising why he was the first to sign the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte in the House of Representatives.

text: Indi na ini makakilibot suno kay Sandro ilabi na sa mga ginpanghambal ni Sara sa iya pamilya.
english: Sandro said this is not surprising especially with what Sara said to her family.

text: Ginhalimbawa sini ang statement anay ni Sara sang Oktubre 2024 nga kalkalon ang bangkay sang iya Lolo nga si the late President Ferdinand E. Marcos, Sr.
english: He cited Sara's statement in October 2024 that the body of her grandfather, the late President Ferdinand E. Marcos, Sr., will be exhumed.

text: sa Libingan ng mga Bayani kag itagbong sa West Philippine Sea.
english: in the Libingan ng mga Bayani and be thrown into the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ikaduha suno kay Sandro amo ang pahayag ni Sara nga kun may magpatay sa iya, may ginmanduan man ini nga patyon si President Marcos, First Lady Liza Marcos, kag House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Second, Sandro said, is Sara's statement that if someone kills her, she has also ordered the killing of President Marcos, First Lady Liza Marcos, and House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: “Alangan naman kung sasabihin ng tao na gusto silang hukayin yung lolo mo at itapon ‘yung katawan sa West Philippine Sea, sasabihin niya gusto niyang patayin ang Pangulo at ang First Lady na aking [mga] magulang at gusto niyang patayin ang Speaker, eh bakit naman nagugulat ang tao na pipirma ko diyan?” paathag sang mamalidha.
english: "If someone says they want to dig up your grandfather and throw his body in the West Philippine Sea, he says he wants to kill the President and the First Lady who are my parents and he wants to kill the Speaker, why is the person surprised that I sign it?" the lawmaker explained.

text: Suno sa kongresista, indi dapat pagbalewalaon ang kaangay sini nga mga statement ilabi na kun halin ini sa tawo nga may mataas nga posisyon.
english: The congressman said such statements should not be ignored especially if they come from people in high positions.

text: “Bakit naman nagugulat ang tao na pipirma ako diyan?
english: “Why is the person surprised that I will sign it?

text: You know, these are statements that cannot be taken lightly, especially from someone in such a high position,” dugang sini.
english: You know, these are statements that cannot be taken lightly, especially from someone in such a high position,” it added.

text: “Of course, I’ll be the first one to sign.
english: “Of course, I’ll be the first one to sign.

text:
That should come as no surprise.”

Si Sandro amo ang subang nga bata sang presidente kag first lady, kag hinablos man siya ni Romualdez.
english:
That should come as no surprise.”

Sandro is the eldest son of the president and first lady, and he is also Romualdez's nephew.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini nga ginlaygayan siya sang iya amay nga himuon lamang ang iya trabaho bilang congressman kag sundon kun ano ang sinumpaan sa Konstitusyon.
english: He also shared that his father advised him to do his job as a congressman and follow what is sworn in the Constitution.

text: Pahayag sini, isa ka constitutional duty nga magsunod siya sa impeachment process bilang isa ka elected representative.
english: He said it is a constitutional duty for him to follow the impeachment process as an elected representative.

text: “Well, katulad po sa sinabi ng ating Pangulo ay nung nagpirmahan na sa impeachment complaint ay tinanong ko siya kung ano ba ang advice niya.
english: “Well, as our President said, when he signed the impeachment complaint, I asked him what his advice was.

text: And tama naman yung sinabi niya: ‘Do your duty as a congressman and uphold your oath to the Constitution that you swore to protect,'” dugang sini sa isa ka interview.
english: And he was right: 'Do your duty as a congressman and uphold your oath to the Constitution that you swear to protect,'” he added in an interview.

text: Sang Miyerkules, 215 ka mga mamalidha ang nagpirma para ma-impeach sa Kamara si Sara.
english: On Wednesday, 215 lawmakers signed a petition to impeach Sara from the House.

text: Si Sandro ang una nga signatory kag si Romualdez naman ang katapusan nga nagpirma.
english: Sandro was the first signatory and Romualdez was the last to sign.

text: Kahapon, Pebrero 7, may yara sang House release nga nagsaad nga may 25 pa gid ka dugang nga representatives nga nagpirma man para sa impeachment — buot silingon, 240 na subong ang complainants halin sa Kamara.
english: Yesterday, Feb. 7, there was a House release promising that there were 25 additional representatives who also signed for impeachment — that is, there are now 240 complainants from the House.

text: Yara subong ang bola sa Senado para sa patigayunon nga impeachment trial.
english: The ball is now in the Senate for the impeachment trial.

text: Ginapamatukan sang grupo sang mga mangunguma ang ginhimo sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga pag-apruba sang panibag-o nga importasyon sang linibo ka metriko tonelada sang puti kag pula nga bombay.
english: The farmers' group is opposing the Department of Agriculture (DA)'s approval of the new importation of thousands of metric tons of white and red bombay.

text: Suno kay Jayson Cainglet, executive director sang Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG), indi ini ang tion para nga mag-import sang amo nga produkto.
english: According to Jayson Cainglet, executive director of Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG), this is not the time to import such products.

text: Ginklaro sini nga wala sila nagabalabag sa importasyon, apang dapat kuntani nga himuon ini pagkatapos sang ani kaangay sang bulan sang Hulyo, Agusto, kag Septyembre.
english: He clarified that they are not blocking imports, but should have done so after the harvest like in the months of July, August, and September.

text: Pahayag sini, kun ginasiling sang DA nga maga-abot na sa masunod nga duha ka semana ang imports, peak harvest man ini sa Pilipinas gani maga-dungan ang suplay.
english: He said that if the DA says that the imports will arrive in the next two weeks, it is also peak harvest in the Philippines so the supply will be simultaneous.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga na-atrasar lang ang harvest subong nga tuig bangud sa Bagyo Pepito, apang wala sang ginapanan-aw nga problema sa volume.
english: He said the harvest was delayed this year due to Typhoon Pepito, but no problems are expected in the volume.

text: Suno pa kay Cainglet, may pila ka mga mangunguma nga temprano pa nga naga-harvest sang ila produkto, bangud sa kahangawa nga mangin tuman ka nubo ang farmgate prices kun mag-inabot na ang bombay nga gin-import.
english: According to Cainglet, there are some farmers who are harvesting their products early, due to concerns that farmgate prices will be too low when the imported bombay arrives.

text: Una na nga ginpaathag ni DA spokesperson kag Assistant Secretary Arnel De Mesa nga indi man madamo ang iga-import bangud ginkonsiderar man ang peak harvest sa Marso.
english: Earlier, DA spokesperson and Assistant Secretary Arnel De Mesa explained that not much will be imported because the peak harvest in March is also considered.

text: Ginalantaw nga magaabot ini sa Pilipinas sa Pebrero 20.
english: It is expected to arrive in the Philippines on February 20.

text: Sandig sa gin-aprubahan ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., lakip sa i-import amo ang 3,000 metric tons sang red onions kag 1,000 metric tons sang white onions.
english: According to the approval of Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., among the imports are 3,000 metric tons of red onions and 1,000 metric tons of white onions.

text: Panigurado ini suno sa tiglikom nga bastante ang buffer stocks sang pungsod samtang ginahulat ang fresh harvest.
english: The secretary said this is to ensure that the country has sufficient buffer stocks while waiting for the fresh harvest.

text: “This importation of 3,000 metric tons of red onions and 1,000 metric tons of white onions is intended to ensure we have sufficient buffer stocks while we await the fresh harvest,” suno kay Tiu Laurel.
english: “This importation of 3,000 metric tons of red onions and 1,000 metric tons of white onions is intended to ensure we have sufficient buffer stocks while we await the fresh harvest,” according to Tiu Laurel.

text: “We will not risk a potential shortage that unscrupulous traders could exploit to drive up prices, as we saw in the past.
english: “We will not risk a potential shortage that unscrupulous traders could exploit to drive up prices, as we saw in the past.

text: We do not want a repeat of the 2022 crisis,” dugang sini.
english: We do not want a repeat of the 2022 crisis,” it added.

text: Kun matandaan, sang 2022, nagsaka ang presyo sang bombay sa P700 kada kilo bangud sa kakulangan sang suplay nga ginpahayag nga ginpalala pa sang atrasado nga imports.
english: In 2022, the price of bombay rose to P700 per kilo due to supply shortages that were reportedly exacerbated by delayed imports.

text: Base sa data sang Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI), ang monthly consumption sa Pilipinas ang yara sa 17,000 metric tons para sa red onions kag 4,000 metric tons naman para sa puti nga sibuyas.
english: Based on data from the Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI), the monthly consumption in the Philippines is 17,000 metric tons for red onions and 4,000 metric tons for white onions.

text: Madamo ang halos indi makapati sang istorya sang isa ka lalaki nga sang damlag lang, nakaluwas sa kamatayon sang gintiro ini sang isa man ka lalaki nga iya naka-bais.
english: Many find it hard to believe the story of a man who recently escaped death when he was shot by another man he had a fight with.

text: Natabo ini sa Colorado sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag ginkumpirma mismo sang Commerce City Police Department.
english: This happened in Colorado in the United States of America and was confirmed by the Commerce City Police Department itself.

text: Sa post sang police station, ginpahayag nga nangin mainit ang argumento sa tunga sang duha ka mga lalaki rason nga naimpito ang isa kag gintiro ang biktima sa liog sini.
english: According to the police station, the argument between the two men became heated and one of them shot the victim in the neck.

text: Apang sang amo nga tion, nag-igu ang bala sang .22 caliber sa kulintas mismo nga ginasuksok sang biktima, kag halos indi mapatihan nga amo ini ang rason kun ngaa wala nagdiretso ang bala sa liog mismo sang lalaki.
english: However, at that time, the .22 caliber bullet hit the necklace worn by the victim, and it is almost unbelievable that this is the reason why the bullet did not go straight to the man's neck.

text: Ginpakita sang pulis ang silver chain nga may dugo pa, ginapahayag nga ten millimeters lang ang kalaparon, kag amo ini suno sa otoridad ang isahanon ga rason nga buhi pa ang biktima.
english: The police showed the silver chain with blood, said to be only ten millimeters wide, and this is the only reason why the victim is still alive.

text: “This silver chain — approximately 10 millimeters in width — is likely the only reason the victim of a shooting we responded to yesterday is still alive,” suno sa police department.
english: “This silver chain — approximately 10 millimeters in width — is likely the only reason the victim of a shooting we responded to yesterday is still alive,” according to the police department.

text:
“The .22 caliber bullet … [became] lodged in the chain he was wearing.”

Suno sa otoridad, puncture wound lamang ang naangkon sang lalaki apang ginapatihan nga kun wala ang metal necklace, pat-od nga patal gid ang iya pilas.
english:
“The .22 caliber bullet … [became] lodged in the chain he was wearing.”

According to the authorities, the man sustained only a puncture wound but it is believed that without the metal necklace, his injuries would have been fatal.

text: “Side note– we don’t know what kind of metal this is, but it’s likely not pure silver.
english: “Side note– we don’t know what kind of metal this is, but it’s likely not pure silver.

text: We looked it up… and silver is soft.
english: We looked it up… and silver is soft.

text: So maybe think twice before you knock a knockoff.
english: So maybe think twice before knocking a knockoff.

text: Just incredible,” dugang sa post sang pulis nga nag-viral.
english: Just incredible,” the police officer added in the viral post.

text: Arestado naman ang suspek kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga homicide.
english: The suspect was arrested and is facing charges of homicide.

text: Madamo naman ang nagkomento nga nagapati sila nga magluwas sa silver necklace, isa ka divine intervention ang natabo kag basi suno sa ila, indi pa gid man tyempo sang lalaki nga madula diri sa kalibutan.
english: Many commented that they believe that besides the silver necklace, a divine intervention occurred and maybe, according to them, it is not yet time for the man to disappear from this world.

text: Ginklaro sang Land Transportation Office VI nga padayon ang ila nga pagpangdakop sa mga colorum kag iban pa nga mga salakyan nga nagapalas sa layi.
english: The Land Transportation Office VI clarified that they continue to arrest colorums and other vehicles that violate the law.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Regional Director sang Land Transportation Office VI, iya ginpahayag nga halin sang Oktubre 2025, yara na sa 32 ka mga colorum ang ila nadakpan sa siudad sang Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Regional Director of the Land Transportation Office VI, said that since October 2025, they will have caught 32 colorums in Iloilo City.

text: Sabat ini sang opisina kasunod sang reklamo ni Halley Alcarde, Vice President sang Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporations Inc., nga ang mga naga-overload lang nga mga modernized jeepney ang ginabantayan sang LTO.
english: The office's response follows a complaint by Halley Alcarde, Vice President of the Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporations Inc., that only overloading modernized jeepneys are monitored by the LTO.

text: Nagpanawagan anay si Alcarde sa ahensya nga mangin patas sa ila nga pagpatuman sang mga polisa.
english: Alcarde earlier called on the agency to be fair in its implementation of policies.

text: Suno naman kay Geduspan, wala nila ginapili kun sin-o ang nagakadapat nga dakpon ukon hatagan sang penalidad, apang isa sa mga kinahanglan sa subong nga i-address amo ang pag-overload ukon pagpugok sang mga pasahero sa sulod sang mga mini-bus.
english: Geduspan said they do not choose who deserves to be arrested or fined, but one of the issues that needs to be addressed is the overloading of passengers inside the mini-buses.

text: Madumduman nga mas nangin hugot ang pagpatuman sang Anti-Sardinas policy matapos nga naglapta sa social media ang video sang isa ka overloaded nga modernized jeep sa syudad.
english: It can be recalled that the implementation of the Anti-Sardinas policy became stricter after a video of an overloaded modernized jeep in the city circulated on social media.

text: Nagsaka na sa 128 ka mga tawo ang napatay sa sunog sa walo ka block nga housing complex sa Tai Po, Hong Kong.
english: At least 128 people have been killed in a fire at an eight-block housing complex in Tai Po, Hong Kong.

text: Magluwas sini, 79 ka mga tawo ang napilasan kag 16 ka lawas ang yara pa sa building.
english: In addition, 79 people were injured and 16 bodies are still in the building.

text: Madamo man ang mga tawo nga missing.
english: There are also many missing people.

text: Wala pa napat-od kun ano gid ang rason sang sunog apang suno sa security chief, ang Styrofoam nga nabutang sa gwa sang bintana ang rason sang madasig nga paglapta sang kalayo.
english: The exact cause of the fire has not been determined but according to the security chief, the Styrofoam placed outside the window caused the fire to spread quickly.

text: Magasugod naman ang pagpangita sang ebidensya sang kapulisan pinaagi sa pagsulod sa mga building.
english: Police will begin searching for evidence by entering the buildings.

text: Ginalauman nga magadugay sang tatlo tubtob apat ka semana ang imbestigasyon.
english: The investigation is expected to last three to four weeks.

text: “NOTHING like it” ang pinakauna nga Digital Dinagyang Festival.
english: “NOTHING like it” is the first Digital Dinagyang Festival.

text: Nagpakita ini sang creativity kag henyo sang mga Ilonggo agud ma-selebrar sing maduagon ang Dinagyang bisan pa sa tunga sang panalakay sang COVID-19.
english: This showed the creativity and genius of the Ilonggos to celebrate Dinagyang successfully even in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Gin-cover ini sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw sang radyo, TV kag sang nagakalain-lain nga mainstream media kag digital outlets lakip na ang popular nga Facebook kag YouTube.
english: It was covered for days by radio, TV and a variety of mainstream media and digital outlets including the popular Facebook and YouTube.

text: Ang selebrasyon nagsugod sa Pamukaw mismo sadtong Enero 15 nga natapos sa isa ka special coverage sadtong Domingo, Enero 24, para sa fans sini sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: The celebration began with Pamukaw itself on January 15 and ended with a special coverage on Sunday, January 24, for its fans around the world.

text: Nag-serve bilang Fluvial Parade para sa imahen ni Sr.
english: Served as Fluvial Parade for the image of Sr.

text: Sto.
english: Sto.

text: Niño ang motorcade palibut sa siyudad.
english: Niño the motorcade around the city.

text: Ang pitu ka distrito sang siyudad gin-representar sang pitu man ka tribu, nga samtang limitado ang kadamuon may espesyal nga pagpakita sang mga eksena sa pili kag matahum nga mga lugar sa siyudad, nga sadto lang nakita sang mga bisita nga wala lubos nakalagaw sa siyudad.
english: The seven districts of the city were represented by seven tribes, which while limited in number had a special display of scenes in select and beautiful places in the city, which had only been seen by visitors who had not fully explored the city.

text: Kongrats sa IFFI, sa San Jose Parish Church, kag sa administrasyon ni Mayor Jerry Treñas nga nagpakita sing wala kulang nga paghimud-os agud mapabatyag sing may kahulugan ang pagtuo sang mga pumuluyo  sa kay Sr.
english: Congrats to IFFI, San Jose Parish Church, and the administration of Mayor Jerry Treñas who showed tireless efforts to make the people's faith in Sr.

text: Sto.
english: Sto.

text: Niño.
english: Niño.

text: Viva Señor Santo Niño!
english: Long live the Holy Child!

text:
***

Isa naman ka Ilonggo nga “Filipino First” ang luyag ta dumdumon diri sang belated sa nagligad pa nga bulan sang Enero sa iya pagka-baganihan sa gyera sa pagdampig sa Demokrasya.
english:
***

Another Ilonggo “Filipino First” is what we want to remember here who was belated last January for his heroism in the war for democracy.

text: Ini siya amo si Sergeant Jose Cabalfin Calugas sang Leon, Iloilo, nga naga-isahanon nga Filipino nga nagbaton sang US Congressional Medal of Honor sa iya ginpakita nga talagsahon nga kaisug sadtong World War II.
english: He is Sergeant Jose Cabalfin Calugas of Leon, Iloilo, the only Filipino to receive the US Congressional Medal of Honor for his outstanding bravery during World War II.

text: Ginpakita niya ini sa pagpakig-away sa mga soldado nga mga Hapones samtang ginadampigan ang ila pwesto sa Culis, Bataan.
english: He demonstrated this fighting Japanese soldiers while defending their position in Culis, Bataan.

text: Natabo ini sadtong Enero 13, 1942, sunu sa kay Atty. Rex Savilla+ sa iya libro nga Interresing Facts About West Visayas, Book 15, Page 34.
english: This happened on January 13, 1942, according to Atty. Rex Savilla+ in his book Interesting Facts About West Visayas, Book 15, Page 34.

text: Wala kahadlok nga ginsulay ni Calugas ang wala untat nga “shelling” sa 1,000 ka yarda (3,000 ka tapak) nga kalayuon sang ila battery gun position, agud lang mapwestuhan ini samtang naubos na disable sang “shelling” sang kaaway kag ginbayaan na sang mga kanyonero.
english: Wala kahadlok nga ginsulay ni Calugas ang wala untat nga “shelling” sa 1,000 ka yarda (3,000 ka tapak) nga kalayuon sang ila battery gun position, agud lang mapwestuhan ini samtang naubos na disable sang “shelling” sang kaaway kag ginbayaan na sang mga kanyonero.

text: Wala pangduha-duha nga ginbayaan niya ang iya trabaho sa kusina, kon diin temporaryo anay siya na-assign, agud pwestuhan ang ila battery gun position.
english: Without hesitation, he left his job in the kitchen, where he had been temporarily assigned, to take up their battery gun position.

text: Regular nga artilleryman si Sgt.
english: Regular artilleryman Sgt.

text: Calugas sa Field Artillery (FA) Unit sang Philippine Scouts sang United States Army.
english: Calugas in the Field Artillery (FA) Unit of the Philippine Scouts of the United States Army.

text: Sang matabo yadto, ugaling, si Sgt.
english: When that happened, however, Sgt.

text: Calugas na-assign bilang mess sergeant sa 88th Field Artillery Regiment Battery B sang Philippine Scouts.
english: Calugas was assigned as a mess sergeant in the 88th Field Artillery Regiment Battery B of the Philippine Scouts.

text: Indi dapat maagaw ini sang kaaway!
english: The enemy must not take it!

text: Gani, upod sang isa ka volunteer squad, ginpangunahan niya ang padayon nga pagpakig-away sa mga Hapones sa battery gun position nga ato.
english: So, with a volunteer squad, he led the continued fighting against the Japanese at that battery gun position.

text: Tungod sining padayon nga pagpakig-away nila napunggan pa gani nila sing mga tatlo ka bulan ang pag-abante sang mga Hapones sa Bataan.
english: Because of this continuous fighting they even stopped the Japanese advance on Bataan for about three months.

text: Sang mahibal-an ini ni General Douglas MacArthur dayon sini gin-rekomendar si Calugas sa padungog sang US Cogressional Medal of Honor sadtong Pebrero 24, 1942, although ang paghatag sini sa iya naghulat tubtub maagaw na ang Filipinas sa mga Hapones.
english: When General Douglas MacArthur learned of this, he immediately recommended Calugas for the US Congressional Medal of Honor on February 24, 1942, although the awarding of it to him waited until the Philippines was captured by the Japanese.

text: Ginbaton ni Sgt.
english: Sgt.

text: Calugas, nga nangin Capt.
english: Calugas, who became Capt.

text: Calugas sang mag-retiro, ang ining pinakamataas nga padungog sa mga baganihan sang gyera sang Estados Unidos sadtong 1945.
english: Calugas when he retired, the highest honor among the heroes of the United States war in 1945.

text: Ang iya award nagpahayag sang sumunod: “For conspicuous gallantry and intrepid above and beyond the call of duty in action with the enemy at Culis, Bataan Province Philippine Islands, Jan.
english: His award stated the following: “For conspicuous gallantry and intrepid above and beyond the call of duty in action with the enemy at Culis, Bataan Province Philippine Islands, Jan.

text:
When the battery gun position was shelled and bombed until one piece was out of action and casualties cause the removal of the remaining cannoneers to shelter, Sergeant Calugas, mess sergeant of another battery, voluntarily and on his own accord proceeded 1,000 yards across the shell-swept area to the gun position and joined the volunteer gun squad which fired effectively on the enemy although heavy bombarding and shelling of the position continued.”

***

Nalakip si Calugas sa Bataan Death March kag nahunong bilang Prisoner of War sa Camp Odonnel.
english:
When the battery gun position was shelled and bombed until one piece was out of action and casualties caused the removal of the remaining cannoneers to shelter, Sergeant Calugas, mess sergeant of another battery, voluntarily and on his own accord proceeded 1,000 yards across the shell-swept area and joined the gun position volunteer gun squad which fired effectively on the enemy although heavy bombarding and shelling of the position continued.”

***

Calugas was included in the Bataan Death March and was held as a Prisoner of War at Camp Odonnel.

text: Sang ma-release siya halin sa POW Camp nagbalik siya sa pagpakig-away sa mga Hapon upod sa mga guerrilla.
english: When he was released from the POW Camp he returned to fight the Japanese with the guerrillas.

text: Pagkatapos sang gyera, nataasan na siya sing ranggo bilang kapitan.
english: After the war, he was promoted to the rank of captain.

text: Nabaton man niya ang USC Medal of Honor sadtong Abril 30, 1945.
english: He also received the USC Medal of Honor on April 30, 1945.

text: Nagtaliwan siya sadtong 1998 sa edad nga 91./PN
english: He died in 1998 at the age of 91./PN

text: Magalawig sang 10 ka adlaw ang 18th Palayag Festival nga maga-umpisa subong, Enero 10 tubtob Enero 19, 2025.
english: The 18th Palayag Festival will last for 10 days from today, January 10 to January 19, 2025.

text: Ang Palayag Festival ang tuigan nga selebrasyon sang Buenavista, Guimaras bilang paghatag dungog kay Sr.
english: The Palayag Festival is the annual celebration of Buenavista, Guimaras in honor of Sr.

text: Sto.
english: Sto.

text: Niño nga amo ang ila patron saint.
english: Niño who is their patron saint.

text: Ang tema sang festival subong nga tuig amo ang “Balik Layag: Our history.
english: The theme of this year’s festival is “Balik Layag: Our history.

text: Our dream.
english: Our dream.

text: Our future.
english: Our future.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jay Lord Saplagio, Tourism Officer sang Buenavista, Guimaras, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sang water activities nga ginpreparahan ang Local Government Unit nga ika-enjoy sang local kag foreign tourists sa magabisita sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jay Lord Saplagio, Tourism Officer of Buenavista, Guimaras, said the Local Government Unit has prepared many water activities for local and foreign tourists to enjoy.

text: Nagpasalig naman ang Buenavista-Local Government Unit nga mas madamo pa nga tourist arrivals ang marekord subong nga tuig.
english: The Buenavista-Local Government Unit assured that more tourist arrivals will be recorded this year.

text: Sang nagligad nga 2024, may yara sang 32,719 same day tourist arrivals nga narekord kag 744 ang nag-overnight stay.
english: Last 2024, there were 32,719 same day tourist arrivals recorded and 744 stayed overnight.

text: Suno kay Atty. Raymundo Moderes, Liaison Officer sang Buenavista lgu, may 441 ka mga foreign guests ang nagbisita sa Buenavista sang Palayag Festival 2024 sa diin may yara ini tanan sang tourism receipts nga masobra sa P27 million sa same day tourist arrivals kag malapit sa P4 million nga overnight stay.
english: According to Atty. Raymundo Moderes, Liaison Officer of Buenavista LGU, said 441 foreign guests visited Buenavista during the Palayag Festival 2024 with tourism receipts of more than P27 million in same day tourist arrivals and nearly P4 million in overnight stays.

text: Ang kabug-usan nga gasto sang Buenavista LGU sang 2024 ang yara sa P7 million.
english: The total expenditure of Buenavista LGU in 2024 is P7 million.

text: Nagpasalig man si Buenavista, Guimaras Mayor Samuel Gumarin, ang religious activity ang indi dapat paglaktan sang pamulitika agud mapabilin ang solemnity sini.
english: Buenavista, Guimaras Mayor Samuel Gumarin also assured that religious activities should not be politicized in order to maintain their solemnity.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sabton niya ang tanan nga mga akusasyon nga ginahaboy batok sa ila kon magsugod na ang election period kag indi subong nga Palayag Festival.
english: He also said that he will answer all the accusations thrown against them when the election period starts and not this Palayag Festival.

text: Nakahanda ang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) Region 6 sa tion nga may patigayunon nga mass deportation sang mga undocumented Overseas Filipino Workers (OFW) sa Amerika.
english: The Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) Region 6 is prepared for the mass deportation of undocumented Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) to the United States.

text: Ini ang kasunod man sang ginpagwa nga executive order ni United States President Donald Trump nga nagamando sa mas hugot nga immigration policies.
english: This follows the executive order issued by United States President Donald Trump ordering stricter immigration policies.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. James Mendiola, Regional Director sang OWWA Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga preparado na sila sa pagpanguna sang ila Central Office sa ginalauman nga mass deportation.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. James Mendiola, Regional Director of OWWA Region 6, said they are ready to lead their Central Office in the expected mass deportation.

text: Suno kay Mendiola, sa tion nga matabo ini, may yara sila sang ihatag nga bulig sa mga i-deport nga OFW.
english: Mendiola said that when this happens, they will provide assistance to the deported OFWs.

text: Ang gobyerno man sang Pilipinas suno sa natungdan ang mabayad sang ila pagkaon kag pamasahe partikular sa eroplano.
english: The Philippine government will also pay for their food and airfare.

text: Magluwas diri, may libre man nga accommodation nga ihatag ang OWWA.
english: In addition, OWWA will also provide free accommodation.

text: Nakahanda man suno sa natungdan nga magbulig ang iban pa nga ahensya sang gobyerno kaangay sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) kag iban pa.
english: He said other government agencies such as the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and others are ready to help.

text: Santo naman sa record sang non-profit organization nga Filipino Migrant Center (FMC), isa sa apat ka mga Filipinos sa U.S. ang undocumented.
english: According to the records of the non-profit organization Filipino Migrant Center (FMC), one in four Filipinos in the U.S. is undocumented.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗮

text: Nagahilibi-on nga ginpalab-ot sang isa ka Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia ang nangin eksperyensya sini sa mga personnel sang iya ahensya nga nabase sa amu nga pungsod.
english: An Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, tearfully conveyed his experience to the personnel of his agency based in that country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kizzel May Balayo, 24 kag tumandok sang Banate, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nag-abut ini sa Jeddah sang Disyembre kag sa sulod sang masobra isa ka bulan makapila na ini ka beses nga ginpasapasa sang iya employers.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Kizzel May Balayo, 24, a native of Banate, Iloilo, said she arrived in Jeddah in December and within more than a month she was handed over several times by her employers.

text: Suno kay Balayo, gin-sexually harrased kag ginpagutuman ini sang pila ka mga personnel sa iya nga ahensya sang ini ang nagtinir didto sang apat ka adlaw.
english: According to Balayo, he was sexually harassed and starved by some personnel in his agency when he stayed there for four days.

text: Sa subong, yara na ini sa bag-o niya nga employer apang nagapangabay nga kuntani mabuligan ini nga makapauli na sa Pilipinas.
english: He is currently with his new employer but is asking for help to return to the Philippines.

text: Indi dako nga okasyon ang Valentine’s day sa Germany.
english: Valentine’s day is not a big occasion in Germany.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Aimee Andaya Hilger, may yara man sang pila nga nagabaligya ang tsokolate, mugs kag bulak apang wala sang makita nga decorations sa pila ka mga lugar ukon sa malls sa Germany.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Aimee Andaya Hilger, there are also some who sell chocolates, mugs and flowers but there are no decorations in some places or in malls in Germany.

text: Suno kay Hilger, may lain nga selebrasyon ang mga Germans nga kaangay sang man sang Valentine’s day nga ila ginatawag nga “Maibock” nga ginapatigayon kun Mayo.
english: According to Hilger, the Germans have a different celebration similar to Valentine's day which they call “Maibock” which is held in May.

text: Sa amu nga selebrasyon, nagapang-utod sang kahoy ang mga kalalakihan, genedekorahan kag ginabilin sa atubang sang balay sang ila nga ginahigugma.
english: During the celebration, men cut down trees, decorate them and leave them in front of their loved ones' houses.

text: Masami sa decorations sang kahoy ang may yara sang nakabutang nga “Ich liebe dich” ukon I love you.
english: Often the tree decorations have the words “Ich liebe dich” or I love you.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, naandan na sang mga German nga simple lang nga magpadulong sa restaurants bilang selebrasyon sang Valentine’s day.
english: He added that Germans are used to simply going to restaurants as a celebration of Valentine's Day.

text: Magahatag ang Japan sang dugang nga 2.44 million dollars bilang emergency aid sa Tonga matapos sang dako nga halit nga tuga sang undersea volcanic eruption sang Enero 15.
english: Japan will provide an additional $2.44 million in emergency aid to Tonga following the devastation caused by the undersea volcanic eruption on January 15.

text: Matandaan nga gin-igu man sang tsunami ang Tonga matapos sang paglupok sang bulkan.
english: Tonga was also hit by a tsunami after the volcanic eruption.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma– direkta sa Japan, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang gin-anunsyio sang Japan Foreign Minister nga si Hayashi Yoshimasa.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma – directly in Japan, he said that this was announced by Japan Foreign Minister Hayashi Yoshimasa.

text: Suno kay Palma, naglab-ot sa apat ang napatay sa amu nga South Pacific island nation kag kapin 84 percent sang populasyon ang naapektuhan sang volcanic eruption kag tsunami.
english: Palma said four people were killed in the South Pacific island nation and more than 84 percent of the population was affected by the volcanic eruption and tsunami.

text: Kinahanglan man sang amu nga pungsod ang dugang nga suplay sang mainom nga tubig kag mga pagkaon.
english: The country also needs more supplies of drinking water and food.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, magapadala man ang Japan sang Maritime Self Defense Transport Ship agud nga magbulig sa disaster recovery.
english: He added that Japan will also send a Maritime Self Defense Transport Ship to assist in disaster recovery.

text: Nagapdayon man ang koordinasyon sang Japan sa iban pa pa nga pungsod angut sa pagbulig nga makarecover ang pungsod Tonga.
english: Japan is also continuing to coordinate with other countries to help Tonga recover.

text: Nag-isyu na ang US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) sang WANTED posters nga nagapakita sang nawong ni Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KJC) founder kag pastor Apollo Carreon Quiboloy, ang self-proclaimed ‘owner of the universe’ kag ‘appointed son of God’.
english: The US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has issued WANTED posters featuring the face of Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KJC) founder and pastor Apollo Carreon Quiboloy, the self-proclaimed ‘owner of the universe’ and ‘appointed son of God’.

text: Sa website sang FBI, nakasaad nga lakip sa aliases nga ginagamit ni Quiboloy amo ang “The Appointed Son of God”, “Sir”, “Pastor” kag “ACQ”.
english: The FBI website states that among the aliases used by Quiboloy are “The Appointed Son of God”, “Sir”, “Pastor” and “ACQ”.

text: Suno sa FBI, wanted si Quiboloy bangud sa ginaalegar partisipasyon sini sa labor trafficking scheme nga amo ang nagdala sa church members sa United States paagi sa fraudulently-obtained nga mga visa.
english: According to the FBI, Quiboloy is wanted for his alleged participation in a labor trafficking scheme that brought church members to the United States through fraudulently-obtained visas.

text: Ginapahayag nga ginpwersa man sini ang mga myembro nga mag-solicit sang donasyon para sa bogus nga charity.
english: He also allegedly forced members to solicit donations for bogus charities.

text: Ini nga mga donasyon ang ginpahayag gingamit agud nga ma-finance ang church operations kag ang lavish lifestyles sang mga lider sini.
english: These donations were allegedly used to finance church operations and the lavish lifestyles of its leaders.

text: Ang mga myembro nga maka-solicit para sa simbahan ang ginaalegar ginapwersa nga mag-sulod sa sham marriages ukon ginapa-obtain sang fraudulent student visas agud magpadayon sa pagpang-solicit sa Estados Unidos sa bilog nga tuig.
english: Members who are able to solicit for the church are allegedly forced into sham marriages or obtained fraudulent student visas to continue soliciting in the United States throughout the year.

text: Suno pa sa FBI, may mga babayi nga gina-recruit agud nga magtrabaho bilang personal assistants ukon ‘pastorals’ para kay Quiboloy.
english: According to the FBI, some women are being recruited to work as personal assistants or 'pastorals' for Quiboloy.

text: Ginapahayag nga ang mga babayi ang nagapreparar sang iya nga pagkaon, nagalimpyo sang iya nga balay, kag required man para sa ‘night duty’ ukon magpakighilawas sa kay Quiboloy.
english: The women are said to prepare his meals, clean his house, and are also required for night duty or to have sex with Quiboloy.

text: Sandig pa sa post sang FBI, may koneksyon si Quiboloy pati sa Calabasas, California, Las Vegas, Nevada, kag Kapolei, Hawaii.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Gin-ako sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6  nga wala pa sang pondo para sa rectification sang Aganan flyover sa Barangay Aganan, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 admitted that there is no fund for the rectification of the Aganan flyover in Barangay Aganan, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Sanny Boy Oropel, director sang DPWH Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga wala nalakip sa 2024 budget allocation ang pondo para sa rectification sang nasambit nga flyover.
english: Sanny Boy Oropel, director of DPWH Region 6, said the fund for the rectification of the flyover is not included in the 2024 budget allocation.

text: Suno kay Oropel, may yara sila sang pondo para sa original design plan, apang ang jet grouting ang nagakinahanglan sang dugang nga resources.
english: Oropel said they had funding for the original design plan, but the jet grouting required additional resources.

text: Plano naman nila nga mag-request sang pondo sa Central Office agud matigayon ini.
english: They plan to request funds from the Central Office to achieve this.

text: Sa subong, ang P308 million sa P802-million nga total budget para sa Aganan flyover ang available sa gihapon agud matapos ini sa idalom sang approved design plan.
english: Currently, P308 million of the P802-million total budget for the Aganan flyover is still available for completion under the approved design plan.

text: Apang kinahanglan pa sang ginabanta P210 million para sa rectification kaangay sang natabo sa Ungka flyover.
english: However, an estimated P210 million is still needed for rectification as happened at the Ungka flyover.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Aganan kag Ungka flyovers ang parehas nga gin-desinyo sang United Technology Consolidated Partnership (UTCP) sa idalom sang Bureau of Design sang DPWH-Central Office.
english: The Aganan and Ungka flyovers were both designed by the United Technology Consolidated Partnership (UTCP) under the Bureau of Design of the DPWH-Central Office.

text: Ginpasalig naman ni Oropel nga ginapadasig na sini ang ila plano kag pagpangita sang pondo agud malikawan ang pagkaguba sang Aganan flyover.
english: Oropel assured that they are accelerating their plans and fundraising to avoid the destruction of the Aganan flyover.

text: ILOILO CITY- Daw sa Pilipinas lang ang pamatyagan sang mga Filipino sa Malaysia kun mag-abot ang tion sang Paskwa.
english: ILOILO CITY- Filipinos in Malaysia feel like they are in the Philippines when it comes to Christmas.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Pamela Gabo direkta sa Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, Septyembre pa lang, naga-display na sang Christmas decorations ang mga tawo ilabi na ang mga Pinoy.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Pamela Gabo directly in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, since September, people have been displaying Christmas decorations especially Filipinos.

text: Pahayag niya, mangin ang mga malls ang halos puno sang Christmas lights kag mabatian man ang mga Christmas songs.
english: He said even the malls are almost full of Christmas lights and Christmas songs can be heard.

text: May yara man sang simbang gabi ilabi na ang mga Pinoy.
english: There is also simbang gabi especially the Filipinos.

text: Apang ang kinalain lang suno kay Gabo amo nga sa Pilipinas, nagapulaw gid ang mga tawo agud sug-alawon ang adlaw sang Paskwa kag nagatipon sa noche buena, apang sa Malaysia, naandan sang mga locals nga magkaon sa gwa kag magpauli kag magtulog.
english: But the only difference, Gabo said, is that in the Philippines, people stay up late to celebrate Christmas and gather for Noche Buena, but in Malaysia, locals are used to eating out and going home and sleeping.

text: Sa tanan nga kaaslom nga imo natilawan sa kabuhi, nakahibalo ka bala nga ang pampa-aslom nga prutas nga ‘Batuan’ ang isa sa may pinakamadamo nga mahatag nga benepisyo sa imo ikaayong lawas?
english: Of all the sourness you have tasted in life, did you know that the sour fruit 'Batuan' is one of the most beneficial to your health?

text: Ang Batuan fruit ukon ginatawag man nga Garcinia Binucao amo ang bantog nga pampa-aslom sa mga niluto sang Ilonggo kag Negrense.
english: Batuan fruit or also known as Garcinia Binucao is a famous spice in Ilonggo and Negrense cuisine.

text: Ang shape sini ang kaangay sang iya ka Patatas apang green ang iya nga duag.
english: It is shaped like a potato but green in color.

text: Santo sa pagtuon sa University of the Philippines Los Baños, ang prutas nga “Batuan” ang manggaranon sa vitamin C, potassium, phosphorus, calcium, magnesium, iron, kag trace levels sang zinc, copper kag manganese.
english: According to a study at the University of the Philippines Los Baños, the “Batuan” fruit is rich in vitamin C, potassium, phosphorus, calcium, magnesium, iron, and trace levels of zinc, copper and manganese.

text: Ang mga nasambit nga mineral nga makit-an sa Batuan ang makabulig panubo sang cholesterol levels sang tawo.
english: These minerals found in Batuan can help lower cholesterol levels in humans.

text: Natukiban man sa pagtuon nga ang batuan ang puno man sang anti-obesity properties sa diin epektibo ini para sa mga tawo nga luyag magpaniwang.
english: The study also found that batuan is also full of anti-obesity properties which is effective for people who want to lose weight.

text: Para naman sa mga tawo nga diabetic, ang dahon sang batuan ang napamatud-an man nga epektibo sa pagpanubo sang blood sugar level.
english: For diabetic people, batuan leaves have also been shown to be effective in lowering blood sugar levels.

text: ITUGOT ninyo anay nga masabat naton ang pamangkot sa Iningles sang isa ko ka abyan kon bala may kabuhi nga wala katapusan, ukon “immortality”, para sa tawo?
english: LET us first answer the question in English of a friend of mine whether there is eternal life, or “immortality”, for man?

text: Well, for sure, God did not mean to live alone throughout eternity.
english: Well, for sure, God did not intend to live alone throughout eternity.
