text: That must be a very sad reality.
english: That must be a very sad reality.

text: God needs His devoted children to enjoy it with Him through all that endless time.
english: God needs His devoted children to enjoy it with Him through all that endless time.

text:
***

Nangin “shocking” sa University of the Philippines community ang balita halin sa kay Defense Secretary Lorenzana nga ginatapos na niya ang UP-DND Agreement nga ginpirmahan sadtong Hunyo 30, 1989.
english:
***

The news from Defense Secretary Lorenzana that he is terminating the UP-DND Agreement signed on June 30, 1989 was shocking to the University of the Philippines community.

text: Ining Agreement, ukon kasugtanan, naga-bawal sang presensya sang military kag police force sa sulod sang UP premises, except kon may hot pursuit ukon kasubong nga emerhensya.
english: This Agreement, or agreement, prohibits the presence of military and police force inside UP premises, except in the event of a hot pursuit or similar emergency.

text: Nagapasalig ining Agreement sing wala upang sang “intimidating presence” sang mga militar kag mga pulis sa pag-enjoy sang mga manunudlo kag mga estudyante sa UP sang Academic Freedom, ukon hilway kag mapanuri (paagi sa inquiry and research) nga pagpanudlo kag pagtuon sa Higher Education.
english: This Agreement ensures that the “intimidating presence” of the military and police will not interfere with the enjoyment of Academic Freedom, or free and peer-reviewed (through inquiry and research) teaching and learning in Higher Education.

text: Bastante na para sa ila ang security personnel sang UP.
english: The security personnel of UP is enough for them.

text: Kon ngaa ginapauntat ang pagpatuman sang UP-DND Agreement sang Hunyo 30, 1989, sunu kay Secretary Lorenzana, ina kuno tungod kay ang UP-Dilliman kag pitu pa sang iya constituent universities sa pungsod, nangin isa ka “haven”, ukon dalangpan kag panaguan, sang mga myembro sang CPP-NPA.
english: The reason why the implementation of the UP-DND Agreement on June 30, 1989, is being suspended, according to Secretary Lorenzana, is because UP-Dilliman and seven of its constituent universities in the country have become a haven for CPP-NPA members.

text: Diri man kuno ang madamo nga estudyante ginapang-recruit sa pagsulod sa ila armado nga hublag.
english: It is also here that many students are recruited to join their armed movement.

text: Sa pag-aha sa kay Lorenzana nga sugilanunan anay ini, siling ni Lorenzana nga kinahanglan anay sabton sang UP authorities kon ngaa may mga estudyante sang state university ang na-encuentro sang tropa sang gobyerno nga nalakip sa mga napatay nga mga rebelde.
english: Lorenzana said the UP authorities must first answer why government troops encountered state university students among the dead rebels.

text: Diri bala matuod natun-an sining mga UP student ang indi patas nga pagpakamalaut kag ang pagpakigsumpong na sa aton maki-Demokrasya nga gobyerno upod sang mga maka-komunista nga grupo sa idalom sang pila nila ka manunudlo?
english: Is it true that these UP students learned the unfair condemnation and opposition to our pro-democracy government with the pro-communist groups under some of their teachers?

text: Tungod man bala kay ginapabay-an lang sang UP authorities nga mabuyok ining mga estudyante sang mga progresibo nga pagpati kag mag-upod sa armado nga paghublag batok sa aton gobyerno?
english: Is it because the UP authorities are allowing these students to be influenced by progressive beliefs and join the armed movement against our government?

text: Tungod man bala sini nga kinahanglan na ang bag-o nga kasugtanan agud indi mabutang naman sa peligro ang aton Demokrasya diri mismo sa UP?
english: Is it because of this that a new agreement is needed so that our democracy here in UP is not put in danger?

text: Mahibal-an naton ini kon matigayon gid man ining pakigsugilanon sang UP authorities kag sang Department of National Defense (DND).
english: We will know this if this talk between the UP authorities and the Department of National Defense (DND) is finally achieved.

text:
***

By the way, ginpanubli pa sang mga unibersidad sa karon nga panahon ang ining ideya sang Academic Freedom sa Greece, ang iloy-iloy sang Demokrasya.
english:
***

By the way, universities today have inherited this idea of Academic Freedom from Greece, the mother of Democracy.

text: Diri nagsugod ang pagpamuno sa mga pumuluyo paagi sa botohan sang ila mga representante.
english: This is where the government of the people through the vote of their representatives began.

text: Diri man sa Greece ginapasanyog ang mataas nga kinaalam kag pilosopiya, arte kag matayog nga values sang pagkatao kag sang katilingban.
english: Here in Greece, too, high knowledge and philosophy, art and high values ​​of humanity and society are promoted.

text: Nonetheless, nagka-problema man ang gobyerno sang Greece, nga isa ka welfare state, kon paano mapasalig sing lubos ang pagpatuman sang Academic Freedom sa mga unibersidad sini.
english: Nonetheless, the Greek government, which is a welfare state, also struggled with how to fully assure the implementation of Academic Freedom in its universities.

text: Ang problema gid sa pagpatuman sing lubos sining Academic Freedom nagsugod sang agawin (coup d’etat) sadtong 1967 ang gobyerno sang military kag ginbuslan sang Military Junta, nga sang ulihi nag-collapse man sadtong 1974.
english: The real problem with the full implementation of this Academic Freedom began when the military government was overthrown (coup d'etat) in 1967 and replaced by the Military Junta, which later collapsed in 1974.

text: Liwat napasanyog ang Academic Freedom sa mga unibersidad sang kasuguan nga nagpatuman sang “Academic Asylum Rule”.
english: Academic Freedom was again promoted in universities by the law that implemented the “Academic Asylum Rule”.

text: Naga-prohibir ining “Rule” sang military kag police force sa pagpahilabot sa aktibidades sa Higher Education sa mga unibersidad.
english: This “Rule” prohibits the military and police force from interfering in Higher Education activities in universities.

text: Sang ulihi ugaling, sa lain-lain nga rason, na-repeal ang iban nga provision sini, nabalik liwat ini, tubtub sining pag-repeal liwat sini sadtong Agosto 2019.
english: Later, however, for various reasons, some of its provisions were repealed, it was restored, until its repeal in August 2019.

text:
Ang rason sang pag-repeal sini sadtong 2019 amo ang “misuse by persons who psychologically or physically harass students, teachers and staff within the universities and damage public property by engaging in illegal activities on university campus that have no relation to research, teaching, or free expression in general, and the abuse of asylum by perpetrators who commit crimes outside of the university premises and then seek refuge within them to take advantage of the rule.”

Wala na kita ugaling kahibalo kon ano ang nadangtan sining ulihi sang mga hitabo sa kontrobersya nila sa Academic Freedom./PN
english:
The reason for its repeal in 2019 was “misuse by persons who psychologically or physically harass students, teachers and staff within the universities and damage public property by engaging in illegal activities on university campus that have no relation to research, teaching, or free expression in general, and the abuse of asylum by criminals who commit out of university premises and then seek refuge within them to take advantage of the rule.”

However, we do not know what the recent events in the controversy over Academic Freedom have led to./PN

text: Yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon ang isa ka Pinay nga domestic worker samtang isa pa ka OFW ang missing matapos nasunog ang high-rise residential complex sa Tai Po district sa Hong Kong.
english: A Filipino domestic worker is in critical condition while another OFW is missing after a high-rise residential complex in Tai Po district of Hong Kong caught fire.

text: Suno kay Foreign Affairs spokesperson Angelica Escalona, yara sa intensive care unit sang isa ka ospital ang isa ka Pinay, samtang wala pa makit-an ang isa pa.
english: According to Foreign Affairs spokesperson Angelica Escalona, ​​one Filipina is in the intensive care unit of a hospital, while the other is still missing.

text: Nahibaluan nga malapit na 100 ang patay sa amo nga sunog.
english: It is known that nearly 100 people were killed in the fire.

text: Wala pa sang kumpirmado nga Pilipino nga ginbawian sang kabuhi sa amo nga insidente.
english: No Filipinos have been confirmed dead in the incident.

text: Nahatagan sang bag-o nga kabuhi ang conjoined twins halin sa Panabo, Davao del Norte matapos nga napaidalom sa madinalag-on nga operasyon sa bulig sang Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
english: Conjoined twins from Panabo, Davao del Norte were given a new life after undergoing a successful operation with the help of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

text: Ini nga kapid amo sanday Akhizah kag Ayeesha nga naga-edad pa lamang sang isa ka tuig.
english: This twins are Akhizah and Ayeesha who are just one year old.

text: Ang Saudi amo ang nag-asikaso para sa surgery, treatment period, kag pati na sa gasto sang pamilya sang kapid samtang yara sila sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: Saudi took care of the surgery, treatment period, and even the twins' family expenses while they were abroad.

text: Sila man ang ikaduha nga set sang Filipino twins nga nahatagan sang Kingdom sang amo nga sahi sang surgical separation.
english: They are also the second set of Filipino twins to be given such a surgical separation by the Kingdom.

text: Suno kay Saudi Ambassador to the Philippines Hisham S.A. Alqahtani, ini nga humanitarian work ang isa sa nalab-ot sang Kingdom sa patag sang pag-separar sang conjoined twins kag paghatag sang outstanding medical care kun sa diin makabig na nga pioneer ang Saudi.
english: According to Saudi Ambassador to the Philippines Hisham S.A. Alqahtani said this humanitarian work is one of the Kingdom's achievements in the field of separating conjoined twins and providing outstanding medical care where Saudi Arabia can be considered a pioneer.

text: Lima tubtub pito ka oras nga surgical procedure ang gin-agyan sang kapid kun sa diin 23 ka consultant doctors, specialists, nursing kag technical staff ang nagbuligay.
english: The twins underwent a five- to seven-hour surgical procedure in which 23 consultant doctors, specialists, nursing and technical staff worked together.

text: Nalakip man sa five-stage procedure amo ang organ restoration.
english: Also included in the five-stage procedure is organ restoration.

text: Sa subong, yara pa sa Riyadh ang kapid kag naga-recover pa lamang.
english: The twins are currently in Riyadh and are still recovering.

text: Tuman naman ang pasalamat sang iloy nga nakit-an nga naseparar na ang lawas sang iya mga bata, naga-practice na ang mga ini sa paglakat, kag natuman na ang handum sang pamilya nga makapangabuhi sang normal.
english: The mother was very grateful to see that her children's bodies were separated, they were practicing walking, and the family's dream of living a normal life was fulfilled.

text: Ang Kingdom of Saudi Arabia nga ginakabig pioneer sa field sang pagseparar sang conjoined twins ang naka-perform na sang masobra 130 ka kaangay nga operasyon sa iban nga nationalities.
english: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, which is considered a pioneer in the field of separating conjoined twins, has performed more than 130 similar operations in other nationalities.

text: Magaabot si Miss Universe 2024 Victoria Kjaer Theilvig sa Pilipinas subong nga adlaw kag natalana nga magtinir sa pungsod tubtub sa Marso 30.
english: Miss Universe 2024 Victoria Kjaer Theilvig will arrive in the Philippines today and is scheduled to stay in the country until March 30.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini sang Miss Universe organization apang wala pa sang ginhatag nga dugang nga mga detalye kun ano ang mga aktibidad sini kag kun diin siya magabisita diri sa Pilipinas.
english: The Miss Universe organization announced this but did not provide further details on its activities and where she will visit the Philippines.

text: Tumandok siya sang Denmark kag amo ang nakakuha sang korona sang 73rd edition sang pageant nga ginpatigayon sa Mexico.
english: She is a native of Denmark and won the crown in the 73rd edition of the pageant held in Mexico.

text: Siya ang first ever Miss Universe titleholder halin sa Denmark.
english: She is the first ever Miss Universe titleholder from Denmark.

text: Matabo ang iya pagbisita samtang masako man ang preparasyon sang masobra 60 ka mga kandidata para sa Miss Universe Philippines nga ang koronasyon hiwaton sa Mayo 2.
english: Her visit comes as more than 60 candidates are busy preparing for the Miss Universe Philippines pageant, which will be coronated on May 2.

text: Ginpaathag ni President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr. explained.

text: nga wala sang sarang magamit ang Pilipinas agud mapilit nga maghalin ang “monster ship” sang China nga yara sa sulod sang teritoryo sang Pilipinas.
english: that the Philippines has nothing to use to force the departure of China's monster ship within Philippine territory.

text: Sa Malacañang, ginpamangkot si Marcos kun islan na bala sang gobyerno ang paagi ukon tikang sini bangud daw kaangay nga nagapabungol-bungol lang ang China Coast Guard (CCG) vessel CCG-5901.
english: In Malacañang, Marcos was asked whether the government would change its approach or steps because the China Coast Guard (CCG) vessel CCG-5901 seemed to be deaf.

text: Makapila ka beses na ini nga ginaradyuhan samtang yara sa Philippine exclusive economic zone (EEZ) apang ginaradyuhan man sini pabalik ang barko sang Pilipinas.
english: It has been radioed several times while in the Philippine exclusive economic zone (EEZ) but it also radios back to the Philippine ship.

text: Suno kay Marcos, wala sang aircraft carrier ang Pilipinas nga may upod nga destroyer, frigate, kag submarine nga sarang pakadtuon didto kag magtulod palayo.
english: According to Marcos, the Philippines does not have an aircraft carrier with destroyers, frigates, and submarines that can go there and push away.

text: Malayo ang China sa Pilipinas kun padamo-damo kag padaku-daku sang barko ang pagahambalan suno sa presidente, apang nagpasalig ini nga padayunon ang pagdepensa sa teritoryo kag kinamatarong nasyon sa sulod sang EEZ.
english: China is far from the Philippines when it comes to increasing the number and size of ships, the president said, but he assured that it will continue to defend the territory and national rights within the EEZ.

text: ”Well, we don’t have the means na paalisin.
english: ”Well, we don’t have the means of policing.

text: Hindi naman – buti kung mayroon tayong aircraft carrier na may kasamang destroyer, frigate, at saka submarine na papupuntahin natin doon para matulak silang palayo.
english: No – fortunately we have an aircraft carrier with destroyers, frigates, and submarines that we can send there to push them away.

text: Wala naman tayong ganoon,” suno sa chief executive.
english: We don't have that,” the chief executive said.

text: ”Kung sa palakihan at paramihan lang ng barko, malayo tayo sa China.
english: "If it's just to expand and increase the number of ships, we're far from China.

text: Pero ang policy naman natin is that we will just continue to defend our territorial, our sovereign territory and our territorial rights in the EEZ,” dugang sang presidente.
english: But our policy is that we will just continue to defend our territorial, our sovereign territory and our territorial rights in the EEZ,” the president added.

text: Sang weekend, gin-report sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) nga natabog sang BRP Teresa Magbanua ang monster ship halin sa coastline sang Zambales.
english: Over the weekend, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) reported that BRP Teresa Magbanua chased the monster ship off the coastline of Zambales.

text: Ginapahayag nga 117 nautical mules ang distansya sini halin sa coastline sang amo nga probinsya.
english: It is reportedly 117 nautical miles from the coastline of the province.

text: Napilasan gid ang apat ka tawo — isa ang yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon — matapos nga naglupok ang isa ka World War II-era bomb sa isa ka construction site malapit sa riles sang tren sa Munich, Germany.
english: Four people were seriously injured — one in critical condition — after a World War II-era bomb exploded at a construction site near a train track in Munich, Germany.

text: Ginapahayag 550 pounds ang bug-at sang amo nga bomba.
english: The bomb reportedly weighed 550 pounds.

text: Sunod nga ginsuspinde ang operasyon sang tren halin kag padulong sa Donnersbergerbruecke — isa sa busiest stations sa Germany.
english: Train operations from and to Donnersbergerbruecke — one of the busiest stations in Germany — were subsequently suspended.

text: Nagbalik man ang operasyon pagkahapon.
english: The operation also resumed yesterday.

text: Masami nga may makit-an nga unexploded bombs sa Germany apisar 76 ka tuig na ang nakaligad matapos ang giyera.
english: Unexploded bombs are often found in Germany even though 76 years have passed since the end of the war.

text: Masami ini nga makit-an sa mga construction sites.
english: It is often found on construction sites.

text: Nagpaandam ang Social Security System (SSS) sa mga transport cooperatives nga magapasaka sila sang kaso kon indi mabaydan ang kontribusyon sang ila mga driver subong nga bulan.
english: The Social Security System (SSS) has warned transport cooperatives that they will file cases if their drivers' contributions are not paid this month.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Amiel Genova, Senior Communications Analyst sang Social Security System Visayas, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa ila nga pagsekyar sa mga payment sang kooperatiba, may mga nabaydan naman sila sa kontribusyon sang ila driver apang may mga yara man nga indi kompleto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Amiel Genova, Senior Communications Analyst of the Social Security System Visayas, said that based on their verification of the payments of the cooperative, they have already paid some of their driver's contribution but there are also incomplete ones.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga basehan man sa pagpasaka sang kaso ang mga dokumento nga indi ma-comply sa ila talatapan ukon sa account officer.
english: He also said that the documents that are not complied with in their office or the account officer are also grounds for filing a case.

text: Suno kay Genova, posible ini mangin factor sa pagpatuman sang legal nga mga tikang ilabi na kon ang employer ang unresponsive.
english: According to Genova, this may be a factor in the implementation of legal measures especially if the employer is unresponsive.

text: Nagpanugyan man ang natungdan sa mga employer nga indi na pagpalab-uton sa amo nga punto bangud apektado man ang mga trabahador.
english: He also advised employers not to reach that point because workers are also affected.

text: Preparado ang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) sa patigayonon nga Opening Salvo sang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) is ready for the Opening Salvo of the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Kim Legada, Director sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga kahapon nga adlaw, lakip ang kapulisan sa nagsekyar sang venue sang mga competing group.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Kim Legada, Director of the Iloilo City Police Office, said that yesterday, the police were among those who checked the venue of the competing groups.

text: Suno kay Legada, masobra 100 ang i-deploy sang ila talatapan sa palibot sang syudad subong nga hapon agud nga mapabilin nga malinong ang kahiwatan.
english: Legada said more than 100 personnel will be deployed around the city this afternoon to keep the event peaceful.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagkoordinar ang ila talatapan sa Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) agud nga mapasigurado ang dalagan sang trapiko samtang nagapadayon ang aktibidad.
english: He also said that their office coordinated with the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) to ensure the flow of traffic while the activity continues.

text: Nagalaum man si Legada nga mangin matalunsay ang road closure sa pila ka dalan sa city proper.
english: Legada also hopes that the road closure on some roads in the city proper will be smooth.

text: Nagpangulihot liwat ang Pilipinas sa international index nga nagatakos sang resilience sa mga pungsod sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The Philippines has again performed in the international index that measures the resilience of countries in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Sandig sa COVID Resilience Index sang Bloomberg para sa bulan sang Nobyembre, ika-53 out of 53 countries ang Pilipinas.
english: According to Bloomberg's COVID Resilience Index for the month of November, the Philippines ranked 53rd out of 53 countries.

text:
Gin-rank ang mga pungsod base sa kun daw ano ka-epektibo gin-handle ang virus “with the least social and economic upheaval.”

Gintawag sang Bloomberg ang ila listahan nga, “The Best and Worst Places to Be as Winter Meets Omicron.”

Lakip man sa 12 ka data indicators sa amo nga index amo ang virus containment, quality of healthcare, vaccination coverage, overall mortality kag pag-uswag may kaangtanan sa pagpahanugot liwat sa mga byahe.
english:
The countries were ranked based on how effectively they handled the virus “with the least social and economic upheaval.”

Bloomberg called their list, “The Best and Worst Places to Be as Winter Meets Omicron.”

Also included in the 12 data indicators in the index are virus containment, quality of healthcare, vaccination coverage, overall mortality and progress related to the resumption of flights.

text: Ginlantaw man ang vaccine doses per 100 people, lockdown severity, flight capacity, kag vaccinated travel routes.
english: Vaccine doses per 100 people, lockdown severity, flight capacity, and vaccinated travel routes were also looked at.

text:
Nagpanguna sa listahan ang United Arab Emirates, nga suno sa Bloomberg, “has basically normalized back to pre-pandemic life.”

Dala man sa Top 5 ang Chile, Finland, Ireland kag Spain.
english:
Topping the list was the United Arab Emirates, which, according to Bloomberg, “has basically normalized back to pre-pandemic life.”

Chile, Finland, Ireland and Spain are also in the Top 5.

text: Ang bottom 5 naman amo ang Poland, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia kag Pilipinas.
english: The bottom 5 are Poland, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia and the Philippines.

text: Consistent ang Pilipinas nga bottom-dweller sa international rankings sa COVID response — pagtuon nga gintawag na sang Malacañang nga “biased.”##
english: The Philippines is consistently the bottom-dweller in international rankings on COVID response — a study that Malacañang has called “biased.” ##

text: Wala pa sang bastante nga pagtuon ukon data nga nagapamatuod nga mas makalalaton pa ipaanggid sa Delta variant ang Omicron, ang bag-o nga variant of concern nga una na-detect sa South Africa.
english: There are not enough studies or data to prove that Omicron, the new variant of concern that was first detected in South Africa, is more contagious than the Delta variant.

text: Una nga ginpahayag sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga concerning ang mutations sang bag-o nga variant bangud sang mga preliminary evidence nga naga-‘suggest’ nga may increased risk sang reinfection sa sini nga variant.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) initially said the mutations of the new variant were concerning because of preliminary evidence that suggested an increased risk of reinfection with the variant.

text: Ginahibalo man kun makasarang pa ang existing nga COVID-19 vaccines batok sa sini nga variant.
english: It is also unknown whether existing COVID-19 vaccines are still effective against this variant.

text: May mga theoretical predictions nga naga-guwa kag gina-link ang mutations sa abilidad sang sini nga variant nga ma-evade ang existing immune protection sang tawo.
english: There are theoretical predictions emerging and linking the mutations to the ability of this variant to evade a person’s existing immune protection.

text: Apang sandig sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, isa ka public health expert, ginatun-an pa lang subong kun daw ano ka epktibo ang antibodies sa pag-neutralise sa new variant.
english: However, according to an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, a public health expert, is still studying how effective the antibodies are in neutralizing the new variant.

text: Minimum public health standards man sa gihapon ang ginapanugyan agud nga maproteheran ang lawas batok sa infection.
english: Minimum public health standards are still recommended to protect the body against infection.

text: Importante man ang vaccination suno kay Padilla.
english: Vaccination is also important, Padilla said.

text: Talalupangdon man subong ang madasig nga pag-implementar sang ban sa lain-lain nga mga pungsod.
english: Also notable today is the rapid implementation of the ban in different countries.

text: Suno kay Padilla, importante ini nga paagi agud mapunggan ang pagsulod sang virus sa isa ka lugar.
english: Padilla said this is an important way to prevent the virus from entering an area.

text: Nahibaluan nga pila lang ka oras matapos nag-anunsyo ang South Africa nga may na-detect nga new variant nga may multiple mutations, nagpatuman gilayon sang flight ban ang Britanya.
english: It is known that just hours after South Africa announced that a new variant with multiple mutations had been detected, Britain immediately imposed a flight ban.

text: Ginsundan ini sang Austria, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands kag Estados Unidos kag iban pa nga dalagku nga pungsod.
english: This was followed by Austria, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands and the United States and other major countries.

text: Apisar ‘proteksyon’ ang rason kun ngaa may global rush sa pagpatuman sang flight ban, ginpakamalaot naman ini sang South Africa kag gintawag nga “draconian,” unscientific kag baliskad sa abiso sang WHO.
english: Although 'protection' is the reason why there is a global rush to implement the flight ban, South Africa condemned it and called it "draconian," unscientific and contrary to the WHO's advice.

text: Mahimu na maka-apply sa City Social Welfare and Development Office ang mga solo parents agud nga makabaton sang ₱1000 nga monthly subsidy halin sa Iloilo City Government kag may booklet pa para sa 10% nga discount sa pagbakal sang mga gamit sang mga kabataan.
english: Solo parents can now apply to the City Social Welfare and Development Office to receive a ₱1000 monthly subsidy from the Iloilo City Government and a booklet for 10% discount on the purchase of children's items.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilot Frances Grace Parcon, chairman sang Committee on Women and Family sa Iloilo City Council iya ginpahayag nga mga solo parent nga may minimum wage and below ang mahimo makapasa sang mga requirements sa City Social Welfare and Development Office para mapaidalom sa screening.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Frances Grace Parcon, chairman of the Committee on Women and Family in the Iloilo City Council, said solo parents with minimum wage and below can submit the requirements to the City Social Welfare and Development Office to be screened.

text: Suno kay Councilor Parcon, kabahin sa mga mahimo nga mag-apply ang mga balo, seperado sa asawa ukon bana kag pwede man ang indi kasado nga sigurado nga may kustodiya sang bata.
english: According to Councilor Parcon, among those who can apply are widows, separated from their husbands or wives and can also be unmarried who are sure to have custody of the child.

text: Paathag niya, diretso na ang pag-apply sa City Social Welfare and Development Office kag indi na mag-agi pa sa barangay ang application agud mapaidalom gilayon sa case study.
english: He explained that the application is directly to the City Social Welfare and Development Office and the application does not have to go through the barangay to be immediately subjected to case study.

text: Ginpalawig pa ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. extended the

text: ang termino ni Philippine National Police Chief Police General Rommel Francisco Marbil sang apat ka bulan.
english: the term of Philippine National Police Chief Police General Rommel Francisco Marbil of four months.

text: Suno kay Presidential Communications Office, ini ang epektibo sang Pebrero 7, 2025 nga amo ang iya retirement day.
english: According to the Presidential Communications Office, this will be effective on February 7, 2025 which is his retirement day.

text: Sa memorandum nga pirmado ni Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, nasaad nga gin-aprubahan ni Marcos ang extension sang government service ni Marbil nga lapaw sa compulsory retirement age nga 56.
english: In a memorandum signed by Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, it was stated that Marcos approved the extension of Marbil's government service beyond the compulsory retirement age of 56.

text: Si Marbil amo ang ika- 30 nga PNP chief.
english: Marbil is the 30th PNP chief.

text: Siya ang myembro sang Philippine Military Academy- Sambisig Class of 1991.
english: He is a member of the Philippine Military Academy- Sambisig Class of 1991.

text: Nagsugod ang iya pagpangalagad bilang PNP chief sang Abril 1, 2024.
english: He will begin his term as PNP chief on April 1, 2024.

text: Nakakuha ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) sang dugang nga mga importante nga equipment kag devices halin sa condominium unit ni Deng Yuanqing nga amo ang Chinese national nga gindakop bangud sa gin-alegar nga pagpang-espiya diri sa Pilipinas.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has recovered additional important equipment and devices from the condominium unit of Deng Yuanqing, a Chinese national who was arrested for alleged espionage in the Philippines.

text: Sa follow-up operation sa iya ginatiniran sa Makati, ang nakumpiskar sang otoridad nagalakip sang laptop, computer, external drives, router, kag modem nga mahimo magamit sa remote access kag data extraction.
english: In a follow-up operation at his residence in Makati, the authorities seized a laptop, computer, external drives, router, and modem that can be used for remote access and data extraction.

text: May na-recover man nga IDs, passports, ankagd deposit slips nga kada transaction nagabalor sang minilyon ka pesos.
english: IDs, passports, and deposit slips worth millions of pesos per transaction were also recovered.

text: Iga-check pa sang otoridad paagi sa forensic investigation kun personal ini nga transaksyon ukon parte sang operasyon sa pagpang-espiya.
english: Authorities will check through forensic investigation whether this was a personal transaction or part of an espionage operation.

text: Enero 17 sang naaresto si Deng kaupod sa duha ka Pinoy samtang sakay sa salakyan nga puno sang high-tech devices nga ginapatihan nga para sa pagpang-espiya particular na sa mga military camps, facilities, kag EDCA sites sa Pilipinas.
english: Deng was arrested on January 17 along with two Filipinos while riding in a vehicle loaded with high-tech devices believed to be used for espionage particularly in military camps, facilities, and EDCA sites in the Philippines.

text: Gin-classify sang World Health Organization (WHO) ang B.1.1.529 variant nga na-detect sa South Africa bilang SARS-CoV-2 “variant of concern” kag posibe nga mas madasig nga maglaton.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) has classified the B.1.1.529 variant detected in South Africa as a SARS-CoV-2 “variant of concern” and potentially more transmissible.

text: Suno sa WHO, sandig sa preliminary evidences, may yara ini nga dala nga increased risk of reinfection kag may yara sang “detrimental change in COVID-19 epidemiology.
english: According to the WHO, based on preliminary evidence, it carries an increased risk of reinfection and a “detrimental change in COVID-19 epidemiology.

text: “Sa South Africa suno sa WHO, madasig nga nagsaka ang infections sini nga mga sinemana, kag naga-coincide ini sa variant nga subong ginkilala bilang omicron.
english: “In South Africa, according to the WHO, infections have risen rapidly in recent weeks, coinciding with the variant now known as omicron.

text: “This variant has been detected at faster rates than previous surges in infection, suggesting that this variant may have a growth advantage,” suno sa statement sang WHO.
english: “This variant has been detected at faster rates than previous surges in infection, suggesting that this variant may have a growth advantage,” according to the WHO statement.

text: Una ini nga nareport sa South Africa sang Nobyembre 24 kag nakit-an naman sa Botswana, Belgium, Hong Kong kag Israel.
english: It was first reported in South Africa on November 24 and has been found in Botswana, Belgium, Hong Kong and Israel.

text: Sa Estados Unidos, ginpahayag ni infectious disease chief Dr Anthony Fauci nga bisan ‘red flag’ ang reports kaangot sa new variant, posible nga mabatuan gihapon ini sang vaccines agud nga malikawan ang serious illness.
english: In the United States, infectious disease chief Dr. Anthony Fauci said that even if reports of the new variant are a red flag, it is still possible to fight it with vaccines to prevent serious illness.

text: Ginpabugal ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga nagbato ang Kamara para sa ikaayo sang mga pumuluyo nga Pilipino, nagpanindugan batok sa kurapsyon, kag naglikaw nga madala sang pwersa nga amo ang nagapaatrasar sang pag-umwad sang nasyon.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez boasted that the House stood up for the good of the Filipino people, stood up against corruption, and avoided being carried away by the forces that are retarding the development of the country.

text: Kaundan ini sang speech sang house speaker kagab-i, Pebrero 5, antes nag-adjourn ang session sang Kamara para sa midterm elections.
english: This is the content of the speech of the house speaker last night, February 5, before the House session adjourned for the midterm elections.

text: “Isinulong natin ang interes ng sambayanan.
english: “We will advance the interests of the people.

text: Lumaban sa mga puwersa ng kadiliman.
english: Fight the forces of darkness.

text: Hindi umatras sa kampon ng kasamaan,” kabahin sang speech samtang nagapalakpak naman ang iban nga mga mamalidha.
english: Do not retreat to the camp of evil,” part of the speech while other lawmakers applauded.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga wala nagapalagyo ang Kamara sa mga katungdanan sini sa tawo.
english: He said the House was not running away from its duties to the person.

text: Ginsulit man sini nga nagaserbe sila sa publiko kag nagapati nga wala sang institusyon nga mas mataas pa sa republika kag wala sang ambisyon nga mas mataas pa sa Konstitusyon.
english: He also reiterated that they serve the public and believe that no institution is higher than the republic and no ambition is higher than the Constitution.

text: “From the outset of the 19th Congress, we committed ourselves to a singular purpose: to be the vanguard of progress, the custodians of justice, and the architects of a future where every Filipino, regardless of station, has access to opportunity, security, and dignity.
english: “From the outset of the 19th Congress, we committed ourselves to a singular purpose: to be the vanguard of progress, the custodians of justice, and the architects of a future where every Filipino, regardless of station, has access to opportunity, security, and dignity.

text: We have not wavered.
english: We have not wavered.

text: We have not faltered,” dugang niya.
english: We have not faltered,” he added.

text:
“This chamber has been a crucible of ideas and action, where principled debates gave birth to policies that strengthened our institutions, empowered our people, and fortified our economy.”

Dugang pa sang house speaker, napasar nila ang 75 national laws kag 112 local laws lakip ang 30 Legislative-Executive Development Advisory Council (LEDAC) priority measures.
english:
“This chamber has been a crucible of ideas and action, where principled debates gave birth to policies that strengthened our institutions, empowered our people, and fortified our economy.”

The house speaker added that they have passed 75 national laws and 112 local laws including 30 Legislative-Executive Development Advisory Council (LEDAC) priority measures.

text: Walo diri suno sa iya ang may direkta nga suporta sa Bagong Pilipinas vision ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Eight of them, he said, have direct support for the New Philippines vision of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Ini nga closing speeach ang natabo inoras matapos sini ginpangunahan ang session kun sa diin na-istoryahan ang impeachment complaints batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: This closing speech came hours after he led the session where the impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte were discussed.

text: ISA KA shocking nga balita ang nabaton ni University of the Philippines (UP) President Danilo Concepcion sadtong Enero 15, 2021 halin sa Department of National Defense (DND).
english: A SHOCKING news was received by University of the Philippines (UP) President Danilo Concepcion on January 15, 2021 from the Department of National Defense (DND).

text: Nabaton sini sadtong adlaw ang sulat ni Defense Secretary Delfin N. Lorenzana nga nagapahibalo sa iya nga ginapauntat na sini ang UP-DND Agreement nga nahisugtan sadtong Hunyo 30, 1989.
english: He received a letter from Defense Secretary Delfin N. Lorenzana that day informing him that he was terminating the UP-DND Agreement signed on June 30, 1989.

text: Ginpirmahan ini sadto ni anay UP President Jose Abueva kag sang Dept.
english: It was signed by former UP President Jose Abueva and the Dept.

text: of National Defense Secretary Fidel Ramos sang Cory Administration.
english: of National Defense Secretary Fidel Ramos of the Cory Administration.

text: Ining Agreement naga-bawal sa military kag police forces sa pagsulod sa UP-Diliman kag sang pitu pa sini ka constituent universities sa bug-os nga pungsod, except kon naga-conduct sang hot pursuit ukon ano man nga emerhensya.
english: This Agreement prohibits the military and police forces from entering UP-Diliman and its seven other constituent universities nationwide, except when conducting a hot pursuit or any other emergency.

text: “Without academic freedom, the University of the Philippines would lose its meaning and purpose,” paathag sang daw napus-an itlog nga monga ang UP President sa isa ka indignation rally nga ginhiwat sang UP students sadtong Enero 19 batok sa “repressive presence” sining mga alagad sang kasuguan.
english: “Without academic freedom, the University of the Philippines would lose its meaning and purpose,” the UP President explained at an indignation rally held by UP students on January 19 against the “repressive presence” of these law enforcement officers.

text: Sa matandaan pa, may ginduso nga kasubong nga Agreement pagkatapos natabo ang isa ka grim incident sa sulod sang UP campus sadtong Hunyo 16, 1981.
english: It can be recalled that a similar Agreement was proposed after a grim incident occurred inside the UP campus on June 16, 1981.

text: Naga-involver ini sang isa ka staffer sang Philippine Collegian.
english: It involves a staffer of the Philippine Collegian.

text: Gin-aresto ini sa suspetso nga ginpatay niya ang isa ka opisyal sang US Army nga na-asign sa Joint US Military Assistance Group (JUSMAG).
english: He was arrested on suspicion of killing a US Army officer assigned to the Joint US Military Assistance Group (JUSMAG).

text: Nag-plead “not guilty” si Donato Continente apang gin-convict kag gin-sentensyahan sing 14 ka tuig nga pagkabilanggo.
english: Donato Continente pleaded “not guilty” but was convicted and sentenced to 14 years in prison.

text: Gin-alegar sini sa pagdakop sa iya nga gin-torture kag gin-abduct siya sang “uniformed authorities”.
english: He alleged that during his arrest he was tortured and abducted by the “uniformed authorities”.

text: Tungod sini, sadtong Oktubre 28, 1981, ginpirmahan ni anay Defense Sec.
english: As a result, on October 28, 1981, former Defense Sec.

text: Juan Ponce Enrile kag UP student leader Sonia Soto ang Soto-Enrile Accord agud ma-protejeran ang mga UP students sa presensya sang mga military kag police forces sa kon diin man nga campus sang UP.
english: Juan Ponce Enrile and UP student leader Sonia Soto signed the Soto-Enrile Accord to protect UP students from the presence of military and police forces on any UP campus.

text: Ginhingyo liwat sang UP ining Accord pagkatapos ang Revolutionary Government kag sang napatuman na ang 1987 Constitution ni anay President Cory Aquino.
english: UP requested this Accord again after the Revolutionary Government and after the implementation of the 1987 Constitution of former President Cory Aquino.

text: Napasugtan naman ini sadtong 1989.
english: It was approved in 1989.

text:
***

Indi na bala kinahanglan ang ining 1989 Agreement kon ngaa ginpauntat na?
english:
***

Is this 1989 Agreement no longer needed and why has it been discontinued?

text: Dapat ipabilin pa, sunu sa mga taga-UP, agud padayon nga maseguro ang ila hilway nga pag-enjoy sang Academic Freedom sa UP.
english: It should be maintained, according to UP officials, to continue to ensure their free enjoyment of Academic Freedom at UP.

text: Kinahanglan untaton na ini, sunu sa DND, kay indi na ini kinahanglan sa karon kay lain na ang sitwasyon.
english: This should be stopped, according to the DND, because it is no longer necessary because the situation is different.

text: Gintudlo sini ang pagpati nga ang UP isa na ka haven sang mga NPA cadre nga masami nagapanago diri kon ginalagas sang mga otoridad.
english: He pointed to the belief that UP is now a haven for NPA cadres who often hide here when pursued by the authorities.

text: Diri man kuno gina-recruit ang mga bag-o nga mga myembro sang CPP-NPA-NDF.
english: This is also where new CPP-NPA-NDF members are recruited.

text: Ginkwestyon pa gani sang DND kon ngaa dapat mangin espesyal gid ang treatment sang UP samtang wala man ginapangayo ang kasubong nga Accord sang iban nga unibersidad.
english: DND even questioned why UP should be treated so specially when other universities are not asking for a similar Accord.

text:
***

Ano gid bala ang paghangop ta sa Academic Freedom diri sa Filipinas?
english:
***

What is our understanding of Academic Freedom here in the Philippines?

text:
Ang 1987 Philippine Constitution nagasiling sa Article XIV, Section 5, “(2) Academic freedom shall be enjoyed in all institutions of higher learning; (3) Every citizen has a right to select a profession or course of study, subject to fair, reasonable, and equitable admission and academic requirements; (4) The State shall enhance the right of teachers to professional advancement.”

Ang ginatumod diri nga “professional advancement” sang mga manunudlo amo ang “right” sa wala upang nga pagpasanyog sang “inquiry and research” agud matungkad ang kamatuoran (truth) sang mga bagay, kag ang indi man pagpugong sa mga estudyante sa amo man nga hilikuton sa ila pagtuon.
english:
The 1987 Philippine Constitution states in Article XIV, Section 5, “(2) Academic freedom shall be enjoyed in all institutions of higher learning; (3) Every citizen has a right to select a profession or course of study, subject to fair, reasonable, and equitable admission and academic admission; to professional advancement.”

The professional advancement of teachers is the right to promote inquiry and research in order to determine the truth of things, and not to prevent students from doing the same in their studies.

text: Ining Academic Freedom sa idalom sang Article XIV mas ginaathag sa Bill of Rights (Article III) nga nagakilala sini nga isa ka kinamatarong (right).
english: This Academic Freedom under Article XIV is further clarified in the Bill of Rights (Article III) which recognizes it as a right.

text:
Ang Section 4 sini nagasiling: “No law shall be passed abridging the freedom of speech, of expression, or of the press, or the right of the people peaceably to assemble and petition the Government for redress of grievances.”

Katulad sang mga kasuguan sang iban nga mga pungsod, ang ano man nga “freedom” may limitasyon ugaling agud protejeran ang mas mataas nga interest sang pungsod kag sang iya mga pumuluyo.
english:
Section 4 thereof states: “No law shall be passed abridging the freedom of speech, of expression, or of the press, or the right of the people peaceably to assemble and petition the Government for redress of grievances.”

Like the laws of other countries, any “freedom” has limits however to protect the higher interests of the country and its people.

text:
***

By the way, kay kasuguan ang naghatag sining kinamatarong sa Academic Freedom kag kon ano ang mga limitasyon ang bagay diri, indi bala dapat kuhaon anay sang DND ang pahanugot sang korte (Judiciary) kon ano gid ang dapat, indi kay paagi lang sa Executive prerogative sa idalom sang aton Separation of Powers?/PN
english:
***

By the way, since the law gives this right to Academic Freedom and what the limits are, shouldn't the DND first get the permission of the court (Judiciary) as it should be, not just through the Executive prerogative under our Separation of Powers?/PN

text: Atubangon sang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala ang Colombian player nga si Emiliana Arango sa iya labing-una nga pagtapak sa main draw sang French Open.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala will face Colombian player Emiliana Arango for her first time in the main draw of the French Open.

text: Matabo ini sa Domingo, Philippine time.
english: It will take place on Sunday, Philippine time.

text: Si Arango naga-edad sang 24-anyos kag nagapang-88 sa rankings sang Women’s Tennis Association (WTA).
english: Arango is 24-years-old and ranked 88th in the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) rankings.

text: Yara sa mas mataas nga posisyon ang 19-anyos nga pambato sang Pilipinas nga sang isa ka adlaw lamang nagsaka sa career-high ranking nga 69.
english: The 19-year-old Philippine boxer is in a higher position, having climbed to a career-high ranking of 69 in just one day.

text: Ini ang debut ni Eala sa main draw sang nasambit nga women’s singles tournament matapos ang iya third round exit sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is Eala's debut in the main draw of the women's singles tournament after her third round exit last year.

text: Apisar bag-uhan sa main draw, indi ini ang una nga tion nga makahampang ang Pinay sa Roland Garros bangud kun matandaan nadag-an sini ang juniors doubles trophy kaupod kay Oksana Selekhmeteva sang 2021.
english: Despite being new to the main draw, this is not the first time the Filipina has played at Roland Garros as she won the juniors doubles trophy with Oksana Selekhmeteva in 2021.

text: Natalana nga itiglawas sang isa ka dance group sa Western Visayas ang Pilipinas sa World Supremacy Battlegrounds sa Dubai, United Arab Emirates sa Hulyo 7 tubtob 13.
english: A dance group from Western Visayas is scheduled to represent the Philippines at the World Supremacy Battlegrounds in Dubai, United Arab Emirates from July 7 to 13.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jonathan Yukie Igpuara, manager sang Fearless Street Company, iya ginpahayag nga dako ini nga kahigayunan agud mapakita sang grupo ang ila talento agud saksihan sang bilog nga kalibutan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jonathan Yukie Igpuara, manager of Fearless Street Company, said this is a great opportunity for the group to showcase their talent for the whole world to witness.

text: Suno kay Igpuara, sa subong, masako ang ila grupo sa preparasyon para sa ila mangin performance sa hiphop nga genre nga ila intrahan.
english: According to Igpuara, their group is currently busy preparing for their performance in the hiphop genre.

text: Magluwas diri, ginatinguhaan nila nga makatipon man sang pondo agud panggasto nila sa ila pagpadulong sa Dubai.
english: In addition, they are also trying to raise funds to spend on their trip to Dubai.

text: Nagapati naman ini nga masarangan sang ila grupo nga magmadinalag-on sa international stage.
english: He believes that his team can succeed on the international stage.

text: Mas madasig nga matapikan sang balatian nga rheumatic fever kag rheumatic heart disease ang mga kabataan nga naga-edad lima tubtob 15 anyos.
english: Children between the ages of five and 15 are more susceptible to rheumatic fever and rheumatic heart disease.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. James Catoto, Specialist in Internal Medicine – Cardiology sa West Visayas State University Medical Center, iya ginpahayag nga ang rheumatic heart disease amo ang kondisyon sa diin ang valves sang tagipusuon sang tawo ang permanente nga naguba tuga sang rheumatic fever.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. James Catoto, Specialist in Internal Medicine – Cardiology at West Visayas State University Medical Center, said rheumatic heart disease is a condition in which the valves of the human heart are permanently damaged due to rheumatic fever.

text: Suno kay Dr. Catoto, ang rheumatic heart disease ang ginatunaan sang rheumatic fever nga amo ang isa ka inflammatory nga balatian sa diin maapektuhan sini ang mga nagaalangot-angot nga tisyu sang lawas ilabi na sa tagipusuon, panit, joints kag utok.
english: According to Dr. Catoto, rheumatic heart disease is caused by rheumatic fever which is an inflammatory disease that affects the connective tissues of the body especially the heart, skin, joints and brain.

text: Bangud sini, ang valve sa tagipusuon sang tawo ang nagabanog sa diin sa paglawig sang panahon, nagakaguba ini.
english: As a result, the valve in the human heart becomes swollen and over time, it becomes damaged.

text: Ini ang nagaresulta sa indi normal nga pagfunction sang heart kag nagahulog sa balatian nga heart failure.
english: This causes the heart to function abnormally and falls into the disease of heart failure.

text: May dako man nga risgo nga makaangkon sang balatian nga rheumatic heart disease ang mga kabataan nga indi gilayon madapatan sang pagbulong ang mga inpeksyon sa lawas ilabi na ang strep throat infections.
english: There is also a high risk of developing rheumatic heart disease in children who do not receive immediate treatment for infections in the body, especially strep throat infections.

text: Ginpahayag ni Catoto nga bangud ang rheumatic fever ang ginahalinan sang rheumatic heart disease, ang pinakamaayo nga treatment diri amo ang likawan ang rheumatic fever pinaagi sa paggamit sang antibiotics agud mapaayo ang trep infections.
english: Catoto said that since rheumatic fever is the cause of rheumatic heart disease, the best treatment is to avoid rheumatic fever by using antibiotics to cure trep infections.

text: ILOILO CITY- Pinakataas nga Automated Teller Machine sa kalibutan sa diin bala makit-an?
english: ILOILO CITY- Where can I find the tallest Automated Teller Machine in the world?

text: Atensyon sa mga mahilig magsaka sa bukid ukon mountaineers, sa madugay na ninyo nga pagsaka, may bes bala nga nakakita kamo sang automated teller machine sa kabukiran?
english: Attention to those who like to climb mountains or mountaineers, in your long climbing, have you ever seen an automated teller machine in the mountains?

text: Siguro wala gid kay kun huna-hunaon, imposible man nga may magbutang sang automated teller machine sa putok-putukan sang bukid.
english: Maybe not because if you think about it, it's impossible for someone to put an automated teller machine on top of a mountain.

text: Pero dali lang, kay didto sa kabukiran nga napatung-an sang China kag Pakistan, may yara sang isa ka Automated Teller Machine nga nakabutang sa kataason nga 4,693 meters nga ginakabig highest-altitude nga machine sang cash.
english: But hurry up, because in the mountains between China and Pakistan, there is an Automated Teller Machine located at an altitude of 4,693 meters that is considered the highest-altitude cash machine.

text: Didto ini sa Khunjerab Pass sa Gilgit-Baltistan province sa northern Pakistan.
english: It is in Khunjerab Pass in Gilgit-Baltistan province in northern Pakistan.

text: Gin- install ini sang National Bank of Pakistan (NBP) sang 2016, ini ang solar- kag wind-powered cash machine.
english: Installed by the National Bank of Pakistan (NBP) in 2016, it is a solar- and wind-powered cash machine.

text: Naglawig sang apat ka bulan ang pag-install sini.
english: It took four months to install.

text: Tuman man ka budlay ang pag-provide sang maintenance kag pag- refill sang cash sa machine sa regular basis bangud ang pinakamalapit nga bangko ang may kalayuon nga 82 kilometros.
english: It is also very difficult to provide maintenance and refill cash in the machine on a regular basis because the nearest bank is 82 kilometers away.

text: Kalabanan nga kliyente diri amo ang border guards nga nagakuha sang ila monthly salaries gikan diri, amo man ang pila ka pumuluyo sa lugar kag ang mga tawo nga nagatabok sa border.
english: Most clients here are the border guards who get their monthly salaries from here, as well as some residents in the area and the people crossing the border.

text: Ginabanta man nga 4 to 5 million rupees ukon $18,350 – $23,000 ukon P1M tubtob P1.5M ang gina-withdraw sa amo nga machine kada duha ka semana.
english: It is also estimated that 4 to 5 million rupees or $18,350 – $23,000 or P1M to P1.5M are withdrawn from the machine every two weeks.

text: Ginapasiguro ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. assures

text: sa mga mangunguma nga indi na magnubo pa ang presyo sang unmilled rice kadungan sang pagnubo man sang presyo sa merkado kasunod sang ginapatuman nga P20-per-kilo program.
english: to farmers that the price of unmilled rice will not decrease along with the decrease in market prices following the implementation of the P20-per-kilo program.

text: Suno kay Marcos, magapadayon ang pagbakal sang National Food Authority (NFA) sang humay nagikan sa mga mangunguma sa presyo nga P18 kada kilo para sa fresh, kag P19 tubtob P23 kada kilo para sa clean and dry.
english: According to Marcos, the National Food Authority (NFA) will continue to buy rice from farmers at P18 per kilo for fresh, and P19 to P23 per kilo for clean and dry.

text: Nagpanawagan naman si Senator kag anay Agriculture Sec.
english: Senator and former Agriculture Sec.

text: Francis Pangilinan sa NFA kag sa local government units (LGU) nga baklon ang humay kag iban pa nga mga produkto nagikan sa mga mangunguma sa presyo nga kaangay sa mga mercado.
english: Francis Pangilinan to the NFA and local government units (LGUs) to buy rice and other products from farmers at prices similar to the markets.

text: Pahayag pa niya, nagakadapat nga i-activate ang Sagip Saka Law nga nagapahanugot sa ila nga mag-procure nga wala na sang public bidding.
english: He said the Sagip Saka Law should be activated which allows them to procure without public bidding.

text: Indi mahangpan ni Iloilo 1st District Representative Dr. Janette Garin kun ngaa siya ang ginhingadlan ni Davao City Rep.
english: Iloilo 1st District Representative Dr. Janette Garin on why she was named by Davao City Rep.

text: Paolo Duterte nga nagpanguna sa pagtipon sang pirma para nga madasig nga ma-impeach si Vice President Sara Duterte sa Kamara.
english: Paolo Duterte who led the collection of signatures to quickly impeach Vice President Sara Duterte in the House of Representatives.

text: Sa statement nga gin-release ni Cong.
english: In a statement released by Cong.

text: Pulong kahapon, ginpahayag sini nga akig siya sa desperado kag politically-motivated nga mga lihok para dasigon ang impeachment batok sa iya utod.
english: Speaking yesterday, he said he was angry at the desperate and politically-motivated moves to hasten the impeachment against his brother.

text: Gintawag man sini ang impeachment case nga wala sang basehan kag klaro nga akto sang political persecution.
english: He also called the impeachment case baseless and a clear act of political persecution.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo Philippines kay Garin, ginpahayag sini nga daku nga kuryente kag indi matuod ang impormasyon nga siya ang nanguna sa pagtipon sang mga pirma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Philippines, Garin said the information that he led the collection of signatures was a big electricity and not true.

text: Ginklaro sini nga wala man siya nagpangampanya para diri kag wala nagpangumbinse sa iban bangud kada kongresista ang may yara man sang constituency kag indi madali nga istoryahon kun may yara man sila sang panindugan.
english: He clarified that he did not campaign for this and did not convince others because each congressman has a constituency and it is not easy to talk about if they have a position.

text: Suno kay Garin, nagpirma lamang siya sa impeachment complaint bangud nga indi niya matalikdan ang iya constitutional duty kag nakit-an man sini nga klaro ang mga ebidensya batok kay Duterte ilabi na sa betrayal of public trust.
english: Garin said he signed the impeachment complaint because he could not abandon his constitutional duty and he also saw that the evidence against Duterte was clear especially in the betrayal of public trust.

text: Nagapati man si Garin nga posible nasal-an lang siya ni Cong.
english: Garin also believes that he may have been mistaken by Cong.

text:
Pulong bangud nga ang nagpaathag sang ikaapat nga impeachment complaint nga gin-file sa Kamara amo si House Deputy Speaker Jayjay Suarez nga ginatawag man sang kadam-an nga si “Cong Jay.”

Suno kay Garin, ginatawag man siya bilang si “Cong J” sa Kamara gani posible nga lain nga “J” ang napalab-ot sa impormasyon ni Cong.
english:
House Deputy Speaker Jayjay Suarez, also known as “Cong Jay,” explained the fourth impeachment complaint filed in the House.

According to Garin, he is also called as “Cong J” in the House of Representatives so it is possible that a different “J” was conveyed in the information of Cong.

text: Pulong kag wala na na-check sang maayo antes ang press release.
english: Word and had not been properly checked prior to press release.

text: Pahayag sini, kuntani lantawon man sang maayo ni Congressman Duterte ang mga impormasyon nga iya mabaton.
english: He said Congressman Duterte should also look carefully at the information he receives.

text: Gindugang man sini nga madugay-dugay na nga wala nagakadto sa hearings sa Kamara ang amo nga kongresista gani nga wala sini nagakakita kag nagakabatian kun ano gid ang nagakatabo sa chamber.
english: He added that the congressman has not been attending hearings in the House for a long time so he does not see and hear what is really happening in the chamber.

text: Base sa verified complaint, gin-move sang complainants nga i-impeach si Duterte base sa grounds sang Culpable Violation of the Constitution, Betrayal of Public Trust, Graft and Corruption, and Other High Crimes.
english: Based on the verified complaint, the complainants moved to impeach Duterte based on the grounds of Culpable Violation of the Constitution, Betrayal of Public Trust, Graft and Corruption, and Other High Crimes.

text: Bangud lapaw ang 215 sa one third sang House membership nga 306 ka mga kongresista, yara na sa Senado ang bola sandig sa kun ano ang nakasaad sa 1987 Constitution.
english: With 215 more than one third of the House membership of 306 congressmen, the ball is already in the Senate as stipulated in the 1987 Constitution.

text: Kahapon amo man ang katapusan nga adlaw sang session para sa Kamara kag Senado antes ang pahuway para sa national and local elections.
english: Yesterday was also the last day of session for the House and Senate before the break for national and local elections.

text: Napaslawan ang Iloilo City Police Office nga makumbinsi si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga magpasugot sa ila hingyo nga magpatuman sang signal jamming sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office failed to convince Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas to agree to their request to implement signal jamming at the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Miss Joy Facinal Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nagapanindugan gid ang alkalde nga indi kinahanglan sang signal jamming para lang masiguro ang seguridad sang publiko sa tunga sang kahiwatan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Miss Joy Facinal Fantilaga, spokesperson of Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, said the mayor insists that there is no need for signal jamming to ensure public safety during the event.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, dako man ang pagsalig sang alkalde sa kapulisan nga makapatuman sila sang security measures sa iban nga pamaagi magluwas sa signal jamming.
english: According to Fantilaga, the mayor also has great confidence in the police that they can implement security measures in other ways besides signal jamming.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa sa argumento sang alcalde kun ngaa indi ini pabor sa signal jamming amo ang natabo sang 2023 kun sa diin indi lang ang syudad ang apektado bangud nadulaan man sang signal ang kaiping nga mga banwa kag mangin ang Guimaras.
english: It is known that one of the arguments of the mayor why he is not in favor of signal jamming is what happened in 2023 where not only the city was affected because neighboring towns also lost signal and even Guimaras.

text: Samtang, bukas naman ang Iloilo City Council sa posibilidad nga pamatian ang hingyo sang Iloilo City Police Office nga magpatuman sang signal jamming sa Dinagyang Festival.
english: Meanwhile, the Iloilo City Council is open to the possibility of listening to the request of the Iloilo City Police Office to implement signal jamming during the Dinagyang Festival.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, chairman sang Committee on Public Safety, iya ginpahayag nga kun may yara gid man sang device para sa signal jamming nga masiguro nga sa partikular nga area lamang madulaan sang signal, hatagan ini sang konsiderasyon sang konseho.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Councilor Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, chairman of the Committee on Public Safety, said that if there is a device for signal jamming to ensure that only in a particular area the signal is lost, the council will give it consideration.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna, sa pagkamatuod, bisan wala sang signal jamming sang nagligad nga tuig, nasarangan man sang kapulisan nga mapabilin nga safe ang publiko sa kabilugan nga mga aktibidad sa festival.
english: According to Cabaluna, in fact, even though there was no signal jamming last year, the police were able to keep the public safe during the festival activities.

text: Gintuad naman sang konsehal nga wala pa sila sang nabaton nga letter of request para sa signal jamming halin sa Iloilo City Police Office.
english: The councilor admitted that they have not yet received a letter of request for signal jamming from the Iloilo City Police Office.

text: Gindala sa ospital ang 13 ka mga preso sa Zimbabwe matapos naigu sang kilat samtang nagapanyaga.
english: Thirteen prisoners in Zimbabwe were taken to hospital after being struck by lightning while on duty.

text: Sa 13 ka inmates, apat ang ginapahayag yara sa seryoso nga kondisyon.
english: Of the 13 inmates, four are said to be in serious condition.

text: Suno kay Deputy spokesman for the prison services Peter Chaparanganda, yara sa sulod sang prison yard ang male prisoners sang natabo ang insidente.
english: Deputy spokesman for the prison services Peter Chaparanganda said the male prisoners were inside the prison yard when the incident occurred.

text: Common nga hitabo sa Zimbabwe ang pagpangilat kadungan sang summer thunderstorms.
english: Lightning is a common occurrence in Zimbabwe during summer thunderstorms.

text: Balantayan na ang Opening Salvo sang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahan subong nga Huwebes kag ang opening salvo sang Dinagyang Tribes Competition sa bwas, Biyernes.
english: Watch for the Opening Salvo of Kasadyahan sa Babanwahan this Thursday and the opening salvo of the Dinagyang Tribes Competition tomorrow, Friday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joyce Clavecillas, Executive Director sang Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Incorporated, iya ginpahayag nga magasugod ang kahiwatan sa alas-tres sa hapon kun sa diin ang performance areas amo ang Freedom Grandstand kag Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joyce Clavecillas, Executive Director of the Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Incorporated, said the event will start at 3 pm where the performance areas are the Freedom Grandstand and the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Suno kay Clavecillas, patilaw ini agud labi pa nga malangkag ang mga Ilonggo kag mga turista sa mangin highlights sang Dinagyang Festival sa Enero 25 kag 26.
english: According to Clavecillas, this is a taste to make Ilonggos and tourists more excited about the highlights of the Dinagyang Festival on January 25 and 26.

text: Para sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahan, ang mga festivals nga magapasundayag amo ang Banaag Festival sang Anilao, Kaing Festival sang Leon, Tawili Festival sang San Rafael, Hirinugyaw Suguidadonay Festival sang Calinog, Tinuom Festival sang Cabatuan, Cry of Jelicuon Festival sang New Lucena, Tangyan Festival sang Igbaras, Haw-as Festival sang Dumangas, kag Tultugan Festival sang Maasin.
english: For the Happiness of the Town, the festivals that will perform are the Banaag Festival of Anilao, Kaing Festival of Leon, Tawili Festival of San Rafael, Hirinugyaw Suguidadonay Festival of Calinog, Tinuom Festival of Cabatuan, Cry of Jelicuon Festival of New Lucena, Igbas Festival of Igbaw. Dumangas, and Tultugan Festival of Maasin.

text: Para sa Dinagyang tribes naman, walo ka competing tribes ang magapasundayag nga ginabug-usan sang Tribu Paghidaet sang La Paz National High School, Tribu Salognon sang Jaro National High School, Tribu Parianon sang Distrito sang Molo, Tribu Ilonganon sang Jalandoni Memorial National High School, Tribu Pag-Asa Kang Manduryaw sang Distrito sang Mandurrriao, Tribu Hangaway sang Graciano Lopez Jaena Elementary School, Tribu Molave sang Brgy.
english: For the Dinagyang tribes, eight competing tribes will perform comprising of the Paghidaet Tribe of La Paz National High School, the Salognon Tribe of Jaro National High School, the Parianon Tribe of Molo District, the Ilonganon Tribe of Jalandoni Memorial National High School, the Pag-Asa Kang Manduryaw Tribe of Mandurcia District, and the Grape Hangaway Tribe of Longaway District. Jaena Elementary School, Tribu Molave of Brgy.

text: San Rafael, Mandurriao, kag Tribu Pan-Ay sang Fort San Pedro National High School.
english: San Rafael, Mandurriao, and Tribu Pan-Ay of Fort San Pedro National High School.

text: Maga-perform man ang anom ka barangay-based tribes para sa Sadsad sa Calle Real kag ang Tribu Sidlangan nga amo ang champion sa 2024 Ilomination.
english: Six barangay-based tribes will also perform for Sadsad in Calle Real and Tribu Sidlangan who is the champion in 2024 Ilomination.

text: Kaangot sa opening salvo, may patigayunon nga road closure sa pila ka parte sang City Proper particular na ang Calle Real.
english: In connection with the opening salvo, there will be a road closure in some parts of the City Proper particularly Calle Real.

text: Nag-adjourn ang session sang Senado antes alas syete kagab-i nga wala gin-istoryahan ang articles of impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The Senate session adjourned before 7 pm without discussing the articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Kun balikan ang nagkalatabo kahapon, isa ka oras matapos nagpirma ang 215 ka mga kongresista sa Kamara sa pag-endorso sang impeachment complaint, pormal nga gin-turn over kay Senate Secretary Renato Bantug ang Articles of Impeachment.
english: Recalling what happened yesterday, an hour after 215 congressmen in the House of Representatives signed to endorse the impeachment complaint, the Articles of Impeachment were formally turned over to Senate Secretary Renato Bantug.

text: Nag-abot si House Secretary General Reginald Velasco sa Senado dies minutos antes ang alas dies sa gab-i para mahatag ang beripikado nga complaint para sa impeachment.
english: House Secretary General Reginald Velasco arrived at the Senate ten minutes before 10 pm to submit the verified complaint for impeachment.

text: Dala man didto ang lista sang prosecutors sa impeachment trial nga aprubado man sang plenaryo.
english: The list of prosecutors in the impeachment trial, which was also approved by the plenary, was also included.

text: Antes nagkadto sa Senado, nagtawag man si Velasco kay Bantug kaangot sa iya ipasa.
english: Before going to the Senate, Velasco also called Bantug regarding his bill.

text: Base sa verified complaint, gin-move sang complainants nga i-impeach si Duterte base sa grounds sang Culpable Violation of the Constitution, Betrayal of Public Trust, Graft and Corruption, and Other High Crimes.
english: Based on the verified complaint, the complainants moved to impeach Duterte based on the grounds of Culpable Violation of the Constitution, Betrayal of Public Trust, Graft and Corruption, and Other High Crimes.

text: Bangud lapaw ang 215 sa one third sang House membership nga 306 ka mga kongresista, yara na sa Senado ang bola sandig sa kun ano ang nakasaad sa 1987 Constitution.
english: With 215 more than one third of the House membership of 306 congressmen, the ball is already in the Senate as stipulated in the 1987 Constitution.

text: Kahapon amo man ang katapusan nga adlaw sang session para sa Kamara kag Senado antes ang pahuway para sa national and local elections.
english: Yesterday was also the last day of session for the House and Senate before the break for national and local elections.

text: Maga-resume sila sang session sa masunod pa nga Hunyo 2.
english: They will resume session on June 2.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 3rd district Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo 3rd district Rep.

text: Lorenz Defensor nga napilian man sang Kamara bilang isa sa 11 nga prosecutors sa impeachment trial, ginpahayag sini nga mahimo gid aktuhan sang Senado ang impeachment bisan adjourned na ang Kongreso bilang isa ka lehislatura.
english: Lorenz Defensor, who was also elected by the House of Representatives as one of the 11 prosecutors in the impeachment trial, said the Senate can act on the impeachment even if Congress is adjourned as a legislature.

text: Indi isa ka legislative work ang impeachment suno kay Defensor gani ginabantayan nila ang desisyon sang liderato sang Senado kun mag-convene ini bilang impeachment court antes ang pag-resume sang session sa Hunyo.
english: Defensor said impeachment is not a legislative work so they are waiting for the decision of the Senate leadership if it convenes as an impeachment court before the resumption of the session in June.

text: Suno naman kay Senate Minority Leader Aquilino Pimentel III nga former Senate President, sa normal course of business, diskusyunan ang reklmao sa idalom sang rules sa Hunyo kun mag-resume na ang session.
english: Senate Minority Leader Aquilino Pimentel III, former Senate President, said in the normal course of business, the complaint will be discussed under the rules in June when the session resumes.

text: “Sa normal course of events, mukhang sa June pa.
english: “In the normal course of events, it looks like June.

text: Kasi very extraordinary ‘yung sinasabi ko,” suno sa senador.
english: Because what I'm saying is very extraordinary,” the senator said.

text: “Huwag tayong mapako sa legislative calendar.
english: “Let's not get caught up in the legislative calendar.

text: Kasi pagka impeachment court na kami, meron kaming trial calendar.
english: Because after we're in impeachment court, we have a trial calendar.

text: Iba yun.
english: That's different.

text: Pero unfortunately, meron kaming end of term ng June 30, 2025 wala tayong magagawa doon.
english: But unfortunately, we have an end of term of June 30, 2025 and we can't do anything about it.

text: Constitutional ‘yun eh.##
english: Constitutional ‘yun eh.##

text: Patay ang 45 ka tawo lakip na ang 12 ka kabataan matapos nga nagkalayo sa tunga sang highway ang isa ka bus sa western Bulgaria.
english: At least 45 people, including 12 children, were killed after a bus caught fire in the middle of a highway in western Bulgaria.

text: Indi pa maathag kun ano ang nangin rason sang insidente apang naga-guwa sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon nga nadalasa sang bus ang barikada sa dalan.
english: It is not clear what caused the incident but initial investigation reveals that the bus hit the barricade on the road.

text: Sa tanan nga pasahero sa bus, 7 lang gid ang reported nga nakaluwas, apang nagsuprer man sang sunog sa lawas kag nabali ang mga tiil.
english: Of all the passengers on the bus, only 7 were reported to have survived, but also suffered burns and broken legs.

text: Sandig sa statement sang interior ministry sang Bulgaria, ini ang ‘most deadly bus accident’ sa maragtas sang amo nga pungsod.
english: According to a statement from the Bulgarian interior ministry, this is the 'most deadly bus accident' in the history of the country.

text: Nag-abo gid ang bangkay sang mga pasahero suno kay Interim Interior Minister Boyko Rashkov.
english: The bodies of the passengers were badly burned, Interim Interior Minister Boyko Rashkov said.

text: Gina-imbestigaran subong kun human error ang natabo ukon technical malfunction.
english: It is currently being investigated whether it was a human error or a technical malfunction.

english: Also included are the Ilongo congressmen who signed the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte.

english: Based on a copy obtained by Bombo Radyo from the House of Representatives, all congressmen in Iloilo signed the impeachment.
