text: Ginakabig ni Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor nga dako nga dungog nga malakip sa 11 sa mga prosecutors sa impeachment trial batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor considers it a great honor to be among the 11 prosecutors in the impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga nalipay ini nga ginsaligan siya sang liderato sang kamara agud mangin isa sa mga prosecutors.
english: Defensor, he said he is happy that the leadership of the chamber trusted him to be one of the prosecutors.

text: Suno sa kongresista, isa man ini ka dako nga pagpanghangkat bangud nga dako ini nga responsibilidad nga mapakita ang mga ebidensya agud kumbinsihon ang Senado nga may bastante nga grounds agud i-impeach ang bise presidente.
english: The congressman said it is also a big challenge because it is a big responsibility to show evidence to convince the Senate that there are sufficient grounds to impeach the vice president.

text: Pahayag niya, may nabatyagan man siya nga pressure apang kabahin ini sang iya nga constitutional duties gani ginbaton niya ang amo nga katungdanan.
english: He said he also felt pressure but it was part of his constitutional duties so he accepted the position.

text: Matandaan nga nakatipon sang suporta sang supermajority ang kamara matapos nga 215 ka mga mamalidha ang nagpirma pabor sa pag-impeach kay Duterte.
english: It can be recalled that the chamber gathered the support of a supermajority after 215 lawmakers signed in favor of impeaching Duterte.

text: Ini ang masobra sa required nga 1/3 vote halin sa mga member sang House of Representatives.
english: This is more than the required 1/3 vote from members of the House of Representatives.

text: Matapos nga gin-endorso sa Senado ang impeachment complaint, ginatugyan na sang kamara sa upper chamber sang kongreso ang masunod nga tikang sa pag-convene bilang Impeachment Court.
english: After the Senate endorsed the impeachment complaint, the chamber is leaving the next step in convening the Impeachment Court to the upper chamber of Congress.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang impeachment ang kasunod sang tatlo ka complaints nga gin-file batok kay Duterte bangud sa ginaalegar nga misuse of confidential funds, graft and corruption, kag betrayal of public trust— nga lunsay grounds for impeachment sa idalom sang 1987 Constitution.
english: The impeachment follows three complaints filed against Duterte for alleged misuse of confidential funds, graft and corruption, and betrayal of public trust—all grounds for impeachment under the 1987 Constitution.

text: Dugang ni Defensor, ini nga ikaapat nga impeachment complaint sang kamara ang may yara lang sang pito ka Articles of Impeachment apang tuman ka klaro diri ang mga nahimo ni Duterte nga paglapas sa layi particular na ang pagpahog niya nga patyon ang president nga makabig nga high crime.
english: Defensor added that this fourth impeachment complaint of the chamber has only seven Articles of Impeachment but it is very clear that Duterte's violations of the law particularly his threat to kill the president which is considered a high crime.

text: ‘Pagpang-harass’ sa gihapon ang ginhimo sang Chinese Coast Guard sa supply boats sang Pilipinas sang naghimo ini sang resupply mission sa Ayungin Shoal sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The Chinese Coast Guard continued to 'harass' Philippine supply boats when it conducted a resupply mission in the Ayungin Shoal in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Suno kay Defense Secretary Delfin Lorenzana, ginakabig niya nga pamahog ang ginhimo sang Chinese Coast Guard bangud samtang naka-dock ang supply boats nga BRP Sierra Madre sa Ayungin Shoal, may isa ka rubber boat halin sa Chinese Coast Guard vessel nga may sakay nga tatlo ka tawo kag nagpalapit sa barko sang Pilipinas.
english: Defense Secretary Delfin Lorenzana said he considers the Chinese Coast Guard's actions a threat because while the supply boats BRP Sierra Madre were docked in Ayungin Shoal, a rubber boat from the Chinese Coast Guard vessel with three people on board approached the Philippine ship.

text: Ginapahayag ginkuhaan sang picture kag videos ang ginhimo sang Philippine Navy personnel nga unloading sa mga supplies kag pagkaon.
english: Philippine Navy personnel allegedly took pictures and videos of the unloading of supplies and food.

text: Bangud sini, nakig-angot si Lorenzana kay Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Huang Xilian bangud ginakabig nga acts of intimidation and harassment ang ginhimo sang China.
english: Lorenzana contacted Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Huang Xilian because China's actions are considered acts of intimidation and harassment.

text: Sa monitoring sang AFP Western Command, wala sang untoward incidents nga natabo samtang nagabiyahe ang duha ka resupply boats bangud wala man sila ginbalabagan sang Chinese Coast Guard indi kaangay sang natabo sang nagligad nga semana nga ginbombahan pa ini sang water cannon.
english: According to the monitoring of the AFP Western Command, no untoward incidents occurred while the two resupply boats were traveling because they were not blocked by the Chinese Coast Guard unlike what happened last week when they were bombed with water cannons.

text: Ginsirado ang tanan nga mga eskwelahan sa Delhi, India bangud sa nagalala nga air pollution.
english: All schools in Delhi, India were closed due to worsening air pollution.

text: Gin-ban man ang construction work tubtob sa Nobyembre 21.
english: Construction work has also been banned until November 21.

text: Lima lang sa 11 ka mga coal-based power plants sa syudad ang ginpahanugutan nga mag-operate.
english: Only five of the city’s 11 coal-based power plants have been allowed to operate.

text: Ang particulate matter (PM2.5) ukon tiny particles nga mahimo magsulod sa baga sang tawo ang mas mataas sa safety guidelines sang World Health Organization.
english: Particulate matter (PM2.5) or tiny particles that can enter the human lungs are higher than the safety guidelines of the World Health Organization.

text:
Pila ka bahin sang syudad ang naka-record sang air quality nga mas mataas sa 400 nga gina-categorise bilang “severe.”

Base sa air quality index, ang figure nga yara sa zero tubtob 50 ang makonsidera pa nga “good” kag 51 tubtob 100 naman ang “satisfactory.”

Ang Delhi amo ang world’s most polluted capital bangud sa industrial kag vehicular emissions, yab-ok kag weather patterns.
english:
Several parts of the city recorded air quality above 400 which is categorized as “severe.”

Based on the air quality index, a figure between zero and 50 is still considered “good” and 51 to 100 is “satisfactory.”

Delhi is the world’s most polluted capital due to industrial and vehicular emissions, dust and weather patterns.

text:
Jonathan Keith Flores

Sini nga hapon sang natigayon nga ma-impeach sang kamara si Duterte matapos sila nakatipon sang 215 ka pirma sang mga mamalidha nga pabor sa impeachment.
english:
Jonathan Keith Flores

This afternoon, the House of Representatives managed to impeach Duterte after they collected 215 signatures of lawmakers in favor of impeachment.

text: Ini ang masobra sa required nga 1/3 vote halin sa mga member sang House of Representatives.
english: This is more than the required 1/3 vote from members of the House of Representatives.

text: Sunod nga i-endorso sa Senado ang impeachment complaint.
english: The Senate will next endorse the impeachment complaint.

text: Sa oras nga mabaton nila ini, maga-convene ang mga senador bilang Impeachment Court.
english: Once they receive it, the senators will convene as the Impeachment Court.

text: Samtang, wala pa nagpagwa sang pahayag ang opisina ni VP Sara Duterte tubtob subong.
english: Meanwhile, VP Sara Duterte's office has not yet issued a statement.

text: Mas ginahugtan sang mga lider sa Europa ang mga pagsulundan para sa indi bakunado nga mga indibidwa matapos nga liwat naka-eksperyensya sang bag-o nga wave sang COVID-19 infections ang mga pungsod sa amo nga kontinente.
english: European leaders are tightening rules for unvaccinated individuals after countries on the continent again experienced a new wave of COVID-19 infections.

text: Sa Germany, ginaduso nga i-require ang pagpakita sang proof of vaccination ukon negative test bisan sa pagsakay lang sa bus ukon train.
english: In Germany, it is proposed to require the showing of proof of vaccination or negative test even just to board a bus or train.

text: Two-thirds lang sang mga Germans ang fully-vaccinated — isa sa pinakamanubo nga rates sa western Europe.
english: Only two-thirds of Germans are fully-vaccinated — one of the lowest rates in western Europe.

text:
Sa Austria, ginpwersa nga gin-lockdown ukon wala ginpahalin sa ila nga mga balay ang mga indi bakunado nga mga tawo, magluwas lang sa may tuman ka importante nga mga rason

Sa United Kingdom, ginpahayag naman ni British Prime Minister Boris Johnson nga i-require na ang booster shot agud matawag nga fully vaccinated ang mga tawo.##
english:
In Austria, unvaccinated people were forcibly locked down or not evicted from their homes, except for very important reasons

In the United Kingdom, British Prime Minister Boris Johnson said the booster shot will be required in order for people to be fully vaccinated.

text: Matapos makakuha sang 153 boto pabor sa impeachment, opisyal na nga na-impeach sang House of Representatives si Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: After receiving 153 votes in favor of impeachment, the House of Representatives officially impeached Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Naglapaw ini sa ginakinahanglan nga one-third sang kabilugan nga boto agud diretso nga i-refer ang reklamo sa Senado, nga magaserbe nga impeachment court.
english: It exceeded the required one-third of the overall vote to refer the complaint directly to the Senate, which will serve as the impeachment court.

text: Samtang, ginmanduan  na sang Senate Secretary General ang Senate Public Relations and Information Bureau  nga preparahan  ang posible nga transmittal sang impeachment complaint batok  sa bise presidente subong nga alas-7 sang gab-i.
english: Meanwhile, the Senate Secretary General has directed the Senate Public Relations and Information Bureau to prepare the possible transmittal of the impeachment complaint against the vice president by 7 pm today.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Indi pabor ang Committee on Public Order and Security sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sa pagpatuman sang signal jamming sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The Committee on Public Order and Security of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan is not in favor of implementing signal jamming at the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Ini kasunod sang request sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga magpatigayon sang signal jamming kadungan sang nasambit nga festival.
english: This follows the request of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) to conduct signal jamming during the festival.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar, chairman sang nasambit nga komitiba, iya ginpahayag nga nagakadapat pa nga tun-an kag athagon sang maayo kun signal jamming ukon signal shutdown ang matabo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar, chairman of the said committee, said it is still necessary to study and clarify whether signal jamming or signal shutdown will occur.

text: Suno kay Mondejar, indi na sini luyag pa nga maeksperyensyahan liwat sang mga pumuluyo ang huol nga natuga sang signal jamming sa Dinagyang Festival 2023 sa diin indi lang ang Iloilo City nadulaan sang signal kundi mangin sa mga banwa sa Iloilo Province kaangay sang ang Pavia, Oton, Leganes, Santa Barbara, kag mangin ang probinsya sang Guimaras.
english: Mondejar said he does not want the residents to experience the inconvenience caused by signal jamming during the Dinagyang Festival 2023 where not only Iloilo City lost signal but also the towns in Iloilo Province such as Pavia, Oton, Leganes, Santa Barbara, and Guimaras province.

text: Pahayag niya, ang natabo sang tuig 2023 nga nagakadapat kuntani signal jamming lang ang nangin signal shutdown sa diin nagtuga ini sang problema sa mga nagatrabaho nga nagakinahanglan sang mobile internet connection.
english: He said that what happened in 2023 that should have been signal jamming only became a signal shutdown which caused problems for workers who need mobile internet connection.

text: Nagapangabay ang natungdan nga antes madesisyonan nga i-approve ang request, pasiguruhon anay nga ang maapektuhan lang sang signal jamming amo lang ang mga lugar nga may aktibidad may kaangtanan sa Dinagyang Festival.
english: He requested that before deciding to approve the request, it should be ensured that only the areas that have activities related to the Dinagyang Festival will be affected by the signal jamming.

text: Age does not matter, ilabi na gid kun para ini sa imo nga handum.
english: Age doesn't matter, especially if it's for your dream.

text: Yari ang isa ka feel-good story tuhoy sa isa ka lalaki sa Rhode Island sa Estados Unidos nga nakaangkon sang doctorate sa physics sa edad nga 89 anyos.
english: Here is a feel-good story about a man in Rhode Island in the United States who earned a doctorate in physics at the age of 89 years.

text: Ang lolo amo si Manfred Steiner nga may yara na nga daan sang medical degree kag doctorate sa biochemistry.
english: The grandfather was Manfred Steiner who already had a medical degree and a doctorate in biochemistry.

text: Suno kay Steiner, nahaylo siya sa physics sa edad nga 70 sang nag-retire na siya sa iya trabaho bilang hematologist sa Brown University.
english: Steiner said he was drawn to physics at age 70 when he retired from his job as a hematologist at Brown University.

text: Old dream na ang physics para kay Steiner bangud bata pa lang siya, luyag na niya mangin physicist.
english: Physics was an old dream for Steiner because he wanted to be a physicist when he was young.

text: Antes makuha ni Lolo ang amo nga degree, nagpaninguha gid siya nga makasulod sa iya duha ka klase kada semana tubtub nga na-defend niya ang iya thesis nga “Corrections to the Geometrical Interpretation of Bosonization.”
english: Before Lolo got that degree, he worked hard to get into his two classes a week until he defended his thesis “Corrections to the Geometrical Interpretation of Bosonization.”

text: Nagtimbuok sa bag-o nga record high ang utang sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sa katapusan sang 2024 bangud sa pagluya sang ekonomiya, base sa data sang Bureau of the Treasury.
english: The Philippine government's debt will reach a new record high by the end of 2024 due to the economic slowdown, according to data from the Bureau of the Treasury.

text: Ang nabilin nga utang sang national government ang yara sa P16.5 trillion, nagtaas sang 9.8% ukon P1.44 trillion, halin sa P14.62 trillion sang katapusan sang tuig 2023.
english: The national government's outstanding debt stood at P16.5 trillion, up 9.8% or P1.44 trillion, from P14.62 trillion at the end of 2023.

text: Ginpahayag sang Treasury nga ang bulanan nga pagtaas sa stock sang utang sang gobyerno ang nagapaidalom sa net issuance kag availment sang domestic kag external debt.
english: The Treasury said the monthly increase in the government debt stock underlies the net issuance and availment of domestic and external debt.

text: Amo man ang revaluation effect sang peso depreciation batok sa US dollar.
english: So is the revaluation effect of peso depreciation against the US dollar.

text: Ang domestic debt sang pungsod ang naglab-ot sa P10.93 trillion, nagtaas sang 9.1% halin sa P912.49 billion sang nakaligad nga tuig sang mag-isyu ang gobyerno sang mga debt securities agud padakuon ang kaban sini.
english: The country's domestic debt stood at P10.93 trillion, up 9.1% from P912.49 billion last year when the government issued debt securities to boost its coffers.

text: Ang debt-to-GDP ratio ang yara man sa 60.7 percent, nga mas mataas sa 60.6 percent target.
english: The debt-to-GDP ratio is also at 60.7 percent, well above the 60.6 percent target.

text: Ang GDP growth ang naghinay sa 5.6 percent sang 2024, bangud sa serye sang mga bagyo sa third kag fourth quarters nga naghalit gid sa ekonomiya.
english: GDP growth has slowed to 5.6 percent in 2024, due to a series of storms in the third and fourth quarters that have severely damaged the economy.

text: Nahibaluan nga target sang pungsod ang growth rate nga indi magnubo sa 6 percent sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The country targets a growth rate of at least 6 percent last year.

text: Suno sa mga economic managers, ang nagataas nga utang ang indi dapat pagkabalak-an sa kondisyon nga padayon ang madasig nga pagsanyog sang ekonomiya.
english: According to economic managers, the rising debt should not be a concern provided the economy continues to grow rapidly.

text: Gin-file na sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) kag Philippine National Police (PNP) ang mga kaso nga murder kag attempted murder batok sa mga nagpatay kay former Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) Director kag anay Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) Board Secretary Atty. Wesley Barayuga sang 2020.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and the Philippine National Police (PNP) have filed cases of murder and attempted murder against the killers of former Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) Director and former Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) Board Secretary Atty. Wesley Barayuga in 2020.

text: Lakip sa mga ginpasakaan sang kaso amo sanday former PCSO general manager Royina Garma, former National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) Commissioner Edilberto Leonardo, Lt.
english: Among those charged were former PCSO general manager Royina Garma, former National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) Commissioner Edilberto Leonardo, Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Santie Mendoza, Police Senior Master Sergeant Jeremy Causapin, ang ginpahalin sa pagkapulis nga si Nelson Mariano, isa ka alyas `Loloy’, kag isa pa ka wala nakilala nga suspek.
english: Santie Mendoza, Police Senior Master Sergeant Jeremy Causapin, the dismissed Nelson Mariano, an alias `Loloy', and another unidentified suspect.

text: Matandaan nga liwat nga ginbuksan ang kaso matapos nabulgar sa testimoniya ni Mendoza sa imbestigasyon sang House Quad Committee ang pag-ambush sang Hulyo 30, 2020 nga nagresulta sa kamatayon ni Barayuga sa Mandaluyong City.
english: The case was reopened after Mendoza's testimony in the House Quad Committee's investigation revealed the July 30, 2020 ambush that resulted in Barayuga's death in Mandaluyong City.

text: Diri kag ginpangalanan ni Mendoza sanday Garma kag Leonardo na utok sa pag-ambush kay Barayuga.
english: Mendoza named Garma and Leonardo as the masterminds of the ambush on Barayuga.

text: Ginrekomenda man ang NBI kag CIDG nga himuon nga state witnesses sanday Mendoza kag Mariano bangud sa ila pag-ako.
english: The NBI and CIDG also recommended that Mendoza and Mariano be made state witnesses for their confessions.

text: Ginatugyan naman sang mga ahenya sa Deparment of Justice (DOJ) ang masunod nga mga tikang kaangot sa kaso ni Barayuga.
english: The agencies are leaving the next steps in Barayuga's case to the Department of Justice (DOJ).

text: Ginbawi na sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang ginpatuman sini anay nga ban sa poultry products nga halin sa Brazil.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has lifted its earlier ban on poultry products from Brazil.

text: Ini nga South American country ang isa sa pinakadako nga poultry exporters sa bilog nga kalibutan kun sa diin nagapangatlo ini sa global chicken trade.
english: The South American country is one of the largest poultry exporters in the world, ranking third in the global chicken trade.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., nag-isyu siya sang Memorandum Order No.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. said he issued Memorandum Order No.

text: 35 nga amo ang nagatapos na sang importation ban sa poultry halin sa amo nga pungsod.
english: 35 which ends the importation ban on poultry from the country.

text: Matandaan nga ginpatuman ang ban sang Mayo 19 bangud sa outbreak sang avian influenza.
english: The ban was implemented on May 19 due to the outbreak of avian influenza.

text: Gin-cover sang ban ang poultry meat, piso, itlog, kag semen.
english: The ban covered poultry meat, chicks, eggs, and semen.

text: Ginpaguwa naman ang bag-o nga memorandum sa Pilipinas matapos nag-report na ang Brazilian veterinary authorities sa World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) nga natapna na nila ang outbreak.
english: The new memorandum was issued in the Philippines after Brazilian veterinary authorities reported to the World Organization for Animal Health (WOAH) that they had contained the outbreak.

text: Paagi sa pagbalik sang imports halin sa Brazil, ginpahayag sang DA secretary nga natuman nila ang sugo ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: By returning imports from Brazil, the DA secretary said they have fulfilled the order of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga dapat lain-lain ang sources sang gina-import nga agricultural products.
english: that the sources of imported agricultural products should be different.

text: Mahimo nga isa ka man sa naluoy sa naabtan sang isa ka bride sa Amlan, Negros Oriental nga wala gid nahatagan sang “moment” sa iya kaugalingon nga kasal bangud sa ginpahayag pagsinuplado sang pari nga nag-officiate sa amo nga seremonya.
english: You may be one of those who feel sorry for a bride in Amlan, Negros Oriental who was never given a moment at her own wedding because of the alleged stubbornness of the priest who officiated the ceremony.

text: Madamo gid ang nadismaya sang nalantaw ang video nga samtang nagamartsa pa lang ang bride padulong sa altar, nagsugod na sa misa ang pari rason nga nagadali-dali man ang bride sa paglakat bisan mabudlay para sa iya bangud sa trahe.
english: Many were disappointed when they saw the video that while the bride was marching towards the altar, the priest started the mass so the bride hurried to walk even though it was difficult for her because of the dress.

text: Ang ginkasal amo sanday Janine Sagario kag Jove Sagario.
english: The couple were Janine Sagario and Jove Sagario.

text: Una na nagpaathag ang bride nga naka-schedule ang ila kasal sang Hunyo 8, las-otso sa aga, apang sang Hunyo 7 sang gab-i, ginpahibalo sila sang isa sa ila sponsors nga gin-reschedule sang simbahan ang ila kasal kag sa baylo nga 8:00 am, ginhimo ini nga 9:30 am.
english: Earlier, the bride explained that their wedding was scheduled for June 8, 8 am, but on June 7 night, they were informed by one of their sponsors that the church had rescheduled their wedding and instead of 8:00 am, it was made to 9:30 am.

text: Sang nag-abot sila sang 9:00 pagka-aga, ginpahayag nga nangakig ang mga staff sang simbahan kag ginhambal nga late sila sa schedule nga 8:00.
english: When they arrived at 9:00 the next morning, the church staff reportedly became angry and said they were late for the 8:00 schedule.

text: Sang tion nga ginakuhaan sila sang laragway, pareho nga nagahibi ang bride kag groom sa ila inagyan.
english: By the time their pictures were taken, both the bride and groom were in tears at the experience.

text: Madamo pa gid ang nadismaya bangud nga sang nagtapos ang kasal, gilayon nga ginmandu sang pari nga pasudlon ang lungon bangud misa sa patay ang yara sa schedule.
english: Many were disappointed because when the wedding ended, the priest immediately ordered the coffin to be brought in because the funeral mass was on the schedule.

text: Nalantaw man sang wedding suppliers sa Negros Oriental ang natabo kag bangud naluoy sa bride kag groom, nag-initiate ang wedding violinist nga si John Lester Barot nga magpatigayon sang wedding remake.
english: Wedding suppliers in Negros Oriental also watched the incident and felt sorry for the bride and groom, initiated wedding violinist John Lester Barot to conduct a wedding remake.

text: Natalana ang part 2 sang kasal sa Hunyo 17.
english: Part 2 of the wedding is scheduled for June 17.

text: Sa subong, may yara na sang sponsors para sa host, coffee, bridal car, ice cream, photography, bridal gown, kag iban pa.
english: So far, sponsors are available for host, coffee, bridal car, ice cream, photography, bridal gown, and more.

text: Nagapangita pa sila sang dugang nga sponsors para sa pagkaon kag iban pa para sa magkahagugma.
english: They are still looking for more sponsors for food and other items for the couple.

text: Nag-isyu naman sang statement ang pari nga assigned sa St.
english: The priest assigned to St.

text: Andrew the Apostle Parish kag nagpangayo sang pasensya sa natabo sa kasal.
english: Andrew the Apostle Parish and apologized for what happened at the wedding.

text: “We humbly admit the fact that along the way, there were statements made carried away by emotions.
english: “We humbly admit the fact that along the way, there were statements made carried away by emotions.

text: Hence, we express our sincere apology to the bride and the groom, to their respective families who were directly offended by the turn of these events, and to the people who have seen our humanity as Priests in a time when we were weakest of any possible control,” suno kay Monsignor Albert Erasmo Bohol.
english: Hence, we express our sincere apology to the bride and the groom, to their respective families who were directly offended by the turn of these events, and to the people who have seen our humanity as Priests in a time when we were weakest of any possible control,” according to Monsignor Albert Erasmo Bohol.

text: “We also ask for your kind indulgence for the times we were short in meeting that call.
english: “We also ask for your kind indulgence for the times we were short in meeting that call.

text: In the midst of this unfortunate event, please pray for us as we struggle with our frailties.
english: In the midst of this unfortunate event, please pray for us as we struggle with our frailties.

text: We pray for the peace of everyone concerned in this event,” dugang sini.
english: We pray for the peace of everyone concerned in this event,” it added.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, ang wedding sponsor nga nag-pahibalo sa bride kag groom nga ginlain ang schedule amo gali ang nagsala sa pagpasa sang impormasyon.
english: Based on the investigation, the wedding sponsor who informed the bride and groom that the schedule was changed was the one who made the mistake in passing on the information.

text: Suno sa simbahan, wala sang nag-instruct halin sa parokya nga lainon ang schedule bangud may nakatalana kuntani nga Funeral Mass sa 9:30 a.m. sang amo nga adlaw.
english: According to the church, no one from the parish instructed to change the schedule because there was supposed to be a funeral mass at 9:30 a.m. that day.

text: “She relayed this information in an unofficial capacity.
english: “She relayed this information in an unofficial capacity.

text: This is unfortunate since there was no instruction at all from anyone in the Parish Office that there are changes in the schedule since there was a scheduled Funeral Mass at 9:30 a.m. of that same morning,” dugang ni Bohol.
english: This is unfortunate since there was no instruction at all from anyone in the Parish Office that there are changes in the schedule since there was a scheduled Funeral Mass at 9:30 a.m. of that same morning,” Bohol added.

text: Ginsiling man nga may adjustments nga ginhimo sang nakit-an nga yara na ang bride sa puertahan kag ginpaathag naman sa pamilya sang napatay nga may delay sa misa bangud unahon anay ang kasal.
english: It was also said that adjustments were made when the bride was found at the door and the family of the deceased was explained that there was a delay in the mass because the wedding was to be held first.

text: SALAMAT kay ginpasugtan man ni Presidente Duterte nga matagaan ligwa ang Demokrasya sa pagpabakuna sang mga pumuluyo.
english: THANK YOU for allowing President Duterte to allow Democracy to be given the opportunity to vaccinate the people.

text: Ang balita lokal sadtong Martes, Enero 19, nagasiling nga ginapasugtan na ni Presidente nga makapili ang mga indibidwal nga mga pumuluyo kon ano nga vaccine ang kuhaon nila nga may pagsalig sila, nga pwede ma-provide sang mga ospital halin sa ila mga source basta may approval sang Food and Drug Administrasyon (FDA).
english: Local news on Tuesday, January 19, said the President is now allowing individual citizens to choose which vaccine they will take with confidence, which hospitals can provide from their sources as long as they have the approval of the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

text: Tungod baklon man ini sang mga ospital, natural lang nga baklon man ini sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Since hospitals will buy it, it is natural that the people will buy it.

text: Libre naman ang vaccine nga ma-provide sang gobyerno.
english: The vaccine provided by the government is free.

text: Thanks Mr. President.
english: Thanks Mr. President.

text: Indi ka man gali authoritarian gid – Kaluy-an ang kalag nanday Hitler, Mussoini, etc.!
english: You're not really an authoritarian – have mercy on the souls of Hitler, Mussoini, etc.!

text:
– sa kon ano ang luyag sang pumuluyo sa ila democratic right  “…to life, liberty and pursuit of happiness.”

Bati naton nga medyo maluya ang paghiwat sang pyesta sang Tubungan, Iloilo sadtong Domingo, Enero 17.
english:
– on what the people want in their democratic right “…to life, liberty and pursuit of happiness.”

***

We hear that the celebration of the Tubungan, Iloilo fiesta on Sunday, January 17 was a bit weak.

text: Ang patron saint dira amo si San Antonio de Abbot.
english: The patron saint here is St. Anthony of Abbot.

text: Wala natabo diri ang kinaandan nga pagsinadya kag pag-inabot sang mga bisita agud mamonson kag magbayluhanay sang kahidlaw sang mga himata kag mga abyan.
english: The usual celebration and arrival of guests to bathe and exchange nostalgia with relatives and friends did not take place here.

text: Well, ina kay indi pa tugot ang pagtinipon-tipon sang madamo nga tawo tungod sa ginapatuman pa nga physical distancing kag iban pa nga health measures agud matambagan ang pamintas sang COVID-19.
english: Well, that's because mass gatherings are not allowed due to the ongoing physical distancing and other health measures to address the spread of COVID-19.

text: In other words, pinamilya lang anay ang pagsaulog sang pyesta paagi sa gamay lang nga handa kag pagtipon sang pamilya para sa pagpadungog kag ang pagpangayo sing bugay kay San Antonio de Abbot kag sa Diyos.
english: In other words, the feast was celebrated as a family with a small preparation and family gathering to honor and ask for blessings from St. Anthony of Abbot and God.

text: On the other hand, may maayo man seguro nga nadulot ini tungod makapahuway ang mga pumuluyo sa dalagku nga galastuhanan sa ina nga okasyon sa pag-abebar sa mga bisita kag nagaduaw nga mga himata.
english: On the other hand, it must have brought something good because the residents could rest from the big expenses on that occasion to welcome visitors and visiting relatives.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text:
***

Daku nga bugal sang mga IIonggo ang madamo nila nga “Filipino firsts”.
english:
***

The Chinese are very proud of their many “Filipino firsts”.

text: Una na dira si Gat Graciano Lopez Jaena nga nagpanguna sang Reform Movement batok sa abusado nga gobyerno sang Espanya sa Filipinas upod sanday Dr. Jose Rizal kag Marcelo del Pilar.
english: Earlier, Gat Graciano Lopez Jaena led the Reform Movement against the abusive Spanish government in the Philippines with Dr. Jose Rizal and Marcelo del Pilar.

text: Diri sa Western Visayas  madamo pa ang aton “Filipino firsts” among the professionals, awardees sa nagkalain-lain nga padungog, pagkilala sa ila outstanding nga ihibalo kag pagtukib sa edukasyon, siyensya kag teknolohiya, mga outstanding athletes here and abroad, kag ang First International Chess Master sang Asia nga si Eugene Torre.
english: Here in Western Visayas, we have many more “Filipino firsts” among the professionals, awardees in various honors, recognition for their outstanding knowledge and discovery in education, science and technology, outstanding athletes here and abroad, and the First International Chess Master of Asia Eugene Torre.

text: Ini nga ihibalo nakuha naton sa libro parte sa brief history sang mga Ilonggo, courtesy sang aton abyan nga si Marite Luzurriaga.
english: This knowledge we got from the book about the brief history of the Ilonggos, courtesy of our friend Marite Luzurriaga.

text: Sorry, indi ko na lubos maathagan ang titulo sang libro tungod nalakip ini sa ginhalitan sang Bagyo Frank sa amon lugar sa Mandurriao sadtong pila tuig nga nagligad.
english: Sorry, I can't quite explain the title of the book because it was included in the damage caused by Typhoon Frank in our area in Mandurriao a few years ago.

text: Madamo gani sang pinanid sini ang indi ko na mabasahan samtang ginatuki-tuki ko kon kinahanglan.
english: I couldn't even read many of the pages as I scanned them when I needed to.

text: Luas sa sining mga “Filipino Firsts” halin sa Western Visayas, nga matawag man nga Ilonggo Country, may isahanon nga bagay diri, samtang indi man kilala gid diri sa pungsod, nga natagaan sing daku nga importansya sa kalibutan.
english: Apart from these “Filipino Firsts” from Western Visayas, also known as Ilonggo Country, there is something unique here, while not well known here in the country, that has been given great importance in the world.

text: Ini amo ang isahanon nga dungog sang Philippine dialect nga Ilonggo nga malakip sa 62 ka lenggwahe nga napagkit (inscribe) sa dingding nga bato nga nagalikop sang kaluastro (cloister) sang Pater Noster Church sa Jerusalem.
english: This is the only honor of the Philippine dialect of Ilonggo to be included in the 62 languages ​​inscribed on the stone wall surrounding the cloister of the Pater Noster Church in Jerusalem.

text: Sa duog nga ini gintudluan ni Jesukristo ang mga pumuluyo sang palangadion nga “Amay Namon” (Our Father).
english: In this place Jesus Christ taught the people the prayer “Our Father”.

text: Tungod sini nasapawan sini sa pagpadungog ang mga panguna nga mga dialect sa pungsod nga Tagalog, Cebuano kag Pampagueño nga wala nalakip diri, kundi ang Ilonggo lang.
english: Because of this, it overshadows the main dialects of the country, Tagalog, Cebuano and Pampagueño, which are not included here, but only Ilonggo.

text: Ginlakip gid gani ini ni Atty. Rex Salvilla+ sa iya Interesting facts About West Visayas sa Book 8, pahina 48.
english: It was even included by Atty. Rex Salvilla+ in his Interesting facts About West Visayas in Book 8, page 48.

text: Gintagaan man ini sing pagtalupangod ni Francis Unson sa iya Facebook article.
english: Francis Unson also noted this in his Facebook article.

text: Ginlaragway pa ining inscription sa Facebook sang traveller kag photographer nga si  Quing Obillos.
english: The inscription was described on Facebook by traveler and photographer Quing Obillos.

text: Ining “Amay Namon” (Our Father) nga palangadion nabalhag (unedited) sing masunod:  “ILONGO .
english: This “Our Father” prayer is published (unedited) as follows: “ILONGO .

text: Amay namon nga yara ka sa mga langit, pagdayawon ang imo ngalan, umabut sa amon ang imo ginharian, matuman ang imo buut diri sa duta siling sang sa langit.
english: Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

text: Panhatagan mo kami nian sang kan-on namon sa matag-adlaw, kag patawaron ang mga utang namon siling nga ginapatawad namon ang mga nakautang sa amon, kag dili mo kami ipadaug sa mga panulay, hinonoo luason mo kami sa kalaut.
english: Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.

text: Amen.”/PN
english: Amen.”/PN

text: Suportado sang Malacañang ang panawagan sang pila ka mga mamalidha kag mga grupo nga magpatigayon anay ang Department of Education (DepEd) sang masangkad nga konsultasyon kaangot sa ginaduso nga pag-shift sa trimestral system umpisa sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Malacañang supports the call of some lawmakers and groups that the Department of Education (DepEd) conduct a thorough consultation on the proposed shift to the trimestral system starting next year.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro, importante nga madiskusyunan anay ini sang stakeholders kag tanan nga mga partido agud nga mangin maayo man ang implementasyon sang programa para sa mga estudyante.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro, it is important to discuss the matter with stakeholders and all parties so that the implementation of the program for the students will be smooth.

text: Sa matandaan, sang nagligad nga semana, ginpresentar ni Education Secretary Sonny Angara ang amo nga proposal agud nga himuon na lamang nga tatlo ang subong apat ka grading period sa kada school year.
english: Last week, Education Secretary Sonny Angara presented the proposal to reduce the number of grading periods to three in each school year.

text: Ginakonsiderar suno sa DepEd ang implementasyon sang trimester system sa School Year 2026–2027 sa mga pampubliko nga mga eskwelahan.
english: The DepEd is considering the implementation of the trimester system in School Year 2026-2027 in public schools.

text: Ini ang ginalantaw sang ahensya nga “holistic approach” agud nga mapaayo ang learning continuity kag mabuhinan ang administrative workload sang mga manunudlo.
english: The agency sees this as a “holistic approach” to improve learning continuity and reduce the administrative workload of teachers.

text: Sandig kay Angara, magabukas ang klase sa Hunyo, kag ang una nga trimester maga-umpisa sa Hunyo-Septyembre; sundan sang second-trimester halin sa Septyembre-Disyembre; kag sundan sang third trimester halin Enero-Marso.
english: According to Angara, classes will open in June, and the first trimester will run from June-September; followed by the second-trimester from September-December; followed by the third trimester from January-March.

text: Una naman nga nagpanawagan si Senator Bam Aquino, chairperson sang Senate committee on basic education, nga magpatigayon anay sang inquiry sa amo nga proposal sa baylo nga dali-dalion ang implementasyon.
english: Earlier, Senator Bam Aquino, chairperson of the Senate committee on basic education, called for an inquiry into the proposal instead of rushing its implementation.

text: Nagpabutyag naman sang pagpangduha-duha ang Alliance of Concerned Teachers – Philippines sa proposal bangud indi man ini makasolbar suno sa ila sa krisis sa edukasyon sa Pilipinas.
english: The Alliance of Concerned Teachers-Philippines expressed doubts about the proposal because it does not solve the education crisis in the Philippines.

text: Nagsaka na sa 91 ka mga indibidwal ang napatay samtang 11 pa ang missing kasunod sang mga pagbaha kag landslide dala sang wala untat nga pag-ulan sa central Vietnam.
english: At least 91 people have been killed and 11 are still missing following floods and landslides caused by heavy rains in central Vietnam.

text: Suno sa report sang state media VTV, masobra 235,000 na ka mga balay ang ginbaha, samtang halos 80,000 ka ektarya sang mga pananom ang nagguba sa paglaslas sang mga bagyo nga Kalmaegi kag Bualoi.
english: According to a report by state media VTV, more than 235,000 houses have been flooded, while nearly 80,000 hectares of crops have been destroyed by cyclones Kalmaegi and Bualoi.

text: Patay ang 26 ka mga bata edad 5-6 anyos matapos nasunog ang ila eskwelahan nga human lamang sa kahoy sa southern Niger, West Africa.
english: Twenty-six children aged 5-6 were killed after their wooden school caught fire in southern Niger, West Africa.

text: Magluwas sa mga napatay, pilason man ang 14 ka iban pa nga mga bata samtang lima diri ang yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon.
english: Besides the dead, 14 other children were also injured while five of them are in critical condition.

text: Indi pa matumod sang regional director for education kun ano ang ginhalinan sang sunog.
english: The regional director for education is yet to determine the cause of the fire.

text: Suspendido ang klase kag gindeklarar ang tatlo ka adlaw nga paglalaw sa rehiyon sang Maradi kun sa diin nahamtang ang eskwelahan.
english: Classes were suspended and a three-day lockdown was declared in the Maradi region where the school is located.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tion subong nga tuig nga ginpatay sang sunog ang mga kabataan samtang yara sa ila classrooms.
english: This is the second time this year that fire has killed children while they were in their classrooms.

text: Sang Abril, patay man ang 20 ka mga preschool children sa Niamey sa amo nga pungsod.
english: In April, 20 preschool children were also killed in Niamey in the same country.

text: Ang Niger ang isa sa pinakapigado nga pungsod sa kalibutan kag ang ila nga mga classrooms human lamang sa uhot kag kahoy, kag kun kaisa, ginapapungko lang ang mga bata sa duta.
english: Niger is one of the poorest countries in the world and their classrooms are made of straw and wood, and sometimes, children are made to sit on the ground.

text: Nagsaka pa sa 115 ang mga napatay sa fuel tanker explosion sa Sierra Leone sa Africa.
english: The death toll from a fuel tanker explosion in Sierra Leone in Africa has risen to 115.

text: 99 ka tawo ang una nga nga narekord sang health ministry sa paglupok sang tanker kasunod sang collision nga natabo sa Freetown.
english: 99 people were initially recorded by the health ministry in the tanker explosion following the collision in Freetown.

text: Naglab-ot naman sa ginatos ka mga biktima ang pilason nga nangin pagpanghangkat sa health service sang Freetown nga nag-antos sang nagliligad nga mga tuig bangud sa underfunding kag pagnubo sang medical staff sang 2015-2016 tuga sang Ebola epidemic.
english: Hundreds of victims were injured, which has been a challenge for Freetown's health service, which has suffered in recent years due to underfunding and a reduction in medical staff in 2015-2016 due to the Ebola epidemic.

text: Ang mga myembro sang pamilya nga nasunog ang negosyo kag balay ang nagtulog na lang sa guwa.
english: Family members whose businesses and houses were burned down slept outside.

text: Suno kay Mohamed Lamin Mansaray, tag-iya sang isa ka shop, humalin sang natabo ang insidente, wala pa sila sa gihapon nakabaton sang bulig kaangay sang lugar nga matiniran kag pagkaon.
english: According to Mohamed Lamin Mansaray, owner of a shop, since the incident, they have not received assistance such as shelter and food.

text: Natumod sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) nga ang isa sa anom ka mga suspek sa pagpang-hold up sa Pilar, Capiz ang isa ka pulis.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) identified one of the six suspects in the hold up in Pilar, Capiz as a policeman.

text: Ini amo si Police Officer 1 Lyman John Ochenta, residente sang Pavia, Iloilo.
english: This is Police Officer 1 Lyman John Ochenta, resident of Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa anum sa mga suspek, duha diri ang nadakpan nga amo sanday John Francis Morines Daquilaña kag Jemary Daquelaña lunsay residente sang Barangay Gibato, Dumarao, Capiz.
english: Of the six suspects, two were arrested, namely John Francis Morines Daquilaña and Jemary Daquelaña both residents of Barangay Gibato, Dumarao, Capiz.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga na-dismissed sa serbisyo si Ochenta sang 2017.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said Ochenta was dismissed from service in 2017.

text: Suno kay Araño, may sampaw-sampaw nga kaso nga ginapangatubang ang suspek lakip na diri ang Qualified Piracy bangud sa ginhimo sini sa Carles, Iloilo.
english: According to Araño, the suspect is facing multiple charges including Qualified Piracy for his actions in Carles, Iloilo.

text: Lakip man ang anay pulis sa robbery incident sa Sara, Iloilo kon sa diin gintudlo ang suspek sa pag-hold up sa supervisor sang J&T Express kag pagtaban sang masobra P1 million.
english: The former policeman was also involved in a robbery incident in Sara, Iloilo where the suspect was arrested for holding up a supervisor of J&T Express and stealing more than P1 million.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang natungdan nga nakaupod man si Ochenta pagpanghold-up sa isa ka soft drinks company sa Pilar, Capiz, kon sa diin ginabanta malapit P5 milyones ang ila nataban.
english: He also revealed that Ochenta was also involved in the hold-up of a soft drinks company in Pilar, Capiz, where they stole an estimated P5 million.

text: Sa subong indi pa matumod ni Araño ang rason sang pagka-dismissed ni Ochenta sa serbisyo apang suno sa iya, nakasuhan ini sang grave misconduct bangud sa iya performance sa duty.
english: Araño said he could not identify the reason for Ochenta's dismissal from service but he said he was charged with grave misconduct for his performance on duty.

text: Nagsaka ang tensyon sa pungsod Iraq matapos gintuyo nga patyon si Prime Minister Mustafa Al-Kadhimi.
english: Tensions rose in Iraq after an assassination attempt on Prime Minister Mustafa Al-Kadhimi.

text: Gin-target sang missile kag drone attacks ang mismo balay sang prime minister sa Baghdad, apang nakaluwas ini kag yara subong sa maayo nga kondisyon.
english: Missile and drone attacks targeted the prime minister's own home in Baghdad, but he survived and is now in good condition.

text: Pito sa iya nga mga security guards ang reported nga napilasan sa amo nga assassination attempt.
english: Seven of his security guards were reportedly injured in the assassination attempt.

text: Ginkondenar naman sang US State Department ang ginpahayag akto sang terorismo.
english: The US State Department condemned the alleged act of terrorism.

text: Wala pa sang nag-ako kun sin-o ang may kahimuan sa amo nga pagpang-atake.
english: No one has claimed responsibility for the attack.

text: Nahibaluan nga duha ka adlaw antes ang insidente, may yara man sang natabo nga masingki nga engkwentro sa Baghdad sa tunga sang pwersa sang gobyerno kag sang supporters sang political parties nga suportado sang Iran.
english: Two days before the incident, there were also violent clashes in Baghdad between government forces and supporters of Iranian-backed political parties.

text: Kalabanan sa amo nga grupo ang may yara sang armed wings, kag napierde kag nawad-an sang pwesto sa parliament matapos ang general election sang Oktubre 10.
english: Most of that group had armed wings, and lost and lost parliamentary seats after the general election on October 10.

text: Si Prime Minister Al-Kadhimi ang naka-serbe man anay bilang intelligence chief.
english: Prime Minister Al-Kadhimi also previously served as intelligence chief.

text: Ginakonsiderar siya sang Iran-backed militias bilang suod sa Estados Unidos.
english: Iran-backed militias consider him close to the United States.

text: Gindeklarar na ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. has declared that

text: ang food security emergency agud nga masolusyunan ang padayon kag indi kinaandan nga pagsaka sa presyo sang bugas sa mga merkado.
english: the food security emergency to address the continuous and unusual rise in rice prices in the markets.

text: Sa idalom sang Department Circular No.
english: Under Department Circular No.

text: 03, ginatugutan na ang pag-release sang stocks nga yara sa National Food Authority (NFA) agud nga ma-stabilize ang presyo kag masiguro nga masarangan kag accessible para sa mga Pinoy ang bugas.
english: 03, allows the release of stocks held by the National Food Authority (NFA) in order to stabilize prices and ensure that rice is affordable and accessible to Filipinos.

text: Base pa sa issuance sang ahensya, magapabilin ang food security emergency magluwas lamang kun i-withdraw na ukon bawion na ini sang secretary.
english: Based on the agency's issuance, the food security emergency will remain in place unless it is withdrawn or withdrawn by the secretary.

text: Iga-subject man ini sa pagrepaso sa kada apat ka bulan.
english: It will also be subject to review on a quarterly basis.

text: Ginhimo sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang deklarasyon bangud naga-sige sa gihapon sa pagsaka ang presyo bisan pa nga may pagnubo na sa global prices kag bisan pa nga ginbuhinan na ang taripa sa imported nga bugas sang Hulyo 2024.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) made the declaration as prices continue to rise despite the decline in global prices and despite the reduction of tariffs on imported rice in July 2024.

text: Halin sa 35 percent, ginpanubo sa 15 percent ang tariff rates sa bugas sang amo nga bulan.
english: From 35 percent, the tariff rates on rice were reduced to 15 percent that month.

text: Ginbasehan man sang National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) ang data sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) kun sa diin naglab-ot ang rice inflation sa 17.9 percent sang September 2023.
english: The National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) also based on data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) where rice inflation reached 17.9 percent in September 2023.

text: Lapaw ini sa upper band sang target sang gobyerno nga 4 percent para sa food inflation.#
english: This is above the upper band of the government's target of 4 percent for food inflation.

text: Masobra 10 na ka tuig sang nagsugod nga indi na makalakat ang bed-ridden nga senior citizen nga nalakip sa sunog sa Barangay Rizal Lapuz, Sur, Iloilo City.
english: It has been more than 10 years since the bed-ridden senior citizen who was involved in the fire in Barangay Rizal Lapuz, Sur, Iloilo City began to be unable to walk.

text: Ang biktima amo si Susan Aytona, 68-anyos, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Susan Aytona, 68, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Faustino Aytona Jaruda, pakaisa sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa Barotac Nuevo, nagdesisyon na lang ang ila pamilya nga dal-on ang biktima sa Lapuz agud nga atipanon kasunod sang insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Faustino Aytona Jaruda, the victim's cousin, said that from Barotac Nuevo, their family decided to take the victim to Lapuz for treatment following the incident.

text: Suno kay Jaruda, mahambal pa man ang biktima apang may ginasuprer nga problema sa paminsaron.
english: According to Jaruda, the victim can still speak but suffers from mental problems.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala siya nakahibalo nga wala sang kaupod ang iya pakaisa sa ila balay kag sang nagpauli siya, abo na lang gid ang iya naabtan.
english: He also said that he did not know that his cousin was not with him at home and when he returned home, he found only ashes.

text: Naglaum man ang natungdan nga nahakwat ang biktima agud nga luwason, apang sa ulihi na lamang nila natukiban nga wala gali ini natandog sa iya hiligdaan.
english: The victim was also hoped to be rescued, but they later discovered that he was not touched in his bed.

text: Indi magnubo sa 15 ka mga balay ang nasunog sa nasambit nga lugar, kon sa diin, tubtob subong padayon pa nga ginaimbestigaran ang insidente agud matumod ang rason sang sunog.
english: At least 15 houses were burned in the area, where the incident is still being investigated to determine the cause of the fire.

text: Naghingyo ang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sa Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga i-exempt sa ginapatuman subong nga election spending ban ang P12 billion nga balor sang Ayuda Para sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP) funds.
english: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) has requested the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to exempt from the current election spending ban the P12 billion worth of Ayuda Para sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP) funds.

text: Ginsugid ini ni Comelec chairperson George Garcia kadungan sang Senate inquiry sa ginaduso nga enhanced guidelines sa kontrobersyal nga AKAP.
english: Comelec chairperson George Garcia said this during the Senate inquiry on the proposed enhanced guidelines for the controversial AKAP.

text: Suno kay Garcia, nabaton niya ang sulat sang DSWD sang Enero 16 nga naga-request sa iya nga ipa-iway na lamang ang P12.663 billion AKAP funds kag indi pag-ilakip sa election ban.
english: Garcia said he received a letter from the DSWD on January 16 requesting him to withhold the P12.663 billion AKAP funds and not include them in the election ban.

text: Ini nga pondo ang magluwas pa gid sa P882 million nga una nga nahatagan sang exemption sang poll body subong man nga bulan.
english: This fund is in addition to the P882 million that was first granted exemption by the poll body this month.

text: Wala pa sang sabat si Garcia sa amo nga request bangud wala pa man sang nahatag ang ahensya nga implementation guidelines kaangot sa AKAP.
english: Garcia has yet to respond to the request as the agency has not yet issued implementation guidelines regarding the AKAP.

text: Magluwas diri, wala man nakahatag ang DSWD sang guidelines para sa 27 ka iban pa nga social programs.
english: Besides, the DSWD has not provided guidelines for 27 other social programs.

text: Una na nga ginpatuman sang Comelec ang ban sa Assistance to Individual in Crisis Situations (AICS) sa election period kag ginaplano nga ilakip man ang pagdumili sa distribution sang AKAP 10 ka adlaw antes ang eleksyon.
english: The Comelec has already implemented a ban on Assistance to Individual in Crisis Situations (AICS) during the election period and plans to include a ban on the distribution of AKAP 10 days before the election.

text: Una nga nga nagpabutyag sang kahangawa ang pila sa miyembro sang Kongreso lakip na si Senator Imee Marcos sa P26-billion funding sa AKAP.
english: Earlier, some members of Congress including Senator Imee Marcos expressed concern over the P26-billion funding to AKAP.

text: Apisar may mga espekulasyon, nagpaguwa man sang statement ang mga lider sa Kamara nga nagapanginwala sa claims nga ginagamit ang AKAP para nga makapangayo sang boto para sa masunod nga eleksyon.
english: Despite the speculations, leaders in the House of Representatives also issued a statement denying claims that AKAP is being used to solicit votes for the next election.

text: Naglab-ot sa 10,000 ka mga protesters ang nagpatigayon sang hublag protesta sa dalan sang Glasgow sa Scotland samtang nagapanawagan sa mga lider sa kalibutan sang madasig nga lihok agud matapna ang climate crisis.
english: Up to 10,000 protesters took to the streets of Glasgow, Scotland, calling on world leaders to act quickly to address the climate crisis.

text: Nagawagayway sang banners, nagapulpog sang drum kag nagasinggitan ang mga demonstrador lakip na ang mga myembro sang trade unions kag faith organizations amo man ang mga aktibista nga nagtipon sa dalan sang host city sang 2021 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP26).
english: Waving banners, beating drums and shouting, demonstrators including members of trade unions and faith organizations as well as activists gathered in the streets of the host city of the 2021 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP26).

text: Suno kay Climate activist Greta Thunberg, “failure” ang COP26 climate summit nga nangin public relations event.
english: Climate activist Greta Thunberg said the COP26 climate summit was a public relations event.

text: Ini bangud pahayag niya, nagapahamot lang ang mga lider pinaagi sa paghatag sang manami nga speech kag pag-announce sang commitments kag targets apang sa likod sini amo ang pag-refuse sa gihapon nga maghimo sang tikang agud matapna ang krisis sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: This is because, he said, leaders are just smelling by giving good speeches and announcing commitments and targets but behind it is still refusing to take steps to stop the crisis around the world.

text: Bisan wala sang dala nga warrant of arrest, mahimo nga arestuhon sang otoridad ang madakpan nga nagabaligya kag nagabakal sang boto.
english: Even without a warrant of arrest, the authorities can arrest those caught selling and buying votes.

text: Sandig ini sa Resolution No.
english: This is based on Resolution No.

text: 11104 nga gin-release sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) nga amo ang nagapasangkad pa sang otoridad sang Committee on “Kontra-Bigay” nga mag-monitor sa vote buying and selling sa 2025 elections.
english: 11104 released by the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) which further expands the authority of the Committee on “Kontra-Bigay” to monitor vote buying and selling in the 2025 elections.

text: Sa idalom sini nga resolution, ginatugutan ang law enforcer nga magpatigayon sang warrantless arrest kun nadakpan sini sa akto nga nahimo ang nasambit nga election offence.
english: Under this resolution, the law enforcer is allowed to conduct a warrantless arrest if he is caught in the act of committing the said election offense.

text: “Any law enforcement officer may, without a warrant, arrest a person when, in his or her presence, the person to be arrested has committed, is actually committing, or is attempting to commit the election offense of vote-buying and vote-selling or act constituting ASR (abuse of state resources),” base sa nakasaad sa resolution.
english: “Any law enforcement officer may, without a warrant, arrest a person when, in his or her presence, the person to be arrested has committed, is actually committing, or is attempting to commit the election offense of vote-buying and vote-selling or act constituting ASR (abuse of state resources),” based on the resolution.

text: Ang arestado nga indibidwal ang dapat nga dal-on sa pinakamalapit nga estasyon sang pulis.
english: The arrested individual is to be transported to the nearest police station.

text: Dapat man itugyan sa kustodiya sang pulis ang mga materyales nga gingamit sa vote buying kag vote selling kaangay sang kuwarta ukon iban pa nga goods of value, sample ballots kag iban pa nga campaign materials.
english: Materials used in vote buying and vote selling such as money or other goods of value, sample ballots and other campaign materials should also be handed over to police custody.

text: Kun basehan ang Omnibus Election Code, ang vote buying amo ang akto kun sa diin ang tawo ang nagahatag nagatanyag, ukon nagapromisa sang kuwarta ukon anuman nga may balor — direkta man ukon indi — para nga mahaylo ang iban nga magboto sa isa ka kandidato ukon sa tuyo man nga magkampanya nga indi pagbotohon ang isa ka kandidato.
english: According to the Omnibus Election Code, vote buying is the act in which a person offers, or promises money or anything of value — directly or indirectly — to persuade others to vote for a candidate or with the intention of campaigning against a candidate.

text: Ang vote selling naman amo ang akto kun sa diin may tawo naga-solicit ukon nagabaton — direkta man ukon indi — sang kuwarta ukon anuman nga expenditure kabaylo sang pagboto para sa kandidato ukon para nga indi pagbotohon ang isa ka tawo.
english: Vote selling is the act of soliciting or receiving — directly or indirectly — money or any expenditure in exchange for voting for a candidate or for not voting for a person.

text: Kapin 100 patay kag masobra 100 naman ang pilason matapos naglupok ang fuel tanker sang ini ang nakabunggo sa isa man ka truck sa Sierra Leon sa Africa.
english: More than 100 people were killed and more than 100 injured after a fuel tanker exploded when it collided with another truck in Sierra Leon, Africa.

text: Gilayon nga nag-awas ang gatong, naglupok kag nag-ibwal ang kalayo.
english: Immediately the fuel leaked, exploded and caught fire.

text: Nasunog ang mga salakyan kag motorsiklo sa dalan sang Freetown.
english: Cars and motorcycles were burned on the streets of Freetown.

text: Nagpasalig naman si President Julius Maada Bio nga himuon sang gobyerno ang tanana gud suportahan ang mga apektado nga pamilya.
english: President Julius Maada Bio assured that the government will do everything to support the affected families.

text: Indi lamang ini una nga aksidente nga natabo sa Africa sa diin involved ang tanker trucks bangud sang 2019, naglupok man ang tanker sa Tanzania nga nagpatay sang 85 ka tawo samtang kapin 50 naman ang patay sa kaangay man nga hitabo sa Democratic Republic of Congo sang 2018.
english: This is not the first accident in Africa involving tanker trucks because in 2019, a tanker exploded in Tanzania killing 85 people while more than 50 were killed in a similar incident in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 2018.

text: Nag-withdraw ang Coordinating Council of Private Educational Associations (COCOPEA) sa National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) agud nga mapabilin ang academic freedom.
english: The Coordinating Council of Private Educational Associations (COCOPEA) withdrew from the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) in order to maintain academic freedom.

text: Napasalig man ang COCOPEA sa pagpadayon sang ila collaborative nga papel sa guwa sang NTF-ELCAC kasunod sang konsultasyon sa tunga sang ila mga katapo sa asosasyon kag sa pagrepaso sang ila mga core advocacies.
english: COCOPEA was also reassured to continue its collaborative role outside the NTF-ELCAC following the consultation among its members in the association and the review of its core advocacies.

text: Suno sa COCOPEA, ang konseho nagapabilin nga malig-on sa iya papel bilang isa ka “independent” nga non-government organization nga nagarepresentar sang interes sang pribado nga sektor sang edukasyon samtang nagatinguha ini sa pagpasanyog kag pag-amlig sang kalidad nga edukasyon sa pungsod.
english: According to COCOPEA, the council remains steadfast in its role as an “independent” non-government organization representing the interests of the private education sector as it seeks to promote and protect quality education in the country.

text: Ang inclusion sang COCOPEA sa NTF-ELCAC gin-anunsyo sang executive director sang task force nga si Undersecretary Ernesto Torres Jr.
english: The inclusion of COCOPEA in the NTF-ELCAC was announced by the task force’s executive director Undersecretary Ernesto Torres Jr.

text: sang Nobyembre 2024.
english: of November 2024.

text:
Una na nga ginpahayag ni Torres nga ginarespeto sang NTF-ELCAC ang desisyon sang COCOPEA nga mag-withdraw sa ila Executive Committee bangud ang tikang nga isa ka “internal matter.”

Ginhatagan man pagtamod ni Torres nga magapadayon sa gihapon ang kolaborasyon sang COCOPEA sa nasambit nga task force.
english:
Earlier, Torres said the NTF-ELCAC respects COCOPEA's decision to withdraw from its Executive Committee because the move is an “internal matter.”

Torres also stressed that COCOPEA will continue to collaborate with the task force.

text: Sa pihak sang pag-atras sang COCOPEA, si Torres nagsiling nga ang NTF-ELCAC nagapabilin nga malig-on sa ila kampanya batok sa violent extremism kag terrorist-grooming, partikular ang pagrekrut sang mga lamharon nga estudyante.
english: Despite COCOPEA’s withdrawal, Torres said the NTF-ELCAC remains steadfast in its campaign against violent extremism and terrorist-grooming, particularly the recruitment of young students.

text: Seryoso nga ginakonsiderar ni Vice President Sara Duterte ang plano sa pagpadalagan bilang presidente sang Pilipinas sa 2028.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte is seriously considering a plan to run for president of the Philippines in 2028.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Sara sang weekend kadungan sang pagtambong sa isa ka pribado nga event sa Panabo, Davao del Norte.
english: Sara said this over the weekend while attending a private event in Panabo, Davao del Norte.

text: Pahayag sini, sang nagkadto siya sa Japan kag nagpakigkita sa overseas Filipino workers (OFWs), ginpamangkot siya kun mapapili siya sa 2028.
english: He said that when he went to Japan and met with overseas Filipino workers (OFWs), he was asked if he would run in 2028.

text: Dugang sini, ginakonsiderar na niya ini bangud indi niya mabatas ang estado sang Pilipinas subong nga nagakinahanglan gid nga himuson kag ireporma para nga mangin world-class.
english: He added that he is considering it because he cannot stand the current state of the Philippines that needs to be reformed to become world-class.

text: “I’m seriously considering running in 2028 presidential elections dahil sa mga nakikita natin sa bayan natin na dapat ayusin, na dapat baguhin,” suno sa bise-presidente.
english: “I’m seriously considering running in 2028 presidential elections because of what we see in our country that needs to be fixed, that needs to be changed,” the vice-president said.

text: “Kailangan maging competitive tayo sa mga kapitbahay natin dito sa ating region at sa buong mundo.
english: “We need to be competitive with our neighbors here in our region and around the world.

text: Napag-iiwanan na ang Pilipinas at ayaw natin ‘yun,” dugang pa ni Sara.
english: The Philippines is being left behind and we don't want that,” Sara added.

text: Ini nga statement sa pagkonsiderar sa pagpadalagan sa pagka-presidente ang natabo bisan nga may pag-us-os sa iya nga trust and satisfaction ratings kag may ginapangatubang pa nga tatlo ka mga impeachment complaint.
english: This statement on considering running for president came despite a decline in his trust and satisfaction ratings and facing three impeachment complaints.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, indi pa pinal suno sa vice president kun ano ang iya plano kag partisipasyon sa 2025 elections.
english: On the other hand, the vice president said his plans and participation in the 2025 elections are not yet final.

text: “Hindi ko alam kung makakatulong o makakasama sa mga kandidato ang pag-endorso ko sa kanila.
english: “I don't know if my endorsement of the candidates will help or harm them.

text: Kaya pinag-iisipan ko ‘yun nang maayos,” pahayag sini.#
english: So I'm thinking about it,” he said.

text: Wala nagpirma sa 2021 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP26) pledge ang India nga untatan ang deforestation kag methane gas emissions sa 2030 bangud sa ginkabalak-an sini nga impact sa trade, farm sector kag epekto sa livestock sa rural economy sang pungsod.
english: India did not sign the 2021 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP26) pledge to end deforestation and methane gas emissions by 2030 due to its concerns about the impact on trade, farm sector and livestock impact on the country’s rural economy.

text: Mandaan nga sang Nobyembre 2, nagpromisa ang mga world leaders sa COP26 global climate conference sa Glasgow, Scotland nga untatan na ang deforestation kag methane gas emissions agud nga makabulig sa paghagan-hagan sang climate change.
english: Mandaan said on November 2, world leaders pledged at the COP26 global climate conference in Glasgow, Scotland to stop deforestation and methane gas emissions to help mitigate climate change.

text: Sa $2.7 trillion ukon P136 trillion nga ekonomiya sang India, 15% sini ang halin sa agrikultura samtang tunga sang masobra 1.3 billion ka tawo naman ang nagatrabaho sa nasambit nga sektor.
english: Of India's $2.7 trillion or P136 trillion economy, 15% of it comes from agriculture while half of more than 1.3 billion people work in the sector.

text: Gani dako nga pagpanghangkat para sa nasambit nga pungsod nga buhinan ang methane emissions nga gina-generate sang digestive systems kag higko sang baka.
english: It is therefore a big challenge for the country to reduce methane emissions generated by digestive systems and cow dung.

text: Magluwas sa India, ang China kag Russia ang wala man nagpirma sa pledge nga nagapanawagan sang efforts sa pagbuhin sang emissions sang methane sang 30% sa 2030.
english: Apart from India, China and Russia also did not sign the pledge calling for efforts to reduce methane emissions by 30% by 2030.

text: 25 ang kumpirmado nga patay kag masobra 50 ang pilason sa pagpang-atake sa military hospital sa Kabul, ang kapital sang pungsod Afghanistan.
english: 25 people have been confirmed dead and more than 50 wounded in an attack on a military hospital in Kabul, Afghanistan's capital.

text: Natabo ang duha ka magkasunod nga explosion sa entrance sang 400-bed hospital sa 10th district sang Kabul.
english: Two consecutive explosions occurred at the entrance of a 400-bed hospital in Kabul's 10th district.

text: Ginapahayag 30 minutos ang gap antes natabo ang ikaduha nga paglupok.
english: There was reportedly a 30-minute gap before the second explosion occurred.

text: Suno sa pahayag sang Taliban official, suicide bomber kag gunmen ang yara sa likod sang pagpang-atake.
english: According to the Taliban official, suicide bombers and gunmen were behind the attack.

text: Wala pa sang nag-ako kun sin-o ang responsable sa atake.
english: No one has claimed responsibility for the attack.

text: Kumpirmado man nga lakip sa nagkalamatay ang tanan nga attackers.
english: It was also confirmed that all the attackers were among the dead.

text: Bawat gising is a blessing!
english: Every waking moment is a blessing!

text: Apang para sa magkahagugma nga taga-Brgy.
english: But for the loving residents of Brgy.

text: Bega, San Carlos City, Pangasinan, ang ila pinakadaku nga blessing subong nga tuig amo ang ila triplets nga sanday Althea, Altheo, kag Athena.
english: Bega, San Carlos City, Pangasinan, their biggest blessing this year is their triplets Althea, Altheo, and Athena.

text: Nangin daku nga iwag sa puluy-an ang pag-abot sang tatlo ka kabataan bisan nga masobra pa lang isa ka tuig nga nag-updanay ang ila Mama kag Papa.
english: The arrival of three children was a great light in the home even though their mother and father had been together for more than a year.

text: Ang parents amo sanday Romulo Perez, 61 kag Cecilia Macam, 41.
english: The parents are Romulo Perez, 61 and Cecilia Macam, 41.

text: Pareho na sila nga balo sang nagkilalahay sila kag nahulog ang buot sa isa kag isa.
english: They were both widowed when they met and fell in love with each other.

text: Si Romulo ang may pito na ka anak sa iya una nga asawa samtang may anum naman ka kabataan si Cecilia sa iya una nga bana.
english: Romulo has seven children with his first wife while Cecilia has six children with her first husband.

text: Sa pag-abot nanday Althea, Altheo, kag Athena sa ila kabuhi, 16 na subong ang ila mga anak kun ila nga tingubon.
english: With the arrival of Althea, Altheo, and Athena in their lives, they now have 16 children together.

text: Isa sa mga pagpanghangkat para sa duha amo nga kulang ang ila income para sa triplets bangud pareho lamang sila nga nagahimo sang basket nga human sa kawayan.
english: One of the challenges for the two is that they do not have enough income for the triplets as both of them only make bamboo baskets.

text: Ang ila wish amo nga mapadaku ang triplets nga healthy, mabuot, kag labaw sa tanan, may kahadlok kag pagpalangga sa Ginuo.
english: Their wish is to raise the triplets healthy, kind, and above all, with the fear and love of the Lord.

text: Luyag mo bala nga mangin firm kag smooth ang imo nga panit nga wala mo ginagamitan sang cream ukon gina-imnan sang mga bulong?
english: Do you want your skin to be firm and smooth without using cream or taking medicines?

text: Magkaon ka lang sang langka!
english: Just eat jackfruit!

text:
Panigurado nga maproteheran sini ang imo nga panit gikan sa sun damage bangud may yara ini sang mataas nga amount sang vitamin C.

Suno kay Rujuta Diweka , isa ka celebrity nutritionist, magluwas sa pampanami sang imo nga supat, may yara man ini sang natural chemical nga makabulig likaw sa ulcer.
english:
It will surely protect your skin from sun damage because it contains a high amount of vitamin C.

According to Rujuta Diweka , a celebrity nutritionist, besides making your supat taste better, it also contains a natural chemical that can help prevent ulcers.

text: Ang langka ang good source man sang fiber .
english: Langka is also a good source of fiber.

text: Pahayag sang eksperto, kun magkaon ikaw sang langka, mahinay kag amat-amat lang sini nga ginadigest sang imo nga lawas rason nga indi madasig ang pagsaka sang imo nga blood sugar.
english: According to experts, if you eat langka, it is digested slowly and gradually by your body, which is why your blood sugar does not rise quickly.

text: Gani kadam-an sa mga nagakaon sang langka amo ang mga tawo nga may diabetes.
english: So most of the people who eat jackfruit are diabetic people.

text: Makabulig man ini panubo sang blood pressure nga mahimo magtuga sang heart disease, stroke kag bone loss.
english: It can also help lower blood pressure which can lead to heart disease, stroke and bone loss.

text: Nagpaguwa ang korte sa Manila sang precautionary hold departure order (PHDO) batok kay Senator Jinggoy Estrada kag sa iban pa nga akusado sang plunder bangud sang ginaalegar nga involvement sa flood control corruption.
english: A court in Manila issued a precautionary hold departure order (PHDO) against Senator Jinggoy Estrada and other plunder accused for alleged involvement in flood control corruption.

text: Ang iban pa nga sakop sini nga order sang Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 52 amo sanday former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Manuel Bonoan, former DPWH undersecretaries Maria Catalina Cabral kag Roberto Bernardo, former DPWH regional director Gerard Opulencia, kag former district engineer Henry Alcantara.
english: Other subjects of this order of the Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 52 are former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Manuel Bonoan, former DPWH undersecretaries Maria Catalina Cabral and Roberto Bernardo, former DPWH regional director Gerard Opul and former engineer Henry Altarancia.

text: Suno sa korte, posible nga mag-guwa ang mga respondent sa Pilipinas agud nga malikawan ang pag-aresto sa ila kag pag-atubang sa kaso.
english: According to the court, it is possible for the respondents to leave the Philippines to avoid arrest and prosecution.

text: Paagi sini nga order, may awtoridad na ang Bureau of Immigration and Deportation nga punggan ang nasambit nga mga indibidwal kun maggwa sa pungsod.
english: Through this order, the Bureau of Immigration and Deportation now has the authority to stop these individuals from leaving the country.

text: Ginklaro ni Justice spokesperson Polo Martinez nga wala ini nagakahulugan nga naresolba na ukon may desisyon na sa pending nga kaso nga plunder sa Department of Justice (DOJ).
english: Justice spokesperson Polo Martinez clarified that this does not mean that the pending plunder case in the Department of Justice (DOJ) has been resolved or decided.

text: “Precautionary” ang termino suno kay Martinez nga buot silingon, antes pa man pormal nga mapasaka ang kaso sa korte, may gin-isyu na nga order ang judge bilang antisipasyon pananglitan malagyo ang respondents.
english: Martinez said the term is “precautionary” which means that before the case is formally filed in court, the judge has already issued an order in anticipation of the respondents fleeing.

text: Nagpasa naman sang iya nga counter-affidavit si Bonoan kag naglisensya sa DOJ kaangot sa iya plano nga magkadto anay sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Bonoan submitted his counter-affidavit and obtained a license from the DOJ regarding his plan to go to the United States of America.
